phal po che/ spyotānywa (38)0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdol/ 3bzhi bcu lnga pa/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u/(smad) 3nor bzangs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig tu bstan pa/ 762rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(801) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(960)

ri sna ri sa ri ngasdu dusaX/ sa swā rā starnyes / rdo sha shā 4 lta sna / (shā ne tre mu chordo ci dī tsho 7 rte4 ༷ po pā ྅nyi geg tswamo tsho 18 — dir 4ri ci cho snye bci ci ci— ༷ ci rngu/ ci cho sta —ca ci can kyil ci tsha sa la /ri — ci — — — —————— ga sdu ri / — — — — — —hārdo — mi / 4 54 gu hūṃ rwa 4ci la tre ri khu phyi ci ri shā pa ci ga sa jing sprag rnal —— — —— — byu — ——4 ci cho kho /rgyal ba'i gsung rab yid bzhin nor/ /'dren mdzad lo chen rnam snang srung / /

jug /sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/1ci༄༅gi / sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/bam po dang pori )/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs ridage slong blta na sdug pa de'i la gdams ngag rjes su slos shing raspel ba dang / bsdud 6pa dang rab tu dbye ba dang / bshad pa dang / so sor rnam par bsgom 7pa dang brjod pa dang / yang dag par bstan pa dang / rjes su bsam pa dang /mngon par 'jug par bya ba dang / bkur ba dang khong du chud par bya ba dang /yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba dang / yang dang yang bslas napa dang / shin tu rtogs par bya ba dang / rab tu bstan pa dang / snang bar bya ba dang /rjes su rnam par lta ba dang 9/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za'i 'khor dang bcas pa de mthar gyis yul dge sbyong gi dkyil 'khor gyi grong khyer sgo bzang po gang na ba der phyin te/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug yongs su tshol 38—3

tshol ba las de'i steng gi bar snang las lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za rnams kyis bos pa/ rigs kyi bu khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug ni/ chu klung gi chu 'dus pa07nye ba zhig na/ byis pa stong phrag bcu tsam gyis bskor te/bye ma la rtse gebs rtse zhing 'dug go zhes minas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs grong khyer sgo bzang po dang / nye ba'i chu klung gi chu 'dus gang na ba der dong ④ste phyin pa dang / des glunikhye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug byis pa stong phrag bcu tsamanyegyis bskor cing bye ma la rtse 3rabs rtse ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug gang 3rin ba der song ste/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug gi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug gi mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med 1)pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ji ciltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan tu bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na(1/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ smras pa rigs kyi bu kho bo ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas yi ge dang / grangs dang / brda hunyedang / rtsis kyi tshul bslabs te/bzo thams cad mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ye shes kyi sgor bcugacago / /de ltar rigs kyi bu kho bos 8ni 'jig rten na yi ge dang / mying gi rnam 38—4

pa dang / grangs dang / rtsis dang / brdashedang / shod7thabs shes par bya ba dang / bzosasna tshogs shes par bya ba dang / khams kyi cho ga dang /dug gso ba'i thabs dang / skem pa dang / brjed byed dang / 'byung po'i gdon gyis btab pa gso ba dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / tshong dusakyidang ske/ bza' shing gi ra ba dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal dang / gnas rnam par dgod pa shes par bya ba dang / ra ba dang / khang pa dang / skar khung dang / khang pa brtsegs pa'i tshad shes par bya ba dang / 'khrul 'khor dang ske/ shing rta sbyar ba'i〈tshul sna tshogs shes par bya ba dang / dge mi dge dang ske/ 'jigs mi 'jigs kyi ltasasnyedang / mtshan ma shes par bya ba dang /rmos dang / tshong dang / rnam par spyad pa7sbyar ba'i cho ga shes par bya ba dang / sems can gyi yan lag dang / nying lag gi mtshan gyi rgyud dang /rgyus dang / rnam par dpyad tunyepa shes par bya ba dang / bde 'gro dang ngan song gi las kyiphanyelam rnam par dag par bya ba'i tshul shes par bya ba dang / dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos dang / tshogs mchod pa shes par bya ba dang / bde 'gro dang ngan song gi tshogs shes par bya ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i tshogs shes par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i tshogs shes par bya ba dang / rgyu dang byed pa dang / sbyor ba'i rgyud shes par bya ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad shes te/ de dag la sems can yongs su gzud pa7byed do/ /rab tu dgod pasabyed do/ /yongs su gzhog pa7byed do/ /slob tu 'dzud do/ /sbyong du 'dzud do/ /brtan par byed do/ /lhur len par byed do/ /rdzogs par byed do/ /yongs su sgrub par byed do/ /38—5

yongs su spyod par byed do/ /gsal bar bstan par7byed do/ /rnam par 'phel bar byed do/ /mtshan mar byed do/ /mthar phyin par byed do/ /rnam par sbyong bar byed do/ /dri ma med par byed do/ /shin tu dag par byed do/ /'od gsal zhing dang ri bar byed do/ /shin tu yangs par byed do/ /de ltar rigs kyi bu kho bos ri byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtsis kyi ④tsal shes pa de gang zhe na/ brgya stong phrag brgya na bye ba'o/ /bye ba bye ba na khod khod do/ /khod khod khod khod na thamachedagu'o/ / tha dgu thachu)dgu na khrig khrig go/ /khrig khrig khrig khrig na thams thams jo9 thams thams thams thams na myad myid do / /myad myid myad myid 3)na gang ya'o/ /gang ya gang ya na ban bun no/ /ban bun ban bun na phyar phyur ro/ /phyar phyur phyar phyur na lcag lcig go/ /lcag lcig lcag rtsig na byang bying ngo / /byang bying byang bying na chem chem mo chem chem chem chem na phyal phyol lo/ /phyal phyol phyal phyol na khyud khyud do/ /khyud khyud khyud khyud na zar zer ro/ /zar zer zar zer na khrib khrib po/ /khrib khrib khrib khrib na ya gangs so/ /ya gangs ya gangs na cho ma'o/ /cho ma cho ma na khram khrim mo / /khram khrim khram khrim na nab nub bo/ /nab nub nab nub na sang sang ngo / /sang sang sang sang na brgyud yas so/ /brgyud yas brgyud yas na btang yas so//btang yas btang yas na bkra yar ro/ /bkra yar bkra yar na gsa'aspyodayas so / gsa' yas gsa' sna )yas na mtshungs med do/ /mtshungs med mtshungs med na lam lum mo/ /lam lum lam lum na yal yol lo/ /yal yol yal yol na khral〈 rjekhrul lo/ / khral khrul khral52khrul na thud thud do/ /thud thud thud thud na bsam phyod lhanyedo/ /bsam phyod mibasam phyod na brang breng7ngo / /brang breng brang brengs38—6

na bgrod yas so/ /bgrod yas bgrod yas na bsngo yas so/ /bsngo yas bsngo yas na zang yag go/ /zang yag zang yag na 'phro bkye'o①/ /'phro bkye 'phro bkye na rtse 'phyo'o/ /rtse 'phyo rtse 'phyo na yong tan no/ /yong tan yong tan na brug g.yos so/ /brug g.yos brug g.yos na sang yal lo sang yal sang yal na 'thing yug go/ /'jing yug 'thing yug na yid 'phyo'o/ /yid 'phyo yid 'phyo na nab deb bo/ /nab deb nab deb na khrig thams so/ /khrig thams khrig thams na yal yal7lo/ /yal yal yal yalakhun bgrang yas so/ /bgrang yas bgrang yas na thug yal lo/ /thug yal thug yalaphun shang shang ngo / /shang shang shang shang na yag yag go/ /yag yag yag yag na thamasathim mo thamal)thim tham thim na rlom bsnyal7lo/ /rlom bsnyal rlom bsnyalashen gzhal 'phyos so/ /gzhal 'phyosatshwa) gzhal 'phyos na gzhal yal lo/ /gzhal yal gzhal yal na gzhal med do/ /gzhal med gzhal med na gzhal 'khor to/ /gzhal 'khor gzhal 'khor na gzhal thim mo/ /gzhal thim gzhal thim na gar gzhal lo/ /gar gzhal gar gzhal na gzhal sangs so/ /gzhal sangs gzhal sangs na gzhal thag go/ /gzhal thag gzhal thag na gzhal phul lo/ /gzhal phul gzhal phul na gzhal zhi'o/ /gzhal zhi gzhal zhi na 'phyo 'gyur ro/ /'phyo 'gyur 'phyo 'gyur na nyar nyer ro/ /nyar nyer nyar nyer na phyag phyig go/ /phyag phyig phyag phyig na zal zul lo/ /zal zul zal zul na sal sal lo sal sal sal sal na g.yo ldeg 37go/ /g.yo ldeg g.yo ldeg na phan phun no/ /phan phun phan phun na brnang ya'o/ /brnang ya brnang ya na rem 'drol lo/ /rim 'drol rem 'drol na rdzi ngad do/ /rdzi ngad rdzi ngad na rdzi rdul lo / /rdzi rdul rdzi rdul na phun yol nyunye38—7

lo / /phun yol phun yol 6)na ngad ngad do/ /ngad ngad ngad ngad na bgrang brtsi'o / /bgrang brtsi bgrang brtsi min zab bgrangasango / /zab bgrang zab bgrang ④na dga' rkyangangagengo / /dga' rkyang dga' rkyangakun gzhung 'dal tog/ /gzhung 'dal gzhung 'dal na khrug phyad ⑧do/ /khrug phyad khrug phyadashen 'ol phyod do / /'ol phyod 'ol phyod na gdab yas so/ /gdab yas gdab yas na gcal yas so/ /gcal yas gcal yas na bgrang yas so/ /bgrang yas bgrang yas na byim 'phyo'o3 )/ /byim 'phyo byim 'phyo na yam me'o yam me yam me〈nyen bsnyal yas so/ /bsnyal yas bsnyal yas na〈geldab ldeb bo/ /ldab ldeb ldab ldeb na 'phan 32chad do/ / 'phan chad 'phan7chad na phang phung ngo / /phang phung phang phung min khe'u tshang ngo / /khe'u tshang khe'u tshang7na zhung zung ngo / /zhung zung zhung zung na 1 tshomachog yal lo/ /mchog yal mchog yal na mtha' rtul to3nye/ /mtha' rtul mtha' rtul na yun tsho/'gyangs tho ) / /yun 'gyangs yun 'gyangs na bun lob bo/ /bun lob bun lob na zhuskyulam lom mo/ /lam lom lam lom na5)bsnyad yas so/ /bsnyad yas bsnyad yas na lang ling ngo lang ling lang ling na ljab ljib bo/ /ljab ljib ljab ljib na myi brtsal to/ /myi brtsal myi brtsal na 'byam 2 yas so/ / 'byam yas 'byama'ageyas na snyeng 'grang ngo / /nga 'grang nga 'grang na smos yal 'otsho/ /smos yal smos yal na bkram 7chal lo/ / bkra chal bkra 2 chal na lo rgyas so/ /lo rgyas lo rgyas na 'bumadza )rdib bo/ / 'bum rdib 'bums rtsordib na gangasamegum mo/ / gang gum gang5nyegum na la lo'o/ /la lo la lo na bgrang 'phyos so/ /bgrang 'phyos bgrang 'phyos na bgrang 'phyos la bsgres pa'o / /bgrang ri —nye'aphyos la bsgres pa bgrang 'phyos5nyel bsgres namanyedapag yas so/ /38—8

dpag yas dpag yas natudapag yas la bsgres pa'o/ /dpag yas la bsgres pa dpag yas la bsgres ②na yal phyod do/ /yal phyod yal phyod na yal ③phyod la bsgres pa'o/ /yal phyod la bsgres pa yal phyod la bsgres na mu yal to⑤/ /mu yal mu yal na mu yal la bsgres pa'o/ /mu yal7la bsgres pa mu yal la bsgres na bgrang yol 'okho/ /bgrang yol bgrang yol na bgrang yol la bsgres pa'o/ /bgrang yol la bsgres ⑨pa bgrang yol la bsgres na myi mjal7to/ /myi mjal myi mjal (nyan mi mjal (nyel bsgres pa'o/ /mi mjal (nyel bsgres pa myi mjal yil bsgres yin bsam phyod do/ /bsam phyod bsam phyod na bsam phyod la bsgres pa'o / /bsam phyod la bsgres pa bsam phyod la bsgres ⑩na mtha' 'byam yonye/ /mtha' 'byam mtha' 'byam 9/nyen dpag thag go/ /dpag thag dpag thag na dpag thag la bsgres pa'o/ /dpag thag la bsgres pa dpag thag la bsgres na brjod du myed pa'o/ /brjod du med pa brjod du myed pa na brjod du med pa la bsgres pa'o/ /brjod du med pa la bsgres pa brjod du med pa la bsgres5)na brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du du med pa la bsgres pa shin tu bstan pa'o/ /de'i mdun na bye ma'i phung po chen po dpag tshad du ma'i〈 mtshad dang ldan pa zhig 'dug 'dug pa las/ 'di la bye ma'i 'bru 'di snyed cig yod do zhes bya ba nas / bye ma'i 'bru brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa la bsgres pa la (rte'adi snyed cig5nyeyod do zhes rab tu phye nas bgrang brtsis te〈nyegrangs su bcad do//des bye5nyema'i phung po de brtsisasngo nyakyi brdar bstan pas6)/ shin tu bstan nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bgrang ba'i tshul 'di ni 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa kun na'ang 38—9

yod de①/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bgrang ba'i tshul 'dis shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa dag kyang bgrang zhing rtsi'o②/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang7shar gyi phyogs 'tshams 3)dang / shar lho'i phyogs 'tshams7dang / lho nub kyi phyogs 'tshams rtso)dang / nub byang gi phyogs 'tshams ⑧dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs su yang 49)byang chub sems dpa' rnams bgrang ba'i tshul 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam hu klas pa dag kyang bgrang zhing rtsi'o(te/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bgrang ba'i tshul 'di ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mying du bya ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa thams cad na'ang yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bgrang ba'i tshul 'dis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bgrang zhing rtsi'o/2la/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mying gcig nas〈nyegacig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i bskal pa'i mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig nasalgegacig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa dang / chos kyi mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa dang 8/ sems can gyi mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa dang 8/ las kyi mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan du yod pa kun la'ang 'jug ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi〈rtebagrang ba'i tshul 'di nyid ni/ phyogs bcu nyushen mying du bya ba gcig nas〈cagacig tu brgyud pa bstan du rung ba ji snyed pa thams cad la'ang 'jug ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bgrang ba'i tshul 'dis phyogs bcu na mying gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 38—10

pa ji snyed7yod pa thams cad kyang bgrang zhing rtsi'o②/ /de ltar rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes snang bsrechos thams cad shes par bya ba'i bzo mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad kyi grangs la zhugs pa/ chos kyi tshul thams cad kyi grangs la zhugs pa/ dus gsum gyi grangs la zhugs pa/ sems can thams cad kyi grangs la zhugs pa/ chos kyi phung po thams cad kyi grangs la zhugs pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi grangs la zhugs pa/ chos thams cad kyi ming gi 'khor lo la dbang bsgyurasnyib de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/yon tan brjod pa'am/ spyod yul smos pa'am/ yul brjod pa'am/ stobs bsngags pa'am/ bsam pa brtan7pa'am/ tshogs yongs su brjod pa'am/smon lam bshad par bya ba'am/ spyod pa yongs su bstan7pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa mngon par brjod pa'am/ yang dag par bsgrub pa ⑧yongs su dag pa'amanya/ yang dag par bstan pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par smos pa'am/ ye shes snang ba khong du chud par nus re skan/ song5) rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer rgya mtsho brtan 17pa zhes bya ba yod de1ge / de na dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba zhes bya ba 'dug gis(nye/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 8byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshig thos nas spu g.yos te/ dga' ba chen po'i shugs skyes nas/ rab tu dga' ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur pa ngo mtshar gyi7bsam pa/ rin po che tsharab tu dkon pa thob pa/ 'gro ba mang po la 38—11

phan pa'i sems dang bsam pas byung ba sangs rgyas skyes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par 'gro ba la dbang bsgyuratub/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i blo gros la rten pa/ thams cad du rjes su song ba'i rig pa〈rnam par phye bas 'byung〈kyeb bstan pa la brtson pa/ dus gsum gyi dbyings su ma 'dres pa'i0sangs rgyas kyi yul dang ldan pa/ bsod nams mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho las byung ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi snang ba chen po la sridabang bsgyur dub/khams gsum gyi khyim du sdud pa'i sgo shin tu gcod pa des/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug gi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltasashete/ khye'u dbang po'i dbang phyug gi drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshesalgeganyen gyi gdams ngag gi sprin gyi char yongs su 'dzin pa byed cing / gang ⑩ chen mtsho ltar sprin chen po'i char gyis ngoms myi shes pa 3skyedage ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nyi ma'i ye shes kyi 'od gzer ⑫gyis dge〈nyeb yongs su smin par byas pa'i 8sa gzhi las dbang po'i myu gu 'thon cing skyes pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zla ba nya zhing rgyas pa'i gdams ngag gi 'od gzer gyi dra bas lus dang / sems shin tu tshim par byas pa/ dpyid7 kyi nyi ma'i 'od kyis gdungs pa'i ri dgas hu)kyi tshogs gsal zhing bsil ba'i gangs chu nyushel 'thung bar 'dod pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gi chu 37la 'thung bar 'dod pa/ bung ba mang po 'khor zhing lding bas rgyas par gyur pa'i pad mo shu byedang ldan pa'i5 nyapad+mo'i mtsho ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gis sems kyi me tog bun da ()ri ka kha phye rdunyeb/ rin po che sna 38—12

tshogs kyis yongs su rgyas7pa'i rin po che'i gling ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag rin po che 'phel ②ba'i snang bas sems shin tu snang bar byas pa/'dzam bu'i shing7chen po'i me tog dang / 'bras bu'i tshogs chen po dang ldan pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs su gyur pa/ phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ klu'i dbang po chen po rtsed mo dam pas rtse ba las byung ba'i nam mkha'i sprin chen po ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag thos pa'i tshogs su gyur pa'i rnang geshin tu che ba/sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i 'jig rten gyi brgyan pa'i〈sna tshogs kyi spo ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag las byung ba'i chos dri ma myed pa〈sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i spor gyur pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i7 tshogs kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i brgya byin lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i tshogs rab tu 'jomasalgepa ltarachadage ba'i bshes5nyeganyen gyi gdams ngag las byung ba'i yon tan dri ma myed pa'i tshogs kyis7yongs su bskor cing zil gyis myi gnon tsol gzhan la zil gyis gnon pa de/ mthar gyis grong khyer rgya mtsho brtan7pa gang na ba der phyin te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba yongs su tshol tshol ba las de la skye bo mang pos bstan7te/ rigs kyi bu dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba de7)grong khyer gyi dbus kyi rang gi khyim na 'dug go zhes nas( kye / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i gnas gang namanyeb der song ste/ thal mo sbyar nas sgo gang rten sdod sdod pa dang /des dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i khyim de shin tu rgya che la yangs shing rin po che'i ra (nyebs yongs su bskor ba du hephyogs bzhi nas sgo (nyeshin tu mdzes pa rnam par phye ba/ rin po che tshad myed grangs myed pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ bsod 38—13

nams kyi rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa mthong nas/ de khyim der song ste / kun tu bltas na nyabyedage bsnyen ma phul du byung ba na chungasheshin tu gzhon pasathog ma dar la bab pa/ gzugs mngon zhing mdzes la〈pebalta na sdug pa kha dog dam pa/ pris 5)ya ba shin tu rgyas pa dang ldan pa/ skra phye mar bzhag⑧pa/ lus la rgyan myed pa/ gos dang smad g.yogs dkar po bgos pa/ rin po che'i khri la 'dug pa mthong (7ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par de'i lus sam/ sems kyi dbang ngam/ gzi brjid dngasnyi/ kha dog gis zil gyis ma non pa'i sems can ni khyim de na gang yang myed de/ lha'am mi'ang rung ste/ sems can gang gis dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba mthong bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang / dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la ston pa'i 'du shes su bsam pa zhig /rin po che'i khri la 'dug pa mthong ngo / /gzhan yang khyim de na (stan lha rdzas dang / myi'i rdzas las shin tu 'phags pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i las kyi 1 rnam par smin pas yongs su grub pa bye ba stong phrag bcu bting ba dang nyu1/ mdun du phru ba gcig cig bzhag pa las kha zas dang skom gyi bag gamanyu2/ gos dang rgyan gyi longs spyod kyi bag gzhan ci yang hu)myi snang ngo / /bud myed stong phrag bcu tsam zhig mdun du bo'adug par mthong na'ang 8de dag thams cad kyang lha'i bu mo'i kha dog dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu mo'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu mo'i tshul dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu mo'i spyod pa dang ldan pa/tshotsholha'i bu mo'i longs spyod dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu mo'i tshul du shis 7pa dang ldan pa/lha rdzas kyi gos yid bzhin du gyon pa/ lha rdzas kyi lhab lhub kyis shin tu klubs pa/lha'i bu mo'i skad lta bu'i dbyangs snyan 1 pa dang ldan pa hunyelha'i bu mo'i chu zheng 38—14

mdzes pa dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de'i 'khor gyi bud myed kyang des ci bsgo ba bzhin du byed cing mdun natu'akhod do/ /rim gro7byed do/ /bkur ste byed do / /gdong du lta'og/ /ci bsgo ba nyan cing gnas so/ /rje sar 'khod do/ /yongs su lta'o④/ /rnam par lta'o/ /'dudakyido/ /rab tu 'dud7do/ /phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gi ⑦lus las spos kyi ngad ldang bas ni/ grong khyer de'i 'khor thams cad du dri zhim pos khyab par 'dug ste/ sems can gang gis dri de tshor bar gyur pa ⑧de dag thams cad kyang gnod sems myed pa'i sems dang ske/ shar gnyer bsnyeskyed pa'i sems dang / 'tshe ba myed pa'i sems dang /phrag dog dang / 'jungs pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / sgyu dang g.yo myed pa'i sems dang / chags pa dang / khong khro ba myed pa'i sems dang / zhum pa dang / gzengasarwaskrematho ba myed pa'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang /phan pa'i sems dang / sdom pa la gnas pa'i sems dang / gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba la re ba myed5nyepa'i sems su gyur te/ gang gis de dag gi skad thos pa de dag thams cad kyang dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / dul ba'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis de dag mthong bar gyur pa de dag kyang /'dod chags dang bral ba tsam du rang rang gis shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mthong nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisatshwanyedage bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems 38—15

dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag 1)dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na②/'phags ma ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan nu/tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol / smras pa rigs kyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/bsod nams kyi mdzod myi zad pa'i rgyan ces bya ba thob pasnyiste/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ni phru ba gcig po 'di las mos pa sna tshogs can rnams kha zas ci la dga' ba bzhin du tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dogasnyisna tshogs dang /dri sna tshogs kyis tshim par byed de/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni phru ba gcig po 'di las ci la ༄6)dga' ba'i kha zas kyis sems can brgya'ang yongs su tshim par byed do/ /sems can stong dang sems can brgya phragashestong dang / sems can bye ba dang / sems can bye ba phrag brgya dang / sems can bye ba phrag stong dang ske/ sems can bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / sems can bye ba khragashekhrig brgya phrag stong nas/ sems can brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa mos pa sna tshogs can rnams kyang ci la dga' ba'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim7par byed do//yongs su stobs nyu ripar byed do/ /yongs su dga' bar byed do/ /yongs su mgu bar byed do/ /yongs su spro bar byed do/ /shin tu tshim par byed do/ /yide bde bar byed do/ /'on kyang phru 11ba 'di las 'gong bar hurte'agyur ba med do/ /'gri ba nyi myed de 34dma' bar myi 'gyur ro/ /zad par myi 'gyur ro/ /'brisnyibar myi 'gyur ro/ /sa mtshams yod 7par myi 'gyur ro/ /mthar thug par myi 38—16

'gyur ro/ /mur thug par myi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gzhung de dang 'dra bar sems can 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / de bzhin du gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi nyustong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas sems can mos pa sna tshogs can sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig 'ongs kyang / ci la dga' ba'i kha zas tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang /② dri sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /yongs su dga' bar byed do/ /nyams bde bar byed do/ /shin tu tshim par byed do/ /yid shin tu bde bar byed do/ /'on kyang phru ⑧ba 'di las 'gong bar5ge'agyur ba myed do⑤/ /'grib pa myed do/ /dma' bar myi 'gyur ro//zad par myi 'gyur ro/ /sa mtshams yod par myi 'gyur ro/ /mthar thug par myi 'gyur ro/ /mur thug par myi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can mos pa sna tshogs can dang / bsam pa sna tshogs can thams cad 'ongs par ñca)gyur na yang /de dag thams cad ci la dga' ba'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed pa nas/yid bde bar bya ba'i tsobar du byed do/ /kha zas sna tshogs kyis ji lta ba de bzhin du btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang ⑧/ ro rnam du'o)pa sna tshogs dang / stan sna tshogs dang / mal cha sna tshogs dang / bzhon pa sna tshogs dang / gos sna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs dang hu )/ phrengs31 ba sna tshogs dang / spos sna 38—17

tshogs dang / bdug spos sna tshogs dang / byug pa sna tshogs dang / phye ma sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i shing rta sna tshogs dang / gdugs sna tshogs dang / rgyal mtshan sna tshogs dang /lha'i ba dan sna tshogs dang / yo byad kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byed pa nas/ yid dga' bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas0)sku'i tha ma 'dzin pa gang ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas las gsol cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi 'bras bu brnyes ②par mdzad do/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye bsnyebargya phrag stong dang /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi ④ khams 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tshotu phra ba snyed nas/ de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas sku'i tha ma 'dzin pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de 38—18

dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas las gsol cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu brnyes7par mdzad do/ /shar phyogs na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs na ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na sku ②ma gcig gis nithogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas lasalgegasol cing / snying po byang chub tu bzhugasasnyenas bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad de⑥/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o⑦/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang /'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya dang /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba ⑧brgya phrag ⑨stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed 38—19

pa'i yang brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas las hugasol zhingasngo snying po byang chub la bzhugs nas la/ bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par mdzad sto/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shar phyogs na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og gi phyogs dang /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na/ byang chub sems dpa'ashesku tshe gcig gis thogs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas las gsol cing snying po byang chub tu bzhugs te/ bdud sde dang bcas pa rab tu pham par mdzad nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na bzhugs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong dang /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khamasasgyu'adzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stongasregi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra 38—20

ba snyed dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ rigs kyi bu steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed na/byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i kha zas las gsol cing / snying po byang chub tu bzhugs nasatubadud sde dang bcas padza pham par mdzad de/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis kho mo'i 'khor bud myed stong phrag bcu po 'di dag mthong ngam/ smras pa 'phags ma bdag gis mthong ngo / /smras pa rigs kyi bu bud myed 'di dag la stsogasalgepa brgya stong grangs myed pa phrag bcu kho mo dang skal bsemanyam par spyod pa/ smon lam gcig pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig pa/ 'byung ba'i rgyan gcig pa/ mos pa'i lam rnam par dag pa gcig pa/ kho mo dang skal ba mnyam par dran pa rnam par dag pa/ skal ba mnyam par blo rnam par dag pa/ skal ba mnyam par blo tshad myed par gyur pa/ skal ba mnyam par dbang po rab tu thob pa/ skal ba mnyam par sems kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa/ skal ba mnyam par spyod yul kyisnyiyul dang ldan pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi tshul la zhugs pa/ skal ba mnyam par don nges par rtogs pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi don ston pa/skal ba mnyam par gzugs yirnam par dag pa/ skal ba mnyam par stobs tshad med pa/ skal ba mnyam par brtan pa gzhan gyis myi thub pa/ skal ba mnyam par chos kyi sgra sgrogashepa/ skal ba mnyam par dbyangs rnam par dag pa/ tshad myed pa'i yon tan brjod du yod 42)pas rnam par spyod pa thams cad la skal ba 38—21

mnyam par yon tan rnam par dag pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la kha na ma tho ba myed cing rnam par dag pas/ skal ba mnyam par las kyi rnam par smin pa rnam par dag pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pas①/ skal ba mnyam par byams pa chen pos rgyas par 'gengs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par byed pas/ myi skyo ba'i phyir skal ba mnyam par snying rje chen pos rgyas par 'gengs pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa'i lus yongs su ston pas/ skal ba mnyam par lus kyi lasasnyernam par dag pa / chos kyi dbyings kyi nges pa'i tshig gisatha snyad la skal ba mnyam par ngag gi las rnam par dag pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du skal ba mnyam par 'dod pa/ sangs rgyas ④la mchod cing rim gro zhubya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skal ba mnyam par rgyu ba/ chos thams cad kyi tshul khong du chud par bya ba la skal ba mnyam par mngon sum7du gyur pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad thob par bya ba la skal ba mnyam par spyod pa/ rnam par dag pa sha stag cig kyang yod de/ rigs kyi bu bud med stong phrag bcu po 'di dag kyang skad cig gcig tu 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa rnams la zhal zas yongs su 'bul57ba'i phyir phyogs bcur (2)rgyas par 'dong ngo ⑨/ /phru ba 'di nyid nas kha zas blangs shing / srid pa'i 8tha ma pa /1dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa tunyernams la bsod snyoms 'bul (rnyeba'i phyir phyogs bcur 8rgyas par 'dong ngo ⑫/ /phru ba 'di nyid nas kha zas blangs shing phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste yi dgas kyi tshogs thams cad kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /38—22

rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni phru btu'adi nyid nas lha rnams ni lha'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /klu rnams ni klu'i kha zas kyis/ gnod sbyin rnams ni gnod sbyin gyi kha zas kyis/ dri za rnams ni dri za'i kha zas kyis/ lha ma yin rnams ni lha ma yin gyi kha zas kyis/ nam mkha' lding rnams ni nam mkha' lding gi kha zas kyis/ myi'am ci rnams ni myi'am ci'i kha zas kyis/ lto 'phye chen poshernams ni lto 'phye chen po'i kha zas kyis/ myi rnams ni myi'i kha zas kyisashe/ myi ma yin pa rnams ni myi ma yin pa'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu yud tsam zhig sdod dang de'u resamangon du 'gyur ro/ /dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba des tshig de brjod ma thag tu de'i mod la 'di lta ste/dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas/ sngon gyi smon lam gyis bos pas sems can grangs myed pa zhig shar phyogs kyi sgo nas nang du 'ongs par gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'di lta ste/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i sngon gyi smon lam gyis bos pas/sems can grangs myed pa zhig /lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs kyi sgo nas nang du 'ongs par gyur te/ de ltar 'ongs pa de dag dge bsnyen ma phul du byung bas/ stan de dag la bkod de/ so so nas ci7dga' ba'i kha zas tshod ma sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang ldan pas yongs su tshim par byas so/ /yongs su bstabasalgepar byas so/ /yongs su dga' bsabyas so/ /yongs su mgu bar byas so/ /yongs su spro bar byas so/ /shin tu tshim par byas so/ /yid bde bar byas so/ /kha zas sna tshogs kyis ji lta ba de bzhin du btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ro rnam ⑨pa sna tshogs dang / stan sna tshogs dang / mal cha sna tshogs dang /38—23

bzhon pa sna tshogs dang / gos sna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs dang /phreng ba sna tshogs dang / spos sna tshogs dang / bdug spos sna tshogs dang /byug pa sna tshogs dang / phye ma sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang /rgyan sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i shing rta sna tshogs dang / gdugs sna tshogs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan sna tshogs dang / lha'i ba dan sna tshogs dang / yo byad kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par byas pashenas/ yid dga' bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byas so/ /lha rnams ni lha'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byas so/ /klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa rnams kyang myi ma yin pa'i kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byas pasnyenas/ yid bde bar 'gyur ba'i bar du byas so/ /'on kyang phru ba de las 'gong bar gyur pa geskyed/ 'grib ④pa myed/ dmas pa ⑤skyed/ zad par gyur pa myed/ sa mtshams su gyur pa myed/ mthar thug pa myed/ mur thug pa myed do/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba des/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di shes par zad na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtsibasod nams chen po'i rgya mtsho mi zad pasasti/ myi zad pa'i bsod nams dang ldan pa bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po shin tu bstsags tsho pasad / nam mkha' lta bur gyur pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed pas/ nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po lta bu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsrung7bas/ bsod nams chen po'i 38—24

'khor7yug dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du rin po che〈snyim pa nas char ltar 'thor bsal bsod nams chen po'i sprin du gyur pa/ chos kyi grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed pas/ bsod nams chen po'i mdzod la mngon sum du sa)lta ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi phongs pa'i mun pa sel bas bsod nams chen po'i sgron mar gyur pa/ de dag gi spyod pa5geshes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer 'byung ba chen po zhes bya ba yod de/ de na khyim bdag mkhas pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis(8)/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi7ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba dris hu )shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te/ dge bsnyen ma phul du byung ba'i drung nas blta bas mi nyu1ngoms bzhin du song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs bsod nams kyi mdzod myi zad pa'i rgyan gyi tu rnam par thar pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa de/ bsod nams rgya mtsho de la ni rjes su sems/bsod nams〈nyenam mkha' de la ni kun tu blta8/ bsod nams kyi phung po de ni yongs su 'dzin/ bsod nams kyi ri bo de 3gel ni mngon par 'dzeg /bsod nams kyi tshogs de ni yang dag par sdud/ bsod nams kyi chu bo de la ni yongs su7'bog /bsod nams kyil tshomu stegs de las ni nyusherab tu 'bab/ bsod nams kyi dkyil 'khor de ni yongs su sbyong tu7/ bsod nams kyi gter de la ni yang dag par btso)/ bsod nams kyi tshul de nunyeni rjes su dran par byed/38—25

bsod nams kyi chos ①de ni yongs su 'dzin/ bsod nams kyi rgyud de ⑧ni yongs su sbyong bshebyed cing / mthar gyis grong khyer 'byung ba chen po gang na ba der phyin nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dod cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bas bsgos ④pa'i sems kyi rgyud dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin gyis brlabs5gepa'i bsam pa dngas56)/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la thogs pa med pa'i9)sbyor ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro7bya bas skyo ba med pa'i brtson 'grus dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag lus pa'i7dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nges par gyur pa'i khyabasod nams kyi tshogs thams cad dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rnam par spel ba'i thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pararwatedage ba'i bshes gnyen la nyu2rim gro sna bya ba la mkhas pa dang / rnam par 'phel ba'i dge ba'i 8rtsa ba thams cad dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / yang dag par 'phel ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po dang ske/ yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang / yang dag par 'phel ba'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub pa dang / shin tu yangs par 'gyur ba'i 8snying rje chen pos bdag nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nye bar gyur par yang dag par mthong nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad las byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas chos kyi snang ba yang dag par hu9blang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu snang ba rnam par 'phel bar byed cing khyim bdag mkhas pa yongs su tshol tshol ba las/ grong khyer gyi dbus lam gyi bzhi mdo zhig na rin po che sna bdun gyi stegs bu zhig la/ rin po che 38—26

grangs med pa las byas pa'i khri nor bu rin po che'i rkang pa rdo rje dang / yin dra nī ①la sna tshogs kyis spras pa bkye ba/ gser gyi lcag phod ②kyi dra bas legs par blas pa/ nor bu rin po che dri ma med pa'i snying po can rin po che lnga brgya tsam gyis gzugs legs par brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi stan sna tshogs bting ④ ba/ dugam yo nas lha rdzas kyi gos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang po bsgreng ba / rin po che du ma'i dra bas kun nas yog⑩pa rin po che'i bla re chen po bres pa / bla nas gser dang rin po che'i me tog gi lda ldi mang po bkye ba zhig la 'dug cing / 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi gdugs yu ba dri ma med pa bai ḍūr+ya〈las byas pa ni drung na bsgreng zhing bzung / rin po che'i g.yag kharnga dri ma med pa'i rdul yab ngang pa'i rgyal po lta bus ni legs par g.yab5)spos kyi rim gro'isgo/sheyo byad sna tshogs kyis ni bdugs shing bsangs(nye/ rol mo brdung ba yidang /dkrol ba lha rdzas kyi〈nyedabyangs las 'das par sgra 'byin pa lnga brgya tsam ni g.yas g.yon yinas brdungs shing dkrol/ grong khyer 'byung ba chen po na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams shin tu dga' bar bya ba'i don du lha rdzas kyitshwa 〉mye tog gi sprin gyi char ni kun nas 'bab par gyur18/ g.yog srog chags stong phrag bcu tsam sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba skal ba mnyam par spyod spyod pa ngag nyan cing cirwanyedaga' bar byed pa / lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa yongs su grub pa/ lha dang mi'i gzugs las shin tu 'das pa sha stag gis kun nas bskor cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs khyim bdag mkhas pa gang na ba der song ste/ phyin nas khyim bdag mkhas pa'i5) rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ khyim bdag mkhas pa la 38—27

lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag ni 'di lta ste/sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad shin tu bde ba la dgodamanyu)pa dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas mngon par gdon pa dang / sems can thams cad chos rin po che'i gling du yang dag par bskyal ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sred ②pa'i brlan gshin tu bskam pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi snying rje'i brlan ⑦yang dag par bskyed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang ske/ sred pa rnam par bzlog gepa dang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mos shing bsgrub par bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i byu6)dgon pa las yang dag par bzla ba dang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang chos la dga' zhing mos pa yang dag par bskyed pa dang /sems can thams cad khams gsum gyi grong rdal tshenas gdon pa dang / sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i pho brang du gzud par〈sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs kyis spukyang ske/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar bslab na / )byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba bdag la bshad 38—28

du gsol/ de skad ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag mkhas pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so//rigs kyi bu sems can gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su tshol ba dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen blta bas myi ngoms pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du ①'gro bas myi skyo ba ②dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro bya bas sgyid lug pa med pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bas yid myi bde bsnyemyi skyedakyipa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal ba las phyir myi ldog pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mos shing dang ba'i yid las rnam par myi ldog pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngor blta ba las phyir myi ldog 0pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gi tshul la zhum pa myed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro dang bsnyen bkur bya bas myi skyo ba de lta bu ni shin tu dkon no/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis kho bo'i 'khor 'di dag mthong ngamame/ smras pa 'phags pa mthong ngo / /smras pa rigs kyi bu 'di dag kun kyang kho bos bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dag ste/ 'di dag ni nikho bos de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bskyed pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos pha rol tu phyin pas bsdus teshegasos pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos chos dkar po thams cad kyis bskyed pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la rnam par bskyed pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos 'jig rten gyi rigs las gyen du bskyod pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la bkod pa'o/ /38—29

'di dag ni kho bos 'jig rten gyi lam gyi 'khor lo las bzlog pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la btsud pa'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos ngan song gsum gyi rgyud ①du lhung ba las ②yongs su bzung ba'o/ /'di dag ni kho bos chos nyid khong du chud par bya ba la bkodashepa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na0byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su gyur pa yin no//rigs kyi bu kho bo7ni yid kyi mdzod nas byung ba'i bsod nams mang po thob pa ste/de'i (nyamathus kho bo ni zas 'dod pa rnams la kha gzas kyi sbyin pa byed dol/ /btung ba 'dod pa rnams la btung ba dang / ro'i khyadam pa 'dod pa rnams la ro'i dam pa dang / bza' ba 'dod pa rnams la bza' ba dang / bca' ba 'dod pa rnams la bca' ba dang / bldag ⑩pa 'dod pa rnams la bldag5)pa dang ske/ mur pa 'dod pa rnams la mur pa dang / gos 'dod pa rnams la gos dang —/ me tog 'dod pa rnams la me tog dang / phreng〈geb 'dod pa rnams la phreng 3lheb dang ski/ spos 'dod pa rnams la spos dang / bdug pa 'dod pa rnams la bdug pa dang / byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa dang / phye ma 'dod pa rnams la phye ma dang / rgyan dang lhab lhub 'dod pa rnams la rgyan dang lhab lhub dang / rin po che 'dod pa rnams la rin po che dang / gser 'dod pa rnams la gser dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la dngul dang / mu tig 'dod pa rnams la mu tig dang / rten 'dod pa rnams la rten dang / stan 'dod pa rnams la stan dang / mal cha 'dod pa rnams la mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad 'dod pa rnams la na 7ba'i gsos sman dang yo byad dang / bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon pa dang / dga' ba 'dod pa 38—30

rnams la dga' ba dang / glang po dang rta dang / shing rta dang / ba lang dang /bong bu dang ma he dang / ra lug 'dod pa rnams la glang po dang / rta dang shing rta dang ba lang dang / bong bu dang ma he dang / ra lug dang / rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / ba dan 'dod pa rnams la rgyal mtshan dang /gdugs dang ba dan dang / bran phonyedang bran mo 'dod pa rnams la bran pho50dang bran mo dang 'khor gyi byis pa 'dod pa rnams la 'khor gyi byis pa dang /bud med 'dod pa rnams la bud myed dang / bu mo gzhon nu 'dod pa rnams la bu mo gzhon nu dang / cod pan dang gtsug gi rin po che 'dod pa rnams la cod pan dang gtsug gi rin po che dang / thor pag dudang bcas pa'i gtsug gi rin po che 'dod pa rnams la thor pag ④dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi rin po che dang /skra mthon ting dudri ma myed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa rnams la spa mthon tingakyidri ma myed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin pa byed pa nas/ yo byad sna tshogs thams cad 'dod pa rnams la yang yo byad sna tshogs thams cad kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /rigs kyi bu yud tsam zhig sdod dang / de'u mere mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad dusnyikhyim bdag mkhas pasadhi/ tshig de brjod ma thag tu de'i mod la sems can grangs med pa zhig khyim bdag mkhas pa'i 7sngon gyi smon57lam gyis bos pas8/ phyogs tha dad pa dang / yul tha dad pa hunyedang /gnas tha dad pa dang / 8grong khyer tha dad pa dang / grong rdal tha dad pa dang /tshong 'dus tha dad pa dang / ljongs tha dad pa dang / 'khorasnyigyi grong tha dad pa dang / khyim tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi rgyud tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi ris 7tha dad pa dang / sems can rnam pa myi mthun pa tha dad pa dang /38—31

lam gyi rgyud tha dad pa dang / gnas kyi rnam pa dang / mying du bya ba tha dad pa nas / sems can skye mched rnam pa tha dadanyepa sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ kha zas sna tshogs don du gnyer ba kha zas sna tshogs 'dod pa/ bsam pa tha dad pa bza' ba dang btung ba gtsang ma ri 'dod pa dang / sha 'dod pa dang / kha zas rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs don du gnyer ba/ lam gyi rgyud rnam pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par du skyes pa'i skye mched la gnas patre 'di lta ste/ mi'i nang nas 'bras chan canadang / sran chan dang / khurasnyib dang / skyo ma dang / nya dang /sha la sogs pa kham ⑥gyis bza' ba'i kha gzas sna tshogs don du gnyer ba dang /mi'i nang nas ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad na rnam par spyod pa dag las kyang / kha zas dang btung ba sna tshogs don du gnyer ba dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa thogs pa myed par gtong ba'i rnga'i sgra dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi smon lam gyis bos pas kun kyang 'ongs par gyur te/ 'ongs nas kyang khyim bdag mkhas pa la slongs 3)mo 'debs so/ /gdong du lta'o⑨/ /sdod de⑩/ gsol ba 'debs so//de nas khyim bdag mkhas pas slong ba de dag kun nas 'dus par shes nas(te/yud tsam du bsams te /rtenam mkha' la bltas pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings nas / kha zas dang btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ dri sna tshogs dang ldan pa mang po 'thon te/ leg mthil du 'ongs par sna gyur tochu/ /des de dag yongs su blangs shing de ltar kun nas 'dus pa'i slongs mamo ba mos pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ de dag ci 'dod pa'i zas dang / btung ba'i rnam pa dang / yo byad kyi khyad par thams 38—32

cad kyis yongs su tshim par byas so/ /ci 'dod pa yongs su byin no/ /rab tu dga' bar byas so/ /shin tu tshim par byas so/ /dga' ba shin tu skye bar byas sol/ /nyams shin tu bde bar byas so/ /yid rab tu dga' bar byas so/ /de ltar de dag shin tu tshim par byas nas①/ des kyang mchog ste/ de'i 'og tu chos bstan pa 'di lta ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po bstsags pa'i rgyun yongs su brjod de chos bstanasato/ /phongs pa thams cad 'byung ba ④mi srid pa'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / skyidasnyipa chen po yongs su 'grub par 'byung ba'isnyirgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / chos kyi ye shes kyi tshul 'thob ⑦pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bstsags pa'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / dga' ba bza' ba'i 3)zas rab tu 'thob pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos shin tu brgyan pa'i lus 'thob ⑨pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / thub pa myed pa'i stobs rnam par dag pa 'thob tunye pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / bla na myed pa'i kha zas yongs su shes pa 'thobarwa1pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa dang / bdud kyi dpung thams cad rab tu 'jomasarwa pa'i bsod nams kyi stobs myi zad pa rab tu 'thob pa 'byung ba'i rgyu nyunyeyongs su brjod pa byas te5stechos ston7to/ /des〈nyekha zas don du gnyer cing 'ongs pa rnams la nam mkha'i dbyings nas kha zas rnam pa sna tshogs blangs shing tshim par byas te/de dag la tshe dang / mdog dang / stobs dang smyo/ rme/ bde ba dang / spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ 'thob /shepar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan /6to/ /des btung ba don du gnyer cing 'ongs pa rnams la btung ba mang po zhim pa kha na ma tho ba 38—33

med pa/ yid shin tu dga' bar byed pa 11dag gis tshim par byas nas/ de dag la 'khor bas skom zhing 'khor ba la na dga' ba las rnam par bzlog pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos la dga' zhing sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos pa yongs su bskyed pa'i phyir chos bstan to/ /des ro'i mchog don du gnyer cinga' kyi'ongs pa rnams la ro'i mchog sna tshogs dngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tsha dang / tsha ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba 5rnam pa tha dad pas yongs su tshim par byas te/de'i 'og tu skyes bu chen po'i mtshan ro bro ba'i mchog thob par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan 6to/ /des bzhin pa don du gnyer cing 7)phyogs kyi rgyud sna tshogs nas 'ongs pa rnams la bzhin pa sna tshogs kyi sbyin pas yongs su bsdud ⑧de/ de dag theg pa chen po la gnas par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan riḍaskato/ /des gos don du gnyer cing phyogs sna tshogs nas 'ongs pa kun nas 'dus par shes nas/yud tsam du bsams te/ nam mkha'i dbyings la bltas pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings las gos sna tshogs dang 9/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang ske/ dkar po dang / leb 11rgan dang / shel gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa kha dog sna tshogs can kha dog du mar rnam par dag pa dag 'thon cing lag pa'i mthil du 'ongs pas/ des de dag gis slongs 12mo ba de dag la yongs su bsdud 1 nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa bla na myed pa dang / mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bu thob par 'gyur ba rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan rāto/ /de bzhin du yo byad sna tshogs thams cad kyis ji ltar 'ongs pa'i slongs skamo ba rnams la sdud pa sabyas nas/ ci rigs su chos bstan 1 to/ /de ltar khyim bdag mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 38—34

par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul bstan pa byas nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni yid kyi mdzod nas byung ba'i bsod nams kyi rnam par thar pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' ①yo byad la dbang thob pa rin po che'i lag pa thob par gyur pa/'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad lag pas yongs su khebs par byas shing ske/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du rin po chekhukha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bebs pa de bzhin du rgyan kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / cod pan kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / khang pa brtsegs pa kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang ske/ na bza' kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / lha rdzas kyi7rol mo brdung ba dang dkrol ba dang / glu yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs snyan pa sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / me tog kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / spos kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin dang ske/ bdug spos dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang / phye ma dang chos gos dang /gdugasashedang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs dang / rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i sprin gyi char gedang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyi gnas su sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing bsnyen ⑥bkur ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba tsodang / gdul bar bya ba'i phyir yo byad thams cad kyi sprin gyi lachar 'bebs pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/yon tan brjod pa'am/ rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa7)nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong7)khyer seng ge'i gzugs shes7)bya 38—35

ba yod de/ de na chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen 0)gtsug phud ces bya ba 'dug gis(5)rka/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi snedab dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dga' rangs te④/ mgu zhing nyams bde 5)la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas khyim bdag mkhas pa la chos kyi rim gros slob ma'i tshul bstan te/ de'i byin gyi rlabs ⑥kyis sangs rgyas kyi ④chos thams cad thob par 'gyur bar yongs su blta58)zhing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang de la rag lus par blta ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dben par sems pa〈9)rgyun myi 'chad par bstan pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' shin tu nyan pa'i sems dang ldan par bstan pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang du 'gyur ba'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag dang / tshig mnyan par bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'i dad pa'i dbang po la 7bsam pa byed cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis btam ste 31btang bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen cing bkur ba dang / rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i sems kyis/ khyim bdag mkhas pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ khyim bdag mkhas pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te / khyim bdag mkhas pa'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs bsod nams kyi chu bo de la ni yid ches par sems/ bsod nams kyi zhing de la ni yang dag par blta/ bsod nams hunyekyi ri bo de ni yongs su sbyong tso/bsod nams kyi mu stegs de la ni yang dag par 'dzegam /bsod nams kyi 38—36

mdzod de ni rnam par 'byed/ bsod nams kyi gter de la ni shin tu lto)/bsod nams kyi dkyil 'khor de ni yongs su spyod(mi/ bsod nams kyi phung po de ni yang dag par len②/ bsod nams kyi stobs de ni yongs su bskyed/bsod nams kyi shugs de ni rnam par 'phel bar byed 3)cing / mthar gyis grong khyer seng ge'i gzugs gang na ba der phyin te/ chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen ge)gtsug phud yongs su tshol tshol ba las/ tshong 'dus7kyi srang zhig na 'dug pa mthong nas/ des de'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras sol/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal na/'phags pa lam gang gis bdag thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi man ngag legs par myi stsal matam/de nas chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phud kyis tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyitso)lag palo)nas bzung ste/ rang gi khyim gang na ba der khrid de khyim de bstan nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo'i khyim la ltos shig ces nas / des bltas na khyim de dag cing 'od gsal ba nya )'dzam bu chu klung gi gser las byas pa ste/ yangs shing mtho la dngul gyi thestor bas bskor ba/ shel gyi rtsig hunyepas shin tu legs par brtsigs te/ mdzes par byas pa/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i tu phung po brgya phrag stong gis rab tu brgyan pa/ mu sa ra gal pa'i ka ba bkye banyu ra /mu tig dmar po las byas pa'i seng ge'i khri shin tu bshams pa/ nor bu rin po 38—37

che rang bzhin snang ba'i seng ge'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng hu)ba/ nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba'i bla re bres pa/ gser gyi dra ba yid bzhin gyi nor bus brgyan pas kun nas yog (gepa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs grangs myed pas rab tu brgyan pa/ asma gar bha selas brtsigs pa'i rdzing bu chu bsil bas gang ba dang ldan pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi shing gis bskor ba/ rgya che zhing yangs pa rim pa bcur brtsegs pa/ shin tu mthos3rab/ sgo brgyad dang ldan par 'dug pa mthong nas/ des khyim de'i nang du phyin te/ kun tu bltas na rim khang tha ma'i nang na bza' ba dang btung ba'i rnam pa yongs su gtong ba mthong ngo / /rim khang gnyis pa'i nang na gos kyi rnam pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba mthong ngo ske/ /rim khang gsum pa'i nang na rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan dang / lhab lhub yongs su gtong ba mthong ngo / /rim khang bzhi pa'i nang na btsun mo'i 'khor dga' ba'i yo byad du bya ba bud med rin po che sa chen po'i steng na gzungasnyidu bya ba yongs su gtong ba mthong ngo / /rim khang lnga pa'i nang na yis lnga pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'atshamachos yang dag par bgro ba'i dga' ba la mos pa/ 'jig rten la phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa/gtsug lag thams cad mngon par bsgrub 57pa gzungs kyi tshul dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin las 'irnam par ldang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin la rnam par dpyad 41pa dang / ye shes kyi snang ba mngon par sgrub pa 'dus shing 'khod par / mthong ngo / /rim khang drug pa'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa rab tu thob pa shes rab shin tu zab pa/ rab tu zhi ba'i chos thams cad mngon par shes pa0/38—38

ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / snying po mang pos sgo kun nas byung0ba / bsgribasalgepa myed pa'i spyod yul can myi gnyis pa la yang dag par spyod pa/chos yang dag par bgrosdo ba la rnam par 'phrul ba/ shes da ba kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang zhing rnam par dbye ba dang / rab tu gsal bar byed pa / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo mang po yang dag par bgro ba byedamachodapa rnams kun nas 'dus shing 'khod pa mthong ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo zhi ba'i snying po zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'gro ba thams cad du ye shes rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo myi g.yo ba'i glong57zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo rdul dang bral ba'i 'od ces bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo thub par dka' ba zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'gro ba thams cad mos par byed cing rjes su 'brang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo rgya mtsho'is7)snying po zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo kun tu lta ④ba'i btang snyoms7thob pa zhes bya bsaX/me+e dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo mi zad pa'i mdzod dang ldan pa zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos thams cad kyi tshul rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'gro batshwanyergya mtsho'i nyunyerjes su song ba zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo thogs pa myed pa'i spobs pa zhes bya ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos kyi sprin la dmyigs pas rim pas myi dmyigs pa'i gnas 38—39

shes bya ba dang / de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo de dag la stsogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa0)grangs myed pa brgya ②stong phrag bcu tshang bar yang dag par bgro ri )ba byed cing / rgyan brjod du myed pa shin tu rnam par phye ba'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'khod pa mthong bar gyur to/ /rim khang bdun pa'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' sgra brnyan lta bu'i bzod pa rab tu thob pa thabs dang ye shes rnam par gdon mi za ba la shin tu byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yang dag par 'dzin pa sha stag 'dus shing 'khod pa 'o/mthong ngo / /rim khang brgyad pa'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' ma nyams ⑤ par 'gro ba'i mngon par shes pa rab tu thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par rgyu ba/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du gzugs brnyan rab tu 'byung ba/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du lus ④shin tu rnam par phye ba/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung nas gud du mi 'phags pa'i yul dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rgyal yang dag par gzhol ba/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi 57dkyil 'khor du sngon du brjod pa'i gtam gyi skyes bur gyur pa sha stag kun nas 'dus shing 'khod pa mthong ngo / /rim khang dgu pa'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag 'dus shing 'khod pa mtheng ngo / /rim khang bcu pa'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thog ma byang chub tu thugs bskyed hu )pa dang / spyod pa dang /'byung ba dang / smon lam rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dngatshwa 7bcas pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu sgrog pa dang bcas pa dang / sems 38—40

can 'dul btumadzad pa'i byin gyi rlabs〈kyedang bcas par mthong ngo mthong nas kyang chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phudamasnol 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa khyod la 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa mnga' na/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa de ci lta busazhig tu sbyang ba mdzad mdzad6)/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ni su zhig la yongs su bskrun bskrun(6)/ des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho bos dran te/'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i yang pha rol cig na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'khor lo sna tshogs zhes bya bar/de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings 'od gzer mtha' yas pas yongs su brgyan pa'i chos kyi rgyal po ⑦zhes bya ba mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na myed pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i gekha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ⑨ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ye shes rnam par snang ba la stsogs pa nyan thos bye ba phrag brgya dang / ye shes hu cinyi ma'i gzi brjid la stsogs pa/byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / thabs gcig tu rgyal po 311 chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos spyan drangs nas/ bza' shing gi ra ba chen po rin po che rgyal (gematshan rgyan (rtegyis mdzes pa zhes bya bar gshegs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de grong khyer du gshegs nas/ tshong 'dus kyi srang nas tshuramatshabazhud pa'i tshe/ kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa de dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ sil snyan dang rol mo'i sgra zhig kyang phyung / spos kyi ri 8lu gcig cig 7kyang bsregs te/bdug spos kyis bsangs7 so/ /spos kyi rim lu gcig po de/ de ltar bsregs 38—41

pas zhag bdun du 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad kyang spos kyi na bun gyi sprin kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus dang 'dra bas yongs su khebs par gyur tonyu)/ /spos kyi na bun gyi sprin de dag las kyang sgra 'di skad du brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ga ste/ dus gsum du dri ma myed pa'i ye shes kyi phung po dang ldan pa'im thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ sgrib pa thams cad myi mnga' ba'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad yongs su sbyangs pa ④ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba thams cad kyang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i don chen po tshad myed pa bsgruba'agepar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ro zhes/ de skad du kho bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba las46shugs yang dag par bskyed pa'i phyir/ spos kyi na bun gyi sprin de las / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi brlabs rige kyis sgra'i rnam pa de lta bu byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi brlabs5nikyis/ bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang kho bos gnas gsum du yongs su bsngos te/gsum gang zhe na/ 'di ltar phongs pa thams cad shin tu rgyun gcad pa dang /dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang myi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong ba/ yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngos so1ri/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor thogs pa myed pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' ⑩yon tan rin po che tshad myed pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku rgya mtsho dang /38—42

tha myi dad pa la zhugs pa/ tha myi dad pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi char yang dag par 'dzin pa/ tha myi dad pa'i ①yon tan rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i〈dra ba rnam par rgyas par gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin tha myi dad pa'i yul la zhugs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tha myi dad pasashedage ba'i rtsa ba ④rgyun gcig tu gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang tha myi dad cing rnam par myi rtog par spyod pa/ dus gsum tha myi dad pas mnyam pa nyid la zhugs pa/ bskal pa thams cad tha myi dad par yongs su gnas pas myi skyom⑤ba/kun tu lta ba tha myi dad pa'i yul gyi sa la gnas pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song ⑥rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul sba'ishertsa ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i grong khyer kun nas sgo zhes bya ba na/ tshong dpon spos 'tshong kun tu lta ba zhes bya ba 'dug gisal/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑨byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis mchos kyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phud kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phud la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas7tete / chos kyi tshong dpon rin chen gtsug phud kyi ( drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdon/ bam po gnyis tshupa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa mthong ba la zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa dang 'grogs pa rab tu thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam mtha' yas pa'i tshul gyis snang bar 38—43

gyur pa/ chos kyi tshul mtha' yas pas mngon par brlan pas shin tu rtogs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mos pa mtha' yas pa'i lam gyisashernam par dag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po (mimatha' yas pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ④bsam pa mtha' yas pa'i stobs la gnas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa'i rjes su song ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mtha' yas pa'i stobs yongs su skyes pa/ byang chub sems dpa'a'achogazhan gyis thub pa myed pa5snyematha' yas pa'i rgyal mtshan can/ byang chub sems dpa'i7ye shes snang ba mtha' yas pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos mtha' yas pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa de mthar gyis yul sba'i ④tsa ba gang na ba da)der phyin nas/ grong khyer kun nas tho)sgo yongs su tshol zhing phyogs dang / phyogs mtshams dang / yul phyogs nyen kor kun dang / sgang dang gshong dang / mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa thams cad du yongs su skyo ba myed pa'i bsam pa dang / 'jigs pa myed pa'i sems dang / ldog pa myed pa'i brtson 'grus dang / thub pa myed pa'i sems kyis / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag ma brjed hu pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi spyod pa ma nor bas sems rab tu bsgos pa dang / sgo kun nas rnam par dmyigs 1 pa'i dbang po dang ldan pa dang hunye/ bag skyed pa thams cad dang bral ba dang / myig dang rna ba g.yeng ba myed par kun tu tshol tshol nas yul sba'i 1 rirtsa ba'i dbus shig na/ grong khyer kun nas sgo tshong 'dus kyi rdal 8stong phrag bcu'i gnas su gyur pa/ de shin tu bzang por 7grub pa/ ra ba 7brtan pas bskor ba/ shin tu mtho ba bzhi mdo brgyad kyis brgyan pa 38—44

'dug par mthong ste/ de'inyenang na spos 'tshong kun tu ltasab yang spos 'tshong gi khyams7shig na 'dug pa mthong nas/ spos 'tshong kun tu〈pelta ba gang na ba der phyin te/ spos 'tshong kun du lta52ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i⑧spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma mtshal57)to/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni sems can thams cad kyi nad shes te/ rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang /bad kun las gyur pa dang / cha mnyam par 'khrugs pa dang / gzhan gyis gnod par byas pa dang / mi⑧ma yin pa las gyur pa dang / dug 'thungs pa dang ske/ sngags dang / mtshon dang / ro langs pa'i sbyor ba sna tshogs dang /me las gyur pa dang / chus bskyoda'akhyapa las gyur pa dang / sngangs pa dang 'jigs pa sna tshogs las gyur pa thams cad kyang shes so/ /nad de dag thams cad zhi bar77bya ba yang shes te/ 'di ltar snum hu par bya〈nyeb yang rab tu shes so / /skyug༄par bya 8ba dang / bkrum7ba dang / brta ba dang /(3 gtar ba dang la/ sna'i cho ga 3)dang / nya ra dang / dugs77dang / lums dang /byug pa dang / dug gso ba dang / 'byung po'i gdon myed par bya ba dang /bcud dang / khrus dang / bzhag ༷ )pa dang / bskyed pa dang / kha dog sbyang ba dang / nyam bstod (1pa'ang rab tu shes te/ rigs kyi bu phyogs bcu nas 38—45

sems can gang ji snyed cig kho bo'i7drung du 'ong ba de dag thams cad kyi nad thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar byed de/ nad sos nas kyang legs par bkru ba dang lus la byug pas byug padza byas nas/ ci5 tshul gyi rgyan gyis yan lag shin tu brgyan te/ ci rigs pa'i gos lus la bskon nas/ kha zas bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su tshim par ④byas te⑤/ nor dpag tu med pas kyang phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /de'i 'og tu yang de dag la mi gtsang ba bstan cing / 'dod chags spang ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /byams pa chen po yongs su bsngags shing zhe sdang spang ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /chos rnam par dbye ba'i zhubye brag bstan cing gti mug spang ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /khyad par khong du chud pa'i tshul gyi sgo yang dag par bstan cing cha mnyam pa'i spyod pa dang /nyon mongs pa spang ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi chos dang ldan pa'i gtam thams cad yongs su brjod cing byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'tshad gzung du myed pa yongs su bstan cing risnyen/ snying rje chen po'i'o/'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po bstsags hu ripa yang dag par bsngags shing yon tan tshad med pa 'thob pa dang / 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bar bya ba yongs su bstan cing theg pa chen po'i smon lam 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / bskal pa thams cad du gnas par bya ba'i spyod pa'i dra ba shin tu rgyas par bshad cing byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa 'thob pa dang / 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /sbyin 38—46

pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsngags shing mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'thob pa dang 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i skusheyongs su dag pa thams cad du 'gro ba 'thob ②pa dang 'byung ba'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / sku mdog rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyu yongs su ston to/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku thub par dka'5geb yongs su ston to/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa5geyongs su brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zil gyis ma byanon la/ zil gyis gnonasapa rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing chos kyi sku yongs su dag pasheyongs su ston to/ /thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing 'gro ba thams cad la mngon du gyur pa'i sku gtsang zhing rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to / /smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing bskal pa thams cad kyi dus su 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang 'grogs pa'i sku rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to/ /stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du mngon par 'byung ba'i sku rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing 'gro ba thams cad gebasam pa ji lta ba ⑨bzhin du tshim par mdzad pa'i sku rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to7/ /myi dge ba'i chos thams cad las rnam par ldog pa yongs su brjod cing blta na phul du bzang ba'i sku rnam par dag pa yongs su ston to/ /de ltar de dag chos kyi 38—47

sbyin pas yongs su bsdus tehu)/ nor dang rin po che mtha' yas pa'i tshogs kyis nye bar brtan ②pa byas7shing so sor 'gyed do/ /yang rigs kyi bu kho bo7ni spos dang / bdugasaspos dang / bsgo ba dang / bsku ba sbyor shes te/ 'di ltar spos kyi rgyal po gzhal du med pa la〈)stsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po sin+d+ra ba ra la stsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po mi pham ⑦pa la lastsogs pa dang /spos kyi rgyal po rnam par gsal byed la 0stsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po nyi ma yod pa la ( )stsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po dus dang 'thun pa la ()stsogs pa dang ske/ spos kyi rgyal po sbrul gyi snying po'i tsan dan lasngo stsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po sprin gyi a ga ru la nyunyertsogs pa dang / spos kyi rgyal po dbang po mi 'khrug pa la khestsogs pa/ spos sbyar ba thams cad kyang rab tu shes so/ /yang rigs kyi bu kho bo 8ni sems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa dang / sgo thams cad nas sangs rgyas blta zhing mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i spos kyi gzugs shes te/ rigs kyi bu/ tsosems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa dang / sgo thams cad nas sangs rgyas blta zhing mchod pa dang /bsnyen bkur ba'i spos kyi gzugs 'dis 4 tshokho bo'i bsam pa thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de'i mthus kho bo lhonyesems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i rgyan gyi sprin byin gyis〈r+sharlob pa byed de༄ bye'adi ltar spos kyi khang pa brtsegs kyi pa'i sprin gyi rgyan nas rnam pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs —pa mchod cing rim gror bya ba'i rgyan gyi sprin gyi bar du byin gyis rlob pa ni byed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni nam ci de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pas stebya bar 'dod par gyur zhugepa de'i tshe/ kho bos sems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa 38—48

dang / sgo thams cad nas sangs rgyas blta zhing mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i spos kyi gzugs 'di las spos kyi7mdzod kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin tshad gzung du myed pa bton ②cing / phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nichos kyi dbyings thams cad du spos thams cad kyi mdzod kyi khang pa brtsegs ④pa'i sprin gyi rgyan byin gyis rlob0pa byed do/ /chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi khang pa'i sprin gyi rgyanarnyudang ske/ spos kyi ra ba'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi ba gam gyi sprin gyi rgyan dang /spos kyi rta babs kyi sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi skar khung gi sprin gyi rgyan dang /spos kyi pu shu'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi zla gam7gyi sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi gdugs kyishesprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi lha'i ba dan gyi sprin gyirwago sargyan dang / spos kyi bla bre'i 31sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi gzugs kyi dra ba'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi 'od kyi sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos kyi snang ba hu)dri ma myed pa'i sprin gyi rgyan dang / spos thams cad kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pa'i rgyan byin gyis rlob sto / rigs kyi bu kho bos ni sems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa dang / sgo thams cad nas sangs rgyas blta zhing mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i spos kyi gzugs kyi chos kyi sgo 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos77byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po lta bur gyur pa/ blta na don yod pa/ 'grogs na don yod pa/ rjes su dran na don7yod pa/ brtul zhugs rjes su byas na don yod pa/ mying thos na don yod pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zhi 38—49

bar 'gyur ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud las ldog par 'gyur ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi7chos la skabs phye ba thob par gyur pa༄gye/ mthong ba tsam gyis sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba mthong ba tsam gyis sems can thams cad ③'jigs pa dang / 'khor ba'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad kyi 'jigs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba mthong ba tsam gyis sems can rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyogs la rten par 'gyur ba'i phyir myi 'jigs pa thob par 'gyur ba/mthong ba tsam gyis sems can rnams rga shi'i grog po dang g.yang sar mi⑧ltung ba/mthong ba tsam gyis sems can rnams chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid la gnas pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba 'thob par 'gyur ba de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am yon tan brjod par5srinas re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer ta la'iphurgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod de/ de na rgyal po me zhes bya ba 'dug gis / de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑨byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs/ tshong dpon spos 'tshong kun tu blta hu riba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshong dpon spos 'tshong kun tu blta 9/tsheb la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ tshong dpon spos 'tshong kun tu blta (3ba'i rdung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa de dag rjes su dran par byed cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gi sgo de dag rjes su dran par bya ba dang / bdag 38—50
