shes kyi nam mkha' la mngon par shar ba/ sa'i gzhi ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i dbang po'i myu gu bskyed cing / rnam par spel ba'i phyir byams mi byams dang / mthon7)dman med par 'jig rten na mnyam par gnas pa rlung mar ②ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i shing dang shing phran gyi nags tshal dang / kun dga'ar rtsa ba nas gdon pa'i phyir chags pa med par phyogs thams cad tu rnam par rgyu ba/ 'khor los sgyur 94 ba ltar bsdu ba'i dngos po'i yo byad dang / rkyen gyis 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten na gernam par spyod pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song 0rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi yul dga' 'dzin tshad med pa na/ grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na ⑦kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba zhes bya ba 'dug gisal/de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas spubyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya/ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis0medage bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal to8/ /dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ dge bsnyen mtshwanyemi g.yo ba'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba mngon du byas te/ dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo ba'i gdams ngag rjes su dran par byed cing / dge bsnyen ma mi g.yo bas bstan pa dang / yang dag par bstan pa dang / bsgrags pa dang / bshad pa dang / brjod pa dang /yang dag par brjod pa dang / gzhag 0pa dang / rnam par phye ba dang / smos 38—99

pa dang / rgya cher bstan pa de dag thams cad la gdon mi za bar yid ches shing rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / rjes su bsam pa dang / khong du chud par bya ba dang / sgom 1pa dang / yongs su bsgom du pa dang / gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang ske/ rtogs par bya ba dang / snang bar bya ba dang / mnyam par bya ba myed cing ske/ mthar gyis gnas nas gnas dang yul nas yul du rgyu ste④/ rgyu zhing song song nas yul dga' 'dzin tshad med pa gang na ba der phyin nas/ grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa med cing ri tshol tshol te/ nyi ma nub tu cha ba zhig na kunagrong khyer dga' ba 'dzin par phyin nas/ grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa'i nang du 7nosong ste/ grong khyer gyi lam gyisngonabazhi mdo'i dbus shig tu phyin nas srang gi sgo nas/ sung gi sgo dang lam gyi bzhi mdo nas lam gyi 49)bzhi mdo dang / grong phrag nas grong phrag tu kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba tshol zhing nyu)med med pa dang ske/ mtshan mo mi nyal tsam zhig na grong khyer nyu1dga' ba 'dzin pa'i byang phyogs logs na/ ri shin tu mod pa nyurtezhes bya ba zhig yod pa 32de'i rtse mo rtswa tso dang gel pa dang / sman sna tshogs dga' dga' ltar skyes pas brgyan pa 'od chen po dang ldan pa la genyi ma shar ba lta bur gnas pa mthong ngo / /des snang ba de mthong nas dga' ba'i shugs chen po skyes te 'di snyam du bsams tsoso /bdag gi nyu tshodage ba'i bshes gnyen ri'i rtse mo 'di la gdon mi za bar mthong bar 'gyur ba lta zhig snyam nas/ grong khyer de nas byung ste/ ri shin du mod pa5snyegang na ba der phyin 17pa dang / ri shin tu mod pa (3 de la 'dzegs naḥnas/ ri'i rtse mo snang ba chen po can gang na ba der phyin pa dang / rgyang tsho gering po zhig nas kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba tshangs pa chen po bas ri nyekyang lhag pa'i kha dog dang 38wa 100

ldan pa dpal gyis shin tu 'bar ba zhig nya)tshangs pa stong phrag bcus kun nas bskor te/ 'chags nas 'chag 5)cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ de'i drung du phyin te/ rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ de la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te/'di skad ces nismras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos nag/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ smras pa rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa legs sol/ /legs so rigs kyi bu kho bo ni thams cad du 'gro ba ste6)/ thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i 7)spyod pa la gnas pa'o/ /sgo thams cad du rnam par spyod pas (zhenasnang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / dngos po med pa la gnas pas/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / chos kyi dbyings kun gyi gzhir thug par thal ba'i 9shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes snang ba'i sgo dang ldan pa'o/ / /rigs kyi bu 11de ltar kho bo ni sems can gyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rgyud thams cad dang / sems can gyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad dang / sems can gyi 32shi 'pho ba'i 3)sgo thams cad dang / sems can gyi skye ba'i sgo thams cad dang / srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud tha dad pa thams cad dang /38—101

skye ba'i skye mched sna tshogs kyi 'jig rten gyi gnas rnam pa tha dad pa dag gi sems can kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / chu7zheng rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa / skye ba thukun tu 'brel pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ sbyor ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ mos pa sna tshogs can 'di lta ste lha'i lam gyi rgyud du ④ gtogs pa dang / klu'i lam gyi rgyud du5gegatogs pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi lam gyi rgyud du riganogatogs pa dang / dri za'i lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa dang / lha ma yin gyi lam gyi rgyud dus gtogs pa dang / nam mkha'7lding gi lam gyi rgyud du 9cigatogs pa dang / mi'am ci'i lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 1nyalam gyi rgyud du 8gtogs pa dang / sems can dmyal ba'i lam gyi rgyud du 12gtogs pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud du bigatogs pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud du〈nyegatogs pa dang / mi'i lam gyi rgyud du 8gtogs pa dang / mi ma yin pa'i lam gyi rgyud du〈rtegatogs pa dang ske/ lta ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs la gnas pa (nyenyan thos kyi theg pa la mos pa dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mos pa dang / theg pa chen po la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyi /)don thabs sna tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshul dang sbyor ba sna tshogs kyis byed de/ 'di ltar sems can la la la ni bzo'i rgyus tha dad pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i gzugs5)snang bas 'jig rten gyi bzo sna tshogs bslabs shing don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bstabasam pa'i phyir bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis yongs su bsdu ba'i thabs kyis du rtedon byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi sgo snang ba yongs su bskyed pas pha 38—102

rol tu phyin pa yang dag par brjod cing don byed do)/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sa bon chud mi za bar brtan cings yongs su bskyed pas / byang chub sems dpa'ishesems yongs su brjod cing don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i smon lam yongs su bskyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam pa thams cad du yang dag par brjod pas don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ ngan du spyod ①pa'i rnam par smin pa dang / mthun pa'i rgyus sems can dmyal ba'i lam gyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 8myong bar 'gyur ba yongs su bstan pas / skyo ba yongs su bskyed cingal)don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bskyed pa'i yon tan thams cad ni gdon mi za bar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi 'bras bu'i mthar thug par 'gyur bar brjod pas / dga' ba chen po bskyed cing don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang sku la mngon par mos pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon lam 'debs par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang / bsngags pa yang dag par brjod pas don byed do / /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ mi zlogs shing7lhun gyis grub pa dang ske/ rgyun chad pa med par sangs rgyas kyi phrin ⑧las nan tan du mdzad pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'thob par mos pa bskyed pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che bshebarjod pas don byed do/ /sems can la la la ni 'di lta ste/ tshur zil gyis gnon la phar hu1zil gyis mi gnon pa'i hurtesangs 38—103

rgyas kyi sku phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par mos pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen po yongs su brjod cing don byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang kho bo ni grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa 'di'i bzhi mdo'i phongs 0)thams cad dang /srang thams cad dang / lam gyi sum mdo thams cad dang / grong mtshams thams cad dang / khyim thams cad dang /② mthun par 'dus pa'i zhurdal thams cad dang grong thams cad dang / grong gi rgyud thams cad du rnam pa ji ltar tshogs shing 'dus pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa dang khye'u dang bu mo rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba dang / sbyor ba ji lta ba dang / mthu ji lta ba dang / rnam par spyod pa ji lta ba bzhin du de dag dang / mthun pa'i lus kyi chu zheng dang dbyibs mngon par bsgrubs shing / chos ston kyang / sems can de dag gis de sus gebastan pa dang / de ga gelas 'ongs pa mi shes te/ gzhan du na thos nas ma nor bar nan tanasadu byed pa ni med pa'angadza ma yin no/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na/ zhags pa 'thub pa lta ba rnam pa sna tshogs la mngon par zhen pa/ dgu bcu rtsa drug 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyi nang du yang sems can lta ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs la chags na)pa rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir thams cad dang mthun par gnas te/ rigs kyi bu ci'akhyaltar kho bo grong khyer dga' ba 'dzin pa 'di na nyu risems can gyi don byed cing 'dug pa de bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling gi grong dang 11/ grong khyer dang / ljongs dang /yul dang / khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor thams cad na yang sems can gyi don byed do/ /'dzam bu'i 1 gling na ji lta ba de bzhin du gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / de bzhin du stong dang stong gnyis pa 38wa 104

dang ske/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tesems can gyi rten du bya ba thams cad dang /sems can gyi gnas su bya ba thams cad dang / sems can gyi gzhir bya ba thams cad dang / sems can gyi khams su bya ba'i ming du gtogs pa thams cad dang / sems can yongs su rgyu ba thams cad dang / sems can yongs su 'du ba thams cad dang / sems can zhurgya mtsho na ri gnas pa thams cad dang ske/ sems can gyi rgyudam tshoganas pa thams cad dang / sems can gyi phyogs su bya ba thams cad dang / sems can gyi phyogs mtshams su bya ba thams cad dang ske/ sems can spyod pa'i gnas thams cad du'angasan)/ thabs sna tshogs dang ske/ tshul sna tshogs dang / sgo sna tshogs dang / rigs pa sna tshogs dang /'phrad la pa sna tshogs dang / thabs kyi tshul sna tshogs dang / bya ba sna tshogs kyis ⑦sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /gzugs dang kha dog na sna tshogs yongs su bstan cing mos par bya ba dang / tshig gi lam sna tshogs brjod pas kyang sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad du 'gro ba thams cad kyi rjes su song 7tshob 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad dang / mnyam pa'i lus dang ldan pa bdag dang / sems can gyi lus su tha mi dad pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ 'phrul pa'i 'khor lo rgya chen pos srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad du khyab pa/ 'jig rten gyi skye ba thams cad rang gi lus la rjes su spyod pa/'gro ba thams cad kyis lta 4 na dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sprul pa'i 11'khor lo la brtson pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rigs dang rgyud dang tsher nyi skye ba rab tu 38—105

ston pa/ bskal pa thams cad du gnas pa la thogs7pa med pa'i smon lam gyi 'khor lo dang ldan pa/ mig ②'phrul lta bu'i spyod pa rnam par phye ba'i snang ba rab tu thobam pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byed kyang / gos pasnyimed par gnas pa la brtson pa/ dus gsum gyi 'gro ba'i dbyings mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa/ ye shes kyi dbyings bdag med pa dang ldan pas/ snang bar byas pa'i snying rje chen po mtha' yas pa'i snying po dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bskyed pa la mngon par brtson pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am / yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song57rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul khams chen po zhes bya ba yod de/ de na spos 'tshong7gi tshong dpon longs spyod uta pa la zhes bya ba 'dug gisag/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang ske/ ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shigashes /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tshekun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te/ kun tu rgyu thams cad du 'gro ba'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs lus dang srog la ni the )mi lta/ srid pa'i longs spyod dang yongs su zin pa dang / nye bar blangs pa la0tshemangon par chags pa'i gnas thams cad la ni mi lta hunyesems can gyi yul gyi dga' ba thams cad 1snyel ni mi lta/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang /bro 'dang / reg bya thams cad la ni mi lta/ g.yog 'khor dang longs spyod dang ske/ nye bar spyod pa thams cad la ni7mi lta ste/ rgyal srid dang dbang phyug 38—106

gi dbang gi bde ba thams cad la ni mi lta chal —1)sangs rgyas kyi zhing bla na med par yongs su dag pa mngon par bsgrubs pas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba dang yongs su dag par bya ba la lta (2)ba/mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba53)dang / rim gro bya bas 4/mi ngoms pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la ltam5)ba dang / rang bzhinas6med pa yongs su shes pa'i ye shes khong du chudarke7)par bya ba'i phyir chos thams cad la blta na ba yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad kyi don du ri9)nan tan bya ba las nyam 7pa med par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thams cad la blta 1 ba dang / bskal pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yang dag par gnas par bya ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam chen po la lta ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad du 12'jug par bya ba la lta ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo re rer byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa thams cad gzung ba nya la rnam par 'phrul par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad la lta ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par bzung 7bas mi ngoms par bya ba'i phyir / chos kyi ye shes snang skaba'i 'khor lo thams cad la lta slob/ de sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan 'di dag dang / gzhan dag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen las 'byung 1 ba ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni de dag thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin par yang dag par lta zhing mthar gyis 1 yul khams chen po gang na ba der phyin 19nas/ spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod ud pa la yongs su med cing tshol tshol ba las mthong nas/ spos 'tshong gi tshong 38wa 107

dpon longs spyod ud pa la gang na ba der phyin 1)te/ nadrung du song nas/spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod ud pa la'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod utam pa la la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod ud pa la'i mdun du 'dug te / thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa'i ye shes 'tshal 5te/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bgyi bar yang dga'/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku yongs su grub par bgyi bar yang dga'/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku yongs su 'tshalas bar bgyi bar yang dga'/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su dag par bgyi bar yang dga'/ byang chub sems dpa'im ting nge 'dzin gyi nadakyil 'khor thams cad snang bar bgyid par 9yang dga'/byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su brten 1 par yang dga'/ sgrib pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par gtor bar 11yang dga'/ zhing gi 2dkyil 'khor thams cad du rnam par rgyu bar yang 1 'tshal nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 5byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba tshadang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyis snyen byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur bar 1 ma 'tshal to/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na med pa 18yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 19legs so legs so/ /38—108

rigs kyi bu kho bo ni spos thams cad shes te/ spos sbyar 71ba thams cad dang /bdug spos thams cad dang / bdug spos sbyar ba nathams cad dang / byug pa thams cad dang / byug pa sbyar ba /thams cad dang / phye ma thams cad dang /phye ma sbyar bas54)thams cad dang / spos dang 5/ byug pa dang / phye ma'i rnam pa thams cad kyang shes te/ lha'i spos kyang shes so/ /klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i spos kyang shes so/ /nad gso 6ba'i spos dang / yid mi bde ba bstsal 7riba'i spos dang / 'jig rten gyi dga' ba yongs su bskyed 8)pa'i spos dang / nyon mongs pa 'bar bar 9bya ba'i spos dang —/ nyon mongs pa zhi bar bya ba'i spos dang / 'dus byas kyi dga' ba dang /bde ba sna tshogs yongs su bskyed pa'i spos dang / 'dus byas thams cad las skyo ba yongs su bskyed pa'i spos dang / bag bya ba'i gnas thams cad 1 sel ba'i spos dang / sangs rgyas yid la bya ba'i rgyud yang dag par 'byung ba'i spos dang ske/ chos kyi tshul khong du chud par bya ba'i spos dang / 'phags pas spyad pa'i spos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spos rnam pa tha dad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad rnam par dgod pa'i spos kyang 11shes te/ kho bos spos 12de dag thams cad rnam pa ji lta bu'ang rab tu shes so/ /'byung ba dang ske/ skye ba dang / 'grub pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa dang / yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su spang ba 1 dang / rab tu sbyar ba dang / yongs su spyad pa dang / yul dang mthu dang las dang rgyu yang rab tu shes so/ /rigs kyi bu mi'i 'jig rten na spos glang po'i snying po zhes bya ba/ klu yongs su 'khrug 38—109

par byed pa yod de/ de'i7ri lu til gyi 'bru tsam gyis kyang yul khams chen po thams cad spos kyi sprin gyi dra ba shin tu stug ②pas kun nas khebs par gyur te/zhag bdun du spos chu'i rgyun shin tu phra ba'i char mngon par 'bab bo/ /de'i tshe sems can bu'i lus samasagos la spos chu'i rgyun de dag gis bab par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang me tog gser gyi kha dog du 'dug pas rnam par brgyan pa'i gos dang lus su 'gyur ro/ /khang pa dang gzhal med khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa gang du bab par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang me tog gser gyi kha dog lta bur (7rnam par brgyan par gnas so/ /sems can khyim gyi nang na gnas par+sā)gang gis spos kyi sprin gyi dra ba de la rlung gis mngad pa'i dri tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang zhag bdun du dga' ba dang / mos pa chen pos yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ⑦te/ lus dang sems la bde ba dang dga' ba nisna tshogs kyang rab tu myong bar 'gyur7ro/ /de dag gi lus la yang khams 'khrug pa las gyur pa'am/ gzhan gyis gnod par bya ba las gyur pa'i tunyend kyang 'byung bar nya 'gyur ba med do/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal bsngogedang yidakhemi bde ba yang mi 'byung ngo / /'jigs pa'am/ sngang ba'am bag tsha ba'am / yid 'khrug pa'am/ gnod sems kyang mi rgyu ste/ de dag thams cad zhag bdun du dga' ba dang bde ba skyes te/ gcig la gcig byams pa'i sems su 'gyur ro / /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni de dag de ltar dga' ba dang / nyams bde ba skyes pa rnams la bsam pa dag par bya ba'i phyir ci nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur bsngoshede ltar chos ston77to/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu ri ma la ya las 'byung ni )ba'i tsan dan sa stengasadza skyedam pa zhes bya 38—110

ba yod de/ de lus la bskus na me'i 'obs su mchongs0)kyang tshig pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu rgya mcho1) mtha' nas 'byung ba'i spos gzhan gyis thub pa med pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de rnga'am (gudung la bskus na de'i sgras gzhan gyi ni kyi'akhor thams cad pham par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi 5bu mtsho ma dros pa'i ngogs nas 'byung ba'i a ga ru nag po pad mo'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i ris lu til gyi 'bru tsam gcig gi (7)dris kyang 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad rgyas par gang bar 'gyuratso te/ sems can gang gis spos kyi dri de tshor ba de dag thams cad kyang sdig pa la smod cing sdom pa'i sems rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu ri'i rgyal po kha ba can las 'byung ba'i spos kyi rnam pa 'od dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i dri tshor na sems can de dag 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems su 'gyur 'o)te/ kho bo ni de dag la ci nas kyang rdul dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba de ltar chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu srin po'i 'jig rten nas 'byung ba'i spos kyi rnam pa0 )rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba yod do/ / /de ni 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i longs spyod kyi don du 'byung ste/ des bdugs 1 ma thag tu 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal po'i dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa yang nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu lha'i 'khor chos bzang po nas 'byung ba'i spos kyi rnam pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba 15yod de/des bdugs rkem thag tu lha rnams sangs rgyas kyi dri zhim po dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i gnas na ’ spos kyi rnam pa dag pa'i mdzod ces 18bya ba yod de/ des bdug 19ma thag tu mtshe ma'i lha'i bu thams cad lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i drung du 'dong ngo / /de dag der phyin nas kyang lha'i rgyal 38—111

po rab mtshe mas7chos kyi gtam bya'o②/ /rigs kyi bu dga' ldan gyi gnas na/spos kyi rnam pa sin dusheb ra zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i spos kyi dud pa byang chub sems dpa' tshe gcig gis5gethogs pa chos kyi stan las)'dug pa'i mdun du phyung7na / spos kyi sprin nyachen pos chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par gang zhing /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du rgyan rnam ⑧pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sprin chen po'i char rab tu 'babalgebo/ /rigs kyi bu lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga'i gnas na/ spos kyi rnam pa yid 'phrog pa zhes bya ba yod de/ des lha'i rgyal (2 po rab 'phrul dga'i gnas su bdugs (ten/zhag bdun du chos kyi sprin gyi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa〈nye'abab par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni spos sbyar ba de shes su zad na/ khosnyibos byang chub sems dpa' 1)skyon gyi dri ma med pa 'dod pa'i 'jig rten thams cad nas 8gyen du 'phags pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi zhags pa dang bral ba/ srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam pa dang /gzugs kyis 7rnam par spyod pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis gos pa med pa/chags pa med pa'i ngang tshul can/ sgrib pa med par7)ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ thogs pa med pa'itshwa)ye shes kyi spyod yul dang / yul du ldan 3tshepa/ kun gyi zhu )gzhi'i gnas thams cad la mi gnas par/ srid pa'i kun gzhi dang gnas 31thams cad du rgyu ba rnams kyi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo yongs su smos pa'am/kha na ma tho ba med pa'i spyod pa brjod sa pa'am/ gnod par spyod par nyemed pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rgyud bstan par nus re skan/ /songamanyerigs kyi bu lho 38—112

phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na/ grong khyer khang pa brtsegs pa zhes bya ba yod de/de na mnyan pa dpa' bo7zhes bya ba 'dug gis rigade'i drung du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i ①spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisadu / spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon⑧longs spyod ud56)pa la'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod uta pa la lashelan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor 9)ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te/ spos 'tshong gi tshong dpon longs spyod uta pa la'i drung nasalo)song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs grong khyer khang pa brtsegs par 'gro ba'i lam du 'jug pa'i tshe/ lam gyi gyen thur dang / lam mnyam pa dang /lam gyi thag thug dang / lam rdul yod pa dang / lam rdul med pa dang /lam bde ba dang / lam mi bde ba dang / lam dog pa dang / lam bgegasamatsomed pa dang / lam 'khyug (nyapa dang / lam 'khyug 62pa med pa la rnam par dpyad de bltas hunyenas 'di snyam du bsams so/ /'di ltar bdag dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i drung du 'gro ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi nan tan gyi rgyur 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi nan tan gyi rgyur 'gyur ro/ /sems can la phan gdagasam pa'i lam gyi7rgyur 'gyur ro/ /sems can7thams cad byams snang〈nyedang / mthon dman du gyur pa'i 38g.yang sa las rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems can thams cad mi mnyam pa'i nan tan las bsgyur ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi 3)nyon mongs pa'i rdul rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i lta ba sna tshogs kyi sdong ni 3dum dang /38—113

tsher ma dang / gyo mo dang gsog ma bstsal ①ba dang / chos kyi dbyings bsgribasalgepa med pa la gzhol par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i pho brang du thogs pa med par bskyalasaba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ④rag lus so zhes de de 6)ltar sems shing yid la byed pas spyod pa thub par dka'akheb de mthar gyis grong khyer khang pa brtsegs pa der phyin nas mnyan pa dpa' bo7yongs su rmed7cing tshol tshol ba las grong khyer chen po zhig gi sgo rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs na/ mnyan pa dpa' bo ⑨de tshong pa brgya phrag stong tsam dang / srog 7chags brgya stong du ma gtam sna tshogs mnyan hu)par 'dod pa sha stagatsogs kun nas bskor cing / rgya mtsho'i gtam yongs su brjod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho sems can rnams la ston cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mnyan pa dpa' bo gang na ba der song ste/ phyin nas mnyan pa dpa' bo'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mnyan pa dpa' bo la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ mnyan pa dpa' bo'i mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na13/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi balgem 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang ske/ rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba 38—114

dang ske/ ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bka' stsal0)du gsol/ smras pa rigs kyi bu khyod kyis7de ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tus kyisems bskyed de/ ye shes chen po 'thob pa ( 'byung ba'i rgyu 'dri ba dang /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gling gi gnas su 'gro ba 'byung ba'i rgyung dang / dbyer med pa'i theg pa chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu ⑥dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung bas 'jigs pa dang 'bral (pebar 'gyur ba'i lam gyi nan tan 'byung ba'i rgyu dang / zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / rgyud sna tshogs khong du chud par bya ba'i ye shes kyi lam 'byung ba'i rgyu medang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad du 'gro bas rnam par spyod pa'i smon lam gyi boshing rta'i 'khor lo thogs pa med pa'i lam 'byung ba dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu 13 dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa hu7gzi brjid kyi dba' rlabs kyis rnam par brgyan (nyepa thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / tshul gyi lam 'byung ba dang /rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang / chos kyi phyogs dang / sgo thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mtha'i lam 'byung ba dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i lam 'byung hu ba dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu 'di 'dri ba bolegs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni rgya mtsho'i ngogs kyi grong khyer khang pa brtsegs pa 6'di na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa snying rje chen po'i rgyal mtshan yongs su sbyong zhing gnas te/ rigs kyi bu kho bo ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can phongs pa rnams mthong nas/ de dag gi don du dka' ba spyod de/ de dag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o//38—115

'jig rten gyi zang zing gis ①yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /chos kyi longs spyod kyis de dag yongs su tshim par bya'o/ /de dag la bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi lam man ngag du bstan par bya'o/ /ye shes kyisatshogs rnam par spel bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs yongs su spel bar bya'o/ /byang chub kyi5 sems bskyed par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi bsam pa rnam par dag par bya'o/ /snying rje chen po'i stobs nye bar brtanasrepar bya'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnam par zhi bar bya'o/ /'khor ba'i spyod pas yongs su mi skyo ba'i stobs ④shin tu brtan ⑥par bya'o/ /sems can rgya mtsho bsdu ba la 'di dag sbyar bar bya'o/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i nan tan gyi sgo la dgod par bya'o/ /'di dag la chos rgya mtsho'i ye shes snang ba nye bar bsgrub par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad kyang 'di dag gis ⑦mngon par mthong bar bya'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgya mtsho la yang 'di dag gzud par gebya'o zhes de lta bu'i bsam pa dang / yid la bya bsnyel brtson par kho bos7rgya mtsho'i ngogs kyi grong khyer khang pa brtsegs pa 'di na gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni de ltar 'gro ba la phan pa dang / bde bar57brtson pas5)rgya mtsho chen po'i rin po che'i 3nyegling thams cad kyang shes so/ /rin po che'i 'byung gnas thams cad dang / rin po che'i rigs thams cad dang / rin po che'i gtos༄thams cad kyang rab tu shes so/ /klu'i gnas thams cad dang / klu'itso'akhrug pa thams cad dang / gnod sbyin gyi gnas thams cad dang / — gnod sbyin 'khrug pa thams cad dang / srin po'i gnas thams cad dang / srin po'i 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po'i gnasamo thams cad dang / 'byung po'i 4 bar chad thams cad nyunyernam par zhi bar bya ba yang 38—116

rab tu shes te/ glong ①yod pa thams cad glong ②thams cad bkol ba dang dba' rlabs chen po yongs su spang ba sridang / chu'i kha dog rnam pa tha dad pa'ang rab tu shes so/ /gnyisazla dang gza' skar gyi tshogs yongs su 'khor ba dang ske/ nyin zhag dang skad cig dang / yud tsam dang thang cig kyang rab tu shes so/ /phan tshun du 'gro ba'i shol 'dums dang / bdepo)mi bdes dang /gru'i 'khrul 'khor brtan par bya ba dang / gru bzur ba dang / gru phul ba dang /rlung brdo'ub dang rlung bskyed pa dang / gru bsgyur zhing bzlog pa dang / gru brtod7pa dang / gru btang ba yang rab tu shes so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bo ni shes pa de lta bu dang ldan pas rtag tu sems can gyi don dang dgos tunyepa byed de(rte/ tshong pa'i tshogs gru brtan pos lam bde zhing nye zhor mi 'gyur la mi 'jigs pa nas/ chos kyi gtam gyis hunyedaga' ba dang / spro ba bskyed cing bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rin po che'i gling du phyin par byas nas/ de dag rin po che yithams cad kyis tshogs teyi/ phun sum tshogs par gyur pa ⑩dang /phyir yang 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gyed 'gyed kyang rigs kyi bu kho bo'i gru ni nam tu 7yang bub pa'am/ nye zhor gyur ma myong〈nyeste/ sems can gang gis kho bo mthong bar gyur pa dang / sems can gang gis kho bo'i chos bstan pa thos pa de dag kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thams cad du nye zhor 'gyur ba'i7ce'ajigs pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i ye shes kyang mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ / sred pa'i (3 rgya mtsho bskam pa'i don du'ang rab tu 'jug par 'gyur te/ dus gsum rgya mtsho'i ye shes snang ba 'ang (lharab tu thob bo / /sems can thams cad kyi〈pesdug bsngal rgya mtsho zad par bya ba'i phyir yang5nye38—117

mngon par mos par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mchosare rnyog pa dang bar bya ba'i phyir yang rab tu brtson par 'gyur ro/ /zhing rgya mtsho thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yangs3)brtson 'grus rtsom par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par gang gub las kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro//'gro ba thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho tha dad pa'ang khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho'i57rjes su'ang 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rgya mtsho ji lta ba bzhin du yang gzugs brnyan snyi'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa mthong ba dang / thos pa dang 'grogs pa dang / rjes su dran pa'i chu klung gi dbyangs shes bya ba thob par zad na kho bos byang chub sems dpa' rgya'akhor ba'i rgya mtsho thams cad du rnam par spyod pa nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad kyis gos pa med pa/ lta ba'i rnam pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad kyi chags pa'i chu srin gyi 'jigs pa dang bral ba/ chos rgya mtsho thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / gzhi las rnam par rgyu ba/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho thams cad bsdu ba'i dngos pos yongs su sdud pa'irnyurgya mtsho dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgya mtsho dang 'grogs pa/sems can gyi mngon par chags pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu bsrub pa⑦/dus rgya mtsho thams cad dang / tha mi dad par rnam par spyod pa/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i dmigs pa ⑧shis pa/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyi 'dul ba'i dbres 6)las mi 'da' bar hu node dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song hu)/rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer dga' ba'i phreng turteb zhes bya ba yod de/ de na tshong 38—118

dpon rgyal ba dam pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis/ de'i gan0)du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 97mnyan pa dpa' bo'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal chanas/ mnyan pa dpa' bo la lan brgya stong du maramachagayas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ yang dang yang bltas nas gdong mchi mas bkang ste/ ngu zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen blta bas masnyingoms bzhin du mnyan pa dpa' bo'i drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/⑥ bam po bzhishepa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byams pa chen pos sems can gyi khams tshad med pas)rgyas par dgang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ snying rje chen po'i rlan gyis mngon par brlan pa'i rgyud can3)/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po'i rgyan hu )shin tu bstsags hu7pa nyon mongs pa'i rdul dang mun pa dang dri ma dang 'dam thams cad dang bral ba/ chos mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pas / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam gyen thur med pa la zhugs pa/ dge ba'i chos tshad med pa la 'jug pa'i sgor zhugs pa/ mi dge ba 4)thams cad kyis mi shigs pa'i brtson 'grus brtan pa'i mthu sngon du 'dor ba dang ldan pa/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu byang ba/ rgya chen po'i bde ba rab tu hunyethob pa/ shes rab kyi nyi ma'i 'od zer snang bas/ma rig pa'i mun pa ma lus pa 8bsal ba/ thabs kyi ser bu bde zhing bsil bas blags 8pa'i ye shes kyi me tog gis ⑩rgyas pa/ smon lam chen po'i / tshorgya mtshor 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi tshul dang mthun pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad 38—119

du thogs pa med ①par rgyas ④par 'gengs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi pho brang du thogs pa med par 'gro ba la mngon du gyur pa/byang chub sems dpa'i lam la mngon par mos pa de/ grong khyer dga' ba'i phrengasab gegang na ba der phyin te/ tshong dpon rgyal ba 'a)dam pa yongs su med cing tshol tshol ba las⑥/ grong khyer dga' ba'i phreng ba'i shar phyogs logs kyi 'dab cig na/ shing a sho ku'i nags tshal rgyal mtshan sna tshogs zhes bya ba 'dug pa de'i nang na khyim bdag stong phrag du ma zhig gis bskor te/ grong khyer gyi bya ba sna tshogs yongs su 'gro ④zhing de las brten te/ bdag tu bya ba thams cad yang dag par gzhom pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad yongs sushegatang ba dang ske/ dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad rab tu spang bshedang / mngon par zhen pa thams cad shin tu gzhig pa dang / sred pa'i 'ching ba thams cad gcad par bya ba dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo glegs gcagatshwanyepa dang /the tsom 3 dang yid gnyis dang / nem nur gyi rab rib thams cad rnam par bsal ba dang / g.yo sgyu'i rnyog pa shin tu gdangarwanyeb dang / phrag dog dang ser sna'i dri ma yongs su sbyang ba midang / sems kyi mtsho shin tu gsal bar bya ba dang ske/ sems rnyog pa med pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / dad pasnyirnyog pa med pa'i stobs bskyed de/ sangs rgyas blta ⑩bar mos pa bskyed pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bsngags shing / sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par blang ba0 tshodang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa smos te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs yongs su bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab kyi stobs yang dag par ston (gecing / byang chub sems dpa'i 38—120

dran pa'i stobs rnam par dag pa'i mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi gtam byed cing 'di lta ste/ byang chub tu7sems bskyed pa la mngon par mos par bya ba'i phyir chos ston cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ②gtam de'i rjes duchad chad ④du bsdad nas tshong dpon rgyal ba dam pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ ring mo zhig tu btud nas chos la shin tu gus pa'i bsam pas tshig 'di skad du brjod do/ /'phags pa bdag ni nor bzangs nor bzangs ⑤shes bgyi ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su tshol na ci nas kyang bdag byang chub sems dpa'i 6)spyod pa la slob par 'gyur ba dang / bslabs mnas kyang cipo)nas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyi ba stidang / gdul ba'i don la mngon du mos par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal blta ba las mi 'phang ba 7dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thos par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyitshwanyespyin gyi char yongs su gzungapha/rteb dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul la nan tan du bgyi ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyadatshwa pa dang / bskal pa thams cad du gnas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas yongs su mi skyo ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam 7par 'phrul pa yongs su btsalamatshabar 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs yang dag par mnod tshapa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs rnams la snang ba thob par 'gyur ba de ltar 'phags pas bdag la bshad du gsol/ de nas tshong dpon rgyal ba dam pas / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 38—121

de ltar khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni 'di lta ste/ dngos po med pa la gnas pas mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i mthus/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo thams cad du 'gro ba yongs su sbyong0)ste/ de〈peltar kho bo byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dag pa'i sgo thams cad du 'gro ba 'di la gnas shing / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / mtshe ma'i lha'i snyu gnas thams cad dang / dga' ldan gyi lha'i 'jig rten thams cad dang /'phrul dga'i lha'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / bdud kyi gnas thams cad dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i ris su gtogs pa thams cad dang / lha'i gnas thams cad dang ske/ klu'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / klu'i gnas thams cad dang /gnod sbyin gyi 'jig rten thams cad dang / gnod sbyin gyi gnas thams cad dang ske/ srin po'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / srin po'i gnas thams cad dang ske/ grul bum gyi 'jig rten thams cad dang / grul bum gyi gnas thams cad dang / yi gshedags kyi 'jig rten thams cad dang / yisadags kyi gnas thams cad dang / dri za'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / dri za'i gnas thams cad dang / lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten thams cad dang / lha ma yin gyi gnas thams cad dang / nam mkha' lding gi 'jig rten thams cad dang / nam mkha' lding gi gnas thams cad dang / mi'am ci'i 'jig rten thams cad dang /mi'am ci'i gnas thams cad dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 'jig rten thams cad 38—122

dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas thams cad dang / mi'i 'jig rten thams cad dang / mi'i gnas thams cad dang / grong dang grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang 'dod pa'i khams su gtogs pa'i sems can gyi rgyud thams cad du chos ni ston to/ /chos ma yin pa ni bzlog go/ /rtsod pa ni zhi bar byed do/ /'thab pa ni rnam par bzlogatugo/ /'khrug pa ni nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /g.yul du lhags pa ni rnam par bzlog go/ /shags 'gyed5)pa ni zhi bar byed do/ /mdud parasre'adzin pa ni rab tu sel to/ /bcings pa thams cad ni yongs su gcod do/ /btsonasar thams cad ni mngon par 'dral lo/ /'jigs pa ni7rnam par bzlog go/ /mi dge ba'i las kyi 'du byed ni rgyun gcod do/ /srog gcod pa las ni sems can rnams rnam par zlog7go/ /ma byin par len pa dang 'dod pas logashepar g.yem pa dang / brdzun5) du smra ba dang phra ma dang zhe gcod pa dang / tshig kyal7pa dang chags sems dang / gnod sems dang log7par lta ba las ni sems can rnam par zlogatsogo/ /mi bya ba thams cad ni byed du mi 'dzud do8/ /dge ba'i chos bya ba tsothams cad ni byed du 'dzud do( rme/ /sems can thams cad ni bzo thams cad la slob tu 'dzud de(2/ 'jig rten rnams (perab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang/ zhags pa 'thubadza kye pa thams cad la gong ma'i ye shes khyad 31par du 'phags pa brjod pa'i phyir rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad brjod cing bstan pa'i phyir 'jig rten la phan par 'gyur ba'i gtsug lag thams cad kyang ston to/ /rnam par 'god 38—123

do / /rab tu gsal0)bar byed do/ /brjod7do/ /de bzhin du tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du gzugs kyi khams kyi lha thams cad zil gyis mnan te chos ston to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ji lta ba de bzhin du phyogs bcur yang 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag tu chos ston te③/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang nyan thos kyi chos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang ston to/ /sems can dmyal ba yang ston to/ /sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i lam dang /sems can dmyal ba pa'irnyusems can gyi mi bde ba'ang ston to/ /byol song gi skye gnas kyang ston to/ /byol song gi ⑦skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud tha dad pa rjo dang ske/ byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam du 'gro ba'i lam dang / byol song gi skye gnas su skyes pa'i sdug bsngal yang ston to/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten yang ston to / /gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i lam dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal yang ston to/ /mtho ris kyi spu'ajig rten yang ston to/ /mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i lam dang / mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi dga' bsngoX /spyod pa dang / longs spyod kyang nyuteston to/ /mi'i 'jig rten yang ston to/ /myi'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyil rgyud du 'gro ba'i lam dang mi'i 'jig rten gyi bde ba dang ske/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba sna tshogs kyang ston tehurte/ de ltar rigs kyi bu kho bo ni 'jig rten gyi chos kyang ston to/ /'jig rten kun 'byung ba dang /'jig rten spunab par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi kha na ma tho ba dang /'jig rten nas bo'abyung ba yang ston to7/ /de yang 'dil 1ltar byang chub sems 38—124

dpa'i lam yang dag par bstan pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon rnam par bzlog pa dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yon tan yang dag par brjod pa dang /srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud du mgo 'khor ba dang sdug bsngal du gyur pa yang dag par ston7pa dang / sgrib pa med pa'i chos nyid brjod pa dang / 'jig rten rgyu'i⑧bya ba yongs su bstan pa dang / 'jig rten 'byung ba dang / ldog⑧pa'i bde ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad smos pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyisnyiganas kyi ming du bya ba rnam par bsgomasnyepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos gnas pa med pa mngon par bstanashepa dang / las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'khor lo thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba shin tu brjod pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo thams cad du 'gro ba dngos po med pa la gnas pas mngon par 'du bya ⑧ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus brgyan pa ⑨'di shes par zad na kho bos byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon par shes pa zhing gi dbyings thams cad du sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi lus kyis 6) rgyas par 'gengs pa kun tu lta ba'i ye shes kyis 31rab tu thob pa tshig gi lam dang / sgra thams cad rnam par dmyigs pa la shin tu gzhol ba'i rna ba dang ldan pa/ dus gsum rgyas par 'gengs pa'i chos kyi sgo snang (rteb la dbang rab tu thob pa/chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i ye shes la dbang gis dbang sgyur hunyeba'i skyes bu dpa' bo〈nyesems can tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmyigs par mabya ba la ma 'dres pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i lce yangs shing srab la yid du 'ong ba hu9dang ldan pa/38—125

bsam pa tha dad pa'i sems can rgya mtsho'i yid du 'ong ba'i ①kha dog dang /dbyibs7su ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mnyam pa'i lus sgyu ma lta bu dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mi gnyis pa'i spyod lam gyis / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus la gzhol ba/ dus gsum thams cad du rjes su 'brang ba'i ④ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa nam mkha'i ⑤dbyings ltar tshad med pa'i spyod yul dpag tu med pa'i yul dang ldan pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par7nus re skan/ songakhurigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi yul shu ma phyi ma'i mtha' na/ grong khyer ka ling ga'i⑧nags tshal zhes bya ba yod te⑨/ de na dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis(bye / de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par byamanyeb dang / ji ltar nan tan du byatshwa ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis7tshong dpon rgyal ba dam pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshong dpon rgyal ba dam pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba 8byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas gete/ tshong dpon rgyal ba dam pa'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs mthar gyi tsheyul shu ma phyi ma'i mtha'i grong khyer ka ling ga'i〈 tshonags tshalasngogegang na ba der song ste phyinamakhyenas/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa yongs su tshol zhing sems can kun la medam ripa'i tshe/ —gang nas gang du song bsngo 1de dang der rogs padza gebargya phrag du ma dang / bu mo brgya phrag du ma zhig sung dang lam gyi bzhing mdo dang / lam gyi sum mdo dag napo tshogs te / rjes su 'brang ngo / /skyes pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bud med brgya phrag du 38—126

ma zhig gis kyang rigs kyi bu 'de re0)dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa ni/ grong khyer ka ling ga'i⑧nags tshal 'di nyid kyi bza' shing gi ra ba chen po rgyal ba'i 'od kyis byin pa nyi ma'i mdog na sems can tshad med pa'i don du chos ston cing 'dug go zhes bstan gto/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs bza' shing gi ra ba nyi ma'i mdogasreder phyin nas kun tu btsal te/ bltasatso)na bza' shing gi ra ba de na/ shing zla ba shar ba zhes bya ba khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ 'od sna tshogs kyi kha dog can 'od kyi mdog dang ldan pal/ 'khor kun tu dpag tshad kyi khyon tsam du 'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa mang po dang / lo ma'i shing yongs su 'gengs pa zhes bya ba gdugs kyi rnam pa dang dbyibs su 'dug pa'i 'dab ⑧mas kun nas khebs pa/ be+e ḍūr+ya lasngon po'i kha dog ltar 'dug pa'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan pa mang po dang me tog gi shing me tog gi mdzod ces bya ba/ ri'i rgyal po kha ba can ltar mdangs dga' ba'i dbyibs 4)sna tshogs dang ldan pa kha dog sna tshogs kyi me tog mi zad pa'i char rab tunye'abebs pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi〈nyelha'i pho brang gi rgyan gyi7kun nas 'du ba dang/ sus kyang mi shigs pa lta bu mang po dang / shing tog gi shing rtag tu smin pa'i ro dpe hunyemed pa'i 'bras bu'i tshogs shes bya ba gser gyi ri bo'i lhun ltar 'dug pa/ rtag tu shing tog phun sum tshogs par gnas pa mang po dang lnga/rin po che'i rgyal po'i shing rnam par snang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba rin po che'i rgyal po dpe yimed pa'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i phreng hurteb dang ske/ se mo do dang / rgyan rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i mdzod nas byung ba ltar phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i nyamakha dog grangs med pa'i 38—127

'byung gnas su gyur pa mang po dang / gos kyi shing dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba lha rdzas kyi gos rin po che'i kha dog sna tshogs kyi tshogs rab tu 'gyed cing 'phyang bas shin tu brgyan pa mang po dang / rol mo'i shing dga' ba skyed7pa zhes bya ba lha rdzas las70kyang lhag pa'i rol mo yid du 'ong ba'i sgra snyan⑧pa 'byin pa mang po dang / spos kyi shing kun tu zhim pas brgyan pa zhes bya ba phyogs thams cad du thogs pa med par rnam pa thams cad du yid du 'ongasnyiba'i spos kyi ngad 'byung ba mang po dag kyang yod par mthong / mtshe'u dang lu ma dang / lteng ka dang /rdzing bu rin po che bdun gyi pha gus mtha' brtsigasalgepa/ phyogs bzhi nas rin po che'i them skas btsugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi khri 'phang dus dang 'thun pa'i tsan dan gyi dri zhim pos bskus pas ⑥kun nas bskor dzo)ba/ gzhi rin po che'i rgyal po be+e ḍūr+ya 3)sngon po las legs par blangs pa/ 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi bye ma bdal ba yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu lha rdzas kyi dri yid du 'ongamanyu༄ba can gyis yongs su gang ba/ rin po che'i pad mo dang / ut+pa la dang /ku mu ta4dang / me tog pun da lhastori ka kha dog sna tshogs lha rdzas kyi bsung snyedang ldan pas/ chu kun nas yog pa/ bya bran sna tshogs kyi khya〈nyelha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ sgra snyan pa 'byin cing brjod pas gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing gi phreng ba legs par bkyechabs yongs su bskor cingamanyugebargyan pa dang 8ldan pa shing sna tshogs de dag gi drung thams cad du'ang rin po che'i nyu seng ge'i 1)khri sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mas brgyan pa/lha rdzas kyi stan rin po che sna tshogs 'belas17bar bting ba/ lha rdzas kyi spos dang /38—128

bdug spos kyi51)rnam pa thams cad kyis bdugs na pa/ lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i dar rin po che mngon par spyangs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi bla re bkye cab / rin po che sna tshogs dang 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi dra ba sna tshogs kun nas bres pa/ rin po che'i dril gyi 5dra ba yid du 'ong 6)zhing snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa / mang pos brgyan pa/ 'khor du lha rdzas kyi murin po che'i stanas brgyas9phrag du ma bting zhing bshams pa mthong ngo / /rin po che'i shing drung la lar 3 ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad+mo'i 17snying po can bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che'i 12spos kyi rgyal po'i pad mo'i 1 snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po klu'i rgyan gyi pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge'i bya la'i 7pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba'i pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po phyogs rnam par snang ba'i pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po 15dbang po'i rdo rje'i pad mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po 'gro ba'i gluyid du 'ong 1 ba'i pad+mos snying po byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /rin po che'i shing drung la lar ni seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po mdog dkar po'i pad mos snying po 1 byas pa bshams pa mthong ngo / /bza' shing gi ra ba de'i gzhi thams cad kyang rin po che 9sna tshogs kyis 2 yongs su gang zhing rgya mtsho chen po ltar rin po che'i gling na gis yongs su gang ba mthong ngo / / be+e ḍūr+ya 22sngon po'i dam pas 38wa 129

spras te/ rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i sa7)phyogs ka tsa lin da57ltar reg na bde zhing 'jam pa/ gomasari ripa bor zhing bteg pa'i tshe mtho dmanam47med pa / rdo rje rin po che lta mchog gi pad+mo'i (5)dri yid du 'ong bar zhim zhing reg na bde ba'i sil ma kun tu bkram pa/ ngas7)ngur dang / rma byas she)dang / khrung khrung dang —/ ku na la dang / ka la ping ka dang / ko 9)kyi la dang / dzi ban dzi 7ba ka sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro 'byin tsho1pa mang pos gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi 12rin po che'i tsan dan gyi shing mang po'i snyenags tshal shin tu legs par 'grigs pas skabargyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad+mo'i sprin gyi char dang /rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs mi zad pa'i char rgyun tu 'bab pa/ 'dresalgepa'i nags tshal las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang bu brtsegs ma brgyanas9par bkod 1 pa'i nang nas/ spos kyi rgyal po'irwa bdug spos rin thang 17med pa rtag tu 'thul zhing 2 zhim pa lha'i mdun dumes chos bzang po'i rgyan 2las kyang lhag par 2 brgyan pa/ lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i rin po che'i dra ba sna tshogs kyis kun nas 24zas pa/ mu tig rin po che'i me tog gi phreng 2lhab dang glu/ lda ldi kun nas bres pas 2nerab tu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dril bu rnam pa sna tshogs su rnam par bkye ba'i gser gyi dra ba 'bar bas/ kun nas dkrigs pa/ rol mo'i shing dang / rin po che'i ta la las dril bu'i dra ba rlung cigis legs par bskyod pas yid du 'ong 28ba'i sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs 'byung ba dang ldan pa/ dbang bsgyur 29gyi lha'i rgyal po'i lha mo dpe tshul shin tu bzang ba rnams kyis glu snyan pa'i sgra rab tu yid du 'ong ba len mkha / lha rdzas kyi yid bzhin gyi gos kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pas rnam par mdzes 38wa 130

pa / rgya mtsho chen po ltar kha dog dang / mdog sna tshogs su ldan pas blta na gtang myi bra ba/ khang pa brtsegs pa 1)rin po che'i rgyanas dang ldan pa brgya stong grangs myed pas rab tu brgyan pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i pho brang ltar blta na bzang ba/ rin po che55)sna tshogs rnam par phye cabs rnam pa thams cad du brgyan pa'i gdugs shin tu legs pa/ rnam par bsgreng zhing bkram pas kun nas blta na mdzes pa(5)/ dbang po chen po'i 'jig rten ltar shin tu mdzes pa'i de'us )sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'od snang ba chen po rtag par 'byung ba/tshangs pa chen po'i gzhal myed khang ltar nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po 'gro ba ri yid du 'ong ba'i 'od kyis 'bar ba ste/ bza' shing gi ra ba chen po nyi ma'i mdog 8ces bya ba de/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu stobs dang / byin gyi rlabs 9che zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs shing tshad med de/ rgya chen po dang ldan pa 1 mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tsho/lhade ltar yon tan tshad myed(12/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshogs pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba'i 1 rgyan byang chub sems dpa'i las kyi rnam par smin pas yongs su grub pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po las skyes pa/ sangs rgyas la mchod cing rim gror byas pa'i rgyu 'a thun pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa las byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pas myi 'phrogs pa/ chos kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bus grub pa/ dge ba'i bsod nams dri ma myed pa sargya chen pos grub cing byung ba/dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa bzang po legs par 38—131

byas pa dang / rgyu01'thun pa'i stobs dang / shugs kyis byung ba nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / thun mongasam yin pa/ mu stegs can dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs pa/ bdud kyi lam yongs su rgyu ba thams cad kyis myi tshugs pa/ byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad kyis bltar med pa chosamathong ste/ shing sna tshogs desnyidag gi drung gi seng ge'i khri chen po de dag la'ang dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa/ lus shin tu mdzes pa/ spyod lam zhi ba/ rgyayid zhi ba/ shin tu dben pa/ dbang po thulasnyib / glang po laltar shin tu dul ba/ mtsho ltar dang zhing gsal lashertog pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa/ pad mo la chus mi chags pa ltar 'jig rten gyi chos kyis ma gos pa/ seng ge ltar 'jigs pa dang / skyi g.ya' ba myed pa/ mi 'jigs pa rnam par dag pas/ ri'i dbang po chen po ltar myi sgul ba/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas yid du 'ong ba'i spos kyi rgyal po ltar 'gro ba'i sems tshim par byed pa/ kha ba'i tsan dan ltar nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sman gyi rgyal po blta na bzang59)ba ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnam par zhi bar byed pa'i/ chu'i lha'i zhags pa ltar blta na donatswayod pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od tsho/nyeltar lus dang sems kyi bag yangs〈nyebade ba bskyed 1 ripa/ tshangs pa chen po ltar 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi kun nas ldang ba dang bral ba/ rin po che'i rgyal po nor bu chu 'dang miltar nyon mongs pas rnyog pa can du gyur pa'i sems can gyi sems rab tu dang bar byed pas/ zhing gshin pa ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa 38—132

'dug par mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan de dag la'ang 'khor sna tshogs 'khod par mthong ste/ 'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i bu dbang pos1)chen po la stsogs pa/gtsang ma'i gnas kyi rigs5)su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams 'khod cing dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo rnam par thar pa myi zad pa yang dag par 'byed pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni tshangs pa yid du 'ong ba la stsogs pa/ tshangs pa'i risam su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams 'khod cing dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ gzhi kun nas 'byed pa7zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyurasnyil stsogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu dang lha'i bu mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dag 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas / chos kyi sgo byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' la stsogs pa 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu9)lha'i bu mo'i⑧'khor dang bcas pa rnams pe'akhod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo nyu )thams cad dge bas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan la stsogs pa11/ dga' ldan gyi ‘/2ris su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu lha'i bu mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas chos kyi sgo rang gi sems kyi mdzod kyi glongs zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma bo38—133

la stsogs pa lha'i bu skyilha'i bu mo'i 3)'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing /dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo rgyan mtha' yas pa zhesalgebya ba yang dag par bstan pa gemathong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha'i rgyal po brgya byin la stsogs pa sum cu rtsa gsums3)gyis6)ris su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu lha'i bu mo'i 7'khor dang bcas pa rnama'age'akhod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo skyoma'o)ba'i sgo zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo ske/ /'khor gyi stan la la la ni klu'i rgyal po gang 4) chen mtsho la stsogs pa klu'i rgyal po 'od brgya pa dang / dga' bo dang bsnyenamanyadaga' bo dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / shugs ldan dang / ma dros pa la stsogs pa nyu)klu'i bu mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa klu'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang /yul gyi 'od kyi brgyanam/nyeces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni rgyal po chen po ngal bso po yil stsogs pa gnod sbyin gyi dbang po gnod sbyin gyi bu mo dang / gnod misbyin gyi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i tshamadzod ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni dri za'i rgyal po gnas srung〈nyepo la stsogs pa dri za mang po 8dri za'i bu mo dang / dri za'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo dga' ba mi zad pa charamo/cerab tu 'beb nu 1pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan la stsogs 38wa 134

pa lha ma yin rnamasatulha ma yin gyi bu mo dang / lha ma yin gyi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/chos kyi sgo chos kyi dbyings shes pa'i tshul gyi shugs kyis brgyan nga zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni nam mkha' lding gi dbang po shugs 'dzin chen po la stsogs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po nam mkha' lding gi bu mo dang / nam mkha' lding gi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgosasrid pa'i rgya mtshos 'jigs pa'i yul zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo ske/ /'khor gyi stan la la la ni mi'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la stsogs pa/ mi'am ci'i dbang po mi'am ci'i bu mo dang / mi'am ci'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa snang ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po khro gnyer gdong5sel stsogs pa/lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo dang / lto 'phye chen po'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas la dga' ba skye bsnyizhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo /'khor gyi stan la la la ni skyes pa dang / bud myed dang / khye'u dang bu mo brgya stong mang po 'khodasacing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo khyad par du 'gro ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni srin po'i dbang po rtag tu mdangs 'phrog pa sdong po'i rgyal po la stsogs pa srin po'i dbang po rtso)srin po'i bu mo dang srin po'i byis pa'i 'khor 38—135

dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/chos kyi sgo snying rje 37'byung ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni sems can nyan thos kyi theg pa la mos pa rnams 'khod cing ske/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo ye shes khyad par du 'phags pa'i mthu zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni sems can rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mos pa rnams 'khod cing ske/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya chen po'i 'od ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni sems can theg pa chen po la mos pa rnams 'khod cing /dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes snang ba'i sgo kun tu sgo zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' tsothog mar sems bskyed pa rnams 'khod cing /dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam gyi phung po zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa'adz+wa nas gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rdul dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo carab tu zhi ba'i rgyan ces bya ba yang dag par bstan bapa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bzhi pa ri skal gnas pa rnams 'khod 38—136

cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad mkhyen pa'i shugs kyi7yul 'byung ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa lnga pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sems kyi rgyud me tog gi snying po zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa drug pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge ②rnam par bsgyings pas / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnamasapar snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bdun pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sa byakun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo chos kyi dbyings su lus shin tu rnam par phye ba'i yul zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub semasasnyedapa' sa dgu pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo mi dmigs pa'i stobs kyi (netshoganas kyis brgyana'amepa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sgrib pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /'khor gyi stan la la 38—137

la ni lag na rdo rje'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo ye shes rdo rje mthu bo che'i7rgyan ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo / /de ltar skye ba'i skye mched rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad kyi sems can du gdags pa dang / sems can gyi lam gyi rgyud ji snyed pa de dag gi sems can yongs su smin pa rnam par 'dul ba/ snod du gyur pa ji snyed cig bza' shing gi ra ba der 'ongs shing / 'khor gyi stan la so sor 'khod pa/ bsam pa tha dad pa mos pa mi mtshungs pa/ bsam pa shin tu gzhol bar gyur pa/ dad pa'i ro rngamasakhuchen po dang ldan pa rnams la/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas ci nas kyang thams cadasabla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba/ de lta de ltar chos bstan pa mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa des kun tu lta ba'i btang snyoms dang ldan pa la stsogs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shin tu bstan pa la stsogs ④pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha dad pa la stsogs pa dang / sgrib pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba la stsogs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i sems yang dag par ge'abyung ba la stsogs pa dang / khyad par yod pa'i rgyan la stsogs pa dang / chags pa med pa'i tshul gyi snying po la stsogs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la stsogs pa dang / sems kyi mdzod la stsogs pa dang /kun tu mos pa mngon par sgrubasayipa'i snying po la stsogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo brgya stong grangs med pa non7pa'i phyir te/ bza' shing gi ra ba nyi ma'i mdog der byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ sems can gzhan ji snyed cig 38—138

dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa la lta hu)ba dang / chos mnyan ( )pa'i phyir 'ong ba de dag thams cad kyang sngon/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ dge ba'i chos yang dag par blang bsrel shin tu bkod pas)nas/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i bar du byas pa sha stag go/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis⑤/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba phun sum tshogs pa dang /nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtsug lag khang phun sum tshogs pa dang /'chag sa phun sum tshogs pa dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang /mal cha phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang ske/ dbang chen po phun sum tshogs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / dbyangs kyi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa de lta bu mthong ste/ chos kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang7thos nas/ chos kyi sprin gyi char chen pos sems mngon par brlan pa 1)de'i yid la tsodage slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa phun sum tshogs par byas kyis da hunyeni g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan brgya stong du ma zhig tu hu bya'o snyam pa dang / de'i med la dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ bza' shing gi ra ba dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du bcas pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /de ltar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba bya'o/ /snyam du bsams nas bskor 1dab byed pa'i tshe/ 'khor thams cad na'ang dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa 'dug pa mthong nas mdun du 'dug ste/thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa 38—139

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas hu)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do/ /zhes bdag gis thos na/'phags ma ji ltar ②byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa zhes bya ba thob pa'ol/ /smras pa/'phags ma byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa de'i yul ji lta bu byazhig mchis/ smras pa rigs kyi bu de ni ye shes snang ba ste/ dus gsum du byung ba'i rgyan sems skad cig gi cha shasasnyil rnam par dmigs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /smras pa/ 'phags ma sne)ye shes snang ba de'i yul yang ji lta bu zhig mchis/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ye shes snang ba 'di la sgrub pa dang yongs su5bsgrub pa'i tshe chos thams cad rab tu 'thad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes te/ ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyis phyogs bcu thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa dga' ldan gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa/ thams cad re re la yang lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mchod pa rnam pa tha dad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi (pemachod pa sbyar ba'i phyir 'gro ste/'di ltar lha'i lus dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam 38wa 140

mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dbang po'inyelus me tog gi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / spos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / bdug spos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin nga/ dang / phrengatshababa'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / byug pa'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang /phye ma'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / na bza'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang /gdugs kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rgyal mtshan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / ba dan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i lhab lhub kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i ④dra ba'i rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'isnyiganam yol gyi rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang ske/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam par phye ba'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i sgron ma'i rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i gdan (gegyi rgyan gyi mesprin yongs su 'dzin pa mang pos mchod pa sbyar ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa rnams la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ ji ltar 'gro ba de bzhin du yum gyi skur gshegs pa dang / bltam pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / snying po byang chub tu gshegs pa dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas shing snying po byang chub la bzhugasamathopa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i 3)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / de bzhin du lha'i gnas na bzhugs pa dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding ⑨dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma 38—141

yin pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa dngashe/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang bsam pa yongs su tshim par mdzad nas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar de dag thams cad la'ang yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus rnam pa de lta bu dag gis rnam pa de lta bu'i mchod pa byed cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'gro'ol/ /sems can gang gis kho mo5misangs rgyas mchod pa dang / rim gro byed pa'i lasashe'adi shes par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang kho mo'i drung du 'ong ba de dag thams cad la'ang kho mo ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa 'di nyid ston te④/ rigs kyi bu kho mosheye shes kyi mig gis sems can thams cad la lta 0yang / sems can gyi 'du shes kyang mi bskyedashel/ rlom sems kyang mi byed deni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho yang nyanamanyute/ tshig gi lam thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pas / rlom sems su byed pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mthong ste/ chos kyi lus yongs su shes pas rlomatshware sems su byed pa med dome/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi skyona'akhor lo yongs su 'dzin kyang /chos kyi rang bzhin khong du chud pas rlom sems su byed pa med do/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs kyang / chos nyid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin khong du chud pas rlom sems su byed pa myed hunyedo/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i 7rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' mchos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa la zhugs pa/ chos thams 38—142

cad la rlom sems med par gnas kyang skyil mo krung ①gcig gis chos kyi ②dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rang gi lus su 'dus par ston kyang / skad cig gcig gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'dong ba/ lus la sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'byung zhing rgyu bdu/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa ba duspu'i nyag ma gcig dugis sbams shing mngon par 'phen pa/ rang gi ba spu'i bu gar 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa⑥'du ba dang / 'jig ⑦pa'i bskal pa yongs su ston pa/ skad cig gcig la bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par gnas pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyis yang dag par 'dzud pa/ skad cig gcig gis brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal par 'khor ba ⑧de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi yul bgrod dka' ba na/ grong khyer rin po che'i 7rgyan ces bya ba yod de/ de na bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma zhes bya ba 'dug gis de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par byarwa1ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tsodage slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs shes rab kyi nyunyesnang ba chen po des sems snang bar gyur pa de thams 38—143

cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ①snang ba de la ni sems/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi stobs snang ba de la ni yang dag par rjes su ltal/ sems can thams cad kyi skad rnam par dmyigs pa'i mdzod kyi gzungs kyi tshul de ni brtan par byed/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par 'dzin pa'i gzungs kyi tshul de ni shin tu rgya che bar7byed/ snying rje chen po 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs su gyur pa'i stobs de ni nye bar ston④/ chos thams cad kyi tshul snang ba'i sgo nas yang dag par 'byungasnyiba'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shugs de la ni rab tu rtog /chos kyi dbyings rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par 'gengs pa'i smon lam yongs su dag pa de'i rjes su ni 'brang / chos thams cad kyi phyogs snang bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi 'od de ni shin tu gsal bar byed/chos thams cad kyisar+sā)phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par phye ba rgyas par 'gengs pa'i mngon par shes pa'i stobs de ni mngon par sgrub/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam57dang / dran pa thams cad nye bar blangs pas brtsams pa mthar dbyung phyonaba'i smon lam de ni yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / mthar gyis yul bgrod dka' ba'i grong khyer rin po che'i rgyan gang na ba der phyin te/bcom pa 'onam lha'i bshes gnyen ma yongs su tshol tshol ba dang / de la bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan mngon par mi shes la ye shes kyi spyod yul gyi tshul la mi mkhas pa'i mitshamaji snyed pa de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ mi 'di de ltar zhi zhing dul (1ba'i dbang po dang ldan la 12de ltar shes bzhin dang ldan te/de ltar 'khrul pa med cing de ltar yid 'khrug pa med la de ltar gnya' shing gang tsam du lta ste/ de ltar gnod pas mi tshugs shing de ltar mtshan mar mi 'dzin la/38—144

gzugs kyi rnam pa thams cad la g.yeng ba med pa'i mig dang ldan te①/ yid la brel ②ba med cing / bsam pa zab la mngon par mdzes te/ rgya mtsho ltar 'dug cing sems mi nyams mi 'khrug pa ⑧de la bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen mas ko ci zhig bya/ 'di lta bu dag ni 'dod chags la dga' ba med de/sems phyin ci log dang ldan yang mi srid do/ /'di lta bu dag ni sdug cing gtsang ba'i 'du shes yongs su rgyu bsremed de/ 'di lta bu dag ni 'dod pas 'kholasnyikyang mi srid do/ /'di lta bu dag ni bud med kyi dbang du 'gyur ba med de/'di lta bu dag ni bdud kyi spyod yul la spyod kyang mi srid do/ /'di lta bu dag ni bdud kyi spyodakyiyul la chags pa med de/ 'di lta bu dag ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying bsheyang mi srid do/ /'di lta bu dag ni bdud kyi zhags pas bcings par 'gyur ba med de/ mi dgosalgepa byed kyang mi srid do snyam mo/ /gang yang bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma'i yon tan gyi khyad par mngon par shes shing /ye shes kyi spyod yul mngon du gyur pa de dag ni 'di skad ces 'dzer te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma la yongs su dri bar sems pas1nini khyod kyang thob par bya ba 7legs par thob pa ste/ legs so legs so/ /khyod ni nges par sangs rgyas su smon pa'o/ /khyod ni bdag nges par sems can thams cad kyi〈nyaganas su bsgyur nyugebar 'dod pa'o/ /khyod ni nges par sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags kyi zug rngu dbyung bar 'dod pa'o/ /khyod ni nges par sdug cing gtsang ba'i 'du shes rnam par gtor / bar 'dod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'de re (stebacom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma ni grong khyer gyi lam gyi nyugesum mdo'i byang phyogs logs shig na rang gi khyim na 'dug go/ /de nas tshong 38—145

dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tshig de0)thos nas dga' rangs te④/ mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ bcom pa mnyelha'i bshes gnyen ma'i khyim gang na ba der phyin nas/ de'i khyim che zhing yangs la rin po che'i ra ba rim pa bcus bskor ba/ rin po che ta la'i phreng ba rim pa bcus kun nas bskor ba/ 'obs spos chus gang ba/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i pad mo dang /uta pa la dang / ku mu ta dang / me tog pun da ri gas chu yongs su khebs pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang bani/ gzhi gser gyi bye ma bdal7ba/ spos yid du 'ong ba dang / 'dres pa'i chu dri zhim pas5nyegang ba/rin po chenesil ma mang pos shin tu brgyan pa/ rim pa bcus kun nas bskor ba / rin po che thams cad las byas pa'i7khang pa dang / gzhal med khang dang ske/ khang pa brtsegs pas rnam par dgrigs 8shing ba gam dang rta babs dang ske/ skar khung gi shar bu dang / zla gamatsoseng ge'i shing tags dang /snang ba'i rgyal mtshan la stsogs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od kyis 'bar ba rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs grangs med pa'i 'byung gnas kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dag ra bai ḍūr+yas spras〈snyepa'i gzhimakhyedang ldan pa/ lha rdzas kyi spos zhim po thams cad kyis 'khor thams cad nas bdugs7shing bsangs pa/ a ku ru nag po mchog gi5nyebadug spos kyis dri zhim par bdug5)pa/ spos kyi byug pas 'khor kun nas byugs pa ste/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi lan kun 0gyis rtsig ngos kun tu bres pa/ steng 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi dra ba rin po che sna tshogs kyis rab tu spras pas5)kun nas bkab pa/ gser gyi dril gyi nyedra ba brgya stong rlung gis bskyod cing 'khrol ba'i sgra yid du〈 ce'ong zhing snyan pa 'byung ba/ rin 38—146
