po che thams cad kyi me tog gi sprin sil ma kun tu bkram pas/ rin po che'i me tog gi ①rgyan dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng bas sgo shin tu brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od kyi dra ba snang ba/ mu med par brjod du yod pa/ rin po che byu ru'i〈sdong po dang /rdo rje dang ①/ man shel la stsogs pa'i gter brgya stong kun gyis ④shis pa/phun sum tshogs pasasnyimadzod mi zad pa dang ldan pa/ bza' shing gi ra ba chen po bcus brgyan pa mthong ste/ de na bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma gzugs mdzes shing bzang rgyal blta na sdug pa/ gya rnam pa'i kha dog dam pa ⑧rgyas pa dang ldan pa/ gser gyi kha dog ltar 'dug pa'i mdog can skra mthon ting7du 'dug pa/ lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag tshul dang 'dra bar rnam par grub pa/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha dang mi thams cad las 'phags pa'i kha dog dang gzugs dang dbyibs mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ tshangs pa las kyang 'das pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sgra skad kyi tshul la mkhas pa/ rgyanarwatethams cad dang ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs can rnam par thar pa yi ge'i 'khor lo'i ()rgyan la mkhas pa dang ldan pa/ bzo dang gtsug lag thams cad la mkhas par byung〈nyab/ chos kyi ye shes sgyu ma la mkhas par bslabasalgepa/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs dang tshul rnam pa thams cad du 8thob pa/ rin po che'i lhab lhub sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan ④pa'i lus yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ rin po che thams cad las byas pa'i dra ba 'od shin tu gsal bas lus rab tu brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyan dang /lhab lhub grangs med pas rab tu brgyan pasahunye/ lus shin tu 'bar ba/ nor 38—147

bu rin po che dam pa yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i codamanyapan thogs pa/ rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i phreng meb mdo zungs rdo rje rin po che sna tshogs dang / nor bu rin po che seng ge chosamadzes pa sna tshogs bkye ba mgul na thogs ④pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba spyad pa la skal ba 'thun pa dang / smon lam gcig pa'i 'khor mang po gzhan gyis mi phyed cing yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po'i gter mi zad pa'i mdzod dang ldan pa 'dug pa ⑤mthong ste/des55)khyim de dag thams cad dang / rin po che'i gnas dang / gzhal med khang gisargyan de dag thams cad kyang rang gi lus las byung ba'i 'od dga' bar byed pa/ lus bde ba dang sim 8)pa skyedashepa/ sems khong nas tidaga' bar byed pas gsal zhing nyanyesnang bar byas pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis nyunyebacom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyedamanyarten/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags mas bdag la bstanatswadu gsol/ des smras pa rigs kyi bu kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa zhes bya ba thob ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni lha rnams la 7lha mo'i gzugs dang 38—148

kha dog dang / dbyibs dang chu zheng las kyang lhag par kha dog gsal ba dang /rnam par dag pas ci la7mos pa bzhin du snang bar byed do/ /de bzhin du klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la yang bud med kyi gzugs dang / kha dogashobadang dbyibs dang / chu zheng lhag par 'od gsal zhing rnam par dag pas ci la mos pa bzhin du snang bar byed do/ /sems can gang 'dod chags kyis kun nas 'khor ba'i sems dang ldan pa dag /kho mo'i drung du 'ong gna'ang de dag thams cad la kho mo ni 'dod chags dang 'bralasnyibar 'gyur ba'i phyir chos ston gte/ de dag gis chos de thos nas kyang 'dod chags dang bral ba 6)thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ⑦chags pa med pa zhes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni kho mo mthong ma thag tu 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ④te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dga' ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yang tsherab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni gtam byas pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 'gyur te( 7/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chags pa med pa'i dbyangs shes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni lag nas hunyebazung ba tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rjes su 'gro zhing gnas pa zhes bya ba'ang nyi rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni gcig tu 'grogs pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 'gyur te / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bral bas snang ba zhes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni bltas pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 38—149

'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu zhi ba'i rnam par brgyan hu)ces bya ba yang rab tu thob bo/ /la la ni glal lab tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin pas kyis rgol ba rnam par 'thor ba bzhes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo la la ni myig btsums pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi ⑤yul snang ba zhes bya ba yang ⑥rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni pang du 'khyud57pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba 'thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sdur7cing myi gtong ba'i snying po zhes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo/ /la la ni 'o byas pa tsam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba 'thob par 'gyur te/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad bsod nams kyi mdzod la reg par byed pa zhes bya ba yang rab tu 'thob bo/ /de ltar kho mo ni sems can gang ji snyed cig kho mo'i drung du 'ong ba de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa 'chags pa med pa la tshimangon du gyur pa 'di nyid la rab tu 'god do/ /smras pa/ 'phags ma khyod de lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de khyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba ni gang du bskyed/ phrin (halas ni ji lta bu zhig bstsags(2la/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho mos dran na 'das pa'i dus shig na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa3nye/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i (heb lo sgyur (snyeb/ lha dang mi'i ston pa (938—150

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shin tu mtho7)bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu mtho bar gshegs pa de sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sku medon tu rgyal po'i gnas sgo bzang po zhes bya bar gshegs nas sgo'i them pa la zhabs kyis gnon ④pa'i tshe/ grong khyer de thams cad kyang / rab tu g.yos nas yangs shing rgya che la rin po che du ma las byas par yongs su grub par dugyur te/ steng gi bar snang yang rin po che mang po'i 'od kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba dang/ lha rdzas kyi rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra rab tu 'byung ba dang / lha'i lus kyi sprin tshad med pa 0rgya che bas khebs par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo yang de'i tshe tshong dpon gyi chung ma zhig tu gyur te/ blo gros bzang mo zhes bya'o/ /de nas kho mo cho 'phrul gyis7yang dag par bskulashenas khyim thab dang lhanabacig tu dong7dong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa grong bar gyi srang du gshegs pa la dad pa rgya chen po skyes te⑩/ kho mos ni 37rin po che'i dril bu gcig cig phularwa lo/ /de'i tshe 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu mtho bar gshegs pa'i zham 'bring〈nyen 'dug temi/ des kho mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i 8thabs dang ye shes mtha' yas pa la gnas pa/ bsod nams rgya che zhing yangs pa'i mdzod dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi yul la thub pa med pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na 38—151

grong khyer dge ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na khyim bdag nan khugs shes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten tsan dan gyi khri 'phang can la mchod pa byed ①pa zhig 'dug gisal/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisamanyabacom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te( )/ bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma'isnyidrung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis7grong khyer dge ba'i pha rol tu phyin par khyim bdag nan khugs kyi khyim ga la ba der phyin nas/khyim bdag nan khugs kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑧byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang ske/ ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do/ /zhes bdag gis thos nas6)/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags pas bdag la bshad du gsol/ des smras pa rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa yongs su mi zad pa thob pa ste/ rigs kyi bu kho bo'i〈rtesems kyi rgyud las ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas kyang / sems 38—152

can 'dul ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ma gtogs par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas kyang shin tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i 3)tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa med do/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba med do / /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba med do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten tsan dan gyi khri 'phang kyis sgo 'byed pa ste / kho bosamachod rten gyi sgo 'byed 'byedasnyipas byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi zad pa'i rgyan7ces bya ba thob bo/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid la sems kyi skad cigasheskad cig tu mnyam par gzhog ⑧ste/ sems kyi skad cig thams cad la'ang khyad par gyi rnam pa du ma rab tu 'thob bo/ /smras pa/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin de'i yul ji lta bu zhig mchis / smras pa rigs kyi bu kho bo ⑨ting nge 'dzin 'di la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'di sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bsod skyabs tu nyel stsogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /gser thub dang / log par dad sel dang / thams cad mnga' ba dang /gtsug tor can〈medang / rnam par gzigs dang / rgyal hurtedang / rdzogs mdzad dang / grags mchog dang / pad mo'i bla nyartel stsogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang sangs rgyas mthong ba'i mtshams 'brel pas sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul gyis mngon sum du mthong ste/ sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas brgya yang mthong ngo /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas stong yang mthong ngo / /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas brgya phrag stong yang mthong ngo / /de bzhin du sangs rgyas 38—153

bye ba dang / sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgya dang / sangs rgyas bye ba phrag stong dang ske/ sangs rgyas bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dang /sangs rgyas bye ba dung phyur dang / sangs rgyas bye ba thams thams ①dang /sangs rgyas bye ②ba khrag khrig ①dang / de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas 'byung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud7pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag kyang mthong ngo / /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang mthong ngo / /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis thugs dang po bskyed pa'i tshogs gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa la'ang ④'jug go thugs dang po bskyed pas 'thob pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la'ang 'jug gol/ /smon lam rnam pa tha dad pa mngon par bsgrubs dupa rnam par dag pa la'ang 'jug go/ /spyod pa rnam par dag pa la'ang 'jug go/ /pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa la'angamatho'ajug go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad yongs su bsgrubs nadapa la'ang 'jug go/ /bzod pa brnyes pa rnam par dag pa la'ang 'jug go/ /bdud kyi dkrugs mashernam par 'thor ba'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba la'ang 7'jug go/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan la'angs/rkya'ajug go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par mdzad pa rnam pa /rtetha dad pa la'ang 'jug go/ /sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa rnam pa tha dad pa la'ang 3)'jug go/ /'khor kun nas 'dus pa rnam parwa tha dad pa la'ang ge'ajug go/ / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa tha dad 38—154

pa la'angatu'ajug go/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khyu mchog gi⑧mthu phyung ba la'ang7'jug go/ /sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrulasnyidang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang /cho 'phrul la'ang 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gisasnyichos bstan pa yang shin tu rnam par gsal ba dang / ma 'dres par dran te/ yang dag par 'dzin to/ /dran pas yongs su bcangs so/ /rig⑧pas rab tu shes par byed do/ /blo gros kyis shin tu rnam par 'byed do/ /blos rtogs par byed do/ /shes rab kyis snang bar byed do/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i ⑨byams pa la stsogs pa dag kyang mthong zhing shes te/ sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas brgya yang ⑩mthong ngo / /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas stong yang mthong ba nas/ de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyitshwa)zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag kyang mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis thugs dang po bskyed pa'i tshogs gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa la'ang 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis chos bstan patsoyang shin tu gsal 32ba dang / ma 'dres par 8rjes su dran te yang dag par 'dzin to/ /dran pas yongs su bcangs so/ /rigashepas rab tu shes par byed do/ /blo gros kyisanyernam par 'byed do/ /blos the 1rtogs par byed do/ /shes rab kyis snang bar byed do/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'di sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud nyu)pa mthong zhing shes pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa 38—155

gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 0)pa thams cad kyang shes shing mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis tsho thugs dang po bskyed pa'i tshogs gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ri )la'ang 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud la/pa de la'ang rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / mi zad pa dang / dad pasasnyishes par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus dang / zhe non pasamaju'u khong du chud par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i0)brtson 'grus kyi shugs rnam par 'phel bar byed pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / de'i yul lasazhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs pa59)shes shing khong du chud par byed do / /rnam par snang mdzad la stsogs pa da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad kyang mthong zhing shes te/ sems kyi skad cig gcig la7) sangs rgyas brgya yang mthong zhing shes so/ /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas stong yang mthong ba nas/ de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i nya15rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bar du72yang mthong ste/ nam de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi nyu zhal blta bar dga' ba de'i tshe'ang de bzhin du mthong ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis bstan pa dang / bstan pa sgomadzad pa dang / bstan par 'gyur ba de dgatsha8kyang thos sol/ /thos nas kyang 'dzin to/ /dran pas yongs su bcangs so/ /rigs pas rab tu shes par byed do/ /blo gros kyis rnam par 'byed 1 cido/ / blos rtogs par byed do/ /18shes rab kyis snang bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang 38wa 156

chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa yongs su mya ngan las mi7)'da' ba'i mthar phyin pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum skad cig gcig tu shes pa rab tu thob pa/ skad cig gcig ( gi cha shas la ting nge 'dzin rnam par phye ba la spyad0)pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma las byungachab rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog 'a)pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud pa/sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin rjes su rtogs pa/ bdag dang sems can dang / sangs rgyas mi gnyis par spyod pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i chos kyi rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi 'khrul 'khor kyis 'jig rten gyi dra ba 'gengs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho thams cad dang / mi 'gal bar rnam par spyod pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rnam par7rtogs par byed pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchos bstan pa rnam par rig par byed pa'i ye shes kyi yul can de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na ri gru 'dzin ces bya ba yod de/ de na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po zhes bya ba 'dug gis(87/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi rigeb dang / ji ltar nan tan nya du bgyis31ba dris shig ces nas de'i tshe/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis smras so/ /song shig nor bzangs dpal gyi chu rgyal dbung zhig na/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 32ri rgyal gru 'dzin mdzes pa yod/ /rin chen rgyus byas shing dang nags tshal me tog mang / /bza' shing ra ba rdzing dang chu bran 'bab par ldan1lha/ /ri mchog de la brtan 38—157

par nyu7spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i don du rnam par spyod/ /de'i (migan song dang nor bzangs khyod la mgon po yis / /yon tan rgya chen tshul la 'jug pa ston par (7byed/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis du khyim bdag nan khugs 6)kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ khyim bdag nan khugs la lan brgya stong du mar pagayas phyogs su bskor ba byas tespri/ yang dang yang bltas nas khyim bdag nan khugs kyi drung nas song ngo// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/kha bam po lnga 3 )pa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs khyim bdag nano khugs kyi gdams ngag rjes su sems shing / byang chub sems dpa'i mos pa'i mdzod de ni shes par byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su dran pa'i stobs de ni rjes su dran par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i stobs ni yang dag par 'dzin1sto/ sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i mtshams ni khong du chud par byed/ rnas 32thos pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan de dag gi 32rjes su ni 14'brang / sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i tshul de dang 8ni 'thun par byed/sangs rgyas kyis 15yang dag par bsgrub pa'i rgyan de ni khong du chud par byed/sangs rgyas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba de la ni yid ches par byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin tsu las bsam gyis mi khyab pa de ni mngon du byed cing / mthar gyis ri gru 'dzin gang na ba der song nyunyenas/ri gru 'dzin gyi steng nyurtedu phyin te/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yongs su rmed cing tshol tshol ba las/ nub phyogs 3 3logs kyi ri'i sman 38wa 158

ljongs7mtsho dang / mtshe'u dang 'babakechus mdzes par gyur pa/ be+e ḍūr+yarasne/sngon po'i dkyil 'khor ltar sngo zhing 'jam la gzhon pa'i spang / nags tshalasachen po'i mthongasalgen 'dug pa zhig na/ rin po che'ipo)rdo rje'i rdo stegs7shig la skyil mo krung ⑧bcas te 'dug cing / rin po che sna tshogs kyi rdo stegs ⑨la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas/ kun nas bskor cing chos ston te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sdud pa'i yul byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'i sgo gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba yang dag par ston cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' rangs te kyimagu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas dga' bas rgyas zhing mi 'dzum (3 pa'i mig gis thal mo sbyar nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dad pa'i shugs dang ldan pas sems mi 'khrug71pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong na3nye/sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bar 'dzin pa3nye/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'i chos kyi sprin thams cad yang dag par gzung ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/yon tan dang nan tan thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag lus pa'i 'du shes can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa 8shin tu dka' 8bar sems payi/dge ba'i bshes gnyen las stobs bcu'i ye shes rin po che 'byung zhing thob par 'gyur ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las 3)snang ba mi zad pa 'byung ba'i 'du shes can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rten gyi 3)bsod nams kyi rgyud rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 37ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo yang dag par ston pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/du bye dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen po la 'jug pa'i dzo 1 38—159

yongs su ston 1)par 'du shes pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs yang dag par 'dus pa/ yongs su bskyedabapa'i 'du shes dang ldan pa de / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po gang naphub der phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs ring zhig nas tshur 'ong ba mthong nas/ smras pa/tshur shog dpe 5med pa'i theg pa chen po yangs shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa/ skye ba las 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses shing skyabs 4)kyimed par gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab 2 pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa / sangs rgyas kyi 9chos thams cad mngon sum du gyur pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las 'das te dpe 1 rimed tshad med pa la mngon par mos pa/ snying rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pas11/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab nyarte pa'i blo gros can/ blta na kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la )snyemangon du bltas pa/smon lam chen po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyang ba'i kyi cisems dang ldan pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yongs su gzung 1debar mos pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bstsags pas ngoms mi shes pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams 10ngag la yang dag par 1 zhugs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi 1 ye shes rgya mtsho las byung ba'i yon tan gyi 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 1tshethob par bya ba la mngon du bltas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba dang shugs rab tu thob pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin gyi char yang dag par gzung ba la mngon par mos pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas 2 mthong bas dga' ba dang / mos pa'i shugs kyis yid rab tu bde bar gyur pa/ legs par 38—160

spyod pa tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i shugs kyis mngon par brlan pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ yon tan la nan tan du bya ba'i shugs kyis rnam par dag pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mdzod bdag la mngon du gyur pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i lam gyi shugs gzhan la yongs su bstan pa'i bsam pa can/ snying rje chen po'i shugs ma 1)nyams pa'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes snang ba'i shugs yang dag par gzung ba'i blo gros can khyod 'ongs pa legs so legs sogaci/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa' (spyan ras gzigs kyisal dbang po gang na ba der song nas/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na6/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 7ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags pas bdag la bshad du gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos 8mdog 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa 'od kyi dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs tshad med pa 9'phro ba'i rgyan gyi sprin rab tu 'gyed pa'i lag pa g.yas pa 38—161

brkyang te1/ mtshan dang dpe tshonabyad bzang po las byung ba'i 'od gzer sna tshogs sa dri ma med pa/ lus dang sems kyi bde ba tshad med pa rab tu skyed 'apa'i tshogs kyis shin tu rgyas pa'i lag pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 95cispyi bo la bzhag ste/ 'di 6skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so / /rigs kyi bu nga ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo snying rje chen po'i sgo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba shes te/ rigs kyi bu nga ni 3)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo snying rje chen po'i sgo thogs pa med pa de ni 'gro ba thams cad la dbye ba med par sems can yongs su phyin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la zhugs pa sgo 2rikun nas thos49shing rnam par rig par 'gyur bas/ sems can yongs su bsdu ba dang / gdul ba la nye bar gnas pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar nga 0byang chub sems dpa'i 1 spyod pa'i sgo snying rje chen po'i sgo thogs pa med pa la gnas pas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sems can thams cad kyi dgos pa la'ang 1 sta gon du gnas te/ sbyin pas kyang sems can yongs su sdud 1 do/ /ngag snyan pa dang don bya ba dang / don 'thun pas kyang sems can yongs su bsdud 'do/ /gzugs kyi lus rnam par bstan pas kyang ske/ sems can yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /kha dog dang dbyibs dang gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan te/ rnam par dmigs par bya ba dang /'od gzer kyi dra ba dgye 15bas kyang sems can rab tu tshim 7par byed cing yongs su phyin par byed do/ /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbyangs brjod pa dang /ci la dga' ba'i spyod lam yongs su bstan pa dang / mos pa sna tshogs dang /38wa 162

tshul 'thun par chos bstan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul 41pa sna tshogs dang / dge ba'i chos nabastsags par bag myi byed pa'i sems can gyi sems yongs su bskul ba dang / bsam pa dang 'thun par sprul pa sna tshogs tshad med pa yongs su bstan pa dang / rigs sna tshogs su skyes pa'i sems can rnams dang tsho skal ba 'thun pa'i gzug layongs su bstan 5pa dang / gnas gcig tu 'grogs pas kyang sems can yongs su bsdus 6shing yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar ngas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo snying rje chen po'i sgo thogs pa med pa 'di yongs su sbyangs pas/ 'gro ba thams cad rab tu rten pa'i smon lam bskyed de/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi g.yang sa'i 'jigs 7pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 8rgyud kyi 'jigs pa zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 9mgo rmongs pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 1 bcings pa'i 'jigs pa yongs su gcad 17pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi srog la bab par mi bde ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 12yo byad kyis phongs pa'i 1lha'ajigs pa bsal ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho ba med pa'i 'jigs pa zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi grags pa med pa'i 'jigs pa las yongs su bzla ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'khor du bag tsha ba'i 'jigs pa med par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las rnam par bzla ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lam mun 1 pas 38—163

nyam nga ba phyir mi ldog pa'i snang bas gsal bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad 1skal ba mi mnyam pa dang 'grogs pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu bsal ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi 5sdug pa sa dang bral ba'i 'jigs pa dgag par bya ba dang 4/ sems can thams cad kyi mi sdug pa dang / 'grogs pa'i 'jigs pa med par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad lus la mi bde ba'i 'jigs pa dang bral bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad sems la mi bde ba'i 'jigs pa las dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi mu bde ba dang 'khrugs 6pa las yongs su bzla ba'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad rab tu rten pa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub 7dpa 'di byas so/ /sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa rnam par zhi bar 3bya ba'i phyir yang 'jig rten du rjes su dran pa'i sgo byin gyis brlabs so/ /sems can thams cad 'jigs pa dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi mying 7'khor lo yang 'jig rten du rnam par dmigs par byas so/ /dus ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro bas rnam par dmyigs par bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad kyi 1 rnam pa'i bye brag 11mtha' yas pa dang mnyam par nga'i lus kyang byin gyis brlabs so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar nga ni thabs 'dis sems can thams cad 'jigs pa las yongs su bkrol cing 1rtesangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing 1 phyir mi ldog par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu ngas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo snying rje chen po'i sgo thogs pa med pa 'di thob par zad na/ ngas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par dag pa/38—164

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa khong du chud par rtogs pa/dge ba'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba rgyun mi gcod pa'i rgyud 1dang ldan pa/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyud la rtag tu mnyam par gzhagamatsho pa/ bskal pa thams cad du gnas shing spyod pa las phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ dus gsum thams cad kyi tshul rjes su rtogs pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi klong yongs su 'khyil pa'i rgyud la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i sems rnam par zhi bar byed pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i sems yongs su 'phel ba'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i rgyudam las phyir mi galdog par byed pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs bskor ba byas te gus par bkur bstod 5rinas/ /nor bzangs shin tu dul ba nelho phyogs rgyud du song / /spyan ras gzigs dbang drang srong snying rje rnam /spyod pal/ /rin chen ri'i tshon)sul na gnas par des kyang mthong / /rin chen sna tshogs rdo rje'i ri yi sman ljongs 9rin/ /pad+ma'i snying po'i 1 seng ge'i khri la brtan par hunya'adug /lha dang lha min klu dang srin po mi 'am ci/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bskor cing de la chos kyang ston/ /mthong nas nor bzangs dga' ba tshad med skyes par gyur/ /bsnyen te yon tan rgya mtsho'i rkang 12la phyag 'tshal nas/ /ci nas bzang po'i spyod pa bdag gis thob 'gyur bar12/ /'phags pas thugs rje bskyed de gdams shing bslab par migasol/ /bsod nams brgya pas 'bargyan pa'i dri med lag brkyang 7ste/ /'od sprin dra ba rgya chen bzang po rab bton 38—165

nasasku/ske/ /nor bzangs spyi bor bzhagasho ste sems can rnam dag pa/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po mkhas pas tshig 'di smras/ /sangs rgyas sras po nga zhuni rnam thar cagacig sgo shes/ /ye shes snying po rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje sdugazhi/ /'gro ba thams cad bskyab cing yongs su bsdu phyir byung / / kun tum ribadag nyid rang la byams pa bzhin du rgyu/ /'gro ba mang po thams cad sdug bsngal kun las skyob / /gang rnams dam du bcings shing57/dgra lag5nyephyin pa dang / /lus la gzer cing de bzhin btson rar btsud hupa yang nga yi hu )ming thos bcings shing /1bzung ba thar nyu2bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po dag la nyes pa'i g.yon hunyebyas gsad spangs pa/ /de tshe de dag nga yi 6ming yang dran gyur lon/ /mda' 'phangs de yi 7lus la phog par mi 'gyur te/ /mtshon rnon btab kyang de dag mi 'dzug sgal 1 bar 'gyur/ /dbang po'i 'khor du phyin kyang /snyegang rnams rtsod 3tshegyur pa/ /dgra rnams kun las rgyal 'gyur grags pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /grags dang grogs dang rigs dang nor rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ / nga yi (2 ming dran de dag thub pa med par 'gyur/ /gang gis nga yi 7 nyaming ni ni rjes su dran byas pa/ /de dag rkun ri rtepos 'jigs dogs dgras 'jigs nags phyin te/ /seng ge dom gzig gcan zan g.yag rgod sbrul gang yang / /dgra rnams kun las rgyal zhing 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /gang rnams la las nga yi 3 nyeming zhig dran byas na/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis rin chen stongs dgesu bor gyur tam/ /sol mdag lci me 39rab tu 'bar bar bor gyur kyang / /me rnams pad mos gang ba'i chu yi cigater du 'gyur/ / nga yir ming ni skad 'ga' yud tsam rjes dran na / /rgya mtsho'i chur bor de yi nirtenang du 'chis )mi 'gyur/ /chu bos mi 'khyer me 38wa 166

yi7dbus su tshig ②mi 'gyur/ /don med kun tu mi 'gyur don rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /shing sgrog dbyig chings lcags misgrog de bzhin ltung rnams dang / /brnyas ④shing khyad bsad de bzhin brid cing snibaslus pa dang / /spyos shing bsdigs 0te gshe dang sma phab rnam pa las/ / nga yi57)ming tsam dran par byas natshanathar pashethob/ /gang rnams shar gnyer 3 )sna tshogs glags lta51ji snyed dang / /gang rnams rtag tu zhe sdang mi snyan brjod pa'i 12rnams/ / nga yis)ming thos dran byas snyan par brjod par mi'agyur/ /mthong ba tsam gyis med la byams pa'i sems kyang skye/ / nga yi7ming tsam la la 8gang gis dran byas nas/ sna/ /gnod pa'i don du ro langs sngags dang byad byed pa'i/ /dgra rnams rtag tu de yi 32zil gyis non par 'gyur/ /ma lus dug gis de yi 3)lus la mi tshugs so/ /la la〈 )gang gis nga yi du 1ming tsam dran byas na/ /klu dbang srin tshogs mkha' lding sha za thams cad dang / /grul bum srul po 'tshe byed gtum po'i sems dang ldan nye / /mdangs 'phrog 'jigs byed rmi lam 'ong ba'ang zhi bar 'gyur/ / nga yilo ming ni skad cig yud tsam dran byas kyang / /pha dang ma dang gnyen bshesamanyemadza' ba kun dang yang / /'bral bar mi 'gyur sdang dang 'grogs par de bzhin min/ /nor zad mi 'gyur phongs pa'i dngos su mi 'gyur ro/ / nga yi ming gi (nyerjes su la la dran byed na/ /'di nas shi 'phos mnar med sems dmyal mi 'gro ste/ /byol song tsho )skye gnas yi dgas mi khom gnas su min/ /sems can dag la ()lha dang mi yi 32gnas su skye/ / nga yis rteming ni la la gang gis dran byas na/ /dmus long zhar ba 'on pa zha bor mi 'gyur te/ /'theng tsho ripo long bar mi 'gyur gsal smra 21blta sdug 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por 38wa 167

dbang por 1kun ldan 'gyur/ /la la gang gis nga yi dmying ni rjes dran na/ /sems can dag pa 'di nas shi 'phos phyogs bcu yi ri/ /'jig rten khams su sangs rgyas mngon sum skye bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mthong 'gyur de dag chos kyang thos par 'gyur/ /'di dang de bzhin gzhan dag thabs mang ji snyed kyis/ /'gro bar sems can nga 'dul gzhal dang zad mi nus/ /sangs rgyas sras po ngas ni rnam thar gcig bsgoms ter/ /yon tan can gyi yon tan thams cad ngas mi shes/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba zhes bya ba shar phyogs nas nam mkha'i dbyings las 'ongs te45/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor 6yug gi rtse mor 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro bas/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor /yug gi rtse mo la rkang pa gnyis bor ma thag du/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/ rin po che du ma'i rang bzhin du kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nagazhan du myi 'gro ba des/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od thams cad zil gyis non pa dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye lachen po dang /brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po dang / me dang rin po che dang / glog lha dang / skar ma'i 'od kyang zil gyis non pa de lta bu'i 'od lus las 11bkye ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag kyang snang bar byas/byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi 12lam gyi rgyud thibs po thams cad kyang snang bar byas te / ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad kyang de ma thag tu zhi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa yang nyams su mi 38—168

gnod ①par gyur to(5ci/ /mya ngan gyi zug rngu dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyang rtse zil ri bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di 4thams cad du'ang rin po che'i sprin gyi char phab ste/ me tog dang spos dang / bdug pa dang / phreng 5ba dang ske/ byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par phab ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ngo //de'i lus de'i gzugs brnyan ni sems can thams cad 6gnas su snang ba ste bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du tshim 0par byed pa la mngon par gzhol bas/ ri gru 'dzin de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i drung du yang phyin par snang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba 8'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir phyin pa mthong ngam/ smras pa 'phags pa mthong ngo / /smras pa rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i 9spyod pa la bslab par bgyi 1 chib dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 11byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rkang pa gnyis 32la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po la/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/1 byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu 1 nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i ye shes kyi 38—169

gting ma rnyed pa'i sems kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po blta bas 3)kyang ma ngoms bzhin du bsgo ba dang / mi 'gal bar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba gang na ba der song ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i rkang pa gnyis rigal spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag51dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags pas bdag la bshad du gsol/ des smras pa rigs kyi bu nga 54ni byang chub sems dpa'i ri rnam par thar pa 45)sgo kun tu 'gro ba thob pa'o47ri/ /smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi zhabs kyi drung nas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i zhu7sgo kun tu 'gro ba zhes bya 9)ba 'di brnyes/ 'jig rten gyi khams de ni nyu ci'adi nas ji srid cig na mchis / 'jig rten gyi khams de nas bzhud nas ni 11ji srid cig lags/smras pa rigs kyi bu gnas 'di ni lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgus kyang shes par dka' ste / de ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus mi ldog pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mi 'phrogs nyu2pa'i yul te/ de ni rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma zin pa/38—170

sangs rgyas kyis ma dgongs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bstsags pa/ bsam pa yongs su mnyedag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po ma thob pa/ shes rab kyi mig dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis thos pa'am/ yongs su gzung ba'am /yid ches pa'am/ khong du chud par bya bar mi nus so/ /smras pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gzungs kyis cadad pa dang /mos par bgyi na ⑤'phags pas bdag la bka' mi stsal ⑥tam/ des smras pa rigs kyi bu nga ni shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi snying po dang ldan pa ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa dpal kun nas yang dag par 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas 'ongs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal kun nas yang dag par 'byung ba'i zhabs kyi drung nas spungs byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sgo kun tu 'gro ba 'di thob po/ /rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi snying po dang ldan pa de nas nga song nas ni bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul 3 shin tu phra ba snyed cig 'das te/ sems bskyed pa re re zhing yang gom 11pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig bor ro/ /gom pa re res kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das te12/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dang ldan par shes te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad 1 la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa bla na med pa yid kyis 3 norang bzhin chos nyid mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rgyas btab pa de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba15/ byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba yongs su bskyed pas mchod pa 16byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na 38—171

sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang mthong ste/ de dag thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho yang khong du chud do/ /de dag thams cad kyi dbang po'i 'khor lo 17yang yongs su shes shing bsam pa dang / mos pa ji lta bsabazhin du gzugs kyi lus yongs su bstan ri —3to/ /chos kyi dbyangs rtsorab tu bsgrags so/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su bkye'o/ /yo byad sna tshogs phun sum tshogs dzodapas kyang nye bar bsdud 46do/ /rang gi lus kyang de dag la byin gyis brlabs te/ de ni yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i sbyor ba rgyun mi 'chad dzopa'i phyir ro/ /shar phyogs nas ji ltar 'ongs pa de bzhin du lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang ske/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang // lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs nas kyang de bzhin te / rigs kyi bu ngas ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i ri'o sgo kun tu 'gro 1 ba zhes bya ba 'di shes par zad na/ ngas byang chub sems dpa' phyogs kun tu mngon par gzhol ba/ tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa 31chos kyi dbyings thams cad du lus rnam par bkod pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthun par spyod pa/ zhing thams cad lus 1 kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa/ chos thams cad kyi rgyud kyi tshonarjes su song ba1 ske/ dus gsum gyi rgyud mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa/ chos kyi phyogs kyi borgyud dang mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad du rnam par snang lob/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud thams cad la rnam par rtog pa med pa/ chags pa med pa'i rgyud thams cad khong du chud pa/ gnas med pa'i 38—172

rgyud la rab tu gnas pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod paramatshonus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na 5)grong khyer sgo dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na 5lha lha chen po zhes bya ba 'dug gis 4de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis5gebyang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs ne su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas tege/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i drung nas song ngo /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 8)rgya chen po'i rjes su song ba'i sems ri'o dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i ye shes kyi spyod yul 'dod pa'i ngang tshul can mngon par shes pa chen po mngon par bsgrub 1 dpa'i yul la yon tan gyi khyad par du lta 31ba/ brtson 'grus brtan pa'i go cha rab tu dga' ba'i khyad par thob pa1 / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pas rnam par rtse 1lhaba'i rjes su song ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pa de byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi sa la ni nan tan du 1 byed/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sa la 15ni rnam par dpyodas/ gzungs 1 kyi sa la ni rab tu gnas par byed / smon lam gyi sa la ni 'jug par byed/ so so 1 yang dag par rig 19pa'i sa la ni rjes su slob/ stobs kyi sa la 2 ni yongs su bsgrub cing mthar gyis grong khyer sgo dang ldan pa gang 2 na ba der song ste/ lha lha chen po kun du dris pa dang / de la 'gro ba mang pos 22bstan pa lha/ rigs kyi bu 'de re /38wa 173

lha lha chen po grong khyer gyi lam gyi bzhi7)mdo na bdag nyid shin tu chesabs sems can rnams la chos ston cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu ④nor bzangs lha lha chen po gang na ba der song ste/ lha lha chen po'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas / mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑤byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / yiji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags pas bdag la bshad du gsol/ de nas lha lha chen pos lag pa bzhi phyogs bzhir brkyang 3 ste/ rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las shin tu myur ba'i shugs kyis chu blangs te/ bdag gisapo gdong bkrus nas tshong dpon gyi bu cinor bzangs la gser gyi me tog gis gtor te 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni mthong bar shin tu dka' 0ste/ thos par yang rab tu dka'o/ /skyes bu mchog gi me tog pun darwa1ri ka ni 'jig rten gyirwarephul du bya ba yin pas15/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yin te/ 'jig rten gyi gnas su gyur pa'o/ /'gro ba'i rten du gyur pa'o/ /sems can rnams la snang ba chen po 'byin pa'o/ /lam lormongs pa rnams tshal lam bde ba 7ston pa'o/ /chos kyi tshul du gzung ba 1 la mgon du gyur pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du phyin par bya ba la ded dpon chen por /shegyur pa ste/ de la kho bo 'di 38—174

snyam du sems so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ming ni sems dri ma med pa rnams la rang gi lus kyi gzugs brnyan stiston cing lus rnam par dag pa rnams la mngon par snang ba dang / ngag gi nyes pa spangs pa rnamasashedabyangs kyi snang ba yongs su gdon⑧par byed pa dang / bsam pa dag pa rnams la dus thams cad du mngon sum du gyur par gnas pas/ lta ba ngan pa 'jomasalgepa yin par bsams so9/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i yirnam par thar pa sprin gyi dra ba thob pa'o(pe/ /smras pa 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i5lde/sprin gyi dra ba de'i yul ji lta bu zhig mchis/de nas lha lha chen pos tshong dponas3)gyi bu nya )nor bzangs kyi〈nyamadun du ri chen po tsam gyi gser gyi phung po dang / dngul gyi phung po dang / be+e ḍūr+ya'itshwa phung po dang ske/ shel gyi phung po dang / mu sa ra gal pa'i phung po dang / a sma gar bha'i hunyephung po dang / nor bu rin po che ngang gis snang ba'i phung po dang /nor bu rin po che dri ma med pa'i ④snying po'i phung po dang / nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba'i phung po dang / nor bu rin po che phyogs kun tu mngon pa'i phung po dang / gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang / cod pan gyi phung po dang /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi se mo do'i phung po dang / dpung rgyanam gyi phung po dang ske/ rna cha'i rgyan gyi phung po dang /mi gdubatshwa rmebu'i phung po dang / skamanyarags kyi phung po dang / rkang gdub kyi phung po dang / mu tig dmar po'i dra ba'i phung po dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi phung po dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kyi rgyan tsho/gegyi phung po dang / nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i phung po dang / me tog thams cad dang / spos thams cad 38—175

dang —/ bdug pa thams cad dang / phreng ba thams cad dang / byug pa thams cad dang / phye ma thams cad dang / gos thams cad dang / gdugs thams cad dang / rgyal mtshan thams cad dang / lha'i ba dan thams cad dang /rol mo brdung ba thams cad dang / rol mo dkrol ba thams cad dang /'dod pa'i yul thams cad dang /1 bu mo bye ba brgya stong grangs med pa dag kyang nye bar bstan nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /rigs kyi bu 'di dag las khyer la/ sbyin pa mang po ni byin cig /bsod nams mang po ni gyis shig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams lasamachod cig /sems can mang po ni sbyin pas bsdu ba'i dngos pos yongs su bsdus te/ gtong ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa la khod cig /'jig rten ni sbyin pa la slobs shig /gtang bar dga' 3rib yongs su gtang sab ni ston cig /rigs kyi bu khyod la kho bos ji ltar yo byad kyi rnam pas bsdud pa pa 'di bzhin du sbyin pa'i bsam ⑥pa dang / ma bral ba'i sems can tshad med 75pa dag gi (3)bsam pa'i rgyud kyang gtong bas yongs su bsgo ba byed do/ /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la'ang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bskul 9ba byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang kho bo ni sems can 'dod pa'i dga' bas myos pa1 / yul gyi longs spyod la yongs su chags pa rnams la yul de dag 1mi sdug par byin gyis rlob bo12/ /khro bas non pa dang nga rgyal can dang / rgyags shing dregs pa dang / rlom pa tshar gcod pas/gdul 1 ba rnams la ni gtum zhing srin po ltar mi sdug la 'jigs pa'i lus sha za 38—176

zhing khrag 'thung ba'i tshul dang ldan par bstan te/ rlom pa dang / snyems pas 'khrug pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /le lo can brtson 'grus bor ba'i sems can rnams la ni me dang / chu dang / rgyal po dang rkun po dang /gnod7pa'i 'jigs pa yongs su bstan cing skyo bar byas te92/ brtson 'grus rtsomasapa la 'godasapar byed dod)/ /de ltar thabs de dang de dag gisamakhya)pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi phyogs dang mi mthun pa rab tu gzhom9)pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi tshogs bstsags da)pa dang / sgrib 7 nopa'i ri'i hu ) g.yang sa'i lam thams cad las yang dag par bzla ba dang / sgrib 17pa med pa'i chos la gzud pa'i phyir mi dge ba thams cad las rnam par bzlog ste/ dge ba thams cad phun sum tshogs pa la yang hurtedag par 'god pa nyidabyed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sprin gyi dra ba 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i 8dbang po ltar nyon mongs pa'i lha mam yin skyarab tu 'jomasaspyo pa/ chu ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi me'i phung po zhi bar byed pa/ me'i nyi phung po ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi sred 39pa'i chu skems pa/ rlung ltar 'dzin pa'i mngon par chags pa thams cad kyi ri rnam par 'thor ba/ rdo rje ltar bdag gi 2 tsho'adu shes sra ba'i ni1brag rab tu rnyil ba/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid kyi yul ma ga dha'i 22snying po byang chub nas 2lhasa'i lha 24mo brtan ma gi zhes bya ba 'dug gis 25de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris 3shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 28lha 38wa 177

lha chen po'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ lha lha chen po la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas6)/ yang dang yang ②bltas te/lha lha chen po'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs mthar gyis yul ma ga dha'i ri snying po byang chub tu sa'i lha mo brtan ma gang na ba der song ba dang de 4)'gro ba'i tshe sa'i lha mo brgya stong phrag bcu gcig la gcig 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /sems can thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba zhig ni 'di nas tshur 'ong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can sems canasathams cad kyi ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs 'dral phyi bar 'gyur ba zhig ni 'di nas tshur 'ong ngo / /chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su byung ba chags pa med cing dri ma med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang dam pa 'thob par 'gyur ba zhig ni 'di nas tshur 'ong ngo ye shes kyi mthu bo che rdo rje'i mtshon cha can dpa' bo phas kyi rgol ba'i 'khor thams cad rab tu 'dul ba zhig nisngo ni'adi nas tshur 'ong ngo zhes nas/ de'i mod la lha mo brtan ma snyeril stsogs pa/ sa'i lha mo brgya stong phrag bcus sa chen po rab tu bskyod de/ 'brug sgra zab mo lta bu'i sgra chen po grag par byas nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'od chen pos snang bar byas te/lus rin po che'i rgyan dang / lhab lhub thams cad kyis shin tu brgyan nasal/glog gi phreng 1 riba'i tshogs nam mkha'i dbyings las 'gyu zhing snang ba lta bu sha stag du byas te/ shing thams cad kyi myu gu ni skye bar byed/ me tog gi shing thams cad ni kha 'bu bar byed/ chu klung gi rgyun thams cad ni 'bab par byed/mtsho dang mtshe'u 1 dang lu ma 12thams cad ni rgyas par byed/ spos chu'i char pa nyeni rab tu 'bab par byed/ me tog gi sprin rab tu 'thor ba'i rlung chen po ni 38—178

ldang bar byed/ sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ni rab tu sgra sgrog par byed/lha rdzas kyi gzhal med khang zhibyedang rgyan gyi tshogs mang po ni rab tu ga 'khrol bar byedam/ ba lang dang / khyu mchog dang / glang po dang / stag dang / ri dgas kyi dbang po ni rab tu sgra 'byin par byed/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang /klu dang 'byung po'i dbang po rnams ni 'brug sgra 'byin par byed/ ri'i dbang po chen po rnams ni phan tshun thug par byed/ gter gyi tshogs bye ba brgya stong ni mngon du byung zhu/bar byed cing sa'i 'og nas 'thon to/ /de nas sa'i lha mo brtan mas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'dir 'ongs pa legs so/ /sa'i phyogs 'di ni sngon khyod kyi gnas su gyur te/ kho mo'i mngon sum du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin na/ de'i rnam par sbyin pa'i phyogs 'ga' tsam blta 87bar 'dod dam/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis zhi)sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i 6)rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma 577la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs rigasu bskor ba byas nas/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i po mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma 3 )'tshal lo/ /de nas sa'i lha mo brtan mas57rkang pa'i mthil gyis sa chen po la brdabs te/ rin po che'i gter bye ba brgya stong grangs med pa kyi rab tu brgyan pa bstan 32nas 'di skad ces smras sol/ /rigs kyi bu rin po che'i gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mi'adi dag kyang khyod kyi rjes su 'brang ba'o8/ /khyod kyi sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /khyod kyis ci dgar spyad pa'o / /khyod kyi bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'o/ /khyod kyi bsod nams kyi stobs kyis bsrungs pa'otsho/ 7/ /'di las long ste/ khyod kyis 38—179

ci dgos pa de dag gyis shig /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i 1rnam par thar pa ye shes thub napar dka' ba'i snying po can thob pa ste/de ltar kho mo ni dbyang chub sems dpa'i carnam par thar pa 'di dang ldan pas(zhen /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad tshun chad du byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brang zhing / rtag tu bsrung 6ba la zhugs pa ste/ de tshun chad du rigs kyi bu kho mo ni 7byang chub sems dpa'i /sems kyi spyod pa la rnam par spyod do/ /ye shes kyi yul la 'jug go/ /smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor khong59 du chud par byed do//byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa rjes su rtogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi tshul gyi rjes su 'brang ngo nyu ri/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa thams cad dang / sems rgya chen pos rgyas par 'gengs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi stobs kyis dbang bsgyur huḥb dang / zhing gi dra ba 2thams cad rgyas par dgangatsha12ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan pa yang dag par mnod 8pa dang / dus gethams cad du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba tshayang dag par bstan pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul thams cad dang / mdo sde yang dag par brjod pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi tshul thams cad dang / chos snang ba chen pos snang bar bya ba'i tshul dang / sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i tshul dang /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yang dag par bstan pa'i tshul yang hu rmerjes su rtogs 18par byed do/ /yang dag par 'dzin to/'a/ /yang dag par nod do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa ye shes thub par dka' ba'i snying po can 'di yang bskal pa ri rab kyi 3 sirdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 38—180

pha rol de'i yang pha rol cigatsha3)tu 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar bskal pa〈snang bas rnam par brgyan pa la de bzhin gshegs pa spyan bzangs3po las thob ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa ye shes thub par dka' ba'i snying po can 'di la ri riyongs su dpyod dpyod/rnam par dpyod dpyod/ shin du dpyod dpyod/ yang dag par 'phel bar byed 5byed de⑥/ shin tu rgyas par byed byed pas/ bskal pa bzang po la thug gi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang ma bral lo/ /de srid kyi bar gyis kho mos 7de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 8)yang dag par rdzogs (9)pa'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas 1 )kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig bsnyen bkur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad snying po byang chub tu gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yang mthong ste/ kho mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon sum du mthong ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa ye shes thub par dka' ba'i snying po can 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zham ring01du 'brang ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes 'jug par dka' ba la rab tu zhugs pa/ sems kyi skad cig nyi gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i shugs dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa dri ma med pa'i snying por gyur pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung 12ba thams cad brtag tu mngon par bsgrubs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin tshalas tha mi dad pa'i pho nyar gyur 38—181

pa / de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid kyi yul ma ga dha 0zhes bya ba na grong khyer ser skya'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ de na mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang tsho ldan pa 5zhes bya ba 'dug gis cade'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub risems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisam6)sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i 7rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma 8)la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas 99te/sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i 1 drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i 11gdams ngag rjes su dran par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa ye shes thub par dka' ba'i snying po can de rjes su dran par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa de rab tu goms 2par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi tshul de'i rjes su bsam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pas rnam par rtse ba de la rnam par dpyad pa dang /12 byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i ye shes shin tu phra ba de la rnam par blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho de la 'jug par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i ye shes tha dad pa de khel yid ches par mabya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i ye shes shin tu sbyang ba nyu6de rjes su rtogs par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par nya thar pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho de la 'bab par bya ba byed cing / grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas gang na ba der 38—182

phyin te/ grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas la g.yas phyogs su bskor nyustanas/shar phyogs logs kyi grong khyer gyi gesgo nas song ste/ nyi ma nub nas ring po ma lon pa zhig tu grong khyer gyi lam gyi sum mdo'i dbus shig na/ byang chub sems dpa'i gdams ngag mthun par len pa de mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa mthong bar 'dod cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen yod na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob par 'gyur bar nges ③pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi mig kun tu lta ba'i yulasagyi rang bzhin gyisabyin gyi rlabs 6dang ldan pa/ phyogs thams cad du mngon par gzhol zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la tshebalta ba'i sems kyis mos pa dang / ye shes chen po'i rin snying por gyur pa'i 'du shes kyi sems dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa thams cad la rab tu zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi mig dang ldan pa / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad du ye shes rgya mtsho 'byam 7klas pas rgyas par 'gengs pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mig gis 3 5phyogs thams cad du shes bya'i rgya mtsho la rnam par lta 31ba/ ye shes chen po'i mig 'thob par bya ba la tunyerab tu gzhol zhing bsam pa rtse gcig tu bzhag nas 'dug 'dug pa dang /mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa de kyi grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas kyi steng gi nam mkha'i dbyings las chenor bu rin po che sna tshogs dpe med pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa zhig na/ rin po che'i seng ge'i khri chen po spos zhim po thams cad kyi pad+mo'i 8snying po can zhig la lus kyi mdog gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa/ spa 'jam zhing mang la mthon ting tshadu 'dug pa/ mig dkar nag 1 'byes pa/gzugs bzang zhing kyisnyemadzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ lus rgyan dang lhab lhub thams cad kyis klubs shing brgyan pa/ kha dog bsgyur 37ba'i gos bgos tsho 7pa 38—183

tshangs pa'i gtsug tor gyi cod pan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa thogs pa lus la rgyu skar dang / gza' dang skar chen dang / skar ma'i tshogs thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan snang bar gyur pa 1)'dug padza mthong ngo / /des sems can gyi khams yangs par mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang /log par ltung ba nas sems can ji snyed cig yongs su bgroladzabab de dag thams cad 5kyang de'i ba spu'i sbubs su chud par mthong ngo / /ji snyed cig mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du bkod pa dang / ji snyed cig nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su phyin par byas pasti/de dag thams cad kyang de'i ba spu'i sbubs su chud par mthong ngo / / lus mngon par bsgrub pa dang /7ri gzugs mngon par bsgrub pa dang / kha dog mngon par bsgrub pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis ji snyed cig yongs su spyin par byas pa de dag kyang de'i ba spu'i sbubs su chud par mthong ngo / /nga ro mngon par bsgrub pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag mngon par bsgrub pa dang / skad kyi tshul sna tshogs yongs su sbyar ba ji snyed cig gis yongs su spyin par byas pa gnyede dag kyang / de'i ba spu'i sgo nas rjes su brjod pa thos so/ /dus mngon par bsgrub pa dang / bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 9rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa tshodang / byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su lta 1stob dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par lta 1 ba dang /38—184

byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyes bu seng ge chen po'i rnam par bsgyings pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pas/ rnam par rtse 1ba ji snyed cig gis des sems can yongs su sbyin par byas pa de dag kyang / de'i ba naspu'i sbubs su chud par mthong ngo / /des thabs sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i /chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho de dag mthong zhing 4thos nas dga' parangs te mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa de la lus thams cad kyis phab nas phyag 'tshal te/ langs nas mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa'i mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mo bdag gis 6bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems 7bskyed de de ltar bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin gyi narlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung bar yang dag par mthong bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phyag tu bdag nyid bor ba lags na/ lha mo shul gang la brten na/ byang chub sems dpa'i 9stobs bcu'i sar 'byung bar 1 'gyur ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i shul bdag la bshad du gsol/ de 11skad ces smras pa dang / mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras 12so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod dge ba'i bshes gnyen kyi byin gyis non tes / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshig mnyan sapar 'dod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lagadams ngag la nan tan du byed pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ni de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la nan tan 38wa 185

du byed pas51/ gdon mi za bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sems can thams cad kyi mun pa rnam par sel 5ba'i chos kyi snang bas rgu'agro ba rnam par 'dul ba'i sgo thob pa ste/ bsam pa mi mnyam pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /mi dge ba'i las kyi lam la zhugs pa rnams la snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /dge ba'i las kyi lam la zhugs pa rnams la dga' ba'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /sems mnyam pa dang mi mnyam par ldan pa'i casems can rnams la mi gnyis pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o / /kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams la rnam par byang 5)ba'i sems dang ldan pa'o / /nyam nga bar gyur pa rnams la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o / /dma' ba la 6mos pa rnams la yangs pa la mos pa yongs su bskyed pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /dbang po zhum pa rnams la brtson 'grus chen po'i shugs rnam par spel 7ba'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor ba la mngon par mos pa rnams la 'khor ba'i rgyud kyi 'khor lo las rnam par bzlog pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o / /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mngon par mos pa'i sems can rnams la/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam la dgod pa'i sems dang ldan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo de lta bu'i sems dang ri noyid la bya bar ldan la9/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sems can thams cad kyi mun pa rnam par sel ba'i chos kyi snang bas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba'i sgo 'di dang yang ldan pas sems can gang ji snyed cig mun nag smag tu gyur pa'i nam 1 la mi ni nyal bar gyur/ 'byung po'i tshogs ni rgyu bar gyur/rto/ rkun choms 38—186

mang pos ni7rgyas par gyur/ sems can mi bsrun⑧pa'i tshul can ni phyogs su rgyu bar gyur/ sprin stug po nag pos ni hūṃ )kun nas khebs par gyurab/ dud pa dang rdul gyi tshogs kyis ni kun nas 'grigs ④par gyur/ rdzi yichar mi bzad pas ni rab tu gtags par gyur/ zla skar gyi tshogs ni mi snang bar gyur/mig gis bya ba'i mthu ni med par gyur pa'i mun pa la sems can gang ji snyed cig rgya mtsho la spyod dam/ thang la spyod dam/ ri la spyod dam/ nags tshal gzhan na spyod dam/ yul gzhan na /spyod dam/ grong gzhan na spyod dam/phyogs gzhan na spyod dam/ phyogs mtshams gzhan na spyod dam/ lam gzhan na spyod kyang rung ste/ rgya mtsho la spyod spyod pa las gru du mo/bub par gyur pa'am/ thang la spyod spyod pa las nyam nyes pa'am/ ri la spyod spyod pa las g.yang sa chen por lhung ⑨bar gyur pa'am/ 'brog 3 chodagon pa la spyod spyod pa las kha zas kyis 'phongs 11par gyur pa'am/ nags tshal thibs por sba'i zang zing la thogs samanyaske/ tshul ma yin pa'i nyam nyes shig tu gyur tam/ yul gzhan na spyod spyod pa lasasngo chom pos bcom pa'am/ grong gzhan na spyod spyodamu rapa las mi bsrunamatshapa'i tshul can gyis gtses pa'am/ phyogs gzhan na spyod spyod pa las 'brog rmis pa'am / phyogs mtshams gzhan na spyod spyod pa las mgo rmongs pa'am lam gzhan na spyod spyod pa las nye zhor gyur kyang rung ste/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ni sems can de dag la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas skyabs su gyur par byed pa ste/ 'di ltar rgya mtsho chen po la spyod pa rnams kyi rlung sprin nag po gtor ba dang / chu'i rnyog pa gdang 3 ba dang / rlung mi zad nya pa'i dkyil 'khor bzlog pa dang /rlabs kyi shugs chen po zhi bar bya ba dang / glog gi 3rje'ajigs pa las thar bar 38—187

bya ba dang / phyogs bstan pa dang / chu'i lam legs par dmigs pa dang /'gram bstan pa dang / rin po che'i gling du phyin par bya ba'i phyir lam yongs su bstan7)te/ yongs su sbud gepa'i gzugs dang / dedakhudapon gyi gzugs dang ske/ rta'i rgyal po rngog chen gyi gzugs dang / glang po'i rgyal po'i gzugs dang ske/ rumartso)sbal gyi rgyal po'i gzugs dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'i gzugs dang ske/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i gzugs dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po'i gzugs dang / lto 'phye chen po'i rgyal po'i5nyagazugs dang / rgya mtsho'i lha'i gzugs dang / mnyan pa'i gzugs kyis skyabs su gyur par byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang 'di ltar sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad las yongs su bzlog pa'i phyir skyabasa'agasu gyur par shog shig ces yongs su bsngo'o48ra / /thang la spyod pa'i sems can mun pa chen po57shin tu gnas pa'i nam la/ sa gzhi 'od ma dang / tsher ma dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mos gang ba/ sbrul gdug /1pa gtum po shin tu mang ba/ thag thug dang / mi bde ba'i lam can rdul dang phyar kyi dar shin tu 'thul ba/ rdzi char drag pos gtags pa / tsha ba dang / grang 3 ba'i sdug bsngal yod pa/ sbrul dang gcan zan gyis bag tsha ba yod pa/ thong 7mi dang / chom po rgyu bar gyur pa zhig nam/ mgo 'khor bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams la/ nyi ma'i gzugs dang / zla ba'i gzugs dang / skya reng 17'char ba'i gzugs dang / skar mda' chen po'i gzugs dang / glog gi phreng tsho ba 'byung ba'i gzugs dang / rin po che'i 'od kyi gzugs dang / gza'i 'khor gyi gzugs dang / rgyu 32skar dang skar ma'i tshogs kyi gzhal med khang gi 'od kyi gzugs dang / lha'i gzugs dang / byang 38—188

chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyis skyabs su gyur par 1)byed do/ /sems kyang nadage ba'i rtsa ba 'dis nyon mongs pa'i mun pa thams cad rnam par bsal miba'i phyiral/ sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su shog shig par bskyed do/ /ri'i g.yang sa la spyod cing 'chi bas 'jigs skrag pa rnams kyi srog dbyung ba sbyodang /grags pa 'dod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / snyan pa dang / sgra'i rgyal mtshan 'dod pa dang / longs spyod tshol ba dang / 'dod pa'itswazil gyis non pa dang ske/ yo byad yongs su tshol551ba la brtson pa dang / 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa 'dod cing brtson pa dang / bu dang chung ma gtong mi phod pas thogs par gyur pa dang / lta ba'i thibs por 'khyams pa dang / sdug bsngal ba gyedang ske/ 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa rnams la yang thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas skyabs su gyur par byed de(87/ 'di ltar ri'i rje phug dang / bya skyibs mngon par bsgrub pa dang / shing thog hu sdudang / rtsa ba bzar rung ba mngon par bsgrub pa dang / chu'i lam dang / chu mig mngon par bsgrub pa dang / tsha ba dang ske/ grang ba'i gnyen po mngon par bsgrub pa dang / yang dag pa'i 31lam bstan pa dang / ka la ping ma'i sgra skad bsgrag 32pa dang / rma bya'i rgyal po'i nyanaskad 'byin pa'i dbyangs dang / sman thu'abar bas snang ba'i gzugs dang /ri'i lha'i 'od kyi gzugs dang / ri'i phug dang sul dang / stongs su rlag ste/sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa'i sems can rnams kyi mun pa'i rab rib rnam par bsal tshab dang / sa'i gzhi mnyam par mngon par bsgrub pas skyabs su gyur par byed de/ sems kyang ji ltar bdag gis sems can ri la spyod pa 'di dag yongs su bskyabs sapa de bzhin du 'khor ba'i ri'i lam rgyud g.yang sa 38—189

la gnas shing rga shi'i gdon gyis zin pa de dag gi skyabs su'ang bdag 'gyur b.ranyeshog shig par bskyed ( do/ /nags tshal thibs po'i dra bas thogs pa'i sems can mtshan mos mun pa'isamun nag gis chod de/ shing dang / shing 'phran zhi)'dzings pa'i gseb shin tu nyam nga ba dngasnyi/ chu dang / rtswasngo byedang /spong po dang / 'khri shing gis lam chod pa dang (2)/ shing dang shing phran sna tshogs7)kyi nags tshal thibs pa'i 1 rinang du phyin te/ stag gi sgra thos pas77skrag pa'i snying can don ma grub pas/ sems 'khrugs par gyur pa dang / 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba dang / mi dga' ba sna tshogs kyis nyams mi bdel ba nags tshal stug po nas 'byung ba'i phyogs mi shes pa rnams la/ kho mo ni bde bar 'gro ba'i lam yongs su ston pa byed de9/lha/ sems kyang 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can lta ba'i yithibs po sna tshogs la gnas pa/ sred pa'i dra bas 'khris par gyur pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa rnams sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su 'grel gebar shog shig par bskyed do/ /'brog tso dgon pa la spyod pa'i sems can mun pa'i nang na 'thoms pa ( snarnams kyang thabs kyi sgo 32sna tshogs kyis bde ba yongs su bskyed cing lam bstan te/ de dag 'jigs pa med pa dang / bde ba la rab tu bkod nas/ sems kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa na 'thoms 3)pa ngan song thams cad kyi lam du zhugs pa rnams sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su bkrol cite shin tu phun sum tshogs pas/ bde ba 2 thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la rab tu dgod sa par bya bar shog shig par bskyed desgoge/ rigs kyi bu yul dang ljongs la chags pa'i sems can mngon par chags pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i sdug 38—190

bsngal nyams su myong bar gyur pa rnams la'ang kho mo ni skyo bar bya ba'i thabs sna tshogs kyis yul la mngon par chags pa de ①las gyen du bskyod par ②byed de sems kyang 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad phung po la mngon par chags pa las gyen du bskyod deri ri/ gnas med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod par bya bar shog shig par bskyed do/ /rigs gekyi bu kho mo ni grong na spyod pa'i sems can khyim dang gnas kyi 'ching bas7glags pa rnams mtshan mo mun pa shin tu gnag pas chod pa'i nang na khyim gyi don sna tshogs nyams su gnod pas/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams kyang skyo bar 'gyur ba'i sgo sna tshogs kyis skyo bar byas te/ chags pa med pa'i sems yongs su bskyed nas/chos kyi sbyin pas yongs su bzung ⑥ste/ tshim par byas nas rten ⑦pa med pa'i chos la bkod de'u// sems kyang 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can skye mched drug gi grong la ⑨gnas pa rnams 'khor ba'i lam gyi rgyud kyi tu )spyod yul las gyen du bskyod de/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul la dgod par bya bar shog shig par bskyed do/ /rigs57kyi bu gang yang mtshan mo mun pa shin tu gnag pa'i nang na/ shar phyogs la 3gesogs pa'i phyogs dang / phyogs mtshams re rer phyogs bslad par gyur pa/ sa'i phyogs mnyam pa la mi 32mnyam pa'i g.yang sar 'du shes pa dang / sgang bu la gshong ducha'adu shes par gyur te/phyogs kyi lam dang sa tshod la mgo 'khor bar gyur pa de dag la'ang kho mo ni thabs sna tshogs kyis snang bar byas te/ phyir 'byung ba rnams la ni sgo yongs su7skuston to/ /rgalasnyibar 'dod pa rnams la ni mu stegs 3 tshoyongs su ston to/ /rgyal /snyebar 'dod pa rnams larwarteni gru yongs su ston to/ /khyim du 'gro bar 'dod pa 38—191

rnams la ni khyim yongs su ston to/ /rnam par blta bar 'dod pa rnams la ni 3)phyogs yongs su ston to/ /sa dugegazhi mtho ba dang / dma' ba yangasheyongs su ston to/ /sa'ilo4)phyogs mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang / gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs kyang yongs su ston to/ /lam gyis dub pa rnams la grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs dang khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor kyang yongs su ston to / /tsha ba dang skom pas mnar ba rnams la yang mtsho dang mtshe'u dang / lu ma dang rdzing dang rdzing bu dang chu klung dang / nags tshal dang bza' shing gi ra ba dang ske/ kun dga' 5yid du 'ong ba yongs su ston to/ /sdug pa dang bral zhing phrad par 'dod 7pa rnams la pha dang ma dang bu dang chung ma dang / mdza' bo dang / blon po dang / gnyen bshes dang58)yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs kyishernam pa sna tshogs yongs su ston to3 ri/ /sems kyang hu)ji ltar bdag gis sems can mtshan mo mun pa mun nag / gis chod pa/ mig rab rib kyis nyams pa/phyogs bslad pa/ lam 'khor ba rnams la gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par dmigs par bya ba'i phyir/ snang ba bskyed de32/ 'od byas pa de bzhin du bdag gis yun ring po nas 'khor ba'i mun pa na gnas pa'i sems can yang dag pa nyid kyi phyogs la bslad 1 pa ma rig pa'i mun par 'thoms 8pa ye shes kyi tshamig mi shes pa'i ling tog gis chod pa/ 'du shes dang / sems dang lta bas maphyin ci log tu gyur pa/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes pa/snye/ sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'du shes pa19/ bdag med pa la bdag tu 'du shes pa/ mi sdug pa la sdug par 'du shes pa/ bdag dang sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / gang zag tu 'dzin pa dam po la gnas pani ri/ phung po dang khams 38wa 192

dang skye mched la gnas pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu la mgo 'khor ba/ mi dge ba'i las kyi lam gyi phyogs su zhugs pa/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin par len pa1tsho/'dod pas log par g.yem pa / brdzun bdu smra ba4)/ phra ma zer bsgru ngag rtsub po 'byin pa/ tshig kyal pa smra ba tsho/ chags sems dang ldan pa/ gnod sems kyi sems5shedang ldan pa/ log par lta ba can/ phar mi shes pa/ mar mi shes pa/ dge sbyongaphrodang / bram zer mi shes pa/ dbang po mi shes pa/skyes bu dam par mi shes pa/ chos ma yin pa la chags shing zhen pa/ mi tshul ba'i 'dod pas (nyazil gyis non 1 pa/ log pa'i chos kyis yongs su 'khris pa/de bzhin gshegs pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo nub par bya ba la zhugs pa/ bdud kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnod par byed pa/ theg pa chen po la zhe snang ba/ byang chub kyi sems lho la mos pa spong bar0byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la mi snyan du rjod 7pa/ snod ma skamasalgepar snying ring ba/ gnod pa ma byas par dgrar len pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ skyes bu dam pa ma yin pas/ spyod pa'i chos kyi spyod yul can/ mchod rten dang / dge 'dun gyi dngos po la 'khu ba/ pha ma la nyi log par sems pa32/ mtshams med pa'i las byed pa/ g.yang sa chen po la mngon par ltas 37pa'i sems can rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa shes rab kyi snang ba chen pos bsal 3 )te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bskul nistonas/ theg pa chen po kun tu bzang pos stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi sa'i nirnyelam yongs su ston par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 38—193

tshul rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul dang / stobs bcu yongs su grub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzungs kyi stobs dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku mchog ①tu gyur pa yongs su ston par shog shig /yongs su bstan nas ①kyang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas la rab tu dgod par shog shig par bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni sems can yun ring po nas na zhing nad kyis yongs su skyo ba/lus nyam ri(chung ba dang / rgas pa④/ rga ba'i ⑤ril gyis non pa dang /mgon med pa dang / phongs shing dbul ba dang / log par lhung ba dang /yul56)gzhan du phyin pa dang / phyogs log par zhugs pa dang / btsonakhur na 'dug pa dang / chad pas bcad pa dang / nyes pa7byung ste/ rgyal pos gsad par bkri ba 7rnams kyang srog dang bral gyi (me'ajigs pa las yongs su bskyabs32pa'i phyir gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo ni〈nyesems can nad pa rnams kyi nad thams cad ni thabs thams cad kyis gso bakhenan tan du byed do//rgas pa dang rga ba'i nyugezil gyis non pa rnams la ni bsnyen bkur ba 69dang /rim gro 3 snadang / yo byad kyis mi phongasam/8par yongs su bsdud pa hurtebyed do/ /mgon med pa'i sems can rnams la mgon byed do/ /phongs (cho shing dbul ba rnams la ni nor dang / gser gyi phung pos yongs su sdud du 1do/ /log par lhung ba rnams ni don 'thun pas yongs su sdud nirnyedo/ /yul gzhan du phyin pa rnams ni/ rang gi yul du phyin par byed do/ /phyogs log par zhugs pa rnams ni/ phyogs ma nor bar 'dzud do/ /brtson02ra na 'dug pa rnams ni brtson 24ra nas thar bar byed do/ /chad pas gcad 2gepa ni chad pa'i sdug bsngal 38—194

las grol bar byed do/ /nyes pa byung ste/ rgyal pos gsad par bkri ba 17rnams ni srog gisadabugs phyin pa sku kyithob par byed do④/ /sems kyang bdag ji ltar sems can 'di dag 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa sna tshogs lasam yongs su skyob cing / mgon byed pa de bzhin du bdag gis 'di rnams bla na med pa'i chos kyi yongs su bsdu bas yongs su bsdus te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad las 6yongs su dgrol bar bya'o9)/ /skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang / 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang ske/ 'khrug⑧pa las yang dag par bzla bar bya'o/ /ngan song dang log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su dgrol 6)bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gzungs la tsho/ byerab tu dgod par bya'o/ /chos rin po che sbyin pa'i hu7yongs su bsdu52bas yongs su hu bsdu bar bya'o/ /kha na ma tho ba med pa'i las lamachurab tu dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnam par dag la yang dag lapar bskul bar bya'o/ /rga shi yongs su med pa'i dbyings shin tu rtogs pa lasnyirab tu dgod par bya hu 1bar bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni sems can log pa'i lam la zhugs pa/ lta ba'i〈shernam pa thibs po sna tshogs la mngon par zhen pa/ log par lta ba'i〈caspyod yul can lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las nyam ( nye nga bar 'gyur ba la yongs su spyod pa/ brtul zhugs dang dka' thub sna tshogs la gnas pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma yin yang 6sto/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'du shes pa/ lus gdung ba dang /yongs su gdung ba la rab tu brtson pa/ mtsho dang / mtshe'u du rnyedang / lu ma dang ske/ rdzing bu dang / chu klungs lhadang / ri'i gzar dang / phyogs dang 38wa 195
