phyogs mtshams 17la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal bsho mos pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du gyur pa rnams la yang thabs sna tshogs kyis mgon du gyur par byed de /de dag sdig pa'i lta ba'i rnam pa dang / ngan song thams cad kyi g.yang sar lhung ba'i lam las rnam par bzlog 4)go/ /'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta7ba la rab tu bkod cing / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa la'ang yiyongs su 'god do / /sems 7kyang ji ltar bdag gis sems can 'di dag nyam nga ba'i nan tan dang / sdug bsngal las yongs su bkrol geb de bzhin du bdag gis sems can thams cad kyang / 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la bkod de/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las phyir mi ldog par byas la kun tu bzang po'i smon lam chen pos thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dgod par bya'ol/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad ma dul gyi bar du byang chub sems dpa'i sa las kyang mi g.yo bar bya 49ribar bskyed do/ /de nas mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pas de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i phyogs sems can thams cad nyu )kyi mun pa rnam par sel ba'i chos kyi snang bas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba'i sgo 'di brnan 11te/ bstan par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs nyugekyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gti mug ma rig mun nag bstsal don 12du/ /sems can phan phyir kho mo chos bstan78te/ /dus la bsdad cing 'gro ba bde bar byas/ /'di ni rnam thar tshul mchog zhi ba yin/ /kho mos byams yangs shin tu spyad pa skabyas/ /bskal pa mtha' yas sngon cad shin tu bsgoms / /des ni 'jig rten rgyas bkang snang bar byas( rme/ /nor bzangs 38—196

brtan7pas tshul 'di shes par gyis/ /kho mo'i snying rje rgya mtsho tshad med de(5/ /'di las dus gsum rgyal ba 'jig rten 'byung / /des ri ni 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byed/ /nor bzangs brtan pas tshul 'di shes par gyis/ /'jig rten bde ba mngon par bsgrub pa dang / /ma byas 'phags pa'i bde bas sa mngon bsgrub cing / /des ni kho mo dga' mgungayerangs par byed/ /rgyal sras khyod kyisashetshul 'di shes par gyis/ /sangs rgyas stobs rnams yongs su sbyong ge byed cing / /nyan thos ye shes rnam thar 'bras bu dang / /'dus byas skyon las rtag tu phyir phyogs kyisasti/ /rgyal sras khyod kyis ཿ )tshul 'di shes par gyis/ /kho mo'i mig ni rgya che hunyeyongs su dag /des ni phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mang po mthong ske/ /zhing dbyings de dag kun gyi rang byung rnams/ /byang chub shing dbang drung na bzhugs pa nyartemathong / /sangs rgyas sku ni mtshan gyis yongs nyage brgyan cing / /'od bzang rnam pa sna tshogs kun 'gyed de/ /ba spu kun nas 'od gzer mang 'gyed pa'i8/ /sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa kho tsomos mthong ske/ /zhing dbyings de dag kun gyirdza sems can rnams/ /shi 'pho skye ba'i sgor yang kun mthong ste/ /byis parwa 7de dag 'gro rgyud rgya mtsho na/ /'khor zhing rang rang las kyang myong bar byed/ /kho mo'i rna ba rgya mtsho rnam dag ste/ /der ni sgra rnams ma lus yongs su 'du/ /'gro ba kun kyi sgra skadarwa rgya mtsho dag /kun kyang thos nas dran pas yongs su 'dzin/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag sgra skad thams cad kyis/ /dpe zla med pa'i gsung ni rab brgyan te/ /des ni rgyal ba 'khor lo rab tu bskor3)/ /de dag kho mos thos shing dran pas 'dzin/ /kho mo'i sna yi mthu yang〈 )rnam dag ste/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho dag la thogs pa med/ /38—197

rnam thar gnas rnams kun tu rab 'jug pa'i/ /tshul 'di0)rgyal sras khyod kyis shes par gyis/ /kho mo'i lce ni rgya che rab tu yangs/ /srab cing mdog dmar rin chen 'od du dag /sems can bsam pa jikhubazhin detsha noshes byed/ /rgyal sras khyod kyis tshul 'di shes par gyis/ /kho mo'i chos lusasnyishin tu rnam dag ste//dus gsum kun tu 'od gsal rab tu gnas/ /gzugs lus sems can bsam pa ji bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi dad pa'i ⑤dbang du ⑥mthong / /kho mo'i sems ni chags med zag pa med/ /sgra dbyangs sprin gyi nga ro ji bzhin te/ / de yi 7khongs su mi mchog kun chud kyang / /de la kho mo rnam par shertog pa med//zhing gi dbyings kyi sems can bsam mi khyab/ /de dag sems kyi rgya mtsho kho mos shesal/ /de dag dbang po bsam pa rab shes kyang / /de la kho mo rnam par rtog pa med/ /kho mo'i rdzu 'phrul rab yangs shin tu grub/ /des ni bsam yas ⑨ zhing yang 1 rab tu bskyod31/ /lus kyi 'od dang mthu yang de bzhin te/ /des ni sems can gdul 12dka' shin tu 'dul/ /kho mo'i bsod nams rnam tsoyangs yongs su dag /kun tu rgyan byed zad pa med pa'i mdzod/ /des ni rgyal ba rnams la mchod pa byed/ /'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'ang yin/ /kho mo'i shes rab rnam yangs shin tu dag /des ni chos mang rgya mtsho rab tu shes/ /'gro ba kun gyi the tsom skoyongs su gcod/ /rgyal sras khyodasnyikyis tshul 'di shes par gyis/ /dus gsum kun la kho mo 8zhugs gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho kun kyang mthong zhing shes/ /de dag smon lam la yang rab tu zhugs/ /tshul 'di dpag yas rab tu rdzogs pa yin/ /rdul mang kun la zhing rnams rgya mtsho mthong ske/ /de dag dus gsum 'jug pa ⑩de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi sangs 38—198

rgyas rgya mtsho mthong / /'di ni kun tu gnas pa'i tshul gyisanya)/ /rnam par snang mdzad byang chub sangs rgyas te/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi du zhing rnams yongs bkang zhing / /rdul sbubs kun gyi byang chub shing drung na/ /zhi ba'i chos rnams gsung du sgrog ②pa ltos/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis byamatshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mo khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs nas/ ji srid cig lags/ de ltar khyod tshul 'di lta bus sems can gyi don bgyi ba la sta gon du zhugs pa'i rnam par thar pa de ni khyod kyis brnyes 3)nas ji srid cigal)lags/ de skad ces smras pa dang / mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu sngon 'das pa'i dus ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bskal pa'i yang / pha rol cig tu bskal pa rab tu zhi ba'i 'od ces bya btso/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag lnga brgya skyes pa byung ste/ de'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni rin chen 3)dpal 'byungashezhes bya bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i gling bzhi pa 'bring po rin chen zla ba sgron ma'i 'od ces bya ba de natunye/ rgyal po'i gnas pad mo'i 'od ces bya ba yod de32/ rgyal po'i gnas der rgyal po〈nyechos rab hustemu stegs zhes bya ba chos dang mthun pa'i rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba7gling bzhi la dbang ba rin po che bdun dang ldan pa byung ste/ des sa tsochen po de yang ri dang rgya mtshor bcas pa'i mthas gtugs par chos kyis rgyas par byas nas/ bde bar gnas par byas so/ /rgyal po chos rab hu mu stegs de'i btsun mo chos kyi blo gros zla ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ de srod 1snyel 'dod pas myos shing dga' bar rtse rtse bas dub 37nas nam gyi gung la btsun mo'i 'khor 38—199

gyi gnas su phyin te nyal lo/ /de nas rgyal po'i gnas pad mo'i 'od de'i shar phyogs kyi nags tshal tsho chen po zhi ba'i dpal 'byung ba zhes bya bar rin po che'i rgyal pongosargyan thams cad kyi 'od dang ldan pa'i lhun can/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing chen po'i drung du/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad rab tu sgrogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ de'i mthus 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen chogedapal 'byung ba thams cad ⑤'od chen po kha dog tsho6)du ma can gyis rgyas shing gang bar gyur to/ /rgyal po'i gnas pad mo'i 'od ces bya ba de na mtshan mo'i lha mo zla ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba 'dug 'dug ste/ des rgyal po'i btsun mo chos kyi blo gros zla ba'i gan du song nas / rgyan bgrol57dba'i sgras sad par byas te4ge/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar rgyal po'i btsun mo shes par gyis shig /nags tshal chen po zhi ba'i dpal 'byung bar de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad rab tu sgrog ⑨pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par pasangs rgyas so/ /de nas des rgyal po'i btsun mo 1)de'i mdun du sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam rgya cher bshad do/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal po'i btsun mo de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis snang bar gyur te/ bsam pa thag pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs nas/ des de bzhin gshegs pa de dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun du bcas pa la mchod pa dang /38—200

rim gro cher byas so/ /rigs kyi bu de la 7)ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo chos kyi blo gros zla ba zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin padza tsam du sems na ni/ de ltar mi blta ste/ kho mo ni de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rgyal po'i btsun mo chos kyi blo gros zla ba zhes bya bar gyur toX / /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni mos pa'i sems bskyed pa de dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ bskal pa ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed tshun chad du nam yang ngan song7log par ltung bar ma skyes te/ sems can dmyal bar ma yin no/ /byol song gi skye gnas su ma yin(de)/ yi dgas su ma yin no/ /nam yang rigs dma' bar ma skyes so/ /nam yang dbang po dang mi ldan par ma gyur to/ /nam yang sdug bsngal bar ma gyur te/ de ltar kho mos rtag par lha'i nang du lha'i bdag nyid che ba nyid thob/ mi'i nang du ni(ye/ mi'i bdag nyid che ba nyid thob ste / 'di ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang yang ma bral lo/ /dus ngan par yang ma skyes so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mos sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de7)bskal pa ri rab kyi rdul ⑧shin tu phra ba snyed cig tu lam bde zhing mnyam pa nas nye zho med par phyin kyang de tsam gyis kho mo'i byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po yongs su grub poXpar ma gyur te/ ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bskal pa de dag ni 'das/bskal pa bzang po hu )'di'i snga rol gyi ni bskal pa chen po stong phrag bcu'i thog ma la bab pa hunyede'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzi brjid rdul gyi dri ma myed pa zhes bya bar/ bskal pa mya ngan med cing / rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba byung ste/rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams gzi brjid rdul gyi dri ma med pa'i dpal de ni 38—201

kun nas nyon mongs la 3)rnam par dag par gyur te/ der sangs rgyas lnga brgya byung ngo / /sangs rgyas lnga brgya po de dag gi thog ma la de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/bla na med pa na/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur sa/ba/ lha dang mi'i ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ri rab rgyal mtshan spyan yangs shing zhi ba'i dpal zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe kho mo yang tshong dpon snyan pasarnam par grags pa'i bu mo shes rab snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba/ gzugs mdzes shing bzang la blta na sdug pa kha dog shin tu mdzes shing rgyas pa dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo zla ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba de yang ske/ smon lam gyi dbang gis gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rdul dang bral ba'i rgyal po'i gnas rgyal mtshan sna tshogs su mtshan mo'i lha mo mig rnam par dag pa zhes bya bar gyur te/ des kho mo ri mtshan mo mi nyal tsam zhig na/ pha ma nyal bar gyur pa dang / khyim de yang yongs su bskyod de 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas rang gi gzugs bstan te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa brjod nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thog ma 6mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ zhag bdun lon te/ snying po byang chub la bzhugs 2pa de bstan to/ /de nas kho mo pha ma dang naganyen bshes kyi tshogs chen po dang 'grogs te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo shin tu rnam par dag pa'i zla ba'i 'od sngon du bdar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i spyan sngar phyin to/ /de nas kho mos 9de bzhin gshegs pa de 1 snal mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i zhal mthong ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul zhing sangs rgyas mthong bar byed pa zhes bya ba dang / ting nge 38—202

'dzin dus gsum gyi dbyings7ye shes kyisashogesnang ba'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yang thob par gyur to/ /de thob pas kyang kho mos7bskal pa ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag kyang rjes su dran par gyur to/ /kho mo'i byang chub kyi sems de yang mngon du gyur te/ de ltar kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa de las chos bstan pa thos te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sems can thams cad kyi mun pa rnam par sel ba'i chos kyi snang bas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba'i sgo 'di yang thob par gyur to/ /de thob pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed lus kyisar④rgyas par 'gengs te/'jig rten gyi khams de dag de bzhin gshegs pa7ji snyed cig bzhugasalgepa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i mig lam du snang zhing / bdag nyid kyang de dag thams cad kyis7zhabs kyi drung na 'dug par shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu sems can ji snyed cig skyes pa〈de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i mig lam du snang ste/ de dag gi sgra skad rnam pa tha dad pa'i brdasheyang rab tu shes so/ /sems dang bsam pa dang / dbang po dang mos pa yang rab tu shes so/ /sngon gyi mtha'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du yongs su smin par gyur pa'ang rab tu shes so/ /de dag la bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par 'gyur ba'iphamalus kyang yongs su ston to/ /kho mo'i rnam par thar pa de yang sems kyi skad cig re re la rnam par 'phel te/ rnam par thar pa'i sems de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams brgya'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 1nelus kyis rgyas par 'gengs so/ /de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi 12rdul shin tu phra ba snyed lus kyis rgyas par 'gengs so/ /38—203

de'i 'og ma'i sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed lus kyis rgyas par 'gengs7so/ /de bzhin du sems kyi skad cig re re zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bar dag kyangashelus kyis rgyas par 'gengs sod/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na de bzhin gshegs pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mo'i mig lam du snang ste/ bdag nyid kyang de dag gi zhabs kyi drung na 'dug par shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis chos bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang len to/ /'dzin to / /yongs su 'dzin to/ /nye bar 'dzin torngo)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sngon gyi tshul rgya mtsho dang / smon lam rgya mtsho la yang 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa de dag thams cad kyang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mngon par sgrub bo / /sems can ji snyed cig 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag du skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang / kho mo'i mig lam du snang ste/ sems can de dag gi bsam pa dang dbang po dang mos pa'i bye brag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi bye brag du de dag yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i phyir lus byin gyis rlob steg / de ltar kho mo'i rnam par thar pa de ni sems kyi skad cig re re la yang chos kyi dbyings 'byam rdzi klas pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par 'phel lo / /rigs kyi bu kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sems can thams cad kyi mun pa rnam par sel ba'i chos kyi snang bas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba'i sgo 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' rtsonamatha' dang 38—204

dbus med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis byung ba3)/ chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho'i tshul 'byams0klas par 'dalamachosab la 'jug par dbang sgyur ④ba/ byang chub sems dpas ⑤yang dag par bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i dpal gyis rnam par rtse ba6) 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad yang dag par gzungasnyib la smon lam chen pos byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 9klas pa thams cad sems kyi skad cig gcig gis yongs su dag par bya ba'i bsod nams kyi rgya mtsho chen po yongs su grub pa/ sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i ye shes la dbang bsgyur ba'isngo )'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa'i mun pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i ye shes kyi nyi ma'i mig dang ldan pa/ sems can gyi khams thams cad la theg pa chen po rnam 37par dmigs par bya ba'i mthu dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi the tsom turnyedang /nem nur dang / yid gnyis kyi rab rib rnam par sel ba'i blo gros kyi zla ba dang ldan pa/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad la mngon par chags pa las gyen du bskyod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyis nyu rdul gyi cha shas la nya rirnam par 'phrul pa/ yongs 7su ston pa la dbang bsgyur ba/ dus gsum gyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la ye shes dbyer med pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/ spyod yul la 'jug pa'am/ rnam par thar pas rnam par rtse ba yongs su bstan par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu yul ma ga dha 1 'di nyid kyi snying po byang chub la kho mo 38—205

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed bskyed ①pa/yang dang yang bskul bskulasaba'i mtshan mo'i lhasamo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba 'dug gis 4)de'i gan du song las/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shigatso /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs gyisal/mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /khyod sku shin tu rnam par dag pa mthong / /mtshan gyis rnam brgyan ri bo ji ⑧bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun las mngon 'phags 'jig rten du / /phun sum tshogs sku 'jam dpal bzhin du mdzes/ /khyod kyi chos sku shin tu rnam dag ste/ /dus gsum kun tu mnyam zhing rnam mi rtog /der ni 'jig rten ma lus kun 'dus te⑨/ /'byung zhing rnam par 'jig kyang chags mi mnga' / /lam rgyud 'byam () klas thams cad kun tu yang / /khyod kyi sku ni gzugs brnyan rnam par phye/ /skar chen zla skar rgyu skar tshogs la ji 31bzhin du//spu rtse kun la'ang khyod ni bdag gis mthong / /khyod kyi thugs yangs shin tu rnam dag ste/ /phyogs rnams kun tu 12nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyas/ /der ni mi mchog kun kyang yongs su 'du/ /khyod la ye shes mi rtog dam patshwa mnga'/ /zhing gi rdul snyed rnam pa sna tshogs sprin/ /khyod kyi spu rtse kun nas mngon 'thon cing tsha/ / rgyan mangs bosna tshogs char pa mngon 'bebs shing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhabs drung rgyas par 'gengs/ /'gro ba kun snyed lus rnams mtha' yas pa / /khyod kyi spu rtse kun nas mngon 'thon nyi tshocing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rgyas par yongs bkang nas/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis hu sems can rnam par 38—206

spyod/ /spu rtse kun la bsam yas zhing gi rnams/ /sna tshogs rgyan ldan rnam pa tha dad mthong / /lam rgyud sems can khyod kyis rnamatusbyangs pa/ /ji snyed de dag bsams ②bzhin kun kyang byung ①/ /gang zhig khyod kyi mtshan thos dga' gyur paX/ /de dag thob bya legs thob legs par 'tsho/ /sems can gang gisasnyikhyod kyi sku mthong ba/ /byang chub lam la mngon du bltas par 'gyur⑥/ /de ltar thos nas ⑦rab tu sems dga' la/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyon mongs zhi mdzad pas/ /bskal pa bsam yas ngan song gnas kyang chung 6)/ /khyod kyi zhal lta'i don du mos par bgyi/ /zhing rnams stong gi rdul snyed lus byas te/ /de snyed bskal pa brgyud de khyod 'dra ba'i/ /spu rtse〈nyagacig gi7yon tan legs brjod kyang / /legs pa'i mthar phyin nam du'angasami 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis(ste/ mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis〈snyemangon par bstod nas/ /mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan7pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas(nye/ /yang dang yang bltas te(nye/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur bya bas/ ma ngoms bzhin du mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa'i drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdzo)/ bam po drug (nyepa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa thog ma byang chub tu zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa ni khong du chud par byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying po yang dag par 'byung (tsheb la ni rjes su dpyod/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rgya mtsho 38—207

la ni yongs su 'jug /byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ni yongs su sbyong〈nye)/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ni yongs su gnon/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni rgya cher byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba rgya mtsho ni rjes su 'brang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i snang ba chen po rgya mtsho la ni rnam par ltokye/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab ①pa la gzhol ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po'i sprin ni rgya cher byed/ mtshan mo'i lha mo dpyid dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang ske/ smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor ni zhing thams cad du phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis brlab gepas mngon par sgrub cing / mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpalasadri ma med pa'i 'od gang na ba der song ste/ mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan mo'i yilha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od la/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i sa la spyod pa dang / ji ltar 'byung ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba cho8)ma 'tshal to/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu57)khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la spyod 1 ripa dang ske/ 'byung ba dang 31yongs su 'grub nyu2pa 'dri ba legs so/ /legs so/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams hu byang chub 38—208

sems dpa'i spyod pa la yongs su grub pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon du gyur par mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku mtshan sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnam par ①blta ba'i mig rnam par dag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa rnam par dmyigs par bya ba la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho tshad med pa la chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi tshad kyis7'jug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo nas 'od zer rgya mtsho sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa dngas/ sems can sna tshogs kyi don du bkye ba la 'jug pa dang /ba spu'i bu ga re re nas 'od 'phro ba rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog du 'dug pa rgya mtsho ston pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa rgya mtshos chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang zhing sems can 'dul ba'i byin gyi rlabs 6)la 'jug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung sems can thams cad kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag dang ldan pas/ dus gsum du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra sgrog ⑦pas/ mdo sde thams cad kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra 'byin pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rgya mtshom3)mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bstan pas sems can 'dul ba la 'jug pa 3)ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la hu )yongs su grub pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/ bsam gtan zhi ba'i 1)ribade bas kun tu 38—209

rnam par gnon pa thob pa hu)ste/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ②ni de'i mthus/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang ①mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa la'ang 'jug gol/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang / ting nge 'dzin mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rnam par 'phrul bsargya mtsho dang sngon gyi tshul rgya mtsho dang / mtshan rgya mtsho la'ang 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi9)chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'khor chab rnam pa tha dad ⑧pa la'ang 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i 7tshad sna tshogs dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam pa tha dad pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi 7chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sku'ang hu7'jug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la dngos por mngon par zhen pa'ang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bzhud pa 'gags hu)pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni bzhud pa med pa'onyunyel/ /rang bzhin gyis byungasab med pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni byon pa med pa'o8/ /mi skye ba'i chos nyid dang / mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba'i phyir / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni ma skyes pa'otsho sna/ /mi skye ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni ma 'gags pa'o/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur mthong zhing rnam par dmigs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni mi /shebaden pa ma yin pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi don du byung (rteba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni brdzun pa ma yin pa'o(2 / /shi 'phor spe dang skye ba las rnam par 'das pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni 'pho ba med pa'os / /chos kyi rang bzhin gyis 'jig5nyepa med pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i 38—210

phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni 'jig pa med pa'o/ /ngag gi lam0)thams cad las yongs su 'das pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad ni mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi mthar thug pas(ge/de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni mtshan nyid mi mnga' ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khong du chud par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gtan zhi ba'i bde bas kun tu7rnam par gnon pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i ④bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor snang bas shin tu rgya cher〈byed do/ /shin tu yangs par byed do/ /khong du chud par byed do / /rtogs par byed do/ /mnyam par byed do/ /mngon par sgrub po/ /gzhi snyoms par byed dokyi/ /rab tu 'jug go/ /rnam par 'phel bar byed do/ /nges par sems so/ /nye bar rtog go/ /dran par byed do/ /spyod yul du byed do / /brtanashepar byed do/ /snang bar byed do/ /rab tu brjod do/ /rnam par dpyodasnyedo/ /rnam par 'byed do/ /tshogs su byed do/ /yid ches par byed do/ /yongs su rtog ⑨pa thams cad rgyu ba med pa'i snying rje chen po de la gnas te/ sems can thams cad yongs su bskyabasngo )pa la77yang dag par spyad〈gepar sems rtse gcig tu bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan dang po sgom tunyemo/ /yid kyi las thams cad nye bar zhi bar bya ba dang / ye shes kyi stobs dang / mthus sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba la dga' ba'i 8bde ba la sems rtse gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa sgomadza8mo/ /'khor bar log par zhugs pa la btang snyoms su byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa sgoms mo/ /sems 38—211

can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan bzhi pa sgom 11mo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor (9shin tu yongs par bya ba dang ni/ ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par sgrub pa la mkhas par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tshul la 'jug par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par rtse sgruba'i ye shes thams cad mngon par shes par bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad mngon par bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ sgo kun nas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi tshul yongs su sbyong zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gtan zhi dba'i bde bas kun tu rnam par gnon pa 'di sgom 0mo/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mo rnam par thar pa 'di sgom zhing thabs sna tshogs kyis ⑦sems can yongs su smin par byed de/ 'di ltar nub mo zhi bar gyur pa'i tshe'udaga' ba la mos ḍa pa'i sems can rnams kyis huX mi sdug pa'i 'du shes skyed dzorme/ /mi dga' ba'i 'du shes dang / yongs su skyo ba'i 3)'du shes dang / bgegs5nyesu 'gyur ba'i 'du shes dang / 'ching tsoba'i 'du shes dang / srinatsomo'i 'du shes dang / mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang / sdug bsngal ba'i 'du shes dang /bdag med pa'i 'du shes dang / 34rje med pa'i 'du shes dang / gzhan la rag las pa'i 'du shes dang / rga shi'i 'du shes dang / 'dod pa'i yul dang longs spyod thams cad la dga' ba med pa'i 'du shes skyedarwanyede/ sems can de dag kyang sems de la yongs su sgom nyushepas/ 'dod pa'i dga' bas3)thams cad la / mngon par dga' ba med pas chos la mos pa'i dga' ba la 'jug cing 38—212

khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ngo / /de dag dgon pa la gnas pa'i tshe'ang01chos dang mthun pa'i dad pa yongs su skyed de(mi/ sgra chen po 'jigs pa mi snyan pa'i sgra skad thams cad kyang zhi bar byed do/ /mtshan mo zhi bar gyur pa las gesangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo yang yang gedag par ston to/ /spang ④ba dang 'thun pa'i rkyen yangapo)nye bar ston to/ /khyim gyi sgo yang rnam par 'byed do/ /lam yang yongs su ston to/ /snang bas kyang mngon par byed〈pedo/ /mun pas chod pa yang rnam par sel to/ /'jigs pa'ang med par byed do/ /rab tu byung nyeb la yang yang dag par bsngags pa (7byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi legs pa'ang rjod ⑩do/ /chos kyi legs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi legs pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi legs pa yang rjod nya1do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba la'ang bsngags pa byedamatsho do/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo rnam par thar pa 'di la sgom tunyezhing sems can rnams kyi chos ma yin pa'i 'dod chags kyis 8zhen pa rnams kyi chos ma yin pa'i 'dod chags kyi yongs su rtog 8pa rnams kyang med par byed do/ /tshul ma yin pa'i 'dod pas non 7pa rnams dang nyan/ log7)par yongs su rtogs37pa'i spyod yul can rnams kyi yongs su rtog zhu ripa de dag dang yid la bya ba de dag kyang med par byed do/ /sdig to mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skye ba dang/ sdig to'i yongs su rtog pa skyes par gyur pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur ba'i rkyen nye bar sgrub bo/ /dge ba'i yongs su rtog pa'i 31pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa dang nirte/ spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su 'byung ba'i 3 smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa dang ldan pa dang ske/ byams pa'i tshul dang ldan pa dang / sems can rnams la snying rje chen 38—213

pos rgyas par 'gengs pa dang ldan pa ①dang / lha dang mi'i bde ba rnam pa〈sna tshogs yongs su bskyedam pa dang / ldan pa'i yongs su rtogs pa bskyedasnyipa dang /skyes nas kyang tshul sna tshogs kyi (sa/rkyen nye bar bsgrub par 6)byed pa nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang mthun pa'i rkyen kyang nye bar sgrub pa ⑦byed de/ rigs kyi bu kho mos ni sa)byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gtan zhi ba'i bde bas kun tu rnam par gnon pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' tshekun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis byung57ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa 3 mtha' yas pa'i chos kyi5rnyedabyings kyi ye shes rab tu thob pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis rnam par spel ba'i sems dang ldan pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mthus sems kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul la gnas pa'i sems dang ldan pa/gnas thams cad du sgrib 8pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ zhing rgya mtsho thams cad du zhugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad mthong bar bya ba la zhugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin gyi char yang dag par gzungachaba'i sems dang ldan pa sems can thams cad kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par sel ba/ 'khor ba'i bdesngo snab la 12dga' zhing sred pa zad hu)cing mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i ( ) lam gyis/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du snang ba skyedamanyepa'i sems dang ldan pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa ni 'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ song rigs kyi bu 'di nyid na nga5snyedang yang rgyang mi ring ste/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po byang 38—214

chub kyi g.yas rol cig na①/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar ②rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba 'dug gis snode'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i lam la brtson par bya ba dris shig61/de nas mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis de'i tshe/byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gtan zhi ba'isnyibade bas kun tu rnam par gnon pa 'di nyid brnan yite/ bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ dus rnams kun tu byung ⑦ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ /mngon du bya bar ④mos pa'i sems dang ldan⑨ske/ /de dag mig yangs rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /des ni sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mthong bar 'ong / /rgyal ba'i sku gsal dri ma med la ltosakyi/ /mtshan gyis yongs su rgyanarwatepas shin tu mdzes/ /rgyal ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa chos dbyings rnams / /skad cig re resarwa rgyas 'gengs de la'ang ltos9/snye/ /byang chub shing drung sangs rgyas gdan rab la/ /bde yigashegs rnam par snang mdzad mngon sangs rgyas/ /chos dbyings yangs pa rgyas pa hunyekhyab mdzad cing / /'gro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin 'khor lo bskoratso/ /rgyalasngo bas chos nyid lus med rab zhi ba / /gnyis med rang bzhin med pa thugs chud nas/ / gzugs sku hunyebazang po mtshan gyis brgyan pa yis/ /'gro ba ma lus bkang zhing ston pa mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rgya che bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi dbyings kun yongs su rgyas bkang zhing / /de ni kun tu mnyam par snang ba ste/ /rgyal ba thams cad kun tu ston pa mdzad/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul rab phra ba snyed/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas sku/ /kha dog bzang po gzhan dang0)gzhan snang 38—215

bas / /chos dbyings rgyas par skad cig re res 3)'gengs/ /rgyal ba'i ba spu'i sgo nas 'od zer sprin/ /rgya ches bsam yas mi zad mngon 'byung ba/ /de dag 'gro ba ma lus 'gengs byed cing / /srog chags rnams kyi nyon mongs gdung ba sel / /sangs rgyas sprul pa rgya mtsho mi zad pa/ /rgyal ba'i spu yi 'khor kyenas yongs ston 4cing / /chos dbyings yangs pa rgyas par kun bkang ste/ /srog chags rnams kyi sdug bsngal ngan song sel/ /sangs rgyas gsung snyan rab tu sgrog mdzad pa/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i55)sgra 'od can/ /chos char chen po rab tu 'bebs pa mdzad/ /srog chags byang chub bsam pa yongs su skyed⑥/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho kye spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /'dis (kyeni sngan cad 6)yongs su gzung mdzad pathe / /de dag kun gyi /nyargyal ba rnam par nyi snang mdzad pa'/ /zhing rnams kun tu gzugs brnyan mtshan nyid mthong / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten kun tu 'byung 8/ /sems can re re kun la'ang mngon par bzhugasal/ /mos pa'i tshul bzhin spyod yul gzhan dang gzhan/ /de dag kho mos kun tu shes mi nusal/ /rgyal sras dam pa thams cad ma lus par/ /bde7gshegs pa hu 〉spu gcig gi 1shertsa nyu/las 'byung spe bye/ /rnam thar (tede la gang rnams bsam yas pa/ /de dag thams cad kho mos shes mi nus rnye/ /kho mo'i 'dabs nyan gnas pa'i lha mo 'di/ /'jig rten mgon la mngon gyur gegerab tu dga'/ /ming du snang ba 'od 'phro mig ces bya/ /de la byang chub spyod pa ci 'dra dris/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis (snyematshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od la lan brgya stong du mar 38wa 216

g.yas phyogs su bskoratub byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo kun tu zab pa'i dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi migadams ngag gi labyin gyis brlabs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyiX/ tshig la nan tan du bya ba'i sems yang dag par skyes pa/ dge ba'i gshes sheganyen gyi 56)sman pa la nad pa lta bu'i57)'du shes kyis yongs su spyad pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba yid la byed pa ma 'khrugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen blta ba la bsgribs ⑧pa'i ri thams cad rnam par gtor spuba'i glags rnyed pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba la sems can gyi khams5) thams cad yongs su bskyab 31pa'i snying rje chen po'i tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug pa thob pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba la chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pa'i sems dang ldan pa de32/mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i myig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba gang na ba der song ngo / /de nas mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i myig 'gro bar 3nyernam par snang bas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs de bas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs las byung bas yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba tshogs chen po las byung bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba 1 —rnam par gnon pa chen por byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'drung du 'gro ba brtson 'grus kyi lasala'ajug par dka' nya 7bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba bsdad nya cing shin tu legs par byin 38—217

gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba phyogs mtha' dang dbusadza1)med pa la 'jug par byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba yun ring por gnas pas byung bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba ②don mtha' yas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par dmyigs pa 'byung mebar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba ④lam gyi rgyan mtha' dang dbus med pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gnon par byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba ri sgo kun nas rnam par gnon pas byung bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi (6)drung du 'gro ba g.yo ba med par 'ong bas rnam par gnon par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshogs kyi 8ribartson 'grus la rab tu brtson pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang smon lam chen po rgya mtsho mngon par bsgrub pa'i rnam par gnon pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang /sems can gcig gi don du phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par sdugashebasngal nyams su blang ba'i nyu )zhe non pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang ske/ rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sgra sgrog5)cing yun ring por gnas pa'i rnam par gnon pa dang / brtson 'grus chen po'i go bgos pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang / phyogs rgya mtsho 'byam sna klas pa thams cad du shugs kyis 'gro bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang / ba spu'i sbubs gcig tu phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par byang chub sems dpa'i / spyod pa la gnas pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba 38—218

dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas nas kyang sems kyi skad cigs nyarmore re la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'gengs pa ②la gnas par bya bas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang / dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan dang / lam yongs su gnon par zhe non pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul gyis nirgyun tu zhugs pa'i lam yongs su gnas 0pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ⑤gyi drung du 'gro bsnyudang / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad la dmigs pa las ma g.yos par④/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pasasnyedage ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro bsalgematshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar tu 3rnam par snang ba gang na ba der phyin pa dang /des mtshan mo'i lha mo (1rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar tu rnam par snang ba/bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi hunyedakyil 'khor na 8seng ge'i khri me tog gi snying potshamacan la 'dug cing / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba yangs shing dri ma med pa'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan la/ mnyam tsho/ 7par bzhag pa mthong ngo / /de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sbyin pa la stsogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa mngon par ston pa'i sprin sems can thams cad/mngon par dga' ba3she/ sems can thams cad kyi yid du 'ong bturte/ sems can thams cad kyis blta na nyams su bde ba/ sems can thams cad kyis blta na sdug pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba yang mthong ste/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad la phan gdags shing rtsod ( )pa med par bya ba dang / dngos po thams cad la phangs par rtsi zhunyab med par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad 38—219

la sbyor ba mtshungs pas yongs su gtang7)bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems su bya ba dang / sems can thams cad la brnyas7pa med par yongs su gtangs ba dang / nang dang phyi'i dngos po thams cad yongs su gtang ba dang dga' geb chen po yongs su gtang ⑤bar bstan pa dang /'jig rten thams cad du sems can gyi bsam pa jipo)bzhin gyi sbyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa dang mthun pa'i sgras sbyin⑧pa'i spyod pa yongs su ston pa'i sprin dang / dus gsum du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams gtang7)bar dka' ba yongs su gtong ba'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprin 'thon nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas par gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rnam par dmyigs par gyur parwanyamathong ngo 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog gi/ mthu phyung ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob nyurtepas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/sems can thams cad dang sna mnyam pa'i skye ba sna tshogs su sprul pa'i lus kyi sprin mngon par 'thon teng/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la rgyas par khyab par byas nas/ mngon sum du brtul zhugs /5thams cad kyi yid dam las mi g.yo bar yongs su bstan 49pa dang /sems can gyi khams dang mnyam pa'i dka' thub dang / brtul zhugs tu kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rab tu ston pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad du gnas pa med pa dang / yul thams cad la ltos7)pa med pa dang / 'khor ba thams cad du gnas pa las phyir phyogs pa dang / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa rgyad 38—220

pa'i sgor gzhol ba yongs su ston pa dang / mi sdug pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu ston pa dang / 'jig rten gyi sdug pa'i7)'du shes kyisarnyuphyin ci log rnam par bzlog⑧pa dang / mi rtag pa dang / g.yo ba dang / 'jig pa dang / 'gyur ba'i chos nyid yongs su ston pa dang / 'du byed thams cad kyi chos nyid sdug bsngal zhing bdag med pa yongs su ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la gnas pa dang / mi 'bral bar mos par byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims shin tu dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can rnamasasrel yang dag par bskul ⑤ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi sgras tshul khrims kyi spyod pa yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po yongs su ston par byed cing ske/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems can thams cad dang mnyamapo)pa'i lus kha dog sna tshogs su sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te⑦/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kyang nyams su bzod pa sems can thams cad la yongs su ston pa98)/ sems can thams cad kyis lus la gnod par tho brtsams r+sha)kyang nyams su bzod par byed pa dang 1 3sems can thams cad kyi hu1tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i tshig gis spyo ba nyurtedang /brgyad pa dang / smad pa dang / bskyung 32ba dang / brdeg pa dang /bsdigs 8pa nyams su bzod par byed pa yongs su ston pacadang / sems can thams cad kyis mi sgul〈lhab yongs su ston pa dang / rim gror byas pa 3)dang /rim gror ma byas pa thams cad kyis mtho ba dang dma' bar mi 'gyur ba yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad nyusnyel nga rgyal med pa yongs su ston pa dang /38—221

chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la bzod pa mi zad pas ye shes mi zad pa yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir bzod pa'i spyod panyeyongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lalus dbyibs ④mi sdug cing / kha dog mi mdzes pa'i gzugs rnam par zlog pa 'byed pa dang / sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mdog rnam par dag pa bla na med pa yongs su ston cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ⑤mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa'i skye ba sna tshogs kyi ④lus kha dog dang dbyibs dang / chu zhengashe sna tshogs su sprul pa'i sprin 'thon tedu/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta bshe bzhin du rgyas par khyab par byas nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs chen po la brtson 'grus kyis (nye sngon du 'dor ba/ yang dag par ston pa dang /bdud kyi dkrugs ma thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / byang chub tu brtsams pa mi 'khrugs mi zlogs〈spe/pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rab tu bsgral ba'i brtson 'grus dang mi khom pa dang ngan nyugesong dang / ngan 'gro dang log par ltung ba'i lam thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / mi shes pa'i ri rnam par gtor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur〈nyebs yongs su mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyisa'akhor lo yang dag par blang ba dang / yongs su bzung snyiba'i brtson 'grus dang ske/ sgrib pa thams cad kyi ri rab tu gzhom zhing rnam par gtor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul 38—222

bas mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag ①par bya ba'i brtson 'grus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa bla na med pa yongs su ston cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngos/ /ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas lus sna tshogs kha dog dngarasadabyibs rnam pa tha dad par sprul pa'i sprin 'thon tedu/ thabs sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams kyi dga' ba yongs su skyedasnyipa dang / yidarnyubade ba rnam par zlogashepa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad rnam par smod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa'i chos nyid 'jig rten du sgrog 3)pa dang / dbang po bsdamasalgepa la sems can rnams rab tu dgod pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa bla na med pa yang dag par bsngags pa byed pa dang / 'dod pa'i 'jig rten (3 bdud kyi yul 'jigatshwanyepa dang bcasalgepar yongs su ston pa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang bral ba rnams la 'jig rten gyi 'dodarwanyepa dang / dga' ba'i yul thams cad yongs su ston pa dang / chos la mos shing dga' ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / mthar gyis bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgo mngon par bsgrub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par gsal husteb la nges par rtogs pa'i sems yongs su rjod 8pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su ston 7pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa dang glu/ rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yongs su ston pa byed cing / sems can rnamasatshwa stakyi dga' ba yongs su bskyed 32pa dang / spro ba 'phel bar bya ba dang / nyams bde ba 37yongs su bskyed 2 )pa dang / yid mi 38—223

bde ba bzlogamatshopa dang / sems skyon med pa yongs su bsgrub pa dang / sems las su rung bar bya ba dang / bsam pa rnam par sbyang ba dang / dbang po gsal bar bya ba dang / lus kyi bde ba yongs su bskyed ②pa dang / chos la dga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar bya ba byed cing / sems can rnams ①yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas/ skye ba thams cad dang 'dra ba'i lus kyi sprin sna tshogs 'thon te/ zhing thams cad kyi khongs su gi chud pa'i sems can thams cad kyi yid bzhin du bstan pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gan du 'gro bas skyo ba khye)med pa yongs su ston pa dang /slob dpon dang / bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes 6)gnyen la rim gror mebya ba dang ske/ bsnyen bkur bas skyo ba med pa yongs su ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi na 'khor lo 'khor bam()yang dag par blang zhing yongs su bzung 3 bas skyo ba med pa'i brtson 'grus yongs su ston pa dang /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad khong du chud par bya ba'i tshul yang dag par brjod pa dang / chos kyi sgo rgya mtsho thams cad rnam par 'byed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid dang rang bzhin dang tshul mngon par brjod pa dang / chos thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi sgor yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dri ba 11dang the tsom 1 rgya mtsho rnam par sel bas shes rab kyi yul yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lta ba'i ri shin tu 'joms tu pa'i shes rab rdo rje yongs su ston pa dang / sems kyi skad cig gcig dang ldan pas/sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i shes rab kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba yongs su ston pa gebyed cing / sems can thams 38—224

cad kyi dga' ba yongs su skye bar bya bas sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas kha dog dang dbyibs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus mang po 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam pa'i sprul pa'i sprin 'thon (1)te bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la zhusamangon du gnas shing / sgra skad sna tshogs kyis yongs su sbyang ba'i gebastan pas 'jig rten pa'i ④bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa mngon par ston pa dang /'jig rten pa'i bya ba thams cad rab tu rgyu ba dang khams gsum pa 'byung ba thams cad yongs su bstanam5)pa dang / khams gsum pa thams cad las 'byung ba'i phyogs yang dag par brjod pa dang / lta ba'i mya ngan mi bzad4)pa thams cad las 'byung ba'i phyogs yang dag par bstan pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam gyi khyad par yongs su brjod pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lam las yongs su bzla ba yang dag par ston pa dang / rim gror byas pa dang / rim gror ma byas pa la byams sdang gis gos pa med param yongs su ston pa dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo la mi sheganas pa yang dag par ston pa dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas la stsogs pa gcig nas gcig tu 9)rgyu ba rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / snying po byang chub 1 tu song zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba 31rgyun mi 'chad 12pa yongs su ston pa 15byed cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo ske/ /ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul skoshin tu phra ba snyed kyi lus sprul pa'i sprin 'thon 5te/ sems can gyi 'jig rten thams cad la mngon sum du gnas shing sabyang chub sems dpa' 38—225

kun tu bzang po'i hu)spyod pa dang smon lam yongs su brjodashepa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rnam par dag pa'i mthar thug⑧pa'i smon lam gyi khyad par yongs su brjod pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba yongs su brjodasnyipa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing rim gror bya ba rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su brjodamasapa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa 4)rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi rdulam④shin tu phra ba snyed kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / zhing thams cad du phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par gnas shing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam rnam par dag par bya ba (2)yongs su brjod ⑨pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par ston 7pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs〈rtel 'jug 8pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par brjod 1nyepa dang / dus gsum gyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang /zhing thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyi murnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par ston pa nyunyebyed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang ske/ spyod pa yongs su bstan pas sems can thams cad thams cad tsomakhyen pa nyid la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang nya 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang mnyam pa'i lus kyi sprul pa'i sprin mang po 'thon tenya / sems can thams cad la mngon par gnas shing /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs kyi stobs mu med pa yongs su ston pa dang /38—226

thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems kyi stobs mi zad pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang /chud mi za ba'i chos can yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su sgrub pa'i stobs phyir mi ldog cing phyir mi zlogs 17la thub du pa med pa dang / rgyun med pa dang /③ bla na med pa yongs su ston pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad kyis sami gos pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs bdud chekyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs nyon mongs pa 3)thams cad kyi dri mas nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyi ri rnam par 'thor ba yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po'i stobs bskal pa thams cad du gnas kyang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas skyo ba med pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su bskyod cing bskulashebs/ sems can thams cad rab tu dga' bar byed pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs bdud dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad rab tu 'joms ⑧pa yongs su ston pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i ye shes kyi stobs chen po 'jig rten du rab tu brjod 3)pa byed cing sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / / ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi bob spu'i sgo re re nas kyang lus kyi sprul pa rgya hunyamatsho kha dog mtha' yas pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang mnyam pa'i sprin phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams su rgyas par 'gengs 38—227

pa 'thon hu te/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / ye shes kyi rnam par gnon pa yongs su ston pa dang / sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /ni sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho yongs su shes pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul geba'i dus las mi 'da' ba'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad du grags par sgrog pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad du ye shes kyi tshul rgya mtshos rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad 'du ba dang / 'jig pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gzhi dang dbyibs pa dang / rgyan rnam par dgod pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa na thams cad kyi mchod pa rnam par sprul te④/ spyan sngar phyin nas / mchod cing rim gror ri3 byed pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin yang dag par 'dzin pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa 0byed cing / de ltar ye shes52kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su ston hu )pas sems can rnams kyi dga' ba skyedatshwarme pa dang / sems rab tu /rtedang bar byed pa dang / rab tu dga' ba skyedam rtepa dang ske/ mos pa 'phel bar byed pa dang / yid mi bde ba rnam par zlog 8pa dang ske/ sems rnam par spyod pa dang / sems skyon med par78skye bar byed pa 38wa 228

dang ske/ dbang po gsal bar byed pa dang / mos pa'i stobs yongs su skyedamatsho)pa dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las phyir mi ldog par byed pa mthong ngo pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pas 'jig rten du cisngo ltar sems can yongs su smin par gyur pa mthong ba bde bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad rab tu sgrog ④pa'i tshul gyis mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i 3)thog ma sems bskyed pa'i tshogs dang / dge ba'i bshesalgeganyen bsnyen 2bkur ba'i thabs dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung du phyin cing mchod pa dang / rim gro byas pa'i tshul dang / dge ba'i chos buspyad pa'i thabs ji snyed pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pas gtang bar dka' 1)ba yongs su gtong nya )ba dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyang ba'i 11thabs dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po dang /'khor mang po dang / longs spyod kyi dbang 32chen po yongs su btang ste/mngon par 'byung nyugeba'i thabs ji snyed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dka' ba'i spyod pa brtul zhugs yidang dka' thub chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bzod pa skomangon par bsgrubs hu9pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs hurteyang dag par blang ba'i 32sbyor ba la mi g.yo bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam 1/brtan pa'i chos rgya mtsho sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi nyes byas dang / ngan rna du smra ba dang / nyes par 21spyod pa thams cad bag la zha sa bar byed pa'i sbyor ba dang/ lus dang sems kyi gnod ( gepa nyams su bzod par byed pa'i sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /chos thams cad 'jig pa med pa'i chos nyid la bzod pa dang / chos thams 38wa 229

cad la yid ches pa'i bzod pa dang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs pa'i bzod pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du rtsom zhing sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ji snyed cig yod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus ji snyed cig yod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ji snyed pa thams cad dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya ba ༅dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i (2bsgrub pa rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pas/ rnam par 'phrul pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rgya mtsho la 'jug pa 47ji snyed cig yod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ji snyed pa thams cad dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs ji snyed ringanapa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab chen po'i〈snanyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par sbyang ba'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang / shes rab chen po'i sprin yongs su 'du ba'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang / shes rab kyi gter chen po'i phyiratshogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang / shes rab kyi ④rgya mtsho chen po la rnam par dpyad pa'i tshul dang / sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /thabs chen poshel mkhas pa'i tshul gyi sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / thabs chen po la mkhas pa yongs su dag par bya ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ⑨ji snyed pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus ji snyed cig yod pa dang smon lam chen po'i pha rol tu phyin patsoyongs su grub pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / smon lam chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod 38—230

pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / smon lam chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi/ sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par bya ba'i tshogs chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rkyen du gyur pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho0)chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu bstan pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byam 70klas pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul la yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rnam par dmigs par bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byam7klas pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rgyas par 'gengs pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa (brgya chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i5gelhun ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ri yongs su 'grubashepar bya ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang ske/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa'i rnam pa rab tu phye ba la 'jug pa 'byung ba57yongs su bsgrub pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu 38—231

phyin pa la yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i tshul dang ldan pa'i chos rnams dang /chos yongs su bsdu ba dang / chos kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / las kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / zhing gi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /bskal pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / dus kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems yongs su 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 6)rnam par dgod pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i riba'abyung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i zhurab tu 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rjes gesu 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi ye shes kyilarjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnam par 'byed pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos5yirgya mtsho'i tshul gyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos gang tsochen mtsho'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi rgyud kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi gter gyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi lugs kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 3)spyod pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i dmigs pa can de dag 38—232

thams cad de'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ha)ba spu'i sgo re re nas mngon par 'thon te / sems can gyi lus kyi sprin kha dog sna tshogs can du mngon par mchod tsho cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /'di lta ste/ 'og min dang ske/ shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / ma dros pa dang / mi che ba'i gtsang ma'i gnas kyi lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon mecing /sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /de bzhin du 'bras bu che ba dang ske/ bsod nams 'phel ba dang / sprin dang bral ba'i gelha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /dge rgyas dang tshad med dge ba dang / dge ba chung ba'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thonabacing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /kun snang dang ba dang / tshad med snang ba dang / snang ba chung ngu'i 3)lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon paras ci'athon cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /tshangs chen dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun ris kyi lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon (kyecing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /dbang sgyur ponagyi lha'i rgyal po 3 )lha mo'i tshogs dang lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta 37bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta 12bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon〈nyecing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo tsha /rab dga' ldan gyi lha'i rgyal po lha mo'i tshogs dang lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta 'bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thonas cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed 38wa 233

pa mthong ngo / /rab nya)mtshe ma'i tsulha'i rgyal po lha mo'i tshogs dang lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i ri lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /lha'i rgyal po brgya byin lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon (4)cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /dri za'i rgyal po gnas srung po dang /dri za'i bu dang / dri za'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon zhugacing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / grul bum gyi bu dang grul bum gyi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang dang / klu'i bu dang / klu'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /gnod sbyin gyi ne/rgyal po chen po ngal bso 3)po dang / gnod sbyin gyi bu dang gnod sbyin gyi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /mi'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po dang /mi'am ci'i bu dang/ mi'am ci'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing ske/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po blo gros bzang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i bu dang / lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po shugs drag stobs chen dang ske/ nam mkha' lding gi bu dang nam mkha' lding gi 3)bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thonas(cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /38—234

lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan dang / lha ma yin gyi bu dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo lta bu'i ①lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang / gshin rje'i bu dang /gshin rje'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngolo/ /mi'i dbang po dang skyes pa dang bud med dang khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon lke — cing /sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /de bzhin du 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad du gtogs ༄pa'i sems can thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang drang srong thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /rlung dang chu dang me'i phung po7lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /rgya mtsho dang / chu klung dang / ri dang /nags tshal dang / lo tog yidang / sman dang / shing dang / sa'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /bza' shing gi ra ba dang / grong khyer dang / snying po byang chub dang ske/ nyin par spyidang / mtshan mo dang / nam mkha' dang / phyogs dang /rkang gis 'gro ba sredang / lus kyi ris su gtogs pa dang lta)/ lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon 1 tshocing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ba nas/ de bzhin du lag na rdo rje lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing / phyogs bcur 11rgyas par bkang ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul 38—235

'byam yo)klas pa thams cad du (misems can thams cad la chamangon par gnas shing5ge/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i bar du mthong ste/ mtshan mo'i55)lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro b.ral)rnam par snang ba'i sems thog ma bskyed pa'i tshogs la stsogs pa'i sngon gyis)/ tshe rabs la'uyongs su bsgrubasashepa'i dge ba'i sems gcig nas gcig tu brgyud hu3 de/ rgyun ma77chad pa'i tshul ji snyed pa dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bsngags pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab /3chags pa dang / shi 'pho dang skye ba yongs su bzung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / lus yongs su bzung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / ming gi hurte'akhor lo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gan du 'gro ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /sangs rgyas byung ste bsnyen bkur ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / chos kyi tshig 8dang / yi ge blangs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi nan tan gyi sems gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / ting nge 'dzin thob pas sangs rgyas mthong ba tshegacig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / zhing mthong ba'i mig gi 1 rgyas par bkang 1 pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'dab chags pa dang / chos kyi dbyings khong du chud pa'i ye shes gcig nas )smugacig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /py-i ) sems can gyi 38—236

khams la rnam par lta7)ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtshor gtogs pa'i sems can pha rol gyi shi 'pho 92dang ske/ skye ba shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /lha'i rna ba g.yongs su dag pa rtogs par byed pa'i shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi semasal ril rnam par blta ⑤zhing dbyings la 'jug 6)pa'i sgo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / thog ma lha'i mig la zhugs pa'i sgo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / thog ma (71lha'i rna ba rnam par dmigs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab 58)chags pa dang / thog ma sems can pha rol gyi 1)sems shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / thog ma bdag dang sems can pha rol gyi sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / thog ma dngos po med pa la rab tu gnas te/ mngon par 'du bya ba myed nyi ripa'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i rkyen gcig nas 1nyagacig tu brgyud cing 'dab chag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po'i nyu2rnam par gnon pas/ phyogs rgyas pamu 'gengs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thob mupa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mcho'i tshul 8bsam gyis myi khyab pa la 'jug pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting skye'adzin gyi nya rnam par 'phrul pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa gcig 38—237

nas hu)gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su gnon pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ming du bya ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam la 'jug pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa nas/ mtshan mo'i lha mokhurab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro b.rashernam par snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes shin tu phra ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de'i ba spu'i sgo ④thams cad nas 'asprul pa'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon toX/ /sems can rnams la chos 'chad ⑦pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang /gsal bar byed pa dang / yongs su ston pa dang / rjes su rjod ⑧pa dang /rab tu 'byed pa dang / shin tu rgya cher byed pa dang / 'grang 17ba dang /nges par ston pa dang / rnam par rig par byed pa dang / nye bar bsgrub pa mthong ste/ la la la ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor shin tu 'khrugs pa'i sgra skad kyis chos ston pa mthong ngo / /la la la ni chu'i phung po rab tu rlob pa'i sgra skad kyis/la la la ni me'i me zhi )lce shin tu rlob pa'i sgra skad kyis/ la la la ni rgya mtsho'i 'brug gi sgra skad 3tshekyis/ la la la ni sa yongs su g.yos pa'i sgra skad kyis/ la la la ni ri chen po 3)phan tshun thug nyi cing 'thab pa'i sgra skad kyis tsol la la ni lha'i grong khyer g.yos pa'i nga ro snyan pa'i sgra skad kyis/ la la la ni lha'i gzhal med khang 'thub cing 'khrol 8ba'i sgra skad kyis 7chos ston pa 3lhemathong ngo la la la ni lha'i dbang po'i 3)skad kyis/ la la la ni klu'i dbang po'i skad kyis/3)la la la ni gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i skad kyis/ la la la ni dri za'i dbang po'i 38wa 238

skad kyis/ la la la ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i skad kyis/ la la la ni nam mkha'7lding gi dbang po'i skad kyis/ la la la ni mi'am ci'i dbang po'i skad kyisaX la la la ni lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'ilobaskad kyis/ la la la ni mi'i dbang po'i skad kyis/ la la la ni tshangs pa'i dbang po'i skad kyis/ la la la ni lha mo'i glu'i0dbyangs kyis/ la la la ni lha rdzas kyi rol mo legs par blangs pa'i dbyangs kyis/ la la la ni nor busarin po che'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ la la la ni sems can gyi ris thams cad kyi skad sna tshogs7kyis mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar〈rnam par snang ba'i rnam par thar pa'i yul sems can rnams la nirab tu rjod ⑨pa mthong ngo / / de bzhin du ④byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi tu)sprin gyis byang chub sems dpa'i tunyesgra skad sna tshogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i 8sku'i sprin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i cigasung rnam pa tha dad pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag gi tshul gyis mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i rnam par thar pa'i yul thog ma sems bskyed pa dang bcas pa tsoyongs su byung tshasto/ grub cing yang dag par 'dus pa dang bcas nyu mornam par thar pa'i rnam par rtse 1)ba dang bcas pa/sems can thams cad la rnam par dmigs par nyu)byed pa mthong ngo / /de'i sprul pa'i gzugs kyi sprin re res kyang sems kyi skad cig re re la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa 6)rnam par sbyong ba mthong ngo / /sems can rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa dag kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad las rnam par 'grel ni7pa mthong ngo /sems can gyi khams mtha' dang / dbus med pa dag kyang mi'i phun sum tshogs 38—239

pa la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo / /sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang 'khor ba'i sna)rgya mtsho las gyen ②du bskyod (kyepa mthong ngo sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo / /sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi sar 'dzud la pa/ tshong dpon gyi gebu nor bzangs kyisalgemathong ngo / /thos so rnam par dpyad do/ /zhugs so khong du chud do/ /nges par rtogs so/ / rjes su shes so/ /④rjes su 'brangs so/ /rjes su zhugs so/ /mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis brlabs te/ de ni mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang pos ⑧dga' ba shin tu yangs pa'i rgya mtshomatsho)bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba'i byin dang / sngon skal ba mnyam par spyad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis (1byin du brlabs 3)pa dang ske/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa kun tu bzang po'i snod du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa'i dga' 1 ba'i shugs drag po gang rnguchen mtsho snang ba chen po rab tu thob pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa des/ mtshan mo'i lha mo 3lharab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad 7pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do3 / /rgyal ba'i 38wa 240

chos rnams shin tu zab/ /de la khyod kyis7bskal pa tshad med bslabs/ /bsam pa jikhubazhin gzugs rnams kyisas/ /'gro ba kun bkanga'age'ajig rten rim pas bstan/ /bdag med mgon med log pa yoge/ /'du shes rtag tu 'khrul pa mkhyen gyur nas/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam pa du ma yis/ /lus dang dbang phyug ston mdzad 'gro ba 'dul/ /shin tu rims bral rab tu zhi/ /chos sku gnyis med rnam par dganyepa mnga'/ /'gro ba ma lus gnyis gnas pa/ /sprul pa'i sprin sgra 'brug gis rnam par 'dul/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /khyod ni nam yang mi gnas mi rten 47te/ /yan lag kun rgyas gzugs mchog dang ske/ /dbang phyug yongs su bsgrags pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /phyi dang nang las rnam par grol/ /gnyis las byung ba'i mtsho las 'phags gyur kyang / /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan 2)'gro ba'i rgyud du rab tu ston/ /khyod la g.yo ba mi mnga' ste/ /nams yang rlom sems g.yo ba'i spros mi mnga' /'jig rten spros mos byis pa rnams/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ston 7cing 'dul ba mdzad(spel/ /ting / 'dzin rgya mtsho kun spyod pas/ /bskal pa mang por rtse gcig thub bzhugs kyang / /phyogs bcu'i bde nya gshegs mchod don du/ /spu 6rnams rtse las sprul pa'i sprin kyang 'gyed/ /sangs rgyas stobs la 'jug 6pa'i tshul/ /skad cig re rer mtha' yas thugs su chud/ /sems can bsdu ba'i sbyor ba rnams / /so so'i rkyen 10bzhin go bar bgyi bas nya bstan/ /khyod kyis srid pa'i rgya mtsho dag /las kyis rnam 12bris sna tshogs gzugs gzigs shing / /chos kyi sgrib pa med pa'i lam bstan te/ /sems can kun kyang rnam par sbyong ba mdzad /pe / /khyod 2 sku mtshan bris 21rnam dag kyang / /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa 38—241

dam pa yis/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang tshul du/ /khyod ni lha mo'i sku gzugs ston/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis①/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i ②mig 'gro b.rasnyernam par snang ba la tshul dang 'dra ba'ikhutshigs su bcad pa de das gis mngon par bstod de/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mo khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs nas ji srid cig lags/ lha mo khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba shin tu yangs shing dri ma med pa'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan 'di thob nasasnyiji sridarnyucig lags/ de nas mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro b.rasamernam par snang bas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ dran pa7bskal pa mang 'dasalgepa/ /zhing gi rdul snyed de yi ⑩snga rol na/ /zhing ni rin chen mdogatshwanyebade 'byung / /de yi7bskal pa zhi ba'i dbyangs shes bya/ /gling bzhi bye ba khrag khrigatshwanyeste/ /brgya stong phrag bcu rnams kyis yongs su gang / /tshad med rin chen ri bo 'dra'/ /gling bzhi b.rasnyim bzang po rnam par bkram / /rgyal po'i pho brang bye ba brgya/ /stong phrag bcu rnams yongs su tshang ba ste/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mdangs dga' ba/ /dbus na gnas pa nyurtespos kyi hu rgyal mtshan 'od)/ /der ni phyogs kyi dbang po sa yi bdagazhu pya /'khor los sgyur (1ba mngon par gzugs bzang byunga'age/ /mtshan rab zhugesum cu gnyis dang ldan/ / de yi lus kyang dpe5nyebyad bzang pos brgyan/ /pad mo'i sbubs nas rdzus te byung / /gser gyi mdog bzang 'od byung (gelus dang ldan/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan thams cad du/ /mkha' las du 9'gro zhing 'od kyis de 'gengs so/ / de yi tri rmebu ni stong tshang ni ste/ /kun kyang yan lag 38—242

dam pa'i gzugs dang ldan/ /blon po mkhas shing gsal ba dang / / mdzangs shing yid tshigazhungs bye ba shin tu mang / /btsun mo bye ba phrag bcu tshang / /lha mokhuji bzhin dga' ba'i tshul la mkhas/ /de dag phan sems bde sems kyis //rgyal po de la nye ba'i yid du gnas/ /rgyal po de ni sa chen de/ /ri dang khoramaji yug kun gyi mthasasnyiklas pa'i/ /gling bzhi'i 6)phun sum tshogs pa dag /kun kyang chos kyi stobs kyisalgeganas par byed/ /kho mo 'khor los sgyurasheb yi/ /btsun mo tshangs pa'i sgra skad rin chen lus/ /gser gyi mdog 'chang 7)dri med 'od / /dpag tshad stong du 'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs/ /nyi ma nub par gyur nas kyang / rgyal po sras dang 'khor bcas gzims gyur nas/ /rol mo'i dbyangs kyang zhi gyur te/ /kho mo mal (lhan bde bar nyal nyal natunye/ /nam gyi phyedarwanyetsam gung zhig la/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi rgya mtsho byung bar gyur/ /de tshe rgyal bas rnam 'phrul ba/ /phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste bstan pa mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer rgya mtsho des/ /zhing 7gi rdul snyed 'jig rten khyab par gyur/ /rnam 'phrul sku rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad ma lus rgyas par bkangasnyi/ /sa rnams ri dang bcas par g.yos/ /rgyal ba byung zhes sgra yang yongs su brjodapa/ 3/ /lha dang lha min mi dang klu/ /kun kyang rgyal ba byung bas rab tu dga'/ /sangs rgyas ba spu'i sgo kun nas/ /sprul pa'itshwanyergya mtsho mang po mngon par byung / /des ni phyogs bcu rgyas bkang nas/ /'jig rten bsam pa bzhin du chos kyang bstan/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas de dag kyang / /rgyal bas thams5)cad bdag gi 3 rirmi lam bstan/ /zab mo'i 'brug sgra thos gyur nas//khong du chud pas kho mo dga' yid gyur/ /mtshan mo'i lha mo stong snyed kyang / /38—243
