kho mo'i steng gi bar snang mkhar 3)gnas shing / /rgyal ba'i legs pa brjod byas nas / /kho mo sad par smra zhing brjod/ / lha yi ri blo gros btsun mo longs/ /khyod kyi rgyal po'i khams su rgyal ba geskyes/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho brgya dag tu/ /de 'dra'i phun sum tshogs pa rnam dag kun / /kho mo dgar gyur sad par gyur/ /'od gsal dri med rnam dag mthong / /'od bzang de ni ga las blta blta na/ /byang chub shing rgyal drung gi rgyal ba mthong / /mtshan nyid ④sum cusheganyis kyisalgebargyan / /ba spu 42kun nas 'od zer rgya mtsho bkye/ /ri rab ji bzhin mngon par 'phags/ /rgyal ba g.yas g.yos07)kun tu'ang 3 )de bzhin no/ /mthong nas kho mo rab dga' ste/ /de 'drar 'gyur bar sems kyang yongs su bskyed/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul yangs 11mthong nas/ /kho mos smon lam shin tu rgya chen btabarka/ /kho mos rgyal po bzhengs /2su gsol/ / de yi 1 'khor dang bud med tshogs kyang bslang nyu tsho/ /sangs rgyas 'od yangs 8mthong gyur nas/ /kun kyang bde ba'i lus su gyur/ /rgyal po de dang lhan cig tu/ / bzhon pa 8bye ba srog chags khrag khrig gis/ /yongs su bskor te dpung bcas pa/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar kun kyang dong 1 / /lo grangs stong phrag nyi shur yang / /kho mos rgyal ba de la mchod bkur byas/ /rin chen bdun yang yon du phul/ /rgya mtsho yongs dang 1 bcas pa'i sa yang gsol/ /mdo sde rgya mtsho yon tan sprin/ /smon lam mtsho las yongs su byung ba'i rgyan/ /kun kyang de bzhin gshegs las byung / /bsam pa ji bzhin 'gro bar de bzhin bstan/ /mtshan mo'i lha mo ji snyed cig /de tshe snying brtser kho mo 1/phan bstan rdu tshopa/ /de 'drar gyur te myos bsal 3)zhes/ /kho mo 22mos pa sheyongs su skyes par gyur/ /kho mo'i smon lam de 'dra'i sems/ /38—244

thog ma byang chub mchog tu skyes par 1)gyur/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho tshoguganas pa'i tshe / /srid pa'i rgya mtshos gde ni zhig ma gyur/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rnams / /kho mos〈gedad pa bskyed de mchod pa byas/ /'khor ba'i lha dang mi dbus su/ /yul gyi dga' dang bde la lamangon par smon/ /rgyal ba'i dang po dpal gyi mtsho/ / de yirnyu'og ma yon tan sgron ma steme)/ /rgyal ba gsum pa rin chen dpal/ /sangs rgyas bzhi pa nam mkha'i shes rab po'u)/ /rgyal ba lnga pa me tog mchog /rgyal ba drug pa chags med zla ba'i blo()/ /rgyal ba bdun pa huX'od rgyal chos kyi zla/ /brgyad pa ye shes dkyil 'khor snang ba'o/ /rin chen 'od 'phro ri sgron te(nya/ /rgyal ba dgu sna pa de tshe byung bar gyurahunye/ /bcu pa dus gsum 'od dbyangs mite/ /de dag kho mos dad pas mchod/ /bcu po de las sogasalgepa dag / mi yi tshadabang po dam pa kun mchod de/ /tshul gyi rgya mtsho 'dir zhugs pa'i/ /mig ni de srid yun gyis thob ma gyur/ /de 'og zhing gi 'tshamasal 7sbyor ba/ /rin chen thams cad 'od ces bya ba byung / /bskal pa lha yi〈nyedapal zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga brgya de la nyugebyung bar gyur/ /thog ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byung / /gnyis pa nyi ma'i sgron ma mngon par skyesani )/ /snang ba'i rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas gsum/ / de yi 3tshe'og tu rin chen ri bo'o/ /me tog 'od 'phro rgya mtsho sgron/ / me yi sa dpal dang lha yis gedapal gyi mchog /snang ba'i rgyal po 'od kyi dpal/ /bcu pa /ye shes kun snang rgyal po 'o mi/ /bcu po de la stsogs pa dag / mi yi ni dbang po de dag kho mo yis/ /phung po'i gnas la dad dga' zhing / /gnas med chos la gnas kyi blo mchod dod / /de 'og de yimanyamatshams sbyor ba/ /'jig rten khams bzang sa byung bar gyur pa nizhu no//38—245

pad ma'i7)sgron ma sprin gyi dpal/ /de tshe bskal pa tshangs pa'ishe'od ces bya/ /de la rgyal ba tshad med de/ /de dag 'khor dang bcas pam kho mos mchod/ /rgyal ba de dag thams cad las/ /rim gro chen pos kho mosasrechos kyang thos/ /rgyal ba'i dang gepo rin chen ri/ / de yi sku'og ma yon tan rgya mtsho ste/ /rgyal ba chos dbyings dbyangs kyi tshedapal/ /chos rab rgya mtsho sgrogashepa bzhi pa'o⑨/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan gzungs kyi 'od/ /chos stobs 'od dang nam mkha'i blo gros te / /chos 'od ri bo 7sgo mthon dang / /de dag tharwanyema'i mtshan ni sprin dpal lo / /bcu po de 3gel sogs pa dag /mi yi hunyedam pa de dag kun mchod de8/ /rgyal ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir zhugs pa'i/ /chos nyid de ni dag ma gyur/ /de yishe'og tu de bzhin gshegs/ /nyi ma'i sgron ma dpal gyi dpal zhes bya/ /zhing ni sangs rgyas yod pa ste/ /de la bskal pa zla ba'i dpal byung ngo 7/ /de la stobs bcu byung ba ni/ /bye ba brgyad hu 〉cu yongs su tshang ba ste/ /de dag kun la'ang mchod pa'i sgo/ /rgya che mtha' yas yid 'ong du ma byas/ /thog mar byung ba dri za'i rgyal/ / de yi 3)'og tu sangs rgyas shing rgyal te(rkye/ /rgyal ba gsum pa yon tan ri/ / de yi 33 'og tu rin chen spyan gshegs so/ /rnam par snang mdzad5te'od kyi rgyan rte/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho sangs rgyas gzi brjid dpal/ /'jig rten dbang po 'od bzang dpal/ /kun gyi tha ma chos 'od rgyal po'o/ /bcu po de la du rtestsogs pa dag /bde gshegs de dag thams cad mchod byas kyang / /chos kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa yi he/ /ye shes kho mos thob par ma gyur to/ / de yisa'og tu zhing dag pa/ /rdo rje'i zhu5rang bzhin mi phyed du stagazi brjid brtan(nye/ /kun tu 'od sprin ming ldan byung / /rgyan gcig kun nas mdzes par gnas pa'o/ /de 38wa 246

la sems can dag pa mngatu/ /nyon mongs dri mas nyon mongs du shin tu nyung / /bskal pa rab zhi blo gros 'od/ /sangs rgyas stong rnams byung bas rnam par brgyan / /rgyal ba'i dang po rdo rjeshegatsug /gnyis pa chags med stobs mnga'i mtshan ldan pa/ /rgyal ba chos nyid byagazugs brnyan dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu sgron ma gsal ba'i bdag /rgyal ba lnga pa thugs rje'i 'od/ /rgyal ba drug pa brtul zhugs7rgya mtsho'o/ /bde gshegs bzod 'khor sgronakhum dang / /brgyad pa chos kyi dkyil 'khor snang ba ste/ /snang ba rgya mtshos brgyan pa dang / /de dag tha ma zhi ba'i rgyal po'o/ /bcu po de la sogs pa dag / mi yisnyidam pa de kun kho mos mchod/ /chos nyid nam mkha' mnyam pa 'di/ /rang bzhin yongs su kun nas dag pa ste/ /de la gnas shing zhing gi rnams/ /'byamasaphyo)klas kun tu spyod spyad ma dag go/ / de yi bo'og tu mdangs dga' ba'i(nya/ /zhing gi nyurtespos sgron sprin gyi 3nyedapal zhes bya/ /kun nas nyon mongs yongs su dag / de yi yibaskal pa legs par byung 8zhes bya/ /rgyal tsob bye ba de tshe byung / /de dag kun gyi de che'i 3 7bskal pa brgyan/ /mgon po de dag chos gsung ba/ /kho mos dran pa'i stobs kyis yongs su bzung / /rgyal ba'i (shedang po grags tu)yangs te(bye / /chos kyi rgya mtsho shugs drag dpal gyi rgyal/ /chos dbang rgyal po yon tan sprin/ /chos kyi dpal dang lha yino 1cod pan no/ /ye shes 'od 'phro gzi brjid dpal/ /rkang gnyis dam pa bdun pa de yin no/ /rgyal ba brgyad〈 nyepa nam mkha'i dbyings/ /dgu pa kun tu 'byung ba'i sgron ma ste/ /de dag tha ma'i sangs rgyas ni/ /mdzod spu'i dpal gyi 'od kyi blo gros te/ /rgyal ba mi mchog de dag la/ /mchod pa byas nas sa chags med de ma sbyangs/ / de 38—247

yi71 'og ma rgyan rab can/ /rin chen sna tshogs kun tu gnas pa ste/ /'jig rten rnam par phye ba'i mtha'/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan blo gros mchog / de che'ilgebaskal pa snying po'i patshogs/ /de la sangs rgyas brgya phrag lnga byung ste/ /rnam thar chags med 'di 'dod cing / /rang byung ④de dag thams cad kho mos mchod / /thog ma'i mtshan ni yon tan 'khor/ /zhi ba'i dbyangs dang rgya mtsho phun sum tshogs/ /nyi ma'i gzi brjid dpal gyi bdag /mtshan gyi sprin sgra dbyangs shes bya ba dang / /chos dbyangs〈rgyal po yon tan bdag /bsod nams ri rab zhi ba'irnyu'od kyi rgyal/ /bcu po de la stsogs pa dag /rgyal ba de dag kun kyang kho mos mchod/ /rgyal ba'i lam ni der sbyangs te/ /de la rgyal ba kun kyang yang dag gzhol/ /'on kyang da dung rgyal ba yitsho/ /tshul 'dir 'jug pa'i bzod pa ma thob po/8)/ /de 'og yid 'ong 'od ldan pa/ /yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten khams byung ste9ri/ /zhing dbyangs phreng ba'i blo gros can/ /sems can nyon mongs nyung ba'i gnas yin no/ /bskal pa bde zhing 3)mngon dga' ste/ /de la sangs rgyas bye ba brgyad cu byung / /mi mchog de kun kho mos mchod / /rgyal ba mchog gi 31lam yang rnam par sbyangs/ /rgyal ba'i dang tsho/)po me tog brtsegs/ /rgya mtsho'i snying po yang dag 'byung ba'i mchog /lha dbang gtsug phud rin chen gtso/ /gser gyi ri bo rin chen brtsegs pa dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan nor gyi dpal/ /de dag kun gyi tha ma ye shes blo/ /bcu po de la 3nyesogs pa dag1na /lha dang mi gtso 3gede dag kho mos mchod/ /de 'og mtshams sbyor zhing byung tshab/ /sprul pa bzang po'i rgyal mtshan sgron ma ste/ /bskal pa stong gi dpal zhes bya/ /de la sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig drug /zhi ba'i rgyal 38—248

mtshan zhi gnas dpal/ /zhi ba'i sgron mas31sprin gyi rgyal po'i⑧dpal/ /snang ba'i 'od kyi rgyal po dang / /rnam par sprin mched nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang / /chos kyi sgron ma dpal gyi ri/ /'od 'phro'i dpal dang lha yi gesnying po'i dpal/ /de dag tha mar byung ba ni/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrogs rgyamakhas pa sgron ma'o/ /bcu po de la stsogs pa dag ge /bde gshegs zla ba de dag kho mos mchod/ /'on kyang tshul mtsho 'dir 'jug pa'i/ /bzod pa kho mos thob par ma gyur to/ /de yi 'og 'tshams7sbyor zhing byung ba/ /kun tu snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba ste/ /bskal pa gnas med rnam par brgyan/ /de la sangs rgyas bye ba sum cu drug /dngasnyepo yon tan kun tu sprin/ / de yi tshe'og ma sangs rgyas nam mkha'i thugs//sangs rgyas legs byung rnam hu sgribargyan nyanyadang / /rgya mtsho 3 chos kyi sprin sgra sgrogs pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba chos dbyings gsung dbyangs dang / /sprul pa'i sprin sgra snyan pa'i dpal mnga' dang / /sangs rgyas phyogs kun gzi brjid dang / /chos kyi rgya mtsho yongs byung ⑩sgra dbyangs dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho dpal gyi sgron8 / /rgyal ba'i nyi ma dgu pa byung bar gyur/ /de dag kun gyi tha ma ste/ /rin chen dpal sgron yon tan dpal mchod do/ /rin chen dpal sgron yon tan dpal / /rkang gnyis dam pa byung tshabar gyur pa'i tshe/ /kho mo lha mo zla bzhin te// mi yi7 7dam pa byungs/8tshe mchod pa byas/ /rgyal ba des ni kho mo la/ /mdo sde smon lam rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i rgyan/ /gnas med rgyan kyang rab tu bshad/ /thos nas kho mos dran pa'i stobs kyis bzung nyu9/ /kho mos mig yangs der thob ste / /ting〈 )'dzin zhi dang gzungs kyi stobs 21kyang thob/ /skad cig sa re re zhing brgyud〈 nyepa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho mang po'ang kho mos mthong / /byams tshul 38—249

kun tu snang ba'i sprin/ /byang chub sems rab mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ /snying rje'i snying pos brgyan pa yang / /sangs rgyas stobs kyi tshul7du yangs par skyes/ /'gro ba phyin ci logatsha gyur te/ /rtag dang bde dang gtsang dang bdag zhen pa/ /gti mug mdongs7gyur ma rig bsgribs/ /nyon mongs 'khrugs shing log par 'du shes pa/ /lta ba'i rnam par stug50la spyod/ /lam gyi 'gro rgyud nyam ngar0sred dbang gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bye brag tu/ /las kyis ༅rnam par bris pas kun byung ba/ /'gro rgyud kun gyi shi 'pho'i〈sgor/ /skye bar 'gyur bas kun tu skyer 'gyur cing0)/ /skye dang rga shi gnod pa rnams/ /lus dang sems kyi nyams su myong gyur pa/ /mthong nas de dag phan bde'i phyir/ /zhing rnams 'byam tshims thams cad kyi/ /stobs hunyabacu gang las byung ba yorte/ /bla na med pa'i sems kyang kho mos bskyed(rte/ /de las smon lam sprin byung ba/ /'gro ba kun la bde bar cigazhol ba'i mchog /tshogs rnams 'byung 8ba mtha' yas dang ske/ /lam tshul rgya mtsho rtogs pa'ang de nas byung / /'jug pa'i sprin yangs thob gyur pa/ /lam chud kun tu sgo gsal7shugs ldan te/ /pha rol phyin gyi sprin yangs pa'ang / /chos dbyings 'byam 9/7klas kun tu rnam par 'byed/ /sa gnon shugs drag yangs ldan dang / /dus gsum rgya mtsho'i hu tshul gyi sa rnams la / /chags pa med par spyod par gyur/ /skad cig gcig gis rgyal ba kun drung 'gro/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras kho mos ni/ /spyod pa kun tu bzang po yongs su non19/ /chos dbyings bye brag bcu rnams kyi/ /rgya mtsho'i tshul la'ang kho mo ciX nortogs par 'jug /rigs kyi bu de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/rgyal po 'khor los sgyur 21ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi rgyun mi gcod pa la 38wa 250

zhugs pa/ mi'i bdag po zhes bya ba byung ba/ de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam0)du sems na ni/ rigs kyi bu de ltar mi bltam ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po mi'i bdag po zhes bya ba 'khor los sgyurakhub sangs rgyas kyi rigs rgyun mi gcod ④pa la zhugs pa'o/ /kho mo sad par byed pa'i mtshan mo'i lha mo de ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos sprul pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur52ba'i btsun mo bud med rin po che bzang po'i blo gros ma zhes bya ba byung ba de gragazhan zhig yin pa snyam du sems na ni de ltar myi blta ni)ste/ kho mo ni de'i tshe de'i dus na / 'khor los sgyur7ba'i btsun77mo bud med rin po che bzang po'i blo gros ma zhes bya bar gyur te/ kho mo mtshan mo'i lha mo des sad par byas nas/ sangs rgyas blta ba la nyuteyang dag par bskul to/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems de srid cig nas bskyed de/ de ltar kho mosngogesems bskyed pa de'i mthus/ bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du nam yang ngan song log par ltung bar ma skyes te/ rtag tu rgyun ma 'chad par lha dang hunyemi'i 'gro ba'i rgyud la rten 8cing / thams cad du'ang de bzhin gshegs pa gebalta ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /tha mar kho mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen dpal gyi sgrol tsham yon tan rgyal mtshan mthong ba tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba nyu shin tu yangs shing dri ma med pa'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'di thob ste/ de thob pas kho mo sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i don du rnam pa 38—251

'di lta bus sta gon du gnas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba rgya chen po'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na 'khod cing / sems kyi skad cig re re la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'jug pa'i shugs drag po rgya mtsho chen po rab tu thob pa / 'jug pa'i sgo thams cad la sems kyi skad cig re re zhing smon lam chen po rgya mtshos 'jug pa/ rab tu thob pa/ sems kyi skad cig re re zhing smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tshul la phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par spyadasnyo pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa/ spyod pa re re la'ang lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa/ lus re res kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa la mkhas pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho re re la'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba dumibazhin du lus rnam par dmigs pa'i spyod pa yongs su ston pa la mkhas pa/ zhing thams cad du'ang zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug par mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re zhing bu yang chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgyas par 'gengs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug par mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i tshogs yongs su bsgrub pa5ngariyang dag par bsdus pa la 'jug par mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu yangs par/ yang dag par blang ba rinadang / yongs 38—252

su gzung ba la mkhas pa/ dus gsum thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug par mkhas pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am / yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 3)'di nyid na kho mo dang / rgyang mishering ba zhig na mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal zhes bya ba 'dug gisal/ de'i zhugan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas④/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya ba dang / ji ltar yongs su sbyang bar ⑤bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisayi / mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig9)'gro bar〈rnam par snang ba la/ lan spubargya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltasamatsho/ )te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par tu'isnang ba'i drung /dzortenas song ngo hurte// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/8 bam po bdun pal/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba shin tu yangs shing dri ma med pa'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan de la mos par bya ba dang / khong du chud par bya ba dang / rtogs par bya ba dang / shes par bya ba dang / yid ches par bya ba dang / rab tu gzhol bar bya ba dang / rgyas par dgang bar bya 17ba dang / rjes su shes par bya ba dang / rjes su dran par bya ba dang / rjes su gzhol bar bya ba dang /38wa 253

bsgomanyepa byed cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la nan tan du bya ba dang ske/ gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa la bar chad med par bya ba'i phyir mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i ②mig 'gro bar rnam par snang bas/ 'gro khar gdams ②pa rjes su dran par 'byed cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen blta ba'i rjes su sems pa'i (snyedabang po'i dkyil 'khor dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba thob par bya ba la yang dag par spyod pa/ phyogs kun tu mngon par ltas57pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar yid la bya ba dang / nga rgyal thams cad dang bral ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen⑧bkur ba'i mthu shetshogs chen pos ⑩yongs su bsgrub par zhe non pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa thams cad la bsam pa mi phyed pas zhugs pa/dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brtan57pa yongs su 'phel bar bya ba la brtson 'grus kyi shugs chen po rgya hurtematsho yongs su skyes pa/ bskal pa thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pas 12gnas par bya ba'i smon lam dang ldan pa de/ mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal gyi drung du song ngo / /de de ltar 'gro ba'i tshe/ mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal gyis tsobyang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 'jig rten thams cad mngon du gyur pas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba ston pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos yongs su grub pa'i lus bstan te/ mdzod spu nas 'od zer ye shes kyi 'od kun tu snang ba dri nyisam med pa'i mdangs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'od zer gyi 38—254

'khor stimatha' dang dbus med pa dang ldan pa ②bkye'o/ /des 'jig rten thams cad snang bar byas nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi laspyi bor 'dus te ༷lus thams cad du khyab par gyur to/ /tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'od zer des phyireg par gyur ma thag tu de nyid kyi mod la ting nge 'dzin shin tu rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor thob par gyur to/ /de thob pas mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga'akhuba'i mig 'gro bar〈rnam par snang ba dang / mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun nas7skyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi dpal gnyis kyi bar gyi lam na sa'i dkyil 'khor yod pa de la me'i rdul shin tu phra ba'am / chu'i rdul shin tu phra ba'am/ sa'i rdul shin tu phra ba'am/ rdo rje'i rdul shin tu phra ba'am/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po dam pa sna tshogs kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'amanya/ me tog dang / spos dang / phye ma'i rdul shin tu phra ba'am rgyan thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'am/ dmigs pa thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed cig yod pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba de dag thams cad la rdul phra mo re re zhing yang / 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/chu'i phung po dang bcas/ me'i phung po dang bcas/ rlung gi phung po dang bcas/sa'i phung po dang bcas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtshams dang bcas/ gzhirwatedang bcas rten dang bcas pa hurtedabyibs sna tshogs can sa'i nyushegazhi rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i 8ri'i 'khor sna tshogs can chu rlung 9/snyedang mtsho sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rgya mtsho sna tshogs kyis phonyekun nas 'khor ba/ lha rdzas kyi5nyekhyim sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ shing sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/nam mkha'i tunyedabyings kyi rgyan sna tshogs can/ lha'i grong 37khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan 38—255

dang bcas pa/ klu'i grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin gyi grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ dri za'i grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ lha ma yin gyi grong7khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ nam mkha' lding gi grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyanas②dang bcas pa/ mi'am ci'i grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ lto 'phye chen po'i grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/mi'i grong khyer gyi khyim gyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na rnam 6)par gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi grong khyer gyi khyim gyi buganas dang / sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi yul dang / byol song gi skye gnas kyi 'jig rten gyi yul dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi duyul dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 6)lam gyi rgyud kyi shi 'phophudang / skye ba'i yul dang bcas pa / skye ba 8)sna tshogs kyis ma 'dres pa'i rgyud mtha' yas pa'i bye brag la yongs su gzhol ba rnams 'du zhing 'jig par 6)gyur pa mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang rnam pa sna tshogs su mthong ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams la la ni kun nas nyon mongs par mthong ngo / /la la ni yongs su dag par mthong ngo / /la la ni shin tu kun nas nyon mongs par mthong ngo / /la la ni lam gyi rgyud yongs su dag par 1 mthong ngo / /la la ni kun nas nyon mongs pa la hu7yongs su dag par mthong ngo / /la la ni rnam par dag pa la tu kun nas nyon mongs par mthong ngo / /la la ni shin tu yongs su dag par mthong ngo / /la la ni gzhi mnyam 3 par mthong ngo / /la la ni spyi'u tshugs su gnas par mthong ngo la la ni snrel zhir khu'adug par mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sems can gyi 12lam gyi rgyud dang / sems can gyi skye gnas thams cad na mtshan mo'i 38—256

lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i ①gzi brjid dpal sems can so so nas 'dul ba'i rkyen bzhin du 'jig rten thams cad la ma 'dres par yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la mngon du gyur par gnas par mthong ngo / /sems can tshe'i tshad rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa dang / mos pa'i spyod yul rnam pa sna tshogs can dang / zhulus rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa dang ske/ ngag⑧rnam par phye ba dang / nges pa'i tshig gi 'du byed kyi tha snyad rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa dang / sbyor ba'i rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa dang /dbang gi rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa rnams yongs su smin par bya ba dang gdul ba'i don du sems can thams cad la ma 'dres par mngon sum du gnas paramasamathong ngo / /de yang 'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal ba'i lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang /'jigs ⑥pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas sna tshogs su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi gcig la gcig za ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang ske/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi bkres pa dang / skoms/pa la stsogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / klu'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi klu'i sdug bsngal dang / 'jigs pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang ske/ 'dod pa'i khams su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i khams kyi (8)sdug bsngal dang / 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / mi'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi mtshan mo'i 1)mun pa mun nag gis/ chod pa'i mun pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa 38—257

dang ske/ mi snyan pa dang / bsngags pa ma yin pa dang / grags pa ma yin pa'i sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa la mngon par zhen pa'i sems can rnams kyi grags pa yo)ma yin pa dang / bsngags pa ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'khor gyi 'jigs par lhung〈ba'i sems can rnams kyi 'khor tu bag tsha ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'chi bas 'jigs shing sngang ba'i ①sems can rnams kyi 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang /ngan song gi g.yang sas 'jigs shing sngang ba'isnyisems can rnams kyi ngan song gi g.yang sa'i 'jigs ⑥pa rnam par bzlog ⑦pa dang /'tsho ⑧ba med pas 'jigs shing skrag pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'tshosheb med pa'i0'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chud zos kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba chud zos kyi〈nya'ajigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi sems nyams kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i sems can rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems nyams kyi tunye'ajigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang /sdig to'i〈nyegrogs po dang phrad kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i sems can rnamasatshwastesdig to'i grogs po dang phrad pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral gyis dogs shing bag tsha ba'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba'i 'jigs nyugepa rnam par bzlog pa dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar lhung 7gis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i sems can rnams kyi nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung (chuba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'khor ba'i gnas sna tshogs kyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigasal shing skrag pa rnams kyi 'khor ba'i gnas sna tshogs kyi sdug bsngal gyi /rje38—258

'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems can skal ba mi mnyam pa dang phrad kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba rnams kyi sems can skal ba mi mnyam pa dang phrad pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / dus mi bzad ①par skyes kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba rnams kyi dus mi bzad ④par skye ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / rigs ngan par skyes kyis〈kye'ajigs shing bag tsha ba rnams kyi rigs ngan par skye ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / sdig to'i las byas kyis 'jigs shing bag tsha ba rnams kyi⑦/ sdig to'i las byed pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pas 'jigs shing sngang ba ④rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i 'jigs 6)pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'du shes kyi rnam pa sna tshogs kyis (peganas dang 'ching bas 'jigs shing sngang ba nirnams kyi 'du shes ④rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gnas dang /'ching ba'i 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir hu )sems can thams cad5nyal so sor mngon tu gyur par gnas pa nyurtemathong ngo / /'di lta ste sgo nga las skyes pa'i sems can dang / mngal nas skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang /rdzus te skyes pa dang / gzugs yod pa dang / gzugs med pa dang / 'du shes yod pa dang / 'du shes med pa dang / 'du shes yod pa'ang ma yin/'du shes med pa yang ma yin pa'i sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab hunyepa'i smon lam gyi stobs mngon par bsgrub 0pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs drag po dang / rnam par gnon pa shin tu yangs pa'i stobs dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa chen po'i nyunyestobs dang /mthu dang / byang chub sems dpa' skyekun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon 38—259

lam mngon par bsgrubs 31pa'i stobs kyis snying rje chen po'i tshul rgya mtsho'i shugs drag po shin tu skyes pa'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i byams pa chen pos rgyas par dgang ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bde ba yongs su bsgrub 2)pa dang / dga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i ye shes rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang ldan pas zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba la mngon du gyur par gnas par rimathong ngo / /chos thams ④cad kyi rgyus shes par bya ba la mngon du gyur pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing rim gror bya ba la mngon du gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa yongs su gzung ba la mngon du gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bstsags pa la mngon du gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad rnam par 'phel bar bya ba la mngon du gyur pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems la sgrib pa med par mngon du gyur par gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po yongs su smin par bya ba la mngon du gyur par gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mos pa rgya mtsho rnam par sbyang ba la mngon du gyur pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa'i chos rnam par bzlog pa la mngon du gyur pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa rnam par bstsal ⑤ba la mngon du gyur cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes snang ba yongs su bskyed ⑥pa'i don du gnas pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ⑦mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal gyi byang chub 38—260

sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par gnas shing / 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba ston pa bsam gyis 3)mi khyab pa de lta bur snyemathong nas rab tu dga' ba skyes te/ spro ba chen po'i shugs drag po rgya mtsho rab tu thob nas/ mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal la lus thams cad kyis phab ste phyag byas nas ngor gyen du bltas so/ /de nas mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu laskyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang /mtshan rnam par dag pa de mi snang bar byas te/ mtshan mo'i lha mo'i gzugs su byas tedu/ rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad 'byin cing 'dug par gnas so/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 3)mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal gyi mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /khyod kyi sku yang (ne mtshan rab rgyan gyis brgyan / /shin tu bzang zhing mdzes pa bdag gis mthong / /nam mkha' skar ma'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa bzhin/ /dpe byad bzang pos rnam par bris pa mthong ske/ /'od kyi 'khor can sku bzang dam pa'i mchog /mtha' yas zhing gi rdul khams mang po snyed/ /kha dog sna tshogs rnam pa'i dpe tshul du/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi dbyings su khyab par gang / /'od zer dra ba mang po 'gro sems mnyam / /khyod kyitsob spu'i sgo nas 'gyed btso)mdzad/ /'od zer sgo la pad+mo'i ⑨yid 'ong gnas/ /khyod kyi sprul pa 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /spos kyi na bun sprin du chags pa 'gyed/ /'gro ba'i gzugs su gnas te kun nas mdzes/ /me tog sgo rnams kun nas dgye 1 rimadzad pas/ /chos dbyings bzhugs pa'i rgyal 38—261

ba kun tu khyab/ /khyod kyi phrag pa'i lhun yangs 'phags pa ni/ /rin chen 'od 'phro ri bo ri rab 'dra/ /dri med de ni 'gro ba kun tu gsal/ /gti mug mun nag hu)rnam par bzlog pa ri mdzad/ /khyod kyi dri med zhal ①mdog bzang ba ④las / /na bun sprin dang nyi ma yangs pa 'byung / /khyod kyi nyi ma'isnyi'akhor 'dra 'od bzang bane/ /rnam par snang mdzad spyod yul yangs pa 'byin/ /khyod kyi spyan nas zla skar 'od 'byung ba/ /rtag tu dri med sprin ltar mang ba ste/ /de dag phyogs bcur bkang mazhing 'gro ba rnams/ /rab tu snang byed 'jig rten rab rib sel/ /khyod kyi mtshan las 'gro ba'i lus mnyam pa'i/ /sprul pa rgya mtsho phyogs su khyab par 'phro/ /de dag chos dbyings yangs par0)rgyas 'gengs shing ske/ /sems can tshad med tshogs ⑨rnams yongs su 'dul/ /khyod kyi sku ni 'byam 7klas 11phyogs su snang / /'gro ba kun la mngon gyur hurtedaga' ba bskyed(nye/ /rgyal po me dang rkun po chus bskyed pa'i/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam sel zhi bar mdzad/ /gang tshe khyod kyi spyan sngar bdag btang nas/ /yon tan rnam par sems shing nyer phyin pa/ /de'i tshe 'od zer dri med 'khor bzang btso/ /khyod kyi zhal gyi smin mtshams gseb nas 'thon/ /phyogs rnams rgya mtsho brgya mang snang mdzad nas/ /'jig rten snang ba rgya che yongs bskyed de/ /rnam 'phrul rnam pa mang po rnam 7bstan nas/ /de tshe bdag gi lus kyi gseb tu zhihunye/ /gang tshe 'od kyi 'khor gyis bdag reg pa/ /de tshe bde ba rmad tunyebyung yangs pa myong ske/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin brgya mang yongs su gnon(she/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sgo sdudapag yas mthong bar 'gyur sto// /gom pa rnam bor gyen du bteg pa la'ang ske/ /rdul phran grangs snyed tshul ni bdag gis rig /rdul phran shin tu phra 38wa 262

ba gcig la yang / /zhing gi rdul snyed zhing rnams mthong bar gyur/ /rdul la gnas kyang rnam pa tha dgu ①ste/ /zhing mang brgya ni shin tu nyon yang mongs/ / de yi7'gro ba sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /chongasanger ngu zhing smre sngags yongs su 'don/ /zhing mang la la kun nas nyon mongs dag /de na sdug bsngal mang zhing bde ba chung / /rgyal ba thugs rje can yang der skyes te④/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos rang rgyal de bzhin no/ /zhing tshul la la yongs dag nyon mongs te⑤/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas bzangs ⑥mang pos brgyan/ /skyes pa bud med yongs brgyan blta na sdug /skyon med rgyal ba'i gdung yang rgyun mi 'chad/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho yangs shing dri med pa/ /rdul la gnas shing ⑦mnyam pa'i gzhi dang ldan/ /de dag bskal pa brgya mang sngon gyi tshe/ /rnam par snang mdzad spyod mdzad yongs su sbyangs3)/ /zhing rnams 'byam 3)klas kun nas ⑩rgyal ba dag /shing dbang dam pa'i drung du gshegs pa ston313/ /rnam par 'phrul zhing byang chub 'tshang yang rgya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cing 'dul ba ston/ /rnam par snang mdzad spyod yul yangs pa la/ /khyod kyang kun tu rjes su bzhud5)par mthong ske/ /mchod pa stong phrag tshad med khrag khrig gis/ /rgyal ba kun la mngon par mchod mdzad mthong tsho / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tsotshigs su bcad pa de dag smras nas/ mtshan mo'i lha mo sems can kun tu skyong ba'i gzi brjid dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mo byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa de/ de lta bu mazab pa ni ngo mtshar che na/ rnam par thar pa de'i ming ni ci zhes bgyi/ de khyod kyis brnyes nas yun ni ji srid cig lagasatso/byang chub sems dpas ji ltar nan tan du bgyis na rnam par thar pa de yongs su 38—263

dag par 'gyur/ smras pa rigs kyi bu gnas 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su bcas71)pas yid ches par dka' ba ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam khong du chud pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po milhur len pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab chosapa la zhugs pa/ mi khom pa dang ngan song dang / ngan 'gro'i lam thams cad rnam par bzlog pa la zhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa/ bla na med par bya ba la zhugs pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rgyun mi gcad 4pa la zhugs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad ④kyi bstan pa yongs su gzung 6 ba la zhugs pa/ bskal pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pas/ gnas par bya ba'i smon lam chen po rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/chos rgya mtsho thams cad la bsgribs ji pa med pa'i ye shes snang ba rnam par sbyang ba la zhugs pa/ skad cig re re zhing dus gsum gyi tshul rgya ni/mtsho thams cad du ye shes snang bas/ rnam par gnas pa rab tu thob pa rnams kyi yul te/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis suspubastan par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig gi pha rol tu 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid dpal zhes bya bar bskal pa rdul dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba byung 1 ste/ bskal pa de las 11sangs rgyas ri rab gyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed hu byung bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid dpal zhes bya ba de ni rin 38—264

po che thams cad kyi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ rdo rje las byas pa'i gzhal med khang dang / gnas kyis yongs su mdzes par byas pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i gzhi ni rin po che'i ①rgyal po dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi ②rgya mtsho las blangs pa ste/ lhun dang lus ni nor bu rin po che'i〈spos thams cad kyi rgyal po las gyur pa'o/ /de⑥ni dbyibs kun tu zlum pa ste/ rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa/ lhab lhub thams cad kyisasprin gyi bla res kun nas khyab pa/rin po che'i khor7yug rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ rim pa stong gis yongs su bskor ba/ gling bzhi pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag 9)stong gis ⑧shin tu rgyas par brgyan ⑨pa ste/ de la gling bzhi pa la la ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ste/sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las dang ldan pa rnams kyi tshiganas so/ /la la ni kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa ste/ sems can las 'dren 31 ma dang ldan pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /la la ni rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa ste/ sems can yongs su dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyangasarwartepa/ kha na ma tho ba nyung ba rnams kyi gnas so/ /la la ni shin tu yongs su dag pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dag pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid dpal zhes bya ba de'i shar phyogs logasarwa kyi khor 7yug gi mtshams na/ gling bzhi pa'i rin chen 7me tog sgron tunyema'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa/ma rmos ma bskyedarwartepa'i 'bras 32la yongs su spyod pa/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa'i hu)khang pa brtsegs ni )pa'i gnas dang / gzhal med khang la yongs su spyod pa/ 'khor kun nas yid bzhin gyi shing gis 'khor 38—265

ba / spos kyi shing sna tshogs kyi lhun las spos kyi sprin rgyun mi 'chad0)par 'byung brka/ phreng mib sna tshogs kyi shing las phreng5ri ba'i sprin rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba/me tog sna tshogs kyi shing las me tog kha dog dang / dri bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprin kyi char ④rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab pa/ phye ma dang55)/ kha dog sna tshogs kyi shing gi lhun las 45)spos rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi phye ma'i char rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab pa4)ri/ rin po che'i shing sna tshogs las rin po che'i 'bru mang po 'brulamacho8)ba'i/ kha dog snang bas shin tu snang bar byas pa/ lha rdzas kyi rol mo sna tshogs kyi 7)shing las/ sil snyan sna tshogs kyi sprin rlung gis bskyod cing /nam mkha'i dbyings las sgra dbyangs snyan pa 'byung ba/ nyin mtshan gyi bde ba nyi ma dang zla bas 'byung nyu ༷ba/ nor bu rin po che kun tu snang bas gzhi byas〈nyepa'i sa rab tu mnyam par gyur pa ste/ gling bzhi pa〈rnyeder rgyal po'i/ pho brang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong byung bar gyur te/ rgyal po'i pho brang de dag re re zhing yang chu klung stong gis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /chu klung de dag thams cadarwanyekyang lha rdzas kyi me tog sil mas logang ba'o/ /lha rdzas kyi rol mo dang / glu'i sgra skad snyan cing yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa'o/ /chu 'gram rin po che'i shing yid du 'ong bas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyis hunyeshin tu brgyan pa'i gru phan tshun du 7rgyu ba'o/ /bde ba sna tshogs ci dga' bar yongs su spyad du yod pa'o/ /chu klung k+ko tshogi mtshams kyi gzhi re re dag na'ang / grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu kun nas gnas pa ste/ grong khyer de dag re re zhing yang grong rdal pa/snyebye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gis 19yongs su bskor du — )ba'o/ /grong dang grong khyer dang grong rdal dro nyade dag thams cad kyang lha khu rdzas kyi bza' shing gi ra ba dang /38wa 266

gzhal med khang dang / khang pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /gling bzhi pa 11de'i 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus na rgyal po'i pho brang dbusam rin po che'i me tog sgron ma zhes bya ba yod par gyur to / /de ni skyid cing longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan la/ rtag du lo legs shing bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /lha dang mi mang pos yongs su gang ba'o/ /sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa rnams kyi gnas su gyur pa ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang rin po che7me tog sgron ma zhes bya ba de na rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen ⑥pad mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po zhes bya ba 'khor los sgyur7ba/ gling bzhi la dbang ba pad mo'i snying po las༄rdzus te byung ba / mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis lus shin tu brgyan pa chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che bdun dang ldan pa gnas par gyur to/ /de'i bu dpa' zhing rdul77phod la yan lagasngoḥdam pa'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan gyi 'khor rab tu 'joms〈rtepa/ rnam pa thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i yan lag dam pa dang ldan pa stong tshang bar byung hunyengo / /de'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi bud med kyang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu yod par gyur to0/ /de dag kun kyang 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i skal ba dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba mthun par spyod pa rin po che'i rgyan rang skye'akhrungs su byung ba/ dge ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ lha'i bu mo dang khyad par med par 'dra ba'i gzugs can/'dzam hu)bu chu klung gi gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i mdog hunyedang ldan pa'i lus can/lus kyi ba spu las lha rdzas kyi spos sna tshogs 'byung ba/ lus las lha rdzas kyi 'od dri zhim po dri ma med par /(rab tu 'gyed pa sha stag go/ /de'i blon po bye ba phrag 38—267

bcu byung ste blon po rin po che la ①rtsogs pa dag go/ /'khor los sgyurasnyeba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen pad mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po de'i btsun mo dam pa bud med rin po che dpal gyi bzhin yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba ①gzugs mdzes shing sasdug las/ blta na yid du 'ong ba kha dog bzang po shin tu rgyas pa'i dam pa dang ldan pa/ skra mthon ting9)du 'dug pa/ mig dkar nagashe'abyes pa/ mdog gser gyi kha dog du 'dug pa/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ lus las 8)'od rtag tu 'byung ba/ 'khor kun tu dpag tshad stong gi tshad du 'od kha dog du ma dang ldan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dri zhim po can 'gyed pa byung ngo ske/ /rgyal po'i btsun tsomo dpal gyi bzhin yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba de las bu mo pad+mo bzang nyu )mo mig yid du nyunya'ong ba'i dpal gyi zla ba zhes bya ba yan lag thams cad tshang ba/ gzugs mdzes shing sdug pa/ blta na yid du 'ong ba/'jig rten thams cad gyis blta na mi ngoms pa byung bar gyur tetu)/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur tu ba'i rgyal po la blta na su yang ngoms par mi 'gyur ba de bzhin du 'khor los sgyur boba'i bu mo pad+mo bzang mo yimig yid du 'ong ba'i dpal de la blta bas kyang su yang ngoms par mi 'gyur te/shes rab kyis yongs su ngoms par 'gyur ba ni ma gtogs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na/ sems can rnams kyang nyu tshotshe dpag tu med par gyur te/ tshe tunyel gcig tu nges pa med pas bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de'i dus na sems can rnams kyi dbyibs sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang / dbyangs sna tshogs dang /19 ming sna tshogs dang / rigs sna tshogs dang / che'i tshad sna tshogs dang / chu zheng rnam pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa dang stobs dang /38wa 268

brtson 'grus dang / mthu rnam pa tha dad pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang /yid du mi 'ong ba rnam pa tha dad pa dang / yangs pa dang dma' ba la mos pa sna tshogs kyang yod par gyur te/ de la sems can ji snyed cig kha dog hu)bzang ba dang / yangs pa la mos pa dang / yan lag tshang ba〈gedang / blta na sdug cing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa de dag ni 'di skad ces 'dzer te④/ kye mi dag nga ni khyed pas kha dogasreches bzang ngo zhes zer ro/ /de bzhin du sems can ji snyed cig lus kyi dbyibs legs pa dang ldan par gyur pa de dag kyang / sems can lus kyi dbyibs mi sdug par 'gyur ba 6)rnams la rlom zhing khyad du gsod do//de dag de ltar gcig la gcig khyad du gsod pa las byung ba'i mi dge ba'i rtsa bas tshe'i tshad las kyang yongs su bri bar gyur toge/ /kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba las kyang yongs su bri bar gyur to/ /rgyal po'i pho brang rin po che'i me tog sgron ma de'i byang phyogs logs dge/ snying po byang chub kyi shing kun tu gragasalgepa'i chos kyi sprin sgra'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub kyi rgyan skad cig re re la yongs su ston pa⑨/ rtsa ba rin po che'i rgyal po rdo rje ltar sra zhing mi 'jig pa/ nor bu rin po che thams cad las grub pas lhun shin tu yangs shing rgyas pa/ sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang / mdab nyusne rim dang me tog dang / 'bras bu rin po che thams cad kyi rgyu las grub pa/ kun tu cha mnyam par nyu bkod cing / kun tu khyab pa'i yan lag nyurnyedang ldan pa/ rgyan kun tu rgyas par 'gengs shing mi zad pa dang ldan pa/rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od 'phro nyusnyedang / 'od gzer kun tu snang ba tsha'agyed pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul gyi 15rnam par 'phrul pa'i dbyangs rjes su 38wa 269

sgrog pa yod de/ snying po byang chub de'i mdun rol na/ spos chu'i mtsho rin po che'i me tog dang / glog yonyedang chos kyi 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi dbyangs shes bya ba yod de/ de ni rin po che'i shing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas bskor ba gho/ rin po che'i shing de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi shing gi dbyibs su 'khod palasha stag go/ /spos chu'i mtsho chen po rin po che'i me tog dang ske/ glog dang chos kyi 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi dbyangs zhes bya ba de'i 'gram thams cad kyang nor bu rin po che thams cad bkram zhing rnam par bkod pa ste/rin po che thams cad kyi phreng ba sna tshogs su dgrigs pa'oX/ /rin po che rnam par dag pa las byas pa'i khang pa sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis yongs su brgyan pa'o/ /rgyan rnam par dag pa sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan pa'o/ /snying po byang chub de'i 'khor thams cad kyang nor bu rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rgyan thabasam kyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ pad+ma'i ④snying po can sha stag gis yongs su 'khor ba ste(zhes/ spos chu'i mtsho chen po rin po che'i me tog dang glog dang chos kyi 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi dbyangs zhes bya ba de'i dbus nas/ pad+mo'i rgyal po chen po sheralo ma'i mtshams nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul rnam par ston pa'i 'od gzer gyi sprin gyi rgyan ces bya ba byung bar gyur te/pad+mo chen po de la de bzhin gshegs pa7tsheri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de dag gi nang nas bskal pa'i thog ma pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpal 32gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba hu byung bar gyur te/de ni bskal pa de la nyu )thams cad kyi thog mar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ des lo stong phrag du ma 38—270

zhig du chos bstan pas/ sems can yongs su smin par mdzad nas/ lo stong phrag bcur 'od gzer snang ba'i rnam par 'phrul pas yongs su smin par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de hu)lo stong phrag bcu na 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i tshe pad+mo'i rgyal po chen po lo ma'i mtshams nas/ dusashegasum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul rnam par ston pa'i 'od gzer gyi sprin gyi rgyan ces bya ba de las sems can thams cad rdul dang 'byed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i 'od gzer byung bar gyur te/ 'od des phog pa'i sems can rnams kyis kyang lo stong phrag bcu na⑧de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya bar shes so/ /lo stong phrag dgu na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing de las rdul dang bral ba'i dpal gyi snying po zhes bya ba'i 'od gzer byung gho/ 'od gzer des phog pa'i sems can de dag gis kyang gzugs thams cad shin tu phra bar ⑤mthong bar gyur to/ /lo stong phrag brgyad na de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer sems can thams cad kyi las rnam par smin pa'i dbyangs0zhes bya ba byung ste/ des phog pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi las rgya mtsho khong du chud par gyurashete/ las dran pa'i ye shes kyang thob par gyur to/ /lo stong phrag bdun na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing de nyid las 'od gzer dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba byung ste/'od gzer des sems can de dag shel phog nas dbang po nyams pa med cing yongs su tshang bar gyur to/ /lo stong phrag drug na de bzhin gshegs pa de 5) 38—271

'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba byung ste/des sems can de dag la phog nas bsam pa rgya chen pos rnam par 'phrul bar gyur to/ /lo stong phrag lnga na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par sgra 'byin pa'i gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam pa thams cad du yongs su dag par mthong bar gyur to/ /lo stong phrag bzhi na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul tha mi dad pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba byung nyanaste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 8rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad du song ba la zhugs par gyur to//lo stong phrag gsum na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/byang chub kyi shing chen po de las 'od gzer 'gro ba thams cad la mngon du gyur pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba byung ste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas de bzhin gshegs pa de yang mngon du mos pas mthong bar gyur to/ /lo stong phrag gnyis na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de las 'od gzer dus gsum gyi ye shes kyi glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi tshul rab tu sgrog pa byung ste/ des sems can de dag la reg nas de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sngon gyi tshul rgya mtsho la rtog cing 'jug par gyur to/ /lo stong na de bzhin gshegs pa de 'byung bar 38—272

'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de las 'od gzer ye shes rab rib med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba byung ste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul7pa dang / zhing thams cad dang / sems can thams cad dun/mthong bar 'gyur ba'i mig kun tu lta ba thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de lo brgya na 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer 'gro ba thams cad kyis sangs rgyas mthong ba rnam par smin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas/de bzhin gshegs pa 0skye ba'i 'du shes thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de zhag bdun na skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi shing chen po de nyid las 'od gzer sems can thams cad rab tu dga' ba dang / spro ba dang mos pa yongs su 'byung ba'i dbyangs shes bya ba byung ste/ des sems can de dag la phog nas sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur ba'i dga' ba'i shugs chen po skyes par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar 'od zer gyis 5yongs su smin par bya ba'i tshul tshad med pa rnam pa de lta 4)bus lo stong du sems can rnams yongs su sbyin par mdzad nas zhag bdun pa la thug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams de thams cad yongs su bskyod pa'i tshul tshad med pas yongs su bskyod nas shin tu dag par byin gyis 3)brlabs so/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa ji snyed pa rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems kyi skad cig re re la yongs su bstan par gyur to/ /de nas zhag bdun pa 38—273

tha ma la bab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams de na sems can sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur ba hu)yongs su smin pa de dag thams cad snying po byang chub tu mngon par gzhol bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams de'i khor ②yug thams cad dang / ri rab thams cad dang / ri thams cad dang / chu klung thams cad dang / rgya mtsho thams cad dang shing thams cad dang / sa'i gzhi thams cad dang / grong khyer thams cad dang / ra ba thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang / gzhal med khang thams cad dang / gos dang rgyan dang longs spyod thams cad dang / rol mo'i shing thams cad dang / rol mo brdungasnyeba'i dbyangs thams cad dang / sprul pa'i rgyan thams cad kyi dmigs pa re re las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul dang / mthu'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa'i spos dang / bdug rigaspos thams cad kyi sprin mngon par 'thon te/ rin po che'i 6)'od 'phro ba'i sprin dang / spos dang bduganyuspos thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba 3)dam pa dang / spos rin po che thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sprin dang /gos rin po che dang / rgyan rin po che thams cad kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs kyi ri rab kyi sprin dang phye ma sna tshogs kyi sprin mang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od gzer gyi sprin rnam par ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin rab tu 'gyed pa/ rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba thams cad kyi sprin yongs su 'khrol zhing rdung ⑨ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi smon lam gyi sgra skad kyi sprin rab tu 'byin pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / gsung rgya mtsho'i sprin rab tu sgrog pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byad 38—274

bzang po'i gzugs brnyan sna tshogs kyi sprin rab tu ston par 0)byed cing / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i ltasam sngon du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su ston ①te/ rin po che'i rgyal po'i pad+mo 0chen po'i bralo ma'i mtshams nas/dus gsum gyi yide bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul rnam par ston pa'i 'od gzer gyi sprin gyi7rgyan de'i pad+mo'i 'khor rin po che'i rgyal po las byas pa chen po sha stag tu byas te 'khod do/ /rin po che'i rgyal po'i pad+mo chen po'i 'khor kyi rin po che'i pad mo chen po de dag gi ze ba dang / snying po la seng ge'i khri rin po che'ishepad+mo chen po'i snying po can/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag byung bar gyur te/ rin po che'i snying po can gyi khri de dag la'ang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed skyil mo krung hu )bcas te 'khod par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpal gyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas ma thag tu de'i mod la/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa mang po dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon sum du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor (skyebar gyur to/ / de nas hurtekyang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sems can tshad med pa rnams ngan song dang log par ltung ba thams cad las rnam par bzlog go/ /sems can tshad med pa ni mtho ris su skye ba la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni nyan thos kyi sa (gel rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /38—275

sems can tshad med pa ni shugs drag po'i 6)'od kyis 'byung ba'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /sems can tshad med pa ni brtson 'grus dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /sems can tshad med pa geni chos rab tu bsgom pa'i gnas su byung (miba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni dbang po yongs su dag pa rab tu bsgoms pas 'byung 4)ba'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /sems can tshad med pa ni stobs mnyam pa nyid la yang dag par spyod pa khong du chud pas 'byung ba'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /sems can tshad med pa ni chos kyi pagrong khyer mngon du 'gyur ba'i yul gyi theg pa skye bas 'byung ba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni thams cad du rjes su song ba'i rdzu 'phrul tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyi mi theg pas 'byung ba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni spyod pa'i sbyor ba la yang dag par gzhol ba'i tshul gyis 'byung ba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyis 'jug pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni dmigs pa'i yul thams cad yongs su dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul gyis me 'byung ba'i byang chub la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rnam par dag pa la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la rab tu bkod nado/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa 38—276

dang ske/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang / drug pa dang bdun pa dang /brgyad pa dang dgu pa7)la rab tu bkod do3ni/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa la rab tu bkod do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa smon lam gyi gukhyad par can la btsud do/ /sems can tshad med pa ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang /smon lam rnam par dag52)pa la rab tu bkod do/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa des sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can gyi khams mtha' dang genodabus med pa rnam par dul 6)bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku sna tshogs dang / thabs mkhas pa sna tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos bstan pa yongs su shes par gyur te ri/ rgyal po'i pho brang rin po che'i me tog sgron ma'i sems can gzugs dang / kha dog dang yul dang longs spyod kyis rgyags shing dregs te gcig la gcig khyad du gsod pa de rnams gdul ba'i don du byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos kha dog dang gzugs mchog tu phyinamachos par mngon parashesprul te/ rgyal po'i pho brang der phyin to/ tsho/ /de'i 'od shin tu yangs pas rgyal po'i gnas de dag thams cad du 31yongs su snang bar gyur te/ rgyal po'i gnas de'i 'od dang / 'khor los sgyur 32ba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba 32rin chen pad+mo'i bodapal gyi gtsug phud snying po'i lus las byung ba'i 'od dang / bud med rin po che'i 'od dang / rin po che'i nyisashing gi 'od dang / nor bu rin po che chen po'i 'od dang / gnyi 9zla dang gza' skar dang rgyu skar gyi 'od dang /38wa 277

'dzam0)bu'i gling na 'od ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang mi snang bar gyur te/ dper na nyi ma shar te mun pa dang /⑤ zla ba dang gza' skar dang /rgyu skar gyi 'od kyang mi snang la me dang nor bu'i 'od kyang mi snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang posashezil gyis non nas 'dzam7bu'i gling de na 'od yod pa thams cad kyang mi snang bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na / 'dzam 55)bu chu klung gi gser gyi sa le sbram gyi drung du snag tsa'i gzugs ⑥bzhag na mdzes par mi rung / lha ger mi rung / lha mer mi rung / lhaphunger mi rung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i mdun du sems can de dag gi gzugs kyi lus kyang mdzes par ma rung / lha ger ma rung ske/ lha mer ma rung / lha nger mtsha1)rung ngo / /de nas de dag 'di snyam du gyur te/ de lta bu 0zhig de ltar de'i drung du bdag cag gi lus sam/ 'od dam kha dog gam/ gzi brjid kyis kyang mdzes par ma rung / lha ger ma rung /lha mer ma rung / lha nger marwanyarung ba de lta lha'am/ tshangs pa'am/ ci zhig de'i mtshan ma hu ni gzung bar mi nus so snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos rgyal po'i gnas rin po che'i me tog sgron ma'i dbus 'khor los sgyur hunyeba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po'i yigazhal med khang gi steng gi bar snang la 'dug ste/ 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po shes par gyis shig /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ste/ khyod kyi khams 'di nyid kyi snying po byang chub chos kun tu snang ba'i chos 38wa 278

kyi sprin gyi sgra dbyangs rgyal mtshan 'di nyid na rnam par spyod do zhes pa dang /rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes kyi 'od kun tu 'phro ba pad+mo bzang po 0)mig yid du 'ong ba'i dpal gyi zla bas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i gzugs kyi lus dang ske/ 'od dang ②rnam par 'phrul pa dang rgyan mthong ste/ dbyangs thos nas dga' ba dang / mos pa'i shugs chen po skyes te/ de'i tshe sems 'di snyam du bskyed do/ /bdag gis chadage ba'i rtsa ba gang ci bstsags pa des ④bdag kyang lus 'di 'dra b.rabathob par shog shig /rgyan 'di 'dra ba dang / mtshan 'di 'dra ba dang / spyod lam 'di 'dra ba dang / rdzu 'phrul 'di 'dra bar shog shig /ji ltar 'dis mtshan mo mun nag gi nang na sems can rnams la snang ba chen po bskyed de/ sangs rgyas skye ba yongs su brjod pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bstsal te ye shes chen po 'di〈snang ba bskyed par bya'o/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa thams cad du'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di dang mi 'bral bar shog shig /de nas rigs kyi bu 'khor los sgyuramanyusteba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po yan lag bzhi'i dpung gi tshogs dang lhan cig /rin po che bdun dang lhan cig /bud med kyi tshogs kyi 'khor dang lhan cig bu dang blon po dang / ljongs kyi mi dang lhan cig tu rgyal po'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / rgyal po'i mthu chen pos rgyal po'i gnas rin po che'i me tog sgron ma de nas 'phags te gyen tu nam mkha' la dpag tshad gcig tsam du mngon par 'phags nas/ 'dzam (3bu'i gling thams cad dang ske/ gling bzhi pa'i〈nya'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad snang ba chen pos rgyas par bkang ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas blta ba la yongs su bskul 38—279

ba'i don du rin po che'i ri thams cad la gzugs brnyan mngon par bstan0)cing gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams la mngon sum du gnas te sangs rgyas la ribalta ba de (gutshigs su bcad de glu'i dbyangs kyis bsngags pa/ lus can thams cad skyabs mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byung bar gyur/ /'jig rten gtso bo de blta bar/ /kun kyang langs ④te 'dong bar pagyis/ /lus can kun la phan don du/ /chos rab ston parapozhigang mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba ni/ /bskal pa bye ba'i brgyas lam na'o / /'jig rten phyin cir 9log gyur cing / /mi shes sgrib pas bsgribs5'o)gyur te/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba rnams/ /gzigasaspyo 3shing thugs rje che bskyed nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad gzhil don du/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /bskal nga/ bye ba grangs med du/ /byang chub spyod pa spyad pa mdzad / /bskal pa mtha' yas mu med par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog don dul/ /zhabs dang phyag kyang yongs su btang / /spyan dang snyan dang dbu yang btang ske/ /mthong zhing bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / /thos pa don yod 'gyur ba yin17ske/ /'jig rten mgon po 'jig rten du/ /'byung7)ba bskal pa bye bar dkon / /de ni byang chub gdan la bzhugs/ /gsung ba'i dam pa bltar〈nyeyang yod / /bdud rnams sde dang bcas btul te/ /byang chub mchog tu rnam sangs rgyas / /'od gzer dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa/ /sangs rgyas sku las mngon bkye zhing / /'gro ba tshim par mdzad pa yis/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'di la ltos8//'od zer sprin mang 7grangs med pa/ /sangs rgyas sku las 'thon pa rnams/ /des 17ni sems can snang gyur na/ /bde ba dpe med 'thob par 'gyur/ /38wa 280

brtson 'grus chen po rab rtsom 3)ste/ /rang dang rang gi bsam pa yis/ /mgon po de la mchod pa gyisal/ /tshur sheg de yis gan du 'dong / /de nas rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chenam④pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying pos tshigs su bcad pa de dag gisaphubadag gi khams na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad yongs su bskul te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna 6)tshogs brgya stong phrag bcu 'khor los sgyur 7)ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su grub pa'i char pa/ snying po byang chub kun nas ldang geba'i chos kyi sprin gyi dbyangs kyi rgyal mtshan gyi 'khor kunalo)tu mngon par 'bebs shing / rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin gyi yo )nam mkha' kun nas yog nyurtapar bya ba dang / me tog thams cad kyi bla re'i sprin gyis nam mkha' bla hu nas kheb hunyepar bya ba dang / na bza' sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis nam mkha' kun nas yog cing brgyan par bya ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi dril bu'i dra ba'i bosprin gyis nam mkha'i dbyings brgyan 12par bya ba dang / spos sna tshogs 7rgya mtshos dri zhim par byas pa'i spos gyi nya 'od zer gyi sprin gyi rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis brlab 3)par bya ba dang / rin po che thams cad kyi khri la rin po che'i gdan 'bel bar bting 3)ba'i sprin gyi rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la byin kyis brlab pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal 3 mtshan gyi sprin mngon par bsgreng ba'i rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis brlab dzo 1pa dang / khang pa dang gzhal med khang thams cad kyi sprin gyis kun nas yog pa'i rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la 22byin gyis brlab pa dang / me tog sna da tshogs kyi sprin gyis rikun nas yog pa'i rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis brlab 25pa dang / mchod pa'i rgyan thams cad kyi sprin gyilo 5char rab tu 'bab pa'i rgyan nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis da brlab 38—281

pa byed cing / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ①ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpalabagyi rgyal po gang na ba der songakhuste/phyin nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byaye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal 5yon tan dpal gyi rgyal po'i zhabasalgeganyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngarasamastan nor bu()rin po che chen po'ishephyogs kun tu rnam par snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can la 'dug go/ /de nas 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i bu mo ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i pad+mo bzang mo mig yid du 'ong ba'i dpal gyi zla bas rang gi rgyan rnams lus las〈nyebakrol te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi 'od kun du 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpal gyi rgyal po la gtor to mngon par gtor to/ /de nas rgyan de dag bcom ldan 'das de'i dbu'i gtsug zhu gi steng gi bar snang la nor bu rin po che'i rgyan gyi gdugs chen po nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi dra bas yongs su bskor ba nyi klu'i dbang po'i lus kyis gzung phosteb rgyan thams cad kyi lus kyis (nyedabyibs shin tu legs par kun nas bskor ba/ rgyan gyi gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor bcus yongs su bskor ba/ shin tu dag pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs sna tshogs kyis brgyan 17pa/ rin po che 3 tshothams cad kyi lhab lhub kyi sprin gyis (nyekun nas yog pa/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi shing gi rgyan gyis kun nas khebs pa/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po spos thams cad kyi rgya mtshos yongs su brgyan par 'dug par gyur te/ de'i dbus na byang chub kyi shing chen po chos kyi dbyings las byung ba'i rin po che thams cad kyi yal ga hunyedang / lhun 38wa 282

du ldan pa zhes bya ba rgyan brjod na ①mtha' dang dbus med pa skad cig re re zhing rgyan sna tshogs yongs su ston pa yod pa ldumathong bar gyur to/ /de'i drung na de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis byung ba byang chub sems dpa'i ②rgyan sna tshogs tha mi dad cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rnam par spyod pa sha stag gis bskor cing mdun du byas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyang de la mngon tu gyur pa ④mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de'i sangs rgyas kyis ⑤rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa yang mthong bar gyur to/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud ④pa la'ang zhugs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i 'du ba dang 'jig pa'i bskal pa la'ang ⑧zhugs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams der 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ④rgyud gcig nas gcig tu brgyud ⑩pa la'ang zhugs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi hu1drung na sangs rgyas mchod pa la brtson par gnas pa yang mthong ngo / /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bar bya ba la mngon du gyur par hu yang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus la gzugs brnyan du gyur par 'khod cing bdag nyid kyang nyi rjes su 'brang bar mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs gyi drung dang nyu9byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi drung dang / sems 38—283

can thams cad kyi gnas dang / 'jig rten gyi khams de dang de dag thams cad na'ang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i gzugs brnyan kun tu byung ste / 'jig rten gyi khams de dag re re na'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtshams gyi rgyan dang bcas pa dang ①gzhi dang bcas pa dang / dbyibs dang bcas pa dang / lhun dang bcas pa dang /rgyan sna tshogs yongs su dag pa dang bcas pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis kun nas khebs pa rnam par bkod pa dang / mying dang grangs rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud sna tshogs las brjod pa dus gsum gyi tshul sna tshogs su gtogs pa dang / phyogs 'byamasaklas pa sna tshogs su 'du ba chos kyi dbyings 'byam ri noklas pa sna tshogs kyi khongs su gtogs pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi sna tshogs su 'dus pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings sna tshogs la rnam par gnas pa/ snying po byang chub sna tshogs kyis ④brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis byung ba sangs rgyas kyi sengasage'i gdan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyud sna tshogs can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs mkhas pa sna tshogs yongasal)su brjod pa dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ④ ba'i tshul sna tshogs can /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyangs (1)kyi yan lag dang /gsung gi nga ro sna tshogs rab tu 'byung 1 chib/ skad sna tshogs rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa dang ldan pa dang 11/ mdo sde'i sprin sna tshogs rjes su sgrog 1 pa can dag kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /mthong nas de bas kyang dga' ba dang / mos 38—284

pa'i shugs chen po thob par gyur te/ de de ltar dga' ba'i shugs chen po skyes par gyur pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpal gyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bsgrags pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sde 'khor gyi mdo sde/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang bcas pa yang dag par bstan te/ des mdo sde de thos par gyur nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo stong phrag bcu shin tu phra zhing reg na bde bar7thob par gyur te/ de ni dper na ma'i mngal du rnam par shes pa zhugs par gyur ma thag pa lta bu dang 'di lta ste dper na/ sems can rnams kyi las mngon par bsgrubs pa lta bu dang / 'di lta ste dper na/ zhingar+sā)bzang po dam pa'i sa bon btab nas ring por zhum lon yang myu ④ga skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa 5)lta bu ste/ de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de dag kyang 'jamasazhing yid du 'ong ba ste/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon du rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zhing 'byamadzo)klas pa thams cad du na snang ba rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /dus gsum gyi tshul thams cad la 'jug pa khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo sgrog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'khor ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i sems can 'byung ba'i nga ro rab tu bsgrags pas rnam par dmyigs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi mun nag rnam par sel ba'i smon lam gyi rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 38—285

dang ske/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang dbral0)ba'i smon lam gyis rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi bde ba 'grub pa yongs su 'byin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / 'dul bas mi skyo ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lam la 'jug pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa'i⑧sa thams cad yongs su gnon par sgrub pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /de dag la ri0stsogs pa'i〈geting nge 'dzin gyi sgo stong phrag bcu rnams des thob par gyur ted / de phra ba la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems dang / mi g.yo ba'i sems dang ske/ rab tu dga' ba'i sems dang / dbugs phyin pa'i sems dang /dpag tu med pa'i sems dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sems dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid shin tu zab pa la dmigs pa'i sems dang ske/ byams pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i tshul rgya mtsho la zhugs pa'i sems dang /mngon par zhen pa thams cad las 6)gyen du 'phags pa'i sems dang / 'jig rten gyi yul thams cad la 7mi gnas pa'i sems dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i sems dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzugs dang / kha dog rgya mtshos snang bar gyur pa'i sems dang / 'khrug pa med pa'i sems dang /g.yo ba med pa'i sems dang / khong khro ba med pa'i sems dang / mthon dman med pa'i sems dang / mi skyo ba'i sems dang / mi zlogs5nyepa'i sems dang ske/ zhum pa med pa'i sems dang / chos thams cadam7kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs pa'i sems dang / chos thams cad kyi tshul rgya mcho'i rjes su song 38—286

ba'i sems dang / chos thams cad rab tu 'byed pa'i tshul kyi rjes su song ba'i sems dang / sems can rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa'i sems dang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab0)pa'i sems dang / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mang po'i snang ba yongs su skyes pa'i sems dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i sems dang / sgrib pa thams cad kyi ri rnam par 'thor ②ba'i sems dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen posnyeyang dag par sgrub pa'i sems dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la spobs pa mngon sum du gyur pa'i sems dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yul thams cad la snang ba thob pa'i sems dang / byang ⑤chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad 'phel bar byed pa'i sems dang / phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i sems dang ldan pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam chen po lasalhag par dmyigs par bya bas smon lam rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi smon lam rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i don du mngon par sgrub ste/ 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bar bya ba dang /chos kyi dbyings 'byam klas 6)pa yongs su shes par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du phyi ma'i bskal par byang chub sems dpa'i 7)spyod pa spyad par bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la 3)phyi ma'i mtha'i 3)bskal par gnas par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'gro bar 7bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyen bkur ba 38—287

dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs 1pa thams cad la mchod cing rim gror bya ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam par bsgrub pa dang / rnam par 'tshang rgya bar bya bas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcod napar bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la stsogs pa smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis dbyang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la smon lam mngon par sgrub par gyur to/ /de'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang /smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal yon tan dpal gyi rgyal pos sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bskul ba mdzad do/ /rab tu bstan pa mdzad do/ /yongs su bstan pa mdzad do/ /rnam par dbye ba mdzad do/ /rnam par dgrol ba mdzad do/ /yang dag par bstan par gemadzad do/ /chud za bar mi 'gyur bar 5)bya ba'i phyir rab tu brtan 0par mdzad do/ /rgya chen por khyab par bya ba'i )phyir shin tu yangs par mdzad do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lhur len par bya ba'i phyir rab tu gnas par mdzad de / de ni 'di lta ste/ thog ma sems bskyed 9pa nas nye bar bzung ba phyin cad nyu rmede bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi smon lam 1 rgya mtsho grangs med pa rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/2/ /rigs kyi bu sngon 'das pa'i dus de'i yang pha rol gyi bskal pa bcu pa la 'jig rten gyi khams rin chen 15nyi ma'i 'khor lo rnam par snang ba'i 'od ces bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal gyi dpal gyi migasung rab la bu mo ye shes kyi 'od kun tu 'phro ba pad+mo bzang mo mig yid du 'ong ba'i dpal gyi zla ba de15/38wa 288

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yongs su bskul te1)/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs pad+mo la bzhugs pa zhig bcosalo7so/ /bcos nas kyang ri mo bris so/ /ri mo bris nas kyang rin po ches shin tu brgyan to/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la brten te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu'ang sems bskyed do/ /de 5 ci/dge ba'i rtsa ba des log par mi ltung ba'i chos can du gyur te④mo/ rtag tu lha'i dbang po'i rigs dang mi'i dbang po'i rigs su skyes par gyur to/ /thams cad du yang gzugs mdzes shing sdug la blta na yid du 'ong ba dang / kha dog bzang po shin tu rgyas pa dam pa dang ldan par (5gyur te/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang yang bral bar ma gyur to//dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid kyis tshe rabs de dang 6 de dag du yongs su smin par byas so/ /dran par byas so/ /da 4)yang des byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'gayongs su bsnyen bkur 9te/ yid 'byung nyu )bar ma byas so/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur 11ba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba rin chen pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po zhes bya ba byung ba nyurnyede gzhan zhig yin snyam 1/du sems na ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur steba'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba 12rin chen pad+mo dpal gyi gtsug phud snying po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i btsun mo rdzidapal gyi bzhin 17yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba byung ba de/ gzhan zhig yin snyam nyu8du sems na yang de ltar mi blta ste/ mtshan mo'i lha mo kho mo'i drung na 38wa 289

'dug pa sgra rgya mtsho rab tu zhi ba dang ldan pa 'di yin no/ /rigs7kyi bu de la ji snyam dusngo sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes kyi 'od kun tu 'phro ba/ pad+mo bzang mo mig yid du 'ong geba'i dpal gyi zla ba zhes bya ba byung bsrede gzhan zhig yin snyam skyidu sems na ni de ltar mi blta ste/ kho mo ni de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes kyi 'od kun tu 'phro ba/ pad+mo bzang mo mig yid du 'ong thoba'i dpal gyi zla ba zhes bya bar gyur to/ /kho moshebu mo gzhon nur gyur tege/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan dpal gyi dpal gyi ⑨gsung rab la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad+mo la bzhugs pa bcos pa de ni kho mo'i bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur to/ /de'i tshesngo1byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos/ kho mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bskul ba de ni/ kho mos byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa yin no/ /kho mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rin po che'i 'od kun tu 'phro ba'i dpal hu yon tan dpal gyi rgyal po'i drung du phyin te/rgyan gyis gtor nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul mthong bar gyur te/ kho mos bcom ldan 'das de'i drung nas chos thos par gyur pa de'i tshe/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/ 'jig rten thams cad mngon du gyur pas 'gro ba rnam par 'dul ba ston pa 'dirwanyethob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed decadag thams cad kyang bsnyen bkur te/ yo byad dang mchod cing rim gror bya ba thams cad kyis kyang bkur stir byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis 8chos bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mos thos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi gdams ngag 38wa 290

dang rjes su bstan pa la'ang zhugs par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la kho mos rim gro hu)cher byas te/ rim gro de'i rnam pas sems kyi skad cig gcig la de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i nadakyil 'khor de dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang mthong ste / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang ba'i ④khams de ni 'das par gyur/bskal pa rdul dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor de ni mthar phyin par gyur nas/ de'i rjes la 'jig rten gyi khams ni rin chen 'khor lo sna tshogs kyis klubs shing brgyan pa zhes byabu/ bskal pa ni 'od chen po zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ de la sangs rgyas lnga brgya byung bar gyur to/ /de dag thams cad kyang kho mos bsnyen bkur te/ bskal pa 'od chen po de ri la de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen po'i4)sprin gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba bskal pa'i dang po la byung57)ste/ de mngon par byung ④ba'i tshe/ kho mo mtshan mo'i lha mor gyur pas mchod pa byas so/ /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mthu bo che'i dpal zhes bya ba byung ste/ de la kho mo7'khor los sgyur 3 snabar gyur pas mchod pa byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des kho mo la mdo sde sangs rgyas thams cad skye zhing 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ mdo sde sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i nyu1rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang bcas pa yang dag par bstan te/ de yang kho mos thos nas yongs su bzung ngo / /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa me'i 'od 'phro hu ri'i dpal gyis rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba byung ste de la kho mo tshong dpon gyi bu mor gyur pas mchod pa byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des kho mo la nya mdo sde dus gsum snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/mdo sde 'dzam cibu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang bcas pa yang 38—291
