rgyas rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa la 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnams kyang mngon du gyur par lta'o3)/ /de bzhin gshegs par gyur nas kyang tshimachod pa (byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de sdog las kyang chos bstan pa nyan to/ /chos la yang gnyer ba'i chos kyi byanan tanasnyedu byed do/ /de nas lum bi ni'i nags tshal gyi lha mo gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor bzang pos dga' ba'i dpal gyis 6de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bskal pa tshad med par dmyigs pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i skye bas rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston pa 'di gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 7phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rim gro nabaskyed cing nga la gang 'dri ba/ /de dag bdag las rgyal ba'i sras nyon cig /rgyal ba'i spyod yul blta dka' ༄9)zhi ba ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyi 1 tshul gyis rnam par bstan/ /zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul phran rab snyed kyi/ /sngon gyi bskal pa bsam gyis myi khyab dran/ /bskal pa'i ming ni snga phyi mnyam zhes bya/ /de la rgyal ba bye ba brgyad cu byung / /bskal pa'i dang por de bzhin gshegs byung ba/ /dbang phyug yon tan mi thub rgyal mtshan no/ /nags tshal dam pa gser mdog me tog tu/ /mgon po de 'khrungs bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /mying du dri myed skyed 11pa'i 'od ces bya/ / de yi nyu ma ma mkhas par bdag 1 gyur te/ /bltam 1 ma thag tu gser mdog dam pa'i 'od/ /'jig rten dbang pos bdag gi pang sadu bzhag /gang zag dam pa pang tshadu bzhag tshe yang ske/ /de yi 1 spyi gtsug blta bar mi nus te/ /bsam yas de la g.yas dang 38wa 484

g.yon du yang / /bltas shing mtha' rnyed mthong bar ma gyur to/ /mtshan rab bzang pos de ni yongs su brgyan/ /dri med de sku blta na rab sdug ste/ /rin chen gzugs 'dra bdag gis mthong gyur nas/ /dga' ba'i shugs drag mtshungs myed rnam par 'phel/ / de yi 0)yon tan dpag yas sems sems nas / /kho mo'i bsod nams rgya mtsho dpag med 'phel/ / de yi〈rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho mthong gyur nas/ /rgya chen byang chub sems kyang skyes par gyur/ /rgyal ba'i legs pa rgya mtsho dga' smon nas/ /smon lam rgya mtsho bdag gis rab tu bskyed / /'byamasaklas zhing rnams thams cad rnam par sbyangs④/ /ngan song lam rnams kun kyang rnam par bzlog /zhing rnams 'byams klas kun gyi bde gshegs rnams/ /ma byon bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa dang / /sems can sdug bsngal rnam par dgrol ba'i phyir/ /smon lam rgya mtsho kho mos btab par gyur / /mgon po de las bdag gis chos thos nas/ /rnam thar dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang thob/ /bskal pa zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul snyed du/ /spyad pa spyad der+sā)de yang rnam par sbyangs/ /de la mgon po ji snyed byung gyur pa/ /de dag ma lus bdag gis kun kyang mchod/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho 'di ni sbyong57)byed cing / /de dag bstan pa kho mos yongs su bzung / /zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul phran rab snyed kyi/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba ji snyed 'das byung ba/ /de dag chos kyi 'khor lo kho mos bzung / /rnam thar dkyil 'khor 'di yang rab tu bsgoms / /sangs rgyas zhing gi rdul phran ji snyed pa/ /rdulas rtse 'byam 3klas kun la rnam par mthong / /rdul phran re re la yang rgya mtsho'i zhing / /sngon 3 richad rgyal bas sbyangs pa rab tu mthong / /zhing rnams 'byam nyanyaklas de dag kun tu 38—485

yang 11/ /mgon po thugs rgyud gcig la bsam yas tsho pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul yangs pa yongs su ston mdzad cing / /nags tshal mchog tu 'khrungs gyur bdag gis mthong / /rgyal ba la la rizhing rnams la la na/ /byang chub dam par 'tshang rgya thugs dgongs shing / /dga' ldan 'jig rten nyidasan bzhugs pa yang / /zhing rnams bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i dbyings su rnam 'phrul pa/ /shin tu yangs pa skye ba'ang bdag gis mthong / /na chung dam pa'i tshogs kyi dbus bzhugs shing / /mgon po chos rnamasarnyuston pa'ang9)de bzhin mthong / /zhing rnams bye 8ba'i rdul phranaspyotshorab snyed kyi/ /dpa' bo sems kyi skad cig re re la/ /mngon par 'byung〈7zhing shing rgyal drung gshegs dang ske/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul yangs pa ston pa mthong / /zhing gcig rdul la bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /yul rnams gzhan dang gzhan dag ston mdzad pas/ /'gro rgyud sems can sdug bsngal sgrol 12mdzad cing / /mi gtso rnam par 'tshang rgya bdag gis mthong / /rdul phran re re'i rtse la mi zad pa'i/ / rang 'byungatso'akhor lo rab tu bskor 1 mdzad cing / /dbyangs rnams rgya mtsho mi zad sgrog mdzad pa15/ /chos sprin rgya chen char 'bebs mdzad pa mthong / /'gro ba kun la rnam pa du mar yang / /skad cig re rer mya ngan 'das ston pa/ /zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul phran rab snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing gcig rdul las ⑩bdag gis mthong / /rdul gcig bltas kyang zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /rgyal ba 'byung ba ji snyed kun kyang mthong / /tshe rabs 1 kun tu lus mang khrags3)khrig gis / /de dag mchod pa'i don du nye bar phyin/ /zhing tshul rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /'gro rgyud mi zad 19ji snyed yod pa yis bye/ /'gro ba kun la mngon 38wa 486

du kho mo ni/ /chos sprin yangs pa'i char yang rab tu 'bebs/ /rgyal sras kho mos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /rnam thar dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di shes kyi/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas su/ /thams cad bstan pa0)kho mos nus re skan / /rigs kyi bu kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i⑧rnam par thar pa bskal pa tshad med par dmyigs pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i skye bas rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos gebyang chub sems dpa' sems kyi skad cig re re la bskal pa thams cad du zhugs pa'i mngal nas yongs su byung ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ chos kyi tshul thams cad nges par rtogs pa'i skye ba rab tu ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa'i smon lam gyisasrebasam pa yongs su bskyed()pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba la rab tu gzhol ba/ sems can thams cad kyi rigs dang rgyud kyi lam yongs su bstan pa la gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du pad+mo'i nang nas skye ba 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i dus la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad gdul ba la mngon par mos shing tsher tsha skye bas rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston pa/ zhing 'byams47klas pa thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin yongs su ston pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi lam gyi 8)rgyud du skye ba dang / rigs su gzugs brnyan ri9)byung bar gyur pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas 'di na shākya'i tsobu mo go pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis 11de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 32sems can yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i phyir/ 'khor ba 38—487

na 17'khor bar bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisa'alum bi ni'i nags tshal gyi lha rimo gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor bzang pos dga' ba'i dpal gyi rkang 4pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ lum bi ni'i nags tshal gyi lha mo gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor bzang pos dga' ba'i dpal la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas tedu/lum bi ni'i nags tshal gyi lha mo gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor bzang pos dga' ba'i dpal gyi drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/rjo bam po bcu bzhi 7pa/ de nas tshong na dpon gyi bu nor bzangs lum bi ni'i nags tshal gyi lha mo gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor bzang pos dga' ba'i dpal gyi drung nas song ste/ grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas gang na ba der phyin nas/byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bskal pa tshad med par dmyigs pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i skye bas rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston pa7de nyid bsgom 1 pa dang / khong du chud par bya ba dang / rgya cher bya ba dang /nan tan du bya ba dang / shin tu sbyang ba 31dang / yongs su bsam pa dang /rnam par dbye ba byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par 'gro ba'i khang pa 12chos kyi dbyings rab tu snang ba'i 'od gang na ba der song ngo / /der 'gro ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bgro hu ba'i khang pa'i lha mo mya ngan myed pa'i dpal zhes bya ba de la 1 khyim gyi 15lha mo stong phrag bcu dang bcas pas bsu tshanas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /skyes bu chen po shes rab dang / ye shes chen pos rnam par gnon pa byang chub sems 38wa 488

dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa sgom me pa la lhag par dmyigs pa'i smon lam gyi sems dang ldan pa/ chos yangs pa'i gzhal med khang gi spyod yul la spyod pa/ chos kyi grong khyer du mngon par gzhol ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi tshul mtha' yas pas sems can 'dul mib la 'jug pa rgyun mi gcod pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho snang ba rab tu thob pa/ 'gro ba thams cad rnam par gdul ba la rab tu snang ba'i spobs pa dang / ye shes mngon du gyur pa sems can ri thams cad kyi spyod pa shes pa'i lus kyis 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i spyod pa la 4)mngon du gyur pa'i sems dang ldan pa/'gro ba thams cad kyi sems kyi dga' ba rgya mtsho'i shugs rnam par lta'aphel bar bya ba'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos khong du chud par bya ba'i lam du zhugs pa/ khyod byon 6pa legs so/ /mig phyir glan 7pa myed pas spyod pa dang / spyod lam zab cing rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul can khyod la bltas na/ khyod ni ring po myi thogs par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi rgyan rnam par dag pa bla na myed pa rab tu thob ste/mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rab tu brgyan pa'i lus dang stobs bcu'i ye shes snang bas brgyan pa'i sems kyis 'jig rten du rnam par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus dang rnam par gnon pa la nabaltas na/ khyod ni ring po mi thogs par dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du gyur par mthong ba dang ldan zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i chos zhi ba dang ldan pa'i gzhal 38—489

med khang gi dga' ba myong ba 1dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa zab mor chud par 'gyuratshanaro/ /de yang de ltar khyod dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du 'gro ba dang / blta ba dang bsnyen ri bkur ba dang / gdams ngag ma nor bar blang ba dang / de'i yon tan la nan tan du bya ba'i tshul la brtson par byed pas yongs su mi skyo/ phyir mi ldog /sgyid lug par mi 'gyur te/ khyod la bgegs sam / bar du gcod pa'am/ sgrib pa gang gis kyang myi tshugs te/ bdud dam bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha rnams kyang mdun na gnas pa med pasamagede'i phyir khyod ni ring por 5mi thogs 46)par sems can thams cad dga' bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis )byang chub sems dpa' yongs su 'gror2)ba'i khang pa'i lha mo mya ngan med pa'i dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mo khyod kyis she)ji skad du smras pa de ltar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo kho bo 1 rini sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rnam par zhi bas dga' bar 'gyur tehu1/ sems can thams cad kyi las nyam nga 12ba'i rnam par phyin pa'i nyu phyir ldog 7pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi bde ba 'grub pa dang / sems can thams cad kha na ma tho ba med pa'i las la nan tan tu byed pas dga' ba tshadam pa nyams su tshoras bar 'gyur ro/ /nam sems can de dag las dang nyon mongs pa rnam pa sna tshogs myi bde ba'i sbyor bas sems rnam par 'khrugs shing ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ba'atsho sna/ bde ba'i rgyud na gnas kyang lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal dang yid myi bde ba sna tshogs nyams su myong 1 bar gyur cing / mi dga' bar gnas pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang shin 19tu yid mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo 'di lta 38—490

ste / dper na/ mi shin tu ngang gis byams pa zhig la bu gcig pa sdug cing yid du 'ong ba zhig bdog par gyur la/ de'i yan lag dang nying lag bcad pa zhig mthong na shin tu ngang gis byams pa'i phyir rab tu yid 3)mi bde zhing myi dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe'ang sems can rnams las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis ngan song gsum gyi rgyud du lhung kho ba zhig mthong na rab tu mi dga' rlosal shin tu nyams mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe sems can rnams lus dang ngag dang yid kyis legs par spyad pa yang dag par len pa'i rgyus lus zhig nas bde ba'i rgyudakyimatho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar ④gyur tam/ lha dang mi'i lam gyi rgyud du lus dang sems kyi bde ba nyams su myong ba zhig tu gyur na/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' shin tu bde ba dang ldan zhing / nyams bde ba dang yid dga' ba dang / rab tu spro ba dang / dga' ba'i yid nyams su bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bdag gi don gyi phyir thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon cing don du gnyer ba ma yin te/ 'khor ba'i dga' ba dang / bde ba sna tshogs nyams su myong bar bya ba'i phyir ma yin/'dod pa'i khams su gtogs pa'i dga' ba rnam pa tha dad par yi sna tshogs don du gnyer bas ma yin/ 'du shes dang sems dang lta ba phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i dbang gis ma yin/ kun tu sbyor ba dang / 'ching ba dang / bag la nyal ba dang ske/ kun nas 'khor ba'i dbang du gyur pas ma yin/ sred 7pa dang lta ba'i dbang du gyur pas ma yin/ sems can sna tshogs dang 'du zhing 'dzi ba'i da dga' ba'i 'du shes kyis 'o)sems rnam 3 )par 'phel bas ma yin/ bsam gtan 38—491

gyi dga' ba 1dang bde ba myong ba 95yongs su chags pas ma yin/ sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs 3shing 'khor ba'i rgyud na 'gre 1)ldog pa ma yin gyi/ lha mo byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na 'khod cing /sdug bsngal dpag tu myed pas shin tu mnar ba rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed cing ske/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrubs te5/ de dag 7snying rje chen pos smon lam mngon par bsgrubs pa'i shugs kyis sems can yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la brtson zhing 'khor ba na byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par snang ngo / /de dag ni sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i don du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrib pa med pa yongs su tshol zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba'i 8)smon lam mngon par sgrub po/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa mchod cing rim gror bya ba'i smon lam gyi5skyedabang gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas yongs su skyo ba myed de/ de dag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la 1 spyod pa'i tshe/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i zhing mthong na1 ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba'i smon lam mngon par sgrub bo/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa'i zhing yongs su sbyong zhing sems can thams cad kyi skye mched sna tshogs mthong bar gyur pa'i tshe/ chos kyi sku tha dad pa med cing bla na myed pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir smon lam mngon par sgrub bo / /sems can rnams kyi lus dang ngag dang sems kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ldan par 12mthong na/ sems can thams cad kyi lus dang / ngag dang /sems kyi rgyan yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir smon lam mngon par sgrub bo/ /38—492

sems can skye mched ma tshang ba dang / sems yongs su ma dag pa 37mthong na/sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa yongs sus sbyong zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la spyod pas yongs su skyo ba med do/ /lha mo de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni yongs su skyo ba med pa'i sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' dang dbus med pa la spyod de / de ltar spyod pa ni lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa yongs su bskyed gepas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgyan du gyur pa yin/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la rab tu 'god pa'i phyir pha dang mar gyur pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam du 'dzud 5pas ma ma lta bur gyur pa yin/ ngan song gi g.yang sa'i 'jigs pa las bsrung 6)ba'i phyir lhan cig skyes pa'i lha rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba lta bur gyur pa yin/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i phyir mnyan pa chen po lta bur gyur pa yin/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i 'jigs pa mthams cad rnam par bzlog napa'i phyir skyabs su gyur pa yin/ shin tu bsil ba'i rang bzhin nye bar stobs 9pas gnas su gyur pa yin/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad du 'jug par byed pas mu stegs su gyur pa yin/ chos rin po che'i gling du skyel bas mgon byed nyu )par gyur pa yin / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi me tog gis sems yongs su rgyas par byed pas me tog tu gyur pa yin/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi nyu1'od yangs pa rab tu 'gyed pas rgyan du gyur pa yin/ kun nas mdzes pas dga' ba dang bde ba dam pa byed pa hu yin/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i las la nan tan tu byed pas phrad na legs pa yin/ yan lag dam pa rnam pa thams cad du yongs su tshang ba'i lus dang ldan pas kun tu bzang ba yin/ blta na myi mthun 38—493

pa skyed pas gtang 1mi bra ba'i gzugs dang ldan tsho pa yin/ ye shes kyi 'od gzer rab tu 'gyed pa'i phyir 'od byed pa yin/ chos kyi sgron ma 'dzin pa'i phyir snang ba byed pa yin/ byang chub kyi bsam pa yongs su dag par byed pa'i phyir gsal bar byed pa yin/ bdud kyi las rnam par bzlog( )pa'i phyir dmag dpon du gyur pa yin/ shes rab kyi 'od gzer gyi dra ba rab tu snang ba 'gyed pa'i phyir nyi mar gyur pa yin/ chos kyi nam mkha' la blo'i zla ba 'char bar byed pas zla bar gyur pa yin/ 'gro ba thams cad du chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'babs 4pas sprin du gyur pa yin te/ lha mo de ltar nan tan du byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams pa ni sems can thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bgro 6)ba'i khang pa'i lha mo mya ngan med pa'i dpal khyim gyi lha mo stong phrag bcu dang bcas pas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i me tog dang / phreng ba dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / byug pa dang / ྅)rin po che'i rgyan gyi char yid kyi rang bzhin mngon par phab ste/ kun nas bskor nacing rjes su 'brangs nas/byang chub sems dpa'i khang par 'gro ba'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /byang chub rdzogs par thugs bskyed cing / /sems can kun la thugs brtse 9bas/ /rgyal ba 1 ye shes nyi ma 11rnams/ /bar 'ga'am32zhig na 'jig rten 'byung / /bskal pa bye ba mang pos sna kyang / /khyod kyi zhal mthong shin tu dka'/ /'jig rten ma rig mdongs 0pa la/ /khyod kyi ye shes gnyi mchen yin/ /myi shes rab rib bsgribs pa yi7/ /'jig rten phyin ci log gzigs nas/ /thugs rje chen po rab bskyed de/ /khyod ni rang byung nyid du 38wa 494

zhugs / /khyod kyi7dgongs pa rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub don du brtson / /dge bshes bsnyen bkur bsten mdzad cing / /lus srog phangs par mdzad mi mnga'/ /khyod ni 'jig rten rten du kyimi mnga'/ /'du 'dzi mi mnga' gnas mi mnga'/ / 'dres pa mar mchis mi rtenas )pas/ /dgongs pa thogs med nam mkha' bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod mdzad cing / /bsod nams dkyil 'khor 'od bzang bsazhi / /ye shes sgron ma rab 'gyed pa6)/ /'jig rten tshad med kun tu 'char/ /'jig rten nas kyang 'phags mi mdzad/ /'jig rten chos kyis yong myi 'go3/ /chags pa med par 'jig rten spyod/ /mkha' la ser bu ji bzhin no/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar me bzhin du/ /rtag tu 'bar bas rab tu brtson/ /me lta bu yi nyu )brtson 'grus kyis/tsho1/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pararwartemadzad/ /seng ge bzhin du shin tu dpa'/ /brtson 'grus rnam par gnon pa brtan(ge/ /ye shes rnam par gnon dang ldan/ /gzhan gyis thub pa med par spyod/ /chos dbyings rgya mtsho 'di dag nas/ /rgya mtsho'i tshul rnams ji snyed pa/ /der yang dge bshes bsnyen bkur bas/ /dpa' bo khyod ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bgro miba'i khang pa'i lha mo mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod de17/ de 'gro ba'i phyi bzhin chos 'dod pa'i don du 'brang bar gyur nyu to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par bgro 3 ba'i khang pa chos kyi dbyings rab tu snang ba'i 'od du 3)phyin te/ nang du song nas shākya'ispo )bu mo go pa mthong bar 'dod de kun tu bltas na shākya'i 31bu mo go pa byang chub sems dpa' yang 38wa 495

dag par bgro 17ba'i khang pa chos kyi dbyings rab tu snang ba'i 'od kyi dbus na/stan rin po che byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gnas snang bar byed pa'i (migazugs brnyan gyi pad+mo'i snying po can zhig la bud med rgyal po'i5da/rigs su byung ba / sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i skal ba mnyam pa/sngon sbyin pa'i yongs su bsdu bas shin tu bsdus pa/ tshig snyan cing 'jam par smra ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du/ don mngon du bya bas shin tu bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsgrub pa la don mthun pas shin tu bzung ba/ snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas bu dang bu mo yongs su gzung 4ba'i tshul bcangs pa/ byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'i rang gi khyim thab 5kyi rjes su 'brang ba yongs su dag par byas pa/sngon byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas pa/ bsam gyis myi khyab pas yongs su sbyin par byas pa/ stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor gyis kun nas bskor cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /bud med stong phrag brgyadapa⑥cu rtsa bzhi po de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog pa byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshul la na zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la gzhan gyi 9dring mi 'jog pa/ chags pa thams cad dang77bral ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'khor ba'i 11dga' ba thams cad kyis skyo ba'i yid dang ldan pa/chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul chags pa med pas yongs su dag pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon du bya ba'i sems kyi shugs dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa dang bar du gcod pa'i dra ba dang bral ba/ chags pa'i lam thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/chos kyi sku la legs par sprul pas rnam par spyod pa/ 'jig rten thams cad 38—496

yongs su phyin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la mngon par phyogs pa/ bsod nams rgya mtsho 1)dri ma med pas yongs su byung ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis shin tu byung ba / byang chub sems dpa'i ②stobs kyi shugs yangs pas ye shes kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis sems5mirab tu snang ba yang dag par bskyed pa sha stag go/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi7bu nor bzangs shākya'i 2bu mo go pa gang na ba der phyin nas / shākya'i6)bu mo go pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ langs nas mdun du57'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu na/sems bskyed na ji ltar na 6)byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'khor ba na yongs su hu 3'khor yang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos pa dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yang khong du chud la nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la g.yang mi gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos snang ba yang rab tu thob la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 37yang rgyun mi gcod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la yang rab tu gnas la de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul yang yongs su ston pa dang /'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad las kyang yongs su 'das la/ 'jig rten gyi lam gyi 1)rgyud thams cad du yang nye bar spyod pa dang / chos kyi lus yongs su grub pa dang ldan yang / gzugs kyi lus kha dog mtha' yas pa'ang mngon par sgrub pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i chos kyi sku la yang rab tu gzhol la 'gro ba thams cad kyi kha dog dang dbyibs kyi lus kyang yongs su ston pa dang / chos thams cad brjod du ma mchis par yang rab tu 1 rtogs la/ ngag gi lam dang 38—497

nges pa'i tshig thams cad brjod pas kyang / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad sems can med par yang rab tu shes la/sems can gyi khams gdul ba'i tshul las kyang myi ldog pa dang / chos thams cad ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags 3)par yang khong du chud la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing rim gror bya ba'i sbyor ba las kyang phyir myi ldog pa dang ske/ chos thams cad la las dang rnam par phyin pa ma mchis par yang ②rtogs la/ dge ba'i las mngon par 'du bya ba'i sbyor ba las kyang / phyir mi ldog pa ma 'tshal to/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / shākya'i7bu mo go pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyodasnyibyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i chos nyid rnam pa de lta bus ⑤dri bar sems pa ⑥legs so legs so/ /dri ba brjod pa de dag kyang kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang spyod pa la mngon du gyur pa'i tshig go/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na legs par nyon la shin tu yid la zung 7shig dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis bstan 8par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ chos bcu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam pa 'di lta bu mig 'phrul gyi gzhi'i dpe dang 'dra ba/ ye shes kyi 'od kun tu 'byung ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rlabs po che la brten pa dang / mos pa rgya chen po rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba'i bsam pa rlabs po che rnam par dag pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes rgya mtsho yangs pas ltarab tu brtan 1 pa'i sems dang / sangs rgyas skye ba 'byung ba'i chos bstan pa chen po thos pa rab tu thob pa dang / dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs 38—498

pa la mos pa'i sems kyis gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi brlabs mitshorab tu thob pa dang / rang bzhin gyis snying rje chen po'i⑧lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo thams cad rab tu gcad /pa'i sems kyi stobs shugs drag po dang ldan pa rab tu thob pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams⑥byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam pa 'di lta bu mig 'phrul gyi gzhi'i dpe dang 'dra ba 'od kun tu 'byung ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de la brtson 'grus phyir myi ldog pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni chos de dag thob par gyur nas kyang mi zad pa'i tshul du mngon par sgrub cing / bsgomashepa dang shin tu rgya che bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes 6tshoganyen bsnyen bkur cing rnam pa bcus mngon par dga' bar byed do/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ lus dang srog la phongs bla par mi rtsi (1)ba dang / 'khor ba'i yo ⑨byad don du mi gnyer ba dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i smon lam las phyir mi ldog pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad la rnam par lta 17ba dang /srid pa'i7rgya mtsho thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa'i yid dang / gnas med pa'i chos kyi nam mkha' la mi gnas mi rten nyanapa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam la bsgribs bopa med pa dang / zhing rgya mtsho thams cad du rab tu 'dal skob dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsgribasam pa med pa shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang 38wa 499

ldan pa'i 3)byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur cing mngon par dga' bar dbyed do/ /de nas shākya'i〈8bu mo go pas don de nyid yongs su bstan par bya ba'i cho5phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis phyogs bcural)bltas tenya/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rlabs chen dri med blo ldan gzhan gyi 8don zhugs shing / /dge bshes dam pa bsnyen brtson g.yo dang sgyu med pa/ /ston pa'i 'du shes thob cing skyo med brtson 'grus can/ /de dag spyod pa 'jig rten mig 9'phrul 'dra 'di yin/ /gang rnams mos pa rlabs chen mkha' dang 'dra ldan zhing / /de'i 1 khongs su dus gsum 'jig rten chud pa dang ske/ /zhing dang sems can chos dang sangs rgyas de bzhin pa/ /ye shes 'od byed spyod pa de dag 1'di yin no/ /gang rnams bsam pa mkha' 'dra mtha' dang dbus 1 med la/ /kun nas nyon mongs dri mas ma gos rab dag cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yon tan 'byung 1 gyur pa/ /de dag spyod pa mig 'phrul gzhi yi 1 rnam pa 'dra/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rnam yangs tshad med bsam yas dag1zhe /yon tan rgya mtshos yid gsal mildan pa nyer brtan hu pa/ /de dag bsod nams rgya mtsho'i lus dang 32snying po ste/ /'jig rten spyod kyang 'jig rten dri mas gos mi 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi yan lag sgra skad tshul kun gyis//chos kyi 'brug sgra nyan kyang gang rnams mi ngoms shing / /chos tshul rjes su snyegs06pa'i shes rab 'od kyi sgron/ /de dag 'gro bar 'od gsal byed pa'i spyod 'di yin / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa/ /gzhan dang gzhan dag sems kyi skad cig kun sems shing / /bde gshegs rgya mtsho thams cad lta 2 zhing shes byed pa/ /sangs rgyas sems ldan de dag spyod yul 38wa 500

'di yin no/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam par hu)yangs pa'i 'khor mthong zhing / /de dag ting nge 'dzin tshul rgya mtsho mang po dang / /smon lam rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med tshul 'jug pa/ /mig 'phrul lta bu de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus kun gyis byin brlabs ri te/ /phyi mtha'i bskal par spyod byed kun tu bzang po rnams/ /zhing rnams 'byams noklas kun ritu gzugs brnyan byung gyur pa/ /chos 'od byed pa de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gang rnams ye shes nyi ma'ipo/snying rje'i dkyil 'khor can/ /'gro ba nyam rine nyes mthong zhing chos kyi 'od snang bas/ /'gro ba'i mun pa bstsal cing bstan me pa 'char 'byung ba/ /nyi marabalta bur ⑨de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ / skye dgu 1 mosrid pa'i rgyud na 'gro7)ldog mthong gyur nas/ /yid gsal 'khor ba'i rgyud 12rnams phyir zlog 3nyerab gnas shing / /chos kyi 'khor lo kun nas yongs su sgrub byed pa/ /spyod pa kun bzang dam pa'i blo can rab tu spyod/ /tshul 'dir bslabs sna tshopa de dag mtha' dang dbus myed pa'i/ /lus rnams bsam pa ji bzhin 'gro bar nyer bstan te/ /gzugs brnyan mig yor 'dra ba'i rang lus tshad med pas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho dag na 'gro mang yongs sbyin byed/ /byams tshul shin tu yangs pas 'gro mang rgyas bkang ste/ /mos pa sna tshogs 'gro la rnam par spyod bstan nas/ /'gro bar77bsam pa ji bzhin chos kyi char 'bebs shing / /brtan pa byang chub don du sems can khrag khrig 'dul/ /de nas shākya'i 'bu mo go pas tshigs su bcad pa de dag smras nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa byang chub sems dpa'i nyu 7ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshul thams cad la rnam par blta 38wa 501

ba'i 1yul thob pa'o/ /nor bzangs kyis nasmras pa/ 'phags ma byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshul la 5rnam par lta ba'i yul de'i yul caji lta bu zhig mchis/ smras pa/rigs kyi bu kho mo 5byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 'di la snyoms par zhugs na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i bskal par risangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 7mthong zhing khong du chud lado/ /bskal pa de dag gi sems can lam gyi rgyud thams cad 9)du gtogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /sems can de dag gi shi 'pho dang skye ba'i sgo ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mngon par 'grub pa'i sgo ji snyed cig yod pa dang / las 1 mngon par 'du byed pa nyi1yongs su sgrub pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang / las rnam par spyin pa sna tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /de dag gi las yongs su blangs pa dge ba yang rab tu shes so//mi dge ba dang 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba dang / nges pa dang ma nges pa dang /log par nges pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang bcas pa dang / bag la nyal ba med pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyad par gyur pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su zin pa dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su zin pa dang /12 dge ba dang mi dge ba yongs su zin pa dang / de dag gi dge ba'i chos yongs su 'dus pa dang / sdig to'i chos yongs su 'dus pa'i las yongs su blangs pa yang rab tu shes so/ /bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig byung ba de dag gi mtshan rgya mtsho yang shes shing khong du chud do/ /38wa 502

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 0thugs dang po bskyed 2)pa rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs pa'i tshul rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par bsgrubasams pa yang rab tu shes so/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas byung ba rnams kyi drung du gshegs pa rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas la mchod cing rim gror mdzad pa'i sbyor ba rgya mtshosnyiyang rab tu shes so/ /sngon gebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su 6rirdzogs par mdzad pa rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /'byung ba'i rgyan rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sems can yongs su sbyin par mdzad pa dang / btul ba rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya b.raskosamadzad pa rgya mtsho yang rab tu shes so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khyu mchog gi mthu dang rnam par 'phrul pa yang rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyang rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag na nyan thos ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag gi 'byung ba'i tshul yang rab tu shes so/ /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang rab tu shes so/ /lam bsgoms pa sna tshogs kyang rab tu shes so/ /ye shes thob par bya ba phun sum tshogs shing rnam par dag pa'i bye brag kyang rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis sems can ji snyed cig rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la bkod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gis1)sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ / rang sangs rgyas de dag gis nyu byerang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub khong du 38—50 3

chud pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gi zhi ba'i rnam par spyod pa la rnam par rtse ba'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gis3)rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gis nasems can ji snyed cig yongs su sbyin par byas pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gis chos bstan pa ji snyed cig brjod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas de dag gikhuting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa la rnam par spyod cing rnam par thar pa'i sgo ④rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rnam par brtse sgrub ji snyed cig yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ji snyed pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yide dag gisasngogebyang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ji snyed pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis thog ma dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /thog ma sems bskyed pa'i smon lam dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /smon lam rnam napa tha dad pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 'byung 9ba'i rgyan thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa rnam pa tha dad pa 1 rab tu shes so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi yan lag gi tshogs rnam par dag par bya ba rnam pa tha dad pa yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam la nan tan du bya ba'i rgyan rnam pa tha dad pa yang rab tu shes sol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon pa'i tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon 37pa'i shugs 2tshowa 504

drag po 3)rnam pa tha dad pa yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bzom pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa ྅yongs su gnonang pas rnam par rtse ba dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon 5 pa'i rnam par spyod pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa la rab tu gnas pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bsgom 6pa'i rgyud57kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su sbyang ba'i 8tshul dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa la yang dag par gnas par bya ba dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i mtshan ma dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i dbang dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas sar 'phar ba'i ye shes dag 9kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa nya yongs su bsdu ba'i ye shes dag 11 kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 32sa yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i ye shes kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 1snyernam par dgod pa la yang dag par gnas par bya ba yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgya yang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i r+ṣarnam par brtse snyib dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sade dag sems kyi skad cig re re la ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho sna tshogs thob par byed pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi snang ba'i tshul thob par byed 38—505

pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi glog gi snang ba'i sprin dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa thob pa'i tshul dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par gnon pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'0)rnams zhing rgya mtshor narjes su bgrod par byed pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /chos ④rgya mcho'i tshul zil 'jug pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /sems can rgya mtsho'i mtshan nyid tha dad pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dam par spyod pa'i tshul thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /smon lam gyi tshul sna tshogs rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho rnam pa tha dad pa dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo 8ji ltar mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi (1)khams 'di'i 'das pa dang ske/ da 7ltar byung ba'i bskal pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho la zhugs te/ khong du chud pa de bzhin du phyi ma'i mtha' gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho ji ltar shes pa de bzhin du mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa 11thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho tsho12ji ltar shes pa de bzhin du mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs su chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag 38—506

kyang rab tu shes so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs 6)su chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho rnams ji ltar shes pa de bzhin du mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho rnams ji ltar shes pa de bzhin du mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gnas pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dag na gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par ri riganas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho rnams ji ltar shes pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu lakun tu 'od rnam par snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes sol/ /phyogs bukun tu 'od rnam par snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud du gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho ji ltar shes pas45de bzhin du phyogs rtso)kun tu 'od rnam par snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dag la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa rnams kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /phyogasal kun tu 'od rnam par snang ba'i na'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs bcur 'dab chags su gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 38—507

pa dag la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho rnams rab tu shes pa de bzhin du gzhi dang snying po me tog 3)gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'dir gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam (2klas pa rnams kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ / de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams tshul du bya ba rnams dang /ci de bzhin du ④'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor lo 5rnams dang / 'jig rten 6gyi khams kyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 7bye brag rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 2chu klung rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi glong (spu)rnams dang /'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'khyil pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab dang /ri 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'byung ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams pad+mo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams sdong po dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rta bgab 1dang / 'jig rten gyi 1dmying du bya ba rnams kyi bskal pa rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi nyusnyergyan gyis brgyan 1 pa/ 'di ji ltar shes par gyur pa de bzhin du/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa dag gi bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi smon lam rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /rjes su dran no/ /sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho dag la'ang shes shing / khong du chud do/ /sngon yongs su bsgrubs pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag la'ang shes shing khong du chud do/ /bskal pa mtha' dang dbus med par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yang dag par bzhugs pa mdzad pa dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /zhing yongs su dag 38—508

par mdzad pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sems can yongs su phyin par mdzad pa'i thabs kyi tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur 1mdzad cing gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod cing rim gror mdzad pa'i sbyor ba'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do//sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dag gis〈(chos bstan pa yongs su bzung ba'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sngon gubyang chub sems dpa' 4ting nge 'dzin rab tu brnyes pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /yo byad la dbang bsgyurasnyib rab tu brnyes pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la nan tan tu mdzad pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa mngon par bsgrub pa snyomadzad pa'i tshul dag kyang shes 9shing khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa brnyes pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyi shugs drag po 3)rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /bsam gtan gyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag par mdzad pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi skye gnas thams cad du 9sku'i gzugs brnyan 0yongs su bstan pa mdzad pa'i thabs kyi tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /kun tu bzang 38—509

po'i spyod pa dang smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag par mdzad pa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /zhing rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa dag kyang 1shes shing khong du chud do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par mdzad pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang / shes shing khong du chud do//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las ye shes snang bar gyur pa/ rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing nakhong du chud do/ /sangs rgyas ྅thams cad kyi byang chub yongs su gnas 4pa mdzad pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes snang ba rab tu brnyes〈gepa'i tshul dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs te thugs su chud pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tsiba'i khyu mchog gi mthu dang rnam par rol ba'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /thog ma'i smon lam gyi )tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do / /sems can yongs su sbyin par byed pa dang / gdul 8)ba'i thabs kyi tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ sems can rgya mtsho yongs su sbyin par mdzad pa de dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /sems can de smyo dag gi sems kyi skad cig re re'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel sna ba'i thabs kyi tshul rgya mtsho 38—510

dag kyang7shes shing khong du chud do/ /ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rab tu thob pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /spobs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad yongs su gnon pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /spyod pa'i dra ba mngon par bsgrub (pepa'i tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /mthar gyis yongs su bsgrubasrepa'i phyogs la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi tshul rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /de dag gi dbang po dang stobs dang / byang chub kyisang)yan lag dang ske/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /snyoms par 'jug pa'i rnam par ⑤'phrul pa rgya mtsho dag kyang shes shing khong du chud do/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho khyachos kyi dbyings thams cad du byung ba shes shing khong du chud deg/ mngon par bsgrubs 8pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho dang / ye shes kyi sgyu ma'i dra ba mtha' yas pa la 'jug pa/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa rgyas par 'gengs pa༈)/ sgo mtha' yas pa nas shin tu bstan par bya ba/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par gnas pa la 'jug pas bstan par bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par byung ba thams cad kyang ma 'dres par shes shing /khong du chud de tshimangon par 31sgrub bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang 38—511

chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la rnam par blta tsho1ba'i yul gyi yul ni de lta bu ste/ de'i phyir de la snyoms par zhugs na sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa'i tshul rab tu shes so/ /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i tshogs kyang rab tu shes so/ /sems can thams cad kyi kun tshonanas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i ye shes kyi tshul rnams kyang rab tu shes so/ /sems can thams cad kyi las sna tshogs kyang rab tu shes so/ /nyan thos thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams kyang rab tu shes so/ /nyan thos thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sa yang rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa zhi bas rnam par 'phrul pa yang shes shing khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshul dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i tshul ④rgya mtsho la 'jug pa yang rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug pa yang rab tu shes so/ /de nas tshongamajugedapon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis shākya'i 'bu mo go pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la rnam par lta ba'i yul 'di brnyes nas ji srid cig lags/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ sngon 'das pa'i dus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bskal pa 'das pa'i pha rol cig tu 'jig rten gyi khams mi 'jigs pa byed pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams/de'i bskal pa 'gro ba'i mchog ces bya bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i 38—512

dbus su/ gling bzhi pa bde ba yod pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ gling bzhi pa de'i 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus su/ rgyal po'i gnas sdong po ri bo'i dpal zhes bya ba/grong rdal stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i phul du bya ba byung ba nya ste/ rgyal po'i gnas sdong po ri bo'i dpal de dang khu/ grong rdal stong phrag brgyadamachoXcu rtsa bzhi po de dag kyang so so nas sa'i gzhi bai ḍūr+ya pasngon po las grub pa la gnas pa /rin po che bdun las byas pa'i ra bas kun nas bskor ba/ 'obs spos chus yongs su gang ba gzhi gser gyi bye ma bdal ba/ ut+pal dang / pad+mo dang /ku mu tal)dang / me tog pun+da ri muka shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam kha dog dang 'od kyi dra ba sna tshogs shing dri shin tu ribazhim pas kun nas khyab pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba/ rin po che las byas pa'i stegs bu'i 9)khri 'phang bdun las ta la'i phreng 7ba rim pa71bdun gyis kun nas dgrigs nyi pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi shing gi nags tshal gyi phreng ba dgrigs 32pas kun nas bskor ba steng/ steng nas gser gyi dra ba bres pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis rnam par phye ba'i mig mangs liris mdzes par rnam par bres pas sa'i gzhi shin tu spa bar gyur pa/ dngos grub can gyi tshogs rnam par rgyu ba/ bya tshabatsun pa'i khyus 1 sgra skad yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs snyan pa phyung ba/ bza' shing gi ra ba bye ba brgya phrag 1shestong gis mdzes par byas pa shin tu skyid cing phun sum tshogs par gnas pa skyes pa dang /bud myed brgya stong rab tu dga' bas gang ba/ ser bu bde zhing yid du 'ong bas bskyed〈rtede/ me tog gi char mang po rgyun mi 'chad par rab tu 'grul 2 ba/sa'i bdag po dam pa brgya phrag stong gi gnas su gyur pa dag ste/ grong rdal chen po de dag gi rin po che'i shing thams cad dang / gser gyi dra ba'i rgyan la 51 38—513

stsogs pa rlung gis bskyod de/ rol mo mang po'i sgra dang mnyamanyepa'i sgra skad byung ba dag las yid du 'ong ba'i tshig 'di skad dag 'byungasango / /gsol cig mnobs shig chos la spyod cig /byang chub tu sems skyedashecig /phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la mnga' thob paras nomadzod cig /du khyed rnams bde bar gyur cig ces zer ro/ /rgyal po'i gnas sdong po ri bo'i dpal der khams kyi7rgyal po nor gyi bdag po zhes bya ba byung ste/ de la btsun mo'i 'khor bud med stong phrag brgyadakyicu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /blon po brgya phrag lnga yod par gyur teni/ rgyal po nor gyi bdag po de la bu lnga brgya yod pa de shethams cad kyang / dpa' bo rtul phod pa yan lag dam pa'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan gyi sde rab tu 'joms5)pa shin tu mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po'i mchog shin tu rgyas pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /rgyal po nor gyi bdag po rnyede'i btsun mosridam pa ni pad+mo'i dpal dam pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba ste/ bud med stong phrag brgyadacacu rtsa bzhi po de dag gi nang nas gtso mor bya ba'o/ /de'i bu gzi brjid kyi dbang po zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba shin tu mdzes pa blta na sdug pa/ mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis rab tu brgyan pa'i lus dang ldan pa zhig yod par gyur te/ de la mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag yod par gyur to/ /de'ang 'di ltar rgyal bu /rigazhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po de rkang pa'i mthil7shin tu gnas pa dang ldan te/ sa chen po la rkang pa'i mthil 'dor 7na mnyam par 'dor la/ 'deg na mnyam par 'deg ste/ gzhog5snyen rkang pa'i mthil kun gyis sa chen po la mnyam par reg go/ /de'i rkang pa'i mthil gnyis la 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ lte ba dang bcas pa mu khyud dang bcas pa/ rnam pa 38—514

thams cad du shin tu tshang ba shin tu mdzes pa blta na sdug pa dag kyang byung bar gyur to/ /de'i rkang pa'i bol gnyis kyang shin tu rgyas par gyur to6)/ /rkang pa'i steng gi mdog shin tu gsal la/ shin tu mdzes te/ me tog dam pa bas kyang lhag par mdog bzang zhing gsal bar gyur te/ de'i rka7lag gi sor mo dra bar 'brel par gyur te/ shin tu mdzes pa7rnam par phye ba④/ bu ga med pas zag pa med pa ni dper na ngang pa'i rgyal po gnas srung lta bur gyur to/ /de'i durkang pa'i rting pa yangs pa shin tu dag la (6)shin tu gsal ba rin po che thams cad kyi 'od rab tu 'gyed par grub pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i sor mo rnams kyang ring zhing zlum la tshigs bar ⑦mnyam zhing yangs pa dang ldan par gyur te/ de dag mnyam par sa la 'jog go/ /mnyam par sa las 'deg rten kyigo/ /de'i rkang pa dang lag pa'i mthil yang ka tsa lin+di shi bas kyang lhag par reg na bde bar gyur te/ des skyes pa'am bud med dam/ khye'u dang bu mo gang la reg kyang rung ste/ de dag thams cad kyang 7bde ba dang / 11yid dga' ba'i dam pas tshim zhing yid shin tu bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i byin pa ri dgas e ne ya'i7byin pa ltar 'dug par gyur te/ rimatsha1gegyis gzhol ba dang / shin tu mdzes pa dang / legs par grub par gyur pas/ ri dgas kyi rgyal po e ne yatshatshaltar de la sus kyang bsnyegasalgepa'am/ slebs skyapar mi nus te/ 'gro bas ngal zhing dub par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi dbang po de bdun shin tu mtho ba dang ldan par gyur te/ de'i rkang pa gnyis la shin tu mtho ba skum la shin tu legs pa dang (she/ shin tu rgyas pa dang / tshigs mi snang ba dang / shin tu yid du 'ong ba dang / blta na sdug pa gnyis 37grub par gyur to//38—515

lag pa la 1gnyis/ thal gong gi lhun la tshonaganyis/ ltag pa la gcig ste/ de ltar bdun no/ /de'i mtshan gsang ba'i sbubs na 'dug para'ugrub par gyur te/de'i gsang ba'i gnas sbubs na 'dug pa shin tu mi mngon la nang du nub cing kun nas yog par 'dug pa ste/ dper na glang po cang shes sam/ rta cang shes ltar 'dug pas de gos ma gyon par 'dug kyang bud med dam/ skyes pa'am/khye'u 'am/ bu mo'am/ rgan pa'am / dar la bab pa'am/ bla ma'am/ bla mar bya ba rnams kyis kyang mi mthong ste/ gzhan du na bdag longs pararnyuspyod pa'am / ched du bstan par byas te6/ 'dod pas spyad pa ni ma gtogs so/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po de ro stod seng ge ltar 'dug pa dang ldan par gyur te/ lus rim 7pas rgyas la ro stod shin tu yangs shing rdzogs pas ri dgas kyi rgyal po bas kyang mdzes par dbyibs shin tu legs pa'i ro stod dang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i thal gong rgyas shing lus shin tu rgyas pa lus rnam par phye ba/ lus kyi cha thams cad rkyen du 'bab par mnyam pa/ lus la dma' ba med pa/ lus la mtho ba med pa/ lus la zhum pa med pa/ lus la dgu ba med pa/ lus 8rin po che'i gtan tho)pa shin tu phyis pa bas kyang lhag par gsal bar gyur to/ /de'i 1 dpung mgo shin tu skum zhing sha 313rgyas la shin tu mdzes par gang ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /des mi chen po'i mtshan lag pa shin tu ring ba thob par gyur pa des lus ma btud denya / lus drang por 'dug kyang pus mo'i lha nga gnyis la nyug cing reg go/ /des mi chen po'i mtshan lus che zhing drang ba'ang thob par gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad du mchog tu gyur pa dang ldan la lus tshul dang 'dra bar mnyam pa dang / lus rab tu gnyen ni pa dang /38—516

lus shin tu lji0ba dang / lus rab tu gsal ba dang / lus shin tu sim par byed pa dang ldan par gyur to(2)/ /des mi chen po'i mtshan mgul dung lta bu yang thob par gyur te/ mi dma' ba'i lamagul dang / de'i mgul gyi 'khor thams cad dang / bzhin gyi 'khor thams cad na rtsa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang shin tu mnyam par gyur te/ kun kyang rab tu tshang bar gyur to/ /mi chen po'i mtshan seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu yang thob par gyur te/ za 'gram shin tu 'khregasalgepa dang / bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor shin tu rgyas pa dang / bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor shin tu legs shing yongs su dag pa dang / kha'i sgo shin tu yangs pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /mi chen po'i mtshan so mnyam pa bzhi bcu dang yang ldan par gyur te/ so ma tshang ba med gal zas shig za na yang lan gcig bldad pas7chung ngu na 'bras chan gyi 3)'bru 'ga'amadun/yang ma zhib spu)par za ba med do/ /so thags bzang zhing mnyam pa rab tu thob ste/ mtshams chu sgo med pa dang /shin tu mnyam pa dang / rkyen rkyen botu shin tu mdzes pa ste/ de kha zas shig za na yang 'gos31ba dang / 'chags pa dang / zhen pa dang / ljan ljin tu 'gyur ba'am / tunyethogs par 'gyur ba'am/ gseb nyana'agang bar 'gyur ba med do/ /mi chen po'i mtshan so mnyam pa77rab tu thob par gyur te/ so mnyam zhing rda rdo med pa dang / so lhag med pa dang / so zhum pa med pa dang / so gyes pa med pa dang so thog drung mnyam pa dang / so rdo ba med par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de'i mcheramab shin tu dkar bar gyur te/ mche 17ba skyon med pa/ mche ba shin tu gsal ba/ mche ba shin tu dag pa/ mche ba shin tu brtan par gyur to//mi chen po'i mtshan lce shin tu yangs pa yang rab tu nyu thob par gyur te/ de'i lce 38—517

ni shin tu yangs la srab cing mnyen te/ shin tu 'jam pa dang / las su rung ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang bsgyur na bde ba dang / gdong gi dkyil 'khor kun tu 37'gebs pa dang / bden zhing phan par 'gyur ba'i don dang / yi ge dang ngag dang nges pa'i tshig thogs pa med par brjodakhupar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan par gyur te/ dbyangs yid du 'ong ba dang /rol mo'i sgra dang / glu'i ring ro dang / sil snyan kyi dbyangs dang / sgra skad dang brjod 4cing smra ba'i tshig gi las yid du 'ong ba brjod ⑤pas ngag gi las khyenamangon par dga' ba skyed 7pa/ 'jig rten thams cad mngon par 'dun par 'gyur bar tshangs pa las kyang lhag pa'i dbyangs kyi ngag rjod deni/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor las kyang gud du/ mi 'da' bar ⑨thams cad kyi yid dang /mthun par byed pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de ni/ mig dkar nag 'byes par gyur te1 / mig shin tu dang ba dang / mig yongs su dag pa dang /mig la 'od chags pa dang / mig rnam par gsal ba dang / mig mngon par mdzes pa dang / mig blta na sdug pa dang /(lha mig yid du 'ong ba dang /mig 'dzum pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de ni rdzi ma ba'i rdzi ma7lta bu dang ldan par gyur te1 / mig gi skye mched rin po chemaspupad+ma 'osnyig ltar shin tu dag pa/ mig gi sprin mnyam pa/ mig gi sprin mtshungs pa/ mig gi sprin legs pa/ mig gi sprin yangs pa/ mig gi sprin rdzogs pa/ mig gi sprin shin tu brtan par gyur to/ /de'i smin mtshams su mdzod spu skyes par gyur te/'jam pa las su rung ba/ shin du mnyen pa/ shing bal ltar reg na bde ba8/ dang ba/nyu gsal ba 'od yod pa/ chab brom72lta bu kha ba'i kha dog ltar 38—518

'dug pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od rab tu snang ba dang ldan par gyur to①/ /de'i spyi bo la gtsug tor dusamangon par grub par gyur te/ shin tu legs pa/ kun nas zlum pa / dbus su bab pa/ skra'i rgyan du gyur pa/rin po che'i pad mo 'dab ma bye ba brgya phrag stong dang ldan pa ltar snang ba/ kun nas cha mnyam par gnas pa/ rin thang gdab tu tshad ④med pas gces pa'i gtsug tu gyur pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de ni lapags pa shin tu 'jam pa dang ldan par gyur te/ de'i lus la rdul la'adzi/ dri ma'am/ rngul lam/ ser ga'amanya/ gnyer ma'am/ lhod pa'am/ 'khums 3)pa'am/'phyang ba'am/ slod7bag tu gnas pa med par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de ni mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang ldan par gyur te / 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyirwanyamadog lta bu dang ldan zhing 'od kun tu 'dom gang ba dang / gser ltar gcig tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes par brgyan pa dang /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas dri zhim po'i 'od zer 'byung bas lus kyi rgyanamatsho/gerab rib med cing 'od gsal ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de ni ba spu re rer byung (snyeb dang ldan par gyur te༅/ ba spu'i bu ga re re nas ba spu re re skyes par gyur pa/ be+e ḍūrla 8sngon po'i kha dog lta bu g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa/legs par skyes pa/ mthang la zha 35bar 'dug pa shin tu legs par gnas pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de'i spu yan lag gyen du 'khyil par gyur te /— bhe/phyir mi zlog hunyepa'i spu dang / mi ldog pa'i spu dang / ma 'dres 3rjepa'i spu dang ldan par gyur to/ /gzhon nu de mi chen po'i mtshan skra mthon ting ri du 'dug pa thob par gyur te/ de'i skra nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba'i mdog zhu1ltar 38wa 519

mthon ting 1du 'dug pa/ 'jam pa snum pa/ legs par 'khyil pa/ g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa/ drung shin tu ran pa/ zad zed med pa/ 'jam 'jam ltar 'dug pa/ mi 'dzing nab/ dbyibs mnyam zhing mthun par gnas pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu de shing n+ya gro dha ltar chus zheng gab pa'i mi chen po'i mtshan rab tu thob par gyur te/ kun nas gyen⑧du ran pa dang /kun tu bzang ba dang / kun tu mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur te/ de ni mdun nas bltas na'ang ngoms mi shes shing blta〈pen yid du 'ong bsargyab dang g.yas g.yon dang / 'gro ba dang 'dug pa dang / 'greng7ba dang nyal ba dang ske/ smra ba dang / mi smra bar 'dug pa la bltas na/ yang ngoms mi shes shing yid du 'ong 1 la blta na sdug par gyur to11/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal posngo gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po de mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di〈nyedag gis yongs su brgyan pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi 8blta na yid du mi 'ong ba'i bag med pa tshabalta na bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ blta na sems can thams cad kyi dga' ba yongs su 'byung bas / de lta bu zhig skyes par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de nas lan gcig cigatshwa tshorgyal po 1 gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po de yab kyis gnang nas rgyal po'i gnas sdong po ri bo 19dpal gyi bza' shing gi ra ba spos kyi myu 3 rigu'i rtse mo las 'od kyi sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba der sa bzang po lta nyaba'i phyir bu mo stong phrag nyi shu dang lhan cig tu bsod nams kyi gzi brjid dang dpal gyi da bskal pa bzang po'i rnam par na 'phrul pa'i rgyan gyis byung nas skyes pa dang / bud myed kyi tshogs kyis kun nas dga' bar bya zhing / 'dzams dbu chu klung gi gser gyi shing 38wa 520

rta rdo rje rin po che'i 'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan pa/ rdo rje mthu bo che'i srog shing gi rtsa ba can nyatsan dan dam pa las bsgrubs ripa'i yu ba bzang po dang ldan pa / rin po che'i rgyal po spos sna tshogs kyi shing thags rnam par bkye ba/ rin po che thams cad kyi me tog sna tshogs kyis rab tu mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi dra bas kun nas yogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ seng ge'i khri rin po che dam pa'i dra ba'i ④rgyan gyi snying po can dbus su bshams pa/ bu mo lnga brgyas rin po che'i srad bu'i lda ldi nas yongs su gzung rab/ nam mkha' la chags pa med pa'i rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta cang shes stong dang bcas 6pa la zhon nas gdugs chen po rim gyis gzhol zhing blta na sdug pa/ steng yogs 7rin po che'i rgyal po be+e ḍūr+sha9)dkar po las byas pa/ 'od dri ma myed pa tshad med pa 'byung ba/ rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa rmad du byung ba sna tshogs thams cad kyis spa khyabar spras te/ rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par brgyan pa/ yu ba rin po che'i rgyal po be+e ḍūr+ya bosngon po las bsgreng bas nyu1ni bskyabs/ srog chags brgya stong mang pos ni yongs su bskor/ rol mo brgya stong mang po lha rdzas kyi dbyangs yid du 'ong ba snyan pa dang ldan pa dag ni rab tu blangs/ me tog gi char chen po ni mngon par 'bab12/ lha rdzas kyi spos dri zhim pa'i bdug spos kyi snod bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis ni rab tu bdug cing 'gro bar gyur to/ /de de ltar 'gro ba'i tshe lam yang rgyud brgyad dang ldan par gyur te/ mthon dman myed pa dang / gsog ma dang gyo mo myed pa dang / gser dngul dang rin po che'i rgyal po sna tshogs kyi khams kyis sa'i gzhi rab tu bsgrubs 1 pa dang /gser gyi bye tsham bkram pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog sil mas chal lo38—521

bar gang ba dang / g.yas g.yon nas rin po che'i shing gi phreng bas dkrigs pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha ran bkye ba dang / steng nas rin po che'i dril bu'i gi1dra ba bres pa dang / rin po che'i gnam yol〈sna tshogs kyis bkab pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / snam bu brgya stong rab tu brgyan pa du ma bsgreng zhing spyangs ③pas mdzes par brgyan pa dang /g.yas g.yon nas rin po che'i stegs bu'i phrengasreb rnam par bkod pas rnam par brgyan pa ste/ rin po che'i stegs bu la la la ni slongasashemo ba'i tshogs la yongs su bstabs dzinapa'i don du rin po che'i snod sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su bkang ba bkod/ stegs bu la la la ni rgyan 'dod pa'i slongasasnyemo ba rnams brgyan pa'i don du rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan gyi rnam pa yongs su bkod / stegs bu la la la ni sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bkod/ stegs bu la la la ni su ci 'dod pa de dag la de sbyin pa'i don du kha zas dang btung ba dang /bro ba sna tshogs kyis yongs su bkang ba'i snod mang po bkod stegs bu la la la ni rnam pa thams cad du mchog tu zhim pa'i ro dang / kha dog dang dri dang / bro rkyedang ske/ reg tsoyid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa'i lha rdzas kyi kha zas kyi rnam pa bkod(te/stegs bu la la la ni ro bro ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i lha rdzas kyi shing tog 8sna tshogs thams cad spungs/ stegs bu la la la ni gos 'dod pa rnams yid bzhin du spyod du gzud pa'i the phyir lha rdzas kyi gos rin po che kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa〈thumadog bzang po rnam pa sna tshogs dag dang ri mo sna tshogs shin tu spa bar rnam par phye ba shin tu btsun pa la 'os pa shin tu phra ba/ rab tu 'jam pa/ thags 38—522

su ma btags pa/ bye btubargya phrag stong snyed yongs su bkod par gyur to/ /stegs bu la la la ni byug pa 'dod pa'i sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su spyod du gzud pa'i laphyir/ lha rdzas kyi spos kyisarnam pa kha dog dang / dri rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad dang ldan pa dag kyangasnyibakod par gyur to/ /stegs bu la la la ni sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta badzalta/bzhin du yongs su spyod du gzud pa'i zhuphyir yo byad thams cad kyi phung po dag kyang 47)bkod par gyur to/ /stegs bu la la la ni na chung gzugs bzang ba rab tu mdzes pa shin tu sdug pa/ cha lugs sdug ⑧ku sna tshogs dang ldan pa yo)yid du 'ong ba'i gos sna tshogs gyon pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa/byug pa sna tshogs kyis tshul sdug gur brgyan cing mdzes par byas pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ bud myed kyi bzo dang sgyu dang / shes nyen 7gyi tshul la mkhas pa dag kyangarwa)bkod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i gnas sdong po ri bo'i dpal de nyid na sbrul 'tshong ⑩ma'i dam pa rgyal po'i 1)longs spyod du 'os pa/ blta na mdzes pa zhes bya ba zhig yod pa/ de'i bu mo dga' ba'i 'od kyi dpal shin tu sbyangs pa zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhingakheshin tu mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa ha cang yang7mi ring ha cang yang mi thung / ha cang yang mi sbom/8 ha cang yang sna rmemi phra/ ha cang yang mi dkar/ ha cang yang mi sngo ba/ skra mthon ting hurtedu 'dug pa/ myig dkar nag 'byis pa/ bzhin yid du 'ong ba17 tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ shes nyen ()gyi tshul thams cad la mkhas pa gtsug lag thams cad la shes pa/brtson pa/ le lo myed pa/ rim 'gro (7yod pa/ mos pa dang ldan pa/ byams 38wa 523

pa'i sems 'dogs 1pa/ khong khro ba mi mnga' ba/ blta na mi ngoms shing yid du 'ong ba/ 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang / gti mug chung ba/ ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa/ drang zhing mnyen pa/ g.yo dang sgyu med pa zhig yod de/ de ma nadang lhan cig tu bu mo du ma zhig gis yongs su snobaskor te/ rin po che'i shing rta la zhon nas rgyal po'i gnas sdong pos ri bo'i dpal nas byung ste/ rgyal pos bka' stsal nas/ rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po'i mdun nas/phar 5/rgyal bu gzhon nu de glu 6len zhing 7'dong 'dong ba las/ rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po mthong nas/ 'dod chags kyi sems shin btu mi bzad 9pa zhig g.yos te/ rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po shin tu yid du 'ong ches nas rjes su 'brang zhing sems la rang dbang med pas/ 7blta na sdug pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ma 'di ltar mkhyen par mdzod cig /gal te bdag rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po la ma btang7ston ni 'gum pa'am / srog la 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/bu mo de lta bu'i sems ma skyed 12cig /gzhon nu 'di ni 'khor los sgyur nya ba'i mtshan dang ldan pa ste/ de'i yab nor gyi bdag po mi bzhugs par gyur 0na/'khor los sgyur 15ba'i rgyal srid la gnas par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod do/ /de tso'akhor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal por 'gyur bas/ de'i bud med rin po che nam mkha' la 1 ci'agro ba 'byung bar 'gyur la/ bu mo bdag cag kyang / sbrul 'tshong 9ma dag cig ste/ 'jig rten thams cad dga' bar byed pa yin gyi/yu bus sems can 'ga' zhig la nam 'tsho'i 2 ribar du bsnyen bkur myi byar myi rung ba'ang myed de/ yu bu ni rgyal po nor gyi bdag po'i bkas zhu(rgyal bu gzhon 38—524

nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po'i rim 'gror717 'dong 'dong bar 3)zad kyis ri de lta bu'i sems brtan par ma byed cig /gnas de ni thob par yang shin tu dka'o/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku nyi ma dam pa zhes bya ba mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa bla na myed pa④/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyuramarab lha dang /mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste/de'i snying po byang chub chos kyi sprin shin tu sdug pa'i 'od ces bya ba yang bza' shing gi ra ba spos kyi myul)gu'i rtse mo las 'od kyi sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba de'i nang du byung ste/ der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sku nyi ma dam pa thog marashemangon par rdzogs pararnyusangs rgyas nas/ zhag bdun lon pa de bu mo de 9 shing rta la zhon bzhin du yur zhing 'chog 'chog pa'i rmi lam du mthong nas sad par gyur pa dang / sngon gnyen bshes su gyur pa'i lha mo zhig gis bstan pa/bu mo de bzhin gshegs pa'i 0sku nyi ma dam pa de ni 37snying po byang chub chos kyi sprin shin tu sdug pa'i 'od ces bya ba na 32rnam par spyod cing thog ma mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun lon te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og myin gyi lha'i tshogs kyis mdun du byas shing bzhugs te1lha/ der sa'i lha mo thams cad kyang kun nas 'dus/ chu'i lha mo midang / mye'i lha mo dang / rlung gi lha mo dang /rgya mtsho'i lha mo dang / chu 'aklung gi lha mo dang / ri'i lha mo dang / mtshan mo'i 38wa 525

lha mo dang / skya rengs 1ci'achar ba'i du lha mo dang / nags tshal gyi lha mo dang /shing gi lha mo dang / sman gyi lha mo dang / lo thogashogegi lha mo dang / grong khyer gyi lha mo dang / rkang gis 'gro ba'i lha mo dang / snying po byang chub kyi lha mo dang /lus kyi 'od gzer gyi lha mo dang / sems can gyi ris kyi lha mo dang / nam mkha'i lha mo dang / phyogs thams cad kyi lha mo dag kyang bcom ldan 'das sku nyi ma dam pa'i zhal blta ba'i phyir kun nas 'dus so zhes nas/ de ltar des de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thos pas bag tsha myed pa thobam par gyur te/ skabs su bab nas rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag po'i mdun du de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gzugs kyi mchog gis 'jig rten khyad par 'phags/ /yon tan rnams kyis thams cad phyogs su grags55kyi/ /shes rab stobs kyis (7bdag dang 'dra ma mchis / /sgyu rtsal dga' ba 7sgyu ma'i tshul kun 'tshal/ /srog chags mang po stong phrag du ma yis/ /'dod chags dbang gis bdag la rab bltas kyang / /gzhon nu bdag ni 'jig rten gang la yang / /glo ba chags par gyur pa gcig ma mchis / /sems can gang la yang zhen par gyur pa'am/ /gang la'ang khong khror bdag na gi sems ma gyur/ /gang la'ang dgra myi bgyid de zhe myi sdang / /bdag ni sems can sman par dga' ba lags/ /sku gzhan gshekyisku mchog yon tan rab mnga' khyod/ /gang tshe bdag gis gsal bar mthong gyur pa/ /de tshe dbang po kun kyang nyams su bde/ /rgya che yangs par shin tu dga' bar gyur/ /khyod kyi dbu bzang lcang lor 'khril ba ni/ ri/ /rin chen rnam snang mdog tu mthon ting01gsal / /zhal gyi smin sdug 'phral ba shangs su mdzes/ /khyod kyi zhal〈gesngar lus 38—526

'dinyebadag 'bul lo/ /mtshan gyi rab 'chang gzi brjid che mnga' ba sku gzugs gser gyi ri borkubazang po 'dra/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar bdag lta mi mdzes te②ske/ /zil du rlag⑧pas snag tsha'imatshe/gzugs kyang 'dra/ /spyan gsal ring 6la dkar nag 'byes pas mdzes/ /shin tu zhal rgyas seng ge'i za 'gram can/ /khyod kyi gsung ni thogs pa ma mchis na/ /gsung mchog mnga' bas bdag ni gzung du gsol/ /khyod kyi zhal na ljags yangs mnga' ba nin/ /mdog dmar yangs pa rin chen mchog gi 'od/ /tshangs dbyangs yan lag mchog gi gsung7mnga' bas/ /gsung zhing 'gro ba rab tu dga' ba mdzad/ /khyod kyi zhal na 7thags bzang tshems mnga' ba/ /dung ltar dri med shin tu rnam par gsalami / /'dzum zhing bzhad pa rnam par ston mdzad kyang / /skyes bu dpal 12khyod 'gro ba dga' bar mdzad/ /khyod kyi sku la mtshan rab mdzes pa 1 rnams/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dag cing 'od kyang gsal/ /sku gzugs bzang po yongs su des brgyan pas/ / mi yi bidabang po 'khor los sgyur ba 35rgyan/ /tshade nas rgyal bu hu 1gzi brjid kyi 32bdag pos/ bu mo dga' ba'i 'od kyi dpal shin tu sbyangs pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo khyod bu'i/ khyod la yongs su srung ba ni gang zhig yod/ bu mo nga la ni gzhan gyis yongs su gzung 19ba'i bud med bdag gir byar mi rung ngo zhes nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /blta sdug gzugs kyi yon tan legs ldan pa/ /mtshan bzang bsod nams rnam par dag pa'i lus/ /khyod la dri ba'i don 'di nga la smros/ /lus mchog khyod ni su yis yongs su gzung 3 / /khyod la pha dang ma ni yod dam myed/ /khyim thab myed dam khyod ni su zhig dbang / /gzugs mdzes 21khyod la sems 38—527

can gzhan nam gcig /bdag gi yin par 'du shes byed myed dam/ /khyod kyi yid ni gsod la myi dga' 'grang 1/ /gzhan las ma byin phrogasalgepar mi byed dam / /'dod pas log par g.yem la myi dga' 'grang / /brdzun⑧du brjod smrar 4yid ni mi mos 5sam/ /khyod kyi blo gros mdza' 'byed yemi 'jug7)gam/ /tshig brlang nagazhan la gnod par myi smra 'grang ri'i// /gzhan gyi nor la chags par sems myed dam/ /'gro ba rnams la gnod par myi sems 'grang / /blta boba'i 'brog dgon lam du ma zhugs 'grang hu1/ /las kyi rgyud la ye brngam tsho/gesems myed dam/ /g.yo mdog sgyu yi nya dbang du mi 'gro 'am/ /mi 'thad 'jig rten gnod par myi byed 'grang khu/ /pha ma gnyen dang mdza' bshes 7bla ma la / /sri zhu rim gror 17bya ba'i tshul 'chang ngam/ /phongs par gyur pa yongs su bsdu don du/ /khyed 1 kyi yid la byin par the sems yod dam/ /chos dang mthun par dus su 'doms byed cing / /lus dang sems yid yongs su dag byed la/ /yang dag las su rung ba skyed 19byed pa'i/ /dge bshes rnams la dga' bar0ste sems yod dam/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rim gror byed ldan nam/ /sangs rgyas sras la dga' mchog yod dam myed/ /gang las bde gshegs sras rnams skyer 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi dam pa de ni shes mi shes/ /chos yid mchog la gnas par khyod byed 'grang 21/ /chos min spyad pa'i blo gros med 'grang ngo zhuge /legs pa mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho la/ /gus pa'i sri zhu dga' sems mchog yod dam/ /skye bo mgon med phongs par gyur pa yi/ /'dren pa sa rnams la byams pa'i yid yod dam/ /ngan 3 song 'gro ba'i lam la zhugs pa yi/ /shin tu nyam 25thag snying rje sems 'grang na ngo / /gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa mthong 38wa 528

gyur0)na/ /khyod ni dga' ba mchog dang ldan 'gyur ram/ /skye bo nyon mongs rnams kyis 'khol gyur la/ /shes rab mthu bskyed btang snyoms byed mi byed/ /myi shes gnyid log skye bo mang mthong na/ /byang chub dam par smon lam 'debs byed 'grong〈mi/ /bskal pa mtha' yas spyad pa spyod byed 5)na/ /smon lam dam pas skyo bar mi 'gyur 'grang rtso)/ /de nas bu mo dga' ba'i 'od kyi dpal shin tu sbyangs pa'i ma sbrul 'tshong53)ma'i gtso mo 6blta na sdug pas rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid kyi bdag posamal 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag gi bu mo 'di ni rdzus te byung ba/ pad mo'i nang nas skyes pa ste/ sngan chad na khyim gyi nang nas phyi rol tu ma byung ngo zhes nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ces 9smras sol/ /bu mo 'di la khyod kyis gang smras 1 )pa/ /de ni bdag gis rim pas khyod la〈skrebarjod/ /ji ltar bu mo 'di skyes bskyed bskyed pa/ /bdag gis khyod la gsol gyis nyugegasan du gsol/ /gang tshe dgung sangs khyod ni bltam 1 gyur pa/ /de tshe bdag gi bu mo 'di skyes te/ /rdzus te dri med pad ma'i ngasbubs nas byung / /yan lag kun tshang myig yangs 'di yang skyes/ /dus kyi nang na sos ka dus mchog la/ /sman dang lo tog mamyu gu 'thon pa'i tshe/ /sā tshala'i ra ba bza' shing rab mchog tu/ /bdag ni rtse dga' de khrod mchi mchi ste/ /sna tshogs yal ga'i lo ma rgyas gyur cing / /zhugs shing me tog sdug 1 rgyas sprin gyi mdog /bya bran sna tshogs sgra snyan zhugs shing nang / /nags khrod mya ngam 18ma mchis dgar mchis mchis/ /rgyan dang ldan zhing shin tu yid 'ong la/ /rin chen rad pa 19 sna tshogs 'tshal pa 3 rirnams/ /rol mo glu la shin tu bslabs 31pa yi/ /bu mo brgya phrag brgyad dang bdag kyang ldan/ /spos mchog ldan pa'i pun da ri 22ka 38wa 529

dang ske/ /rdzing0)'gram me tog sil mas bltams pa yis/ /sa phyogs de na bud myed mang po dang / /bdag cag de na dga' bar mchis mchis na/ /chab dbus de nas rin chen pad mo'i mchog /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa byung bar gyur / /lo ma rin chen yu ba be+e ḍūr+yal/ /snying po 'dzam bu chu klung gser las bgyis / /spos mchog rin chen dam pa'i ze ba can/ /'od chen 'dzamakhubu'i rgyal mtshan kun tu 'phro/ /de tshe dgung la gdugs shig shar tamasnyizhes/ /skye bo kun kyang yid gnyis 'tshal bar gyur95/ /dgung sangs gyur nas pad mo chen po de/ /gdugs kyi 'od kyis perab tu rgyas bgyis nas/ /snang ba de dang sgra snyan rab kyang bkye/ /'di 'byung de ni sngon gyi ltas su byung / /bud myed rin chen 'di 'dra 'jig narten du/ /tshul khrims dam pa rnam par dag pas byung / /sug las bgyis pa chab 'tshal mi 'gyur bas/ /'di ni sngon cad7legs par spyad pa'i 'bras/ /spa ni mthon ting nya3 mig yangs ud pa la/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan kha dog rnam dag ldan/ /phreng ba rgyan mchog cha07lugs dbyibs su shis / /dpal ltar dri myed pad mo'i mchog las skyesahurte/ /lus ni rnam dag yan lag rgyan 3/du mnyam/ /lus kyi dbyibs legs yan lag yongs su tshang / /gser gyi gzugs la nor bus phyis 0pa 'dra/ /phyogs kun 'od kyis rnam par gda' 8bar gsal/ /lus las tsan dan rgyal po'i spos kyi dri/ /phyogs su rgyas par 'di yi 8lus las 'byung / /sgra snyan lha rdzas yid du 'ong brjod 3 1tshe/ /kha nas ud pa la yi ngad kyang ldang〈rte/ /'di ni gang tshe 'dzum zhing rgod7)pa'i tshe/ /rol mo'i sgra snyan de tshe 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bud med rin chen 'jig rten 'dir byung ste/ /tha mal kun gyi dbang du 'gyur du )ma lags/ /khyod ma gtogs 38wa 530

par mi yi7'jig rten na/ / 'di yikhubadag po gzhan ni gcig ma mchis/ /mtshan rab brgyan pa'i sku gzugs mdzes mnga' ba/ /khyod kyi zhalasasngar bu mo 'di bzhes gsol/ /'di ni ha cang mi ring mi thung ste/ /ha cang mi sbom ha cang phra ma lags/ /lto ni gzhu 'dra nu ma shas7kyang rgyas/ /yan lag skyon bral 'di ni khyod la 'os/ /grangs dang yi ge shes bgyi tshul rnamasashedang / /lag brda'i tshul dang gtsug lag tshul la mkhas/ /'jig rten kun na bzo rnams ji snyed pa/ /ma lus de la 'di ni pha rol phyin/ /mda' gzhu'i tshul la'ang rnam pa rgyus su mkhas/ /'phong gi cho ga rnam par nges par rtogs/ /dgra yid bzhing zhing7dbab pa kun la yang / /'di ni mchog tu pha rol phyin par gyur/ /lus rnams kun la rin chen rnam dag pa'i/ /'od mchog 'khor gyis shin tu mdzes pa ste/ /sngon bgyis〈nyelegs pas shin tu sdug par brgyan/ /'di ni khyod kyi phyag rjed khyod la 'os/ / mi yisa'ajig rten gnas rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag gsotsoba'i tshul gyi cho ga 'tshal/ /de dag ma lus thams cad zhir77bgyi na'ang / /ma nor sman gyi cho gas gso hunyel mkhas/ /'dzamatshwanyebu'i rgyal mtshan skad rnams thams cad dang / /skye bo'i nges tshig ma lus bye brag dang / /'jig rten tha snyad brjod pa'i mtshams sbyar ba/ /sna tshogs kun la'ang 'di ni pha rol phyinayi/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag mngon par bsgrub pa'i tshul/ /de dag bye brag tshul la'ang rab tu zhugs/ /'jig rten glu gar rnam pa53 ji snyed pa/ /ma lus de rnams kun gyi tshul yang 'tshal〉/ /rol mo sil snyan dag gi thabs rnams dang / / bzhad gdadza nyerol mo'i tshul la rnam par mkhas/ /chags dang ma chags mi rnams mngon 'tshal kyang / /khong khro chags par 'gyur ba ma mchis so//38—531
