yongs su rdzogs par bya dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas hu)lung bstan pa tshad med par tsho yang dag par mnod skyidagos so/ /byang chub sems dpas bzod pa'i sgo dpag tu med pa la 'jug par bya dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas sa52grangs myed pa yongs su sbyang bar bya 6dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas chos kyi sgo dpag tu med pa yongs su dag par bya dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa yongs su sbyang dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpasam7)bskal pa mtha' yas par go cha bgo dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa mchod par bya dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpas nasmon lam mngon par bsgrub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon par bsgrub dgos so/ /rigs kyi bu mdor na sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ni sems can thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /bskal pa thams cad du gnas pas bskal pa thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /thams cad du skye ba yongs su ston pas skye ba thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /dus gsum 31gyi ye shes khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir dus thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /chos7thams cad la nan tan du byed pas chos thams cad dang hunyemanyam par bstan to'i /zhing thams cad yongs su dag par byed pas zhing thams cad dang gemanyam par bstan to / /smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas/ smon lam 7thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa mngon par bsgrub pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang gcig tu 'gyur ba'i tsophyir/ byang 38—628

chub sems dpa' thams cad dang hu)mnyam par bstan to/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na khyod kyis midage ba'i bshes5gyiganyen yongs su btsal ba la skyo bar mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong bas ngoms pa du )bskyed par mi bya'o / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la yongs su dri bas chog shes par mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa las bsam pa phyir ldog par mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phu dud dang / rim gro'i sbyor ba rgyun gcadam(1par mi bya'o / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa la 7 log par gzung bar mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan thob par 'gyur5khub la the tsom 1)mi bskyed do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bo'abyung ba'i sgo bstan pa la yid gnyis nyu1su mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thabs kyi bsam pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i rgyud la zhe sdang bskyed 12par mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mos pa rnam par bskyed pas lus dang sems rnam par ldog par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi /nabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad thos pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bya ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi rgyun thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 8bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad ni 38—629

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgrubs tsho)1pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi〈gesgo snang ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i sgo rnam par dag pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la nan tan du bya ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gnas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa thams cadanguni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtsa bar gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa brtan rgyapa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las skyes ⑥pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ri)nogazungs dang spobs pa'i sgo snang ba thams cad du khridashepa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dag pa'i sgo'i mdzod (spu thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung 7ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes snang ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam khyad par can thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag na 'dug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi 31tshul gyi sna rgyud gcig tu gyur pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten the pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsgrub pa khyad par can mnyam gepa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen 8gyi rgyud las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba'i gnas thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mdzod na 'dug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'byung gnas nas byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po'i 38—630

shugs kyi myu gu thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 37rnam par spel ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par spel ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gter gyi mdzod thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bskyangs tshonapa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams bstsags pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsrungs pa'o//byang chub sems dpa'i tshe rnam par dag pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos mnyan pa'i sprin thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi kha nas byung —)ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' la 'byung ba'i lam la 'jug pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi khong na yod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro 3 byas pas thob pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung 67ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan brjod pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi phyogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bstan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i bdag nyid che ba ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par brjod pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byams pa chen po'i stobs ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po'i stobs ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung 7ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yan lag nathams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 38—631

bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i phan pa nye bar bsgrub pa thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngan song du mi ltung ngo / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni theg pa chen po las myi ldog go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bsam07pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bar myi byed do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis5geshin tu bsrungs pa'i⑧byang chub sems dpa' 4rnams ni sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag tu myi 'dongasnyingo / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bskyangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos las nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni so so'i〈skye bo'i sa las yongs su 'da'o ri/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bsrungasalgepa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon med par mi 'jug go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskyed chos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten gyi chos kyis myi gos pa yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen hunyebakur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni spyod pa thams cad la mi 'khrul par spyod pa ma yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgrubs hu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni brtsam pa gethams cad las phyir mi ldog go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 1geyongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni las dang nyon mongs 38—632

pas thub par dka'atub yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs kyis brtanam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bdud thams cad kyis mi thub pa yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rten la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni byang chubashekyi yan lag thams cad kyisalgenam par 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bsgrib par 'gyur ba'im chos thams cad las rnam par sbyong ba'odu/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sdig to las rnam par bzlogashepa'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni mi bya ba rnams khong du chud par byed pa'o/ /bgamadumed pa'i gnas las yang dag par bzlog 1pa'o/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'o/ /lta ba'i 'ching ba 'thub pa'o / /'khor ba'i grong khyer nas 'don pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi gnas 'dor bar byed pa'o/ /bdud kyi zhags pa las thar bar byed pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu 'byin (mepa'o / /mi shes pa'itshwa thibs po las thar bar byed pa'o/ /lta ba'i mya ngan las yongs su zlo ba'o⑩/ /srid pa'i chu bo las sgrol ba'o/ /'dod pa'i 'dam nas 'byin pa'o/ /lam mispobade ba nas rnam par zlog77pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam yang dag par ston pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam la gzhog pa'o / /nan tan la rab tu 'god pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gro ba'i phyogs rab tu ston pa'o/ /shes rab kyi mig rnam par tshasbyong ba'o/ /byang chub kyi sems rnam par 'phel bar byed7)pa'o/ / snying rje chen po yang 19dag par skyed pa'o/ /(1spyod pa yongs su ston pa'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag rab tu ston pa'o/ /sa la rab tu 'god pa'o/ /bzod pa rnam par 'byed pa'o / /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'grub par 22byed pa'o/ /tshogs 38—633

thams cad skyed 17par byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thams cad stobasam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du phyin par byed pa'o/ /yon tan thams cad yongs su ston pa'o/ /don thams cad yang dag par len du 'jug pa'o/ /nan tan la gzengs ribastod pa'o/ /'byung ba'i sgo ston pa'o//lam gol sku ba las yongs su srung sgruba'o/ /chos snang ba'i sgo snang bar byed pa'o/ /chos kyi sgo mngon par brlan 6par byed pa'o/ /chos thos par bya ba'i sprin gyi char rab tu 'bebs pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa'o/ /lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad las rnam par zlog 3pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la gnas par byed pa'o/ /'di ltar yang rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes napas ma lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni phan pa rgya chen por 9sgrub pas pha lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sdig pa thams cad las srung bas ma ma 31lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa khong du chud par byed pas slob dpon lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni pha rol tu phyin skyonapa'i lam du 'dzudatshwanyepas lam mkhan lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni nyon mongs pa'i nad las thar bar byed pas sman pa lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni ye shes kyi sman rnam par 'phel bar byed pas gangs lori lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'jigs pa thams cad las srung bas dpa' bo 5lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'khor ba'i chu bo chen po las sgrol bas mnyan pa lta bu'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rin po che'i gling du phyin par byed pas skya ba 'dzin pa lta bu'ol/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na de ltar yid la bya ba rgyun ma nyu snachad pas khyod 28—634

kyis ①dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen par gyis shig /khur thams cad bkur bas yongs su mi skyo ba'i phyir sa lta bu'i sems dang / mi phyed pa'i phyir rdo rje lta bu'i sems dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyis mi bsgulasngo ba'i phyir 'khor niyug lta bu'i sems dang / ci dga' bar bka' nyan pas bran lta bu'i sems dang /ngag thams cad mi gcagashepas slob ma lta bu'i sems dang / las thams cad nyams su blang ba la mi smad pas 'jig rten gyi bran lta bu'i sems dang / nyon mongs pa7thams cad kyis mi skyo ba'i phyir ma ma lta bu'i sems dang / bya'o cogam6la mthun par gzung bas g.yog lta bu'i sems dang / nga rgyal dang mtho ba'i nga rgyal spong bas7phyag dar ba lta bu'i sems dang / dus dang dus ma yin par mthon 6)dman du 'gyur bas zla ba nya ba 7lta bu'i sems dang / myi srun 11pa thams cad rnam par spong bas 32rta cang shes lta bu'i sems dang / khur lci ba bkur bas theg pa lta bu'i sems dang / dul ba 1 dang cang shes kyi bsam pas glang po lta bu'i sems dang / myi sgul myi bskyod lapas ri 7lta bu'i sems dang /mi khro bas khyi lta bu'i sems dang / nga rgyal dang dus med pas gdol pa 7lta bu'i sems dang / dregs pa thams cad med pas khyu mchog rwa bcad pa lta bu'i sems dang / rlom sems med pas mtshan bu lta bu'i sems dang / 'gro zhing 'ong bas mi skyo bas gru lta bu'i sems dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag gi mthar phyin par byed pas zam pa lta bu'i sems dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngor bltamo bas bu mdzangs 18pa lta bu'i sems dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' las mi 'gal bar bya bas rgyal po gzhon nu lta bu'i sems kyis nyartedage ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 2 bdag la ni 31nad par 38—635

'du shes bskyed do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni sman pa'i 'du shes dang /gdams ngag la ni sman gyi 'du shes dang / nan tan nyams su blang ba la ni nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ①bdag la ni 'dron na/po'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni lam mtshon pa'i 'du shes dang / gdams ngag la ni lam gyi 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni phyogs bde bar 'gro ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 4bdag la ni pha rol tu 'gro ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni mnyan 5pa'i 'du shes dang / rjes su bstan pa la mu stegs kyi 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni gru'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag la ni zhing pa'i pa'adu shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni klu'i dbang po'i 'du shes dang / gdams ngag la ni char pa'i 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni lo tog 'grub pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag sa la ni dbul po'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni ngal bso po'i ⑨'du shes dang /gdams ngag la ni nor dang don gyi 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni dbul ba sel 〉ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis〈spebadag la ni slob ma'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni slob dpon gyi 'du shes dang gdams ngag la ni bzo ba'i / 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni bzo sna khong du chud pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis tsobadag la ni 'jigs gepa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni dpa' bo'i 'du shes dang / gdams ngag la ni mtshon cha'i 'du shes dang /38—636

nan tan la ni dgra sel ba'i 'du shes bskyedasanyu)par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag la ni tshong pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni skya ②ba 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang / gdams ngag la ni rin po che'i 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni rin po che7sdud pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyisasnyibadag la ni bu dam pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'og/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni pha ma'i 'du shes dang / rjes su bstan pa la ni rigs kyi bu'i tshul gyi 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni tshul ma nyams pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag la ni rgyal po gzhon nu'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni chos kyi rgyal po dang blon po dam pa'i 'du shes dang / gdams ngag la ni rgyal po'i khrims kyi 'du shes dang / nan tan la ni ye shes kyi rgyal po'i cod pan dang rgyan dang / chos kyi thabs mgo la 'ching0)ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i grong khyer la rnam par lta ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya stespyo/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis tshade lta bu'i 'du shes yid la bya ba yongs su sgom ste31/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la nye bar bsnyen par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la lhag pa'i bsam tu pa yongs su dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag thams cad nyams su len pa'i tshe/gangs kyi ri la rten7pa'i rtswa dang gel pa dang / sman dang benags tshal lta bur 8dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis rnam par 'phel lo/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu'i snod du gyur pa ltar chos thams cad kyi snod du 'gyur ro/ /gang ’ tshochen mtsho chen po rin po che mang po'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa ltar yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas 38—637

su 'gyur ro/ /mye'i 1drod kyis rigaser yongs su 'byangaglegeb ltar byang chub kyi sems yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho chen po las 'phags pa'i ri rab ltar 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /pad mo la chus myi chags pa 5ltar 'jig rten gyi chos kyis myi gos par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho chen po ro rul pa dang mi 'grogs pa 6ltar/ spyod pa ngan pa thams cad dang mi 'grogs so/ / yud du 7yar gyi zla ba ltar chos dkar pos rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam 8bu'i gling snang bar byed pa'i nyi ma ltar chos kyi dbyings su snang bar 'gyur ro/ /pha ma dang 'grogs pa'i bu ltar byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi lus thams cad yang dag par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mdor na rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni yon tan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu ni rab tu 9'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu ni yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po 1 bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu ni rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /byin gyi 11nabs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu ni rnam par spyod par 'gyur ro//sgrib pa'i chos bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu ni rnam par sbyong bar hu 'gyur rol/ /sgrib pa'i chos grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu ni yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /bdud grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu las ni yang dag par 'das 1 par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi sgo grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu la ni rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /tshogs rnam par dag pa'i sgo grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu ni yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa grangs med 38—638

pa brgya stong phrag bcu ni kun nas dag par 'gyur ro/ /smon lam chen po grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu ni mngon par grub par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar mdor na byang chub sems dpa'i spyad ①pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa la 'jug pa thams cad dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyis ②rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs dang spobs pa'i snang ba thams cad dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsngo ba'i ye shes dang mngon par shes pa tshad med pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu thob cing yongs su grub du )pa rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtsa bar gyur pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba dag go / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen skye gnas su gyur pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen skye mched du gyur pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen las yongs su skyes pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su〈spel ba dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rab tu rten ⑤pa dag go/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyur gyur pa'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen las rab tu skyes pa dag go/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 67rnam pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan dang / bsngags pa 3rjes su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa tshad med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya chen po thos nas dga' rangs te 38—639

mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ khye'u dpal 'byung bshedang ske/ bu mo dpal gyi blo gros ma gnyis kyi rkang pa la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/khye'u dpal 'byung ba dang / bu mo dpal gyi blo gros ma gnyis la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ khye'u dpal 'byung bshedang / bu mo dpal gyi blo gros ma'i drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdozha bam po bca brgyad 4pa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag gis sems mngon par brlan pa de byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rjes su bstan pa de ni rjes su rnam par sems/ sngon gyi mtha'i lus mang po yang dag par raspyod pa nyams su ma blangs par chud zos pa la bsam pas ni5lalus kyi stobs rab tu brtan par byed/ sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i lus dang sems yongs su dag kyang nadon med par 'khor ba'i sems kyi rgyud du gyur pa la bsam 9 pas ni sems dang yid la bya ba rab tu sbyong / sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i las yang dag pa ma yin pas 'jig rten gyi don du g.yen nyu )spyo ste/ mi gces par sha thang /1ba la bsam /depas ni da 1 ltar byung ba'i don shin tu gces pa la legs par bsgrub pa rnam par sems/ sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i yongs su rtog pa yang dag pa ma yin par rnam par brtags pa las byung ba phyin ci log gis yid la bya ba mukun nas glags pa la bsamalapas ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yang dag pa'i rtog 8pas mngon par 'du bya ba'i stobs yang dag par bskyed1 / 'das pa'i lus kyis hunyebadag gi don gyi sbyor ba la rtsom rtsom pa'i yul la yongs su bsam 17pas ni/ sems can thams cad kyi 38—640

sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par lhag pa'i bsam pa'i 1stobs rab tu brtan par byed/ sngon 'dod pa yongs su tshol tshol ba'i spyod padza ro myed pa la yongs su bsam pasasheni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'thob pa'i sbyor bas ④ridabugs phyin pa chen po 'thob pa'i dbang po'i shugs drag po rnam par 'phel bar byed/'das pa'i dus kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa phyin ci log dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba la yongs su bsam zhu)pas ni/ da ltar byung ba'i dus su phyin ci log med pa dang ldan pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam la yi dam bca' bas sems kyi rgyud yongs su rgyas par byed/ sngon gyi mtha'i brtson 'grus brtsams pa mi cha la 'udon ma yin pa dang / yongs su ma grub pa'i brtson 'grus nyams su blangs pa la yongs su bsam pas ni/ da ltar byung ba'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsdu ba la sta gon du gnas pa'i brtson 'grus chen po rtsom pa'i rnam par gnon gepas lus dang sems kyi gzengasaston)mtho ba yang dag par bskyed⑨ske/ sngon gyi mtha'i 1 sna mur thug pa'i 'gro ba lnga'i rgyud kyi ngan song du bdag dang gzhan bor ba la brtag7nyapas lus 'tsho nyi ba med pa yongs su gzung 32ba la yang dag par bsam 8pas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su bsgrub skupa dang / 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyen bkur bar nus pa'i lus yongs su bzung bas dga' ba dang mos pa'i shugs drag po rgya 7chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed/ da 1 ltar byung ba'i tsherarwarnyemangon par grub kyang rga 16ba dang na ba 2 dang 'chi ba dang mya ngan gyi 'byung gnas su gyur te 'du ba dang 'bral ba'i nya/ gter du gyur pa'i lus kyang phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod 2pa 38—641

la brtson pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsdu ba la brtson pa dang 37 / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal lta du nazhing zhing thams cad du rgyu ba dang / chos smra ba thams cad la rim grorashebya ba dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa yongs su bzung ④ba la brtson pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su btsal ba'i grogs su gyur pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad mthong bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsdu ba la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang ske/ ye shes kyi lus kyi rgyu dang rkyen du gyur pa la bltas shing dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang po dang / shugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par 'phel bar byed cing de lta bu'i sems dang / de lta bu'i yid la bya ba dang / tshul bzhin de lta bu la rab tu brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mos pas yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i dad pa 5dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsam pa 6yongs su bsgrubs 7pa'i nye bar sems pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lhag pa'i bsam pas 37sgro btags pa'i rim gro spudang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang po dang bar sgro btags 3 ripa'i phu dud dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ston pa la mos pas yang dag par bsgrubs ci 1pa'i dbang po dang ba'i 12shugs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la rim gros 1 byung ba'i sems kyi mos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dad pa las yongs su byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs dang /byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad las yongs su grub pa'i mchod pa rnam 7pa tha dad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 38—642

mnyam pa'i lus kyi7thal mo sbyar ba dang / 'gro ba'i lus thams cad du yongs su byung ba'i mig rnam pa sna tshogs kyisal/blta ba dang / 'gro bar geming btags pa thams cad du sgro btags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyis54sprul pa las byung bar sgro btags pa'i lus kyis btud cing phyags bya ba tshad med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i legs par brjod 4)pa'i rgyan mngon par bsgrub pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' dang da ltar byung ba'i dus su byung ba'i sems can gyi 7gnas thams cad yongs su rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang mngon du byas pa'i 'du shes kyi rnamasapa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba thams cad du khyab pa dang / skra'i rtse mo gcig las kyang lhag she pa med par 7byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus kyis 3)rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 32rjes su song ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mig gi 1snyelam rnam par dag par sgro btags pa'i mngon par shes pa snang bas rnam par dmyigs pa dang / phyogs kyi dra ba tha dad pa thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i yid kyi skye mched dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha dad pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 0smon lam mngon par bsgrubs nyidapa'i stobs dang / chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i sgo nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas te/mthas gtugs pa 7thams cad du khyab 1 la/ dus gsum (8du tha mi dad cing rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / nyi dad pa dang mos pa la tsho'ajug pa'i stobs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag snang ba'i phyogs la zhugs pas yul rgya 21mcho1) 38—643

'gram0)gang na ba der phyin te/ de ltar tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs rim gro dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pasadang / phyag bya ba dang /blta ba'i byin gyi rlabasams dang / smon lam dang / 'du shes kyi rjes su song ba de lta bu'i yid dang ldan pa dang / ye shes kyi spyod yul tshad med pa'i sa de lta bu la zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi mig gis khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po'i ca)sgo nas lus thams cad kyis7phab ste/ phyag byas so/ /des 0rnam pa de lta bu'i mngon par bsgrub pa'i tshul yud tsam tu rnam par dpyad nade mos pa dang dad pa las byung ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang /smon lam gyis mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mthusashede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du bdag nyid rgyun mi 'chad par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mngon sum du gnas pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 1 riganas thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs thams cad dang ske/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang thams cad dang / chos rin po che'i gnas thams cad dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas dang / mchod rten thams cad dang 3tshe/ mngon sum du gnas pa nas/'phags pa'i tshogs dang sbyin pa'i gnas dang / bla ma dang pha ma thams cad kyi bar gyi 'gro ba'i 2tshogs thams cad dang / mngon sum du gnas pa dzo//rgyun mi 'chad par ye shes kyi lus tha mi dad pa'i tshul la 'jug pa thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / 'du shes kyi byin gyi sarlabs dang / ye shes yid la bya bas byin gyis brlabs saso/ /khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang tsomadzad kyi rgyan 38wa 644

gyis brgyan pa'i snying po'i sgo nas ji lta ba de bzhin du gong du brjod pa'i dmigs pa thams cad la yang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'dud7cing phyag bya bar〈byin gyis brlabs〈so/ /de bzhin du phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par ④rgyun 'chad pa med par byin gyis brlabs 'a)te/ nam mkha'i dbyings tshad med pa dang mnyam pa nyid dang / chos kyi7dbyings sgrib pa med pa dang mnyam pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'akhuthams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid rnam par mi rtog pa dang mnyam pa nyid dang / grib ma lta bu'i ye shes dang / 'du shes kyisalcergyas par dgang balgemanyam pa nyid dang / mi lam lta bu'i rnam par dpyodapha pa dang tsho/namanyam pa nyid dang / gzugs brnyan lta bu'i7'jig rten dang / 'gro ba thams cad rnam par dmigs pa'i mnyam pa nyid dang / rgyu dang rkyen las byung bas kyi sgra brnyan ⑩lta bu'i mnyam pa nyid dang / 'byung ba dang 'jig pa mi skye ba dang /mnyam pa'i mnyam pa nyid dang / rkyen dang rten pa'i rgyud dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin dang mnyam pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyis las ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su byung ba'i rnam par min pa la ni mos par byed/ rgyu ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su byung ba'i 'bras bu la ni mos par byed/ bstsags 8pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su byung ba'i bya ba thams cad la ni mos par byed/ dang ba tshalas yongs su byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa byung ba thams cad la ni mos parapo byed/ mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su byung ba'i sangs rgyas mchod pa'i sprul pa thams cad la ni mos par (rtebyed/ rim gro las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa thams cad la ni mos par byed/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs las yongs su byung 2 tshoba'i 38—645

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid la ni mos par byed/ shes rab dang thabs las yongs su byung ba'i rgyan yid kyi rang 3)bzhin tu bsgrubs7pa thams cad la ni mos par byed/ smon lam las yongs su byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la ni mos par byed/ bsngo ba las yongs su byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul du gyur pa sbyo /rnam par bsgrub pas 4)rgyas par dgang geba'i rgyan la ni mos par byed cing yongs su bsngo ba'i ye shes chad 56)pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba dang / skye ba med pa'i ye shes rtog 7pa'i 'du shes med pa mnodang / yang dag pa'i spyod pa la 'jug cing rgyu nye bar stsogs pa'i ye shes rgyu dang bya ba'i lta ba med pa dang /phyin ci log med pa'i ye shes phyin ci log gi lta ba dang bral ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i ye shes dbang phyug tu lta ba med pa dang / rten pa la ⑨'jug pa'i ye shes bdag 1 chodang pha rol gyi 'du shes kyi lta ba dang / bral ba dang /chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang 1dbus med pa la 'jug pa'i ye shes mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang bral ba dang / gzugs brnyan lta bur mngon par grub hurtepa'i ye shes 'pho ba'i lta ba med pa dang / mi skye mi 'gag nyunyepa'i ye shes skye ba dang / 'jig pa'i lta ba dang bral ba dang /〉 stong pa nyid kyis 8mi skye ba'i ye shes lta 8ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang bral ba dang / smon lam mngon par sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi stobs dbang phyug med pa'i chos nyid rab tu rtogs 3 pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i mtha'i sgo dang ldan pa'i ye shes mtshan ma thams cad dang bral bas sa bon las myu gu chud nami za ba'i chos nyid dang / rgya las rgya'i gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'i chos nyid dang / gzugs las gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'i chos nyid 38wa 646

dang / sgra brnyan dang sgrar tshomanyam pa rnam par dmigs pa'i chos nyid dang rnam par dpyod pa dang / rmi lam du mnyam par rnam par dmigs pa'i chos nyid dang ske/ sgyu ma'i rnam pa ltar las las yongs su byung ba'i chos nyid dang /nasems gzugs med pas 'jig rten yongs su bskyed pa'i chos nyid dang / rkyen dang rgyur ji ltar bstsags capa bzhin du/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i chos nyid dang las ji ltar bstsags pa dang / mnyam par rnam par smin ltapa 'byung ba'i chos nyid dang / thabs mkhas pas rnam par bsgrubs 6pa'i chos nyid dang chos dang 7chos ma yin pa mnyam pa nyid kyi namangon par brlan pa'i chos nyid dang / ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa de lta bus 49mngon par bsgrubs 1 snapa'i 'du shes dang /yid la bya bas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 11/khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis 12brgyan pa'i snying po'i 1/sgo nas rnam pa /sride lta bur btud de/ phyag 'tshal nas yun ring mo zhig lon pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs bsam gyis mi khyab pas mngon par brlan pa'i sems dang ldan pa lus dang sems shin tu sim par gyur pa de/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i sgo'i tshaganas nas langs te/ yud 7tsam zhig tu 1 khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po de la mig mi 'gebs 1 pas bltas nas/ thal mo sbyar te lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ de lta bu'i 19'du shes dang / yid la bya bas bskul ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ tshig tu brjod pa 'di ni stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ / 'di ni chos thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /21chos kyi 38—647

dbyings tha mi stidad pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa ②sems can gyi khams mi dmigs pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ chos thams cad mi skye ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa3/ 'jig rten thams cad gnas med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas gnas myed pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gnas thams cad rnam par bsgoms pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/brtenamaXpa thams cad la mis rten pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ lus thams cad la mi rten pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod papo / 'du shes kyi rnam pa thams cad bstsalasdo'o/ba'i gnas la rnam 7par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /'di ni chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams〈nyekyi gnas so/ /rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa thams cad du/ rnam par mitsha/2rtog pa'i gnas la rnam par tsho/nyespyod pa/ 'du shes dang sems dang yid thams cad kyis rnam par dben pa'i gnas la spyod pa/ lam thams cad blang ba med pa dang / dor ba med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la 'jug pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ sgo kun nas chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa thabs (stekyi gnas la rnam par spyod pa/nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi zhing nye bar zhi ba'i (geganas la rnam par spyod pa/lta ba dang srid tshapa dang / nga rgyal thams cad spongs pa'i shes rab shas7sheche ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa bskyed //pa thams cad la rnam par rol ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul bsgoms du )pa'i 38wa 648

gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na nye bar gnas pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /'di ni gang de dag bskal pa gcig la ①bskal pa thams cad dang /bskal pa thams cad lashebaskal pa gcig tu 'jug pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa / gang de dag zhing gcig dang zhing thams cad dngashe/ zhing thams cad dang zhing gcig tu tha mi dad pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag chos gcig dang chos thams cad du/ chos thams cad dang chos gcig tu myi 'gal ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag sems can gcig dang / sems can thams cad du sems can thams cad dang / sems can gcig tu tha mi dad pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag sangs rgyas gcig dang /sangs rgyas thams cad du sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sangs rgyas gcig tu myi gnyis pa'i ④gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag dus thams cad la skad cig gcig gis 'jug pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa⑤/ gang de dag sems bskyed pa gcig gisangayizhing thams cad du 'gro ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa / gang de dag sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gzugs brnyan snang ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag 'jig rten thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyi gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gang de dag thob par bya ba thams cad rang la rag las pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa de dag gi gnas so/ /'di ni gang de dag 'jig rten gyi gnas thams cad las gyen du 'phags kyang sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas na snang ba dang / gang de dag zhing thams cad la mi gnas kyang / de 38—649

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir zhing thams cad du rjes su spyod pa dang / gang de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan yongs su gzungamanyarmeba'i phyir zhing thams cad du rjes su spyod kyang gnas nas g.yo ba med pa dang ske/ gang de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na 'dug kyang sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes su mngon par zhen pa dang bral ba dang / gang de dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la rtenango pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang 'gro ba thams cad na de'i ye shes la mnyam zhing 'dra ba med pa dang / gang de dag bdud kyi gnas 5thams cad na spyod kyang 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi dga' ba dang bral ba dang / gang de dag 'du shes kyi rnam pa'i gnas thams cad la rnam par spyod kyang 'du shes kyi rnam pa thams cad rnam par bstsal ba'i yidasnyedang ldan pa dang / gang de dag 'gro ba thams cad du khyab pa'i lus dang ldanasreyang bdag dang sems can du gnyis su bya bar mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi khongs sum chud pa'i lus dang ldan yang / chos kyi dbyings tha dad du bya ba'i gnas la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa thams cad du gnas par bya ba'i smon lam dang ldan yang /bskal pa ring ba dang / thung ba'i 'du shes kyi rnams pas ngashernam par mi spyod pa dang ske/ gang de dag skra'i rtse mo gcig nas mi g.yo yang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang ba de lta bu 9bsgrub dka' ba'i chos kyi phyogs la 'jug pa hu ngernam par spyod pa de dag gis 1nyaganas so/ /'di ni zab mo'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa mi gnyis pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ gnyen po med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ mi 38—650

dmyigs pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ spros 57pa med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chud par dka' ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ 'jig rten gyi yul thams cad kyis )ma gos pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gnas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas dang mthun pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /gang de dag 0mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang nyan thos kyi skyon med par mi 'jug pa dang / gang de dag chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang mi skye ba'i chos nyid du mi ltung ba dang / gang de dag mi sdug pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos nyid mngon du mi byed de 'dod chags kyi chos dang yang lhan cig ⑤mi gnas pa dang /gang de dag byams pa'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang zhe snang gi dri ma'i rjes su song ba'i sems med pa dang / gang de dag rten cing 'brel ba'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang chos thams cad la shin tu rmongs pa med pa dang / gang de dag bsam gtan bzhi'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang bsam gtan gyi dbang gis 'umi skye ba dang / gang de dag tshad med pa bzhi'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang sems can yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i don du gzugs kyi khams kyi lam gyi rgyud du mi 'dong ba dang / gang de dag gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang 3)snying rje chen pos yongs su zin pas gzugs med 38—651

pa'i khams kyi lam gyi rgyud du mi 'dong ba 1dang / gang de dag zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi nyaganas la rnam par spyod kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag gis rig pa'i rnam par grol ba mngon tu mi byed pa dang /gang de dag btang snyoms chen po'i gnas la rnam par spyod kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su mi gtong ba dang / gang de dag stong pa nyid kyi gnas la rnam par spyod kyang lta ba'i rnam pa la mi gnas pa dang / gang de dag mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul dang ldan yang mtshan ma la spyod pa'i sems can rnam par gdul ba la brtson pa dang / gang de dag smon lam thams cad dang bral ba yin yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / gang de dag las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad la dbang bsgyur bayang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i cadon du las dang nyon mongs pa'i rjes su 'brang bar snang ba dang / gang de dag shi 'pho dang skye ba yongs su shes kyang tshe'i shi 'pho dang skye ba yongs su ston pa dang / gang de dag 'gro ba thams cad las rnam par log kyang sems can gdul ba'i dbang gis 'gro ba thams cad du 'dong ba dang / gang de dag byams pa la rnam par spyod kyang gegang la yang chags par rnam par spyod pa med pa dang / gang de dag snying rje la rnam par spyod kyang gang la yang chags par 6rilta bas rnam par spyod pa ma yin pa dang / gang de dag dga' ba la rnam par spyod kyang sems can sdug bsngal ba la rnam par blta tsobs rtag tu mi dga' ba dang ske/ gang de dag btang snyoms la rnam par spyod kyang gzhan gyi don la rtag tu 'bad pa dang / gang de dag mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la rnam par spyod kyang 'dod pa'i khams su skye ba la mi smod (nopa dang / gang de 38—652

dag skye ba thams cad la mi gnas par rnam par0)spyod kyang yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du bya ba la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag rnam par thar pa gsum la rnam par ( suspyod kyang nyan thos kyi rnam par thar pa thob par bya ba la rnam par mi⑧spyod pa dang / gang de dag 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhim rnam par lta geb la rnam par spyod kyang 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i phyir rnam par 'umi spyod pa dang ske/ gang de dag rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab mo brtagasam pa la rnam par spyod kyang shin tu 'gog par ltung bar rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad bsgom0)pa la rnam par spyod kyang shin tu 'byung ba la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag so so'i skye bo'i sa las shin tu 'das par rnam par spyod kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung ba la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga yongs su shes pa la rnam par spyod kyang phung po shin lha tu 'gog par ltung ba la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag bdud kyi las77bzhi las shin tu 'das par rnam par spyod kyang bdud du rtog 31pa la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag skye mched drug las shin tu 'das par rnam par spyod kyang shin tu mngon par 'grubalgepa la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag de bzhin nyid la rnam par spyod kyang yang dag pa'i mthar 1nyeltung ba la rnam par mi spyod pa dang / gang de dag theg pa thams cad kyis 〉'byung ba yongs su ston pa la rnam par mispyod kyang theg pa chen po las nyams pa la rnam par mi spyod pa de dag de lta bur yon tan gyi gnas thams cad la rnam par spyod pa rnams kyi gnas so/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis tsode'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'di la 38wa 653

thugs rje chen po brnyes pas rnam dag pa/ /byams pa bshes gnyen dpal chen 'jig rten phan brtson pa/ /dbang bskur sa gnas rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo ste/ /sangs rgyas yul la rjes su dgongs shing rnam par spyod/ /rgyal ba'i sras po grags pa chen po mnga' ba 1rnams/ /ye shes chen po'i spyod yul rnam thar bzhugs pa dag /gang rnams chos dbyings kun tu thogs med rnam rgyu ba/ /dpe zla med pa de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra yin/ / dus sbyinams tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus stobs kyis 'phags/ /bsam gtan mngon shes stobs kyi mthar phyin shes rtogs pas / /shes rab thabs dang smon lam stobs la gnas pa ci)rnams/ /theg chen pha rol phyin pa rnams kyi gnas 'di yin/ /'di ni chags med blo gros bsam pa rgya chen te/ /nam mkha'i spyod yul ldan pa mi gnas mi rten pa/ /dus gsum thams cad rgyas 'gengs bsgribs 3)pa med pa'i rnamasari kyil/ /srid kun dngos po rnam par bsgoms pa rnams kyi gnas/ /gang rnams chos kun mi skye'i 7tsal la zhugs pa ⑧rnams/ /chos kyisherang bzhin nam mkha'i dngos nyid rtogs mdzad las/ /ci la'ang gnas pa mi mdzad nam mkha'i bya bzhin te/ /mkhyen pas bsnyengs /1pa mi mnga' de 32dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rang bzhin dngos/ /rtog pa'i rgyus bskyed phyin 1 chici log cholas byung mkhyen nas/ /'dod chags bral ba'ang rnam par rtog pa dmi mdzad pa/ /zhi dang nye bar zhi ldan de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams rnam par 7thar dang bden tshul 'phags lam dang / /phung po de bzhin khams dang skye mched rten pa'i dngos/ /yongs su rtogs mdzad mkhas pa zhi bar mi ltung ba/ /shes rab thabs la mkhas 1 pa de dag gnas 'di yin/ /38wa 654

gang rnams sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes phyogs zhugasamaX17shing / /rgyal ba'i zhing la yongs rtog rnam rtog kun zhi la/ /chos rnams dngos po'i rang bzhin med par rtogs mdzad pa/ /zhi bar gzhol ba de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /gang rnams chags med spyod pas chos dbyings 'di dag tu/ /dngos dang bral bar rnam spyod mkha' yi 2)rlung 'dra ba/ /dngos po kun dang bral zhing dngos med rnam spyod pa/ /mi gnas blo mnga' de dag gnas ni 'di yang 'dra/ /gang rnams ngan song rgyud du 'gro ba song gyur te / /sdug bsngal nad pa mi bde nyams su myong gzigs shing / /byams pa'i 'od kyis ngan song thams cad zhi mdzad pa/ /byams dang thugs rje'i thugs mnga' de dag gnas 'di yin/ /nyamatsha monga'i 'khor na gnas shing 'phags lam gol 'gyur te/ / 'dron pa dmus long 56)dmyigs dang bral bar 'gyur me 'dra ba'i/ /'jig rten gzigs shing thar lam rab la 'god mdzad pa/ /'dronamadi po'i bsel ḍarab 'dra ba de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams skye dang mya ngan rga shi dbang gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba bdud kyi zhags pas yongs su bcings gzigs shing / /rnam par bkrol nas mi 'jigs phyogs bder 'don mdzad pa/ /dpa' bo de dag thub par dka' 3 tshoba'i gnas 'di yin/ /nyon mongs nad pa'i 1nya'agro mang gang gis gzigs gyur cing ske/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman chen yongs su bsdu 12mdzad nas/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed cing yongs su 'grel72mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po chen po 'dra ba'i gnas 'di yin/ /gang gis 'gro khumang sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa 35rnams / /nyon mongs gtos 7su lhung ste tsham 1 gyi mtshor lhung ba/ /gzigs shing dge ba'i chos kyi gru chen yongs sbyar ste18/ /sgrol mdzad mnyan pa'i bu 'dra 38wa 655

de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang gis nyon mongs rgya mtsho spyod pa'i 'gro0)gzigs shing ske/ /thams cad mkhyen thugs rin 5chen dgongs dag sems can mchog /srid pa'i rgya mtshor gshegs shing mngon par 'dren mdzad pa/ /mnyan pa'i bu ltar spyod pa de dag gnas 'di yin/ /smon lam gnas na bzhugs shing thugs rje byams spyan gyis/ /gang rnams sems can gnas su rnam par gzigs mdzad cing ske/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho riganas pa'i 'gro mang mngon 'don pa/ /mkha' lding gzhon 'dra de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /gang rnams chos dbyings mkha' la nyi zla 'dra tshul du/ /sems can gnas su 'od kyis khyab par rnam spyod pa/ /smon lam dkyil 'khor ye shes dri med bzang po'i 'od/ /'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams jisems can gcig ni yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /phyi mtha'i bskal pa bye ba zad du brtan gnas la/ /sems can gcig la ji bzhin de bzhin 'gro ba kun/ /'jig rten mgon du gyur pa de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams 'byamadzageglas zhing gcig phyi mtha'ikhubaskal par yang / /'gro don brtson 'grus skyo med spyod pa rnam spyod pa/ /zhing gcig ji bzhin de bzhin 7phyogs rnams kun tu ste/ /bsam pa rdo rje bzhin brtan de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rnams kyi chos zhusprin la/ /stan gcig gnas bzhin rmongs pa med par 'thung ḍā byed kyang / /phyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig 'grangs tshepar mi ngoms sems/ /blo chen rgya mtsho lta bu'i gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /gang rnams zhing mang rgya mtsho brjod 11du med 'dong zhing / /mgon po'i 'khor 1 rnams rgya mtshor yongs su 'jug byed la/ /rgyal ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho /nyerab byed pa/ /chags med spyod yul 33—656

mnga' ba de dag gnas 'di yin/ /brtan pa grangs rnams smon lam rgya mtshor 'jug byed cing / /spyod pa rgya mtshor tiramatha' dang dbus med zhugs gyur te/ /'gro la phan phyir bskal pa rgya mtsholamang spyodas pa/ /yon tan 'byung gnas de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /gang rnams spa rtse gcig tu zhing rnams thams cadang dang ske/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskal pa mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /'dzud cing de yisatshul la 'jug kyang rmongs myed pa tsho/ /chags pa med pa'i mig can rnams kyi gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams sems kyi skad cig gcig la rgya mtsho yi//bskal pa 'dzud byed zhing ④dang sangs rgyas 'gro ba rnams/ /de bzhin 'dzud byed bsgribasamadumed ye shes dran gnas pa/ /yon tan mthar phyin de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /gang rnams zhing mang thams cad rdul du bgrang shebyas shing / /chu bo ma lus thams cad thigs pas tshad bzung ste/ /de snyed grangs su smon lam mngon par sgrub byed pa/ /chags med bgrang ba de dag gnas ni 'di 'dra 'o/ /smon lam gzungs dang ting mi'adzin sgo la 'jug bya ba/ /bsam gtan rnam thar smon lam sgo rnams de bzhin te/ /bskal pa mtha' yas mngon par sgrub cing rnam spyod pa/ /bde gshegs sras po dgongs ldan de dag 'dir 'dong 31ngo / /'di na gnas pa rgyal sras rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /tshig dang don ldan gtsug lag mang po (semangon par sgrub/ /'gro la bder 'gyur bzo yi 12gnas su bya ba dag /rjes su sems ⑩shing dam pa'i gnas na rnam par spyod/ /'di na gnas pa mngon shes thabs dang ye shes kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can 'gro rgyud sna tshogs ji snyed pa/ /kun tu skye zhing 'chi ba'i khyad par rnam par ston/ /rnam thar sgyu ma'i tshul gnas chags med spyod dang ldan/ /'di na gnas pa thog mar 38—657

sems bskyed nyer bzung zhing / /chos bzang mthar thug nyachos kyi spyod pa yongs su ston/ /sprul pa'i sprin gyis chos dbyings yongs su rgyas bkang zhing / /de bzhin rnam 'phrul brgya mang kun kyang nye bar ston/ /gang rnams sems kyi cha gcig byang chub rnam sangs rgyas/ /ye shes blo gros mtha' dang dbus med las( )'jug pa kyi/ /thos te rnam par bsams namache)'jig rten rmongasamagesu rung / /thub par dka' ba de dag gnas ni ne'adi 'dra'o/ /'di ni chags med blo gros rnams / /chos dbyings bsgribs genopa med pa'i 8rnam par spyod byed pa/ /dmyigs pa med pa'i 9spyod yul can/ / dri med bsam pa'i blo gros gnas yin no / /1 gang rnams chags pa med spyod cing / /zhing rnams kun tu gnas pa med par rnam spyod pa/ /mi gnyis shes 11la spyod pa yi/ /mnyam pa med pa de dag gnas 'di yin/ /gang rnams nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang / /mnyam pa'i chos rnams gnas med zhi ba rtogs gyur te/ /gang rnams mkha' yul rnam spyod pa / /rdul dang bral ba de dag gnas 'di yin/ /'di na sna snying rje'i sems ldan pa/ /gnas shing 'gro ba sdug bsngal gzir ba mthong gyur nas/ /'jig rten phan par bsam brtson te/ /snying rje chen po brnyes pa rnam par spyod/ /'di nas 12mi snang med gsal bar/ /sems can kun gyi biganas sum8thogs pa med par snang / /nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa kun las rnam par grol/ /rgyal sras de dag 'di na gnas/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi zhabs drung thams cad kun na yang rdzo/ /zhing rnams kun tu rab tu snang / /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams kyang zad par mdzad/ /'di nas 'gro ba'i lus mnyam dang / /rgyal sras kun gyi lus dang grangs mang 1 mnyam pa 'ikhoshe/ /sprul 38wa 658

pa'i sprin gyis phyogs kyi rnams/ /ma lus thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa mdzad / /'di na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnamasatu// /rgyal ba'i spyod yul thams cad yongs su 'jal byed nacing / /bskal pa bye bar rnam spyod kyang / /yongs su ngoms par 'gyur ba'i ci dus med do/ /'dir 55ni ting 'dzin bye ba nernams / /brjod du med pas skad cig re re 8)rtogs byas shing / /ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas yul rnams rnam par ston pa mdzad/ /'dir ni skad cig brjod med pa'i/ /bskal pa zhing rnams sangs rgyas mtshan la rab bzhugasa'akhyate/ /shin tu yangs pa'i blo ldan pa/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i mthar yang 'byin/ /'di na miganas shing tshad med pa'i/ /bskal par sems rgyud gcig gis rab tu 'jug pa 11byed/ /yongs rtog 12'du shes med bral 1 yang ske/ /'gro ba'i 'du shes dbang 'du ston pa byed/ /de dag ting 'dzin 'di gnas gesu/ /zhugs kyang dus gsum thams cad gsal bar mngon du mthong / /skad cig yud la gnas brten cing / /rnam thar gnas la rnam par spyod pa mdzad / /de dag rnam spyod gnas 'di na/ /ma g.yos lus kyi laskyil mo krung 1 du 'khod bzhin du/ /zhing rnams thams cad kun tu yang / /thams cad khyab par cig car 18yongs su snang / /khyu mchog de dag 'di na gnas/ /bde gshegs rnams las chos kyi rgya mtsho yang dag 'thung / /ye shes rgya mtshor rab tu zhugs / /mi zad yon tan rnams kyi pha rol phyin/ /'di na 19zhing rnams kun grangs dang / /bskal pa'i grangs dang de bzhin chos kyi grangs rnams dang / /rgyal ba ༷ /kun gyi mtshan gyi grangs/ /sgrib med sems dpa' 2 rnam par dgongs pa mdzadadage/ /rgyal sras de dag 'di na lhaganas/ /dus gsum zhing mang 38wa 659

'grangs hu)pa thams cad ma lus par/ /de dag skad cig gcig gis kyang / /yongs su 'byung dang 'jig pa rnam par 'byed/ /rgyal sras de dag 'di na gnas / /rgyal ba'i spyod pa smon lam 'gro ba'i dbang po rnams/ /gnas na⑧rnam par spyod byed kyang / /rgyal sras blo la thogs pa med pas mthong / /rdul phran gcig la gang yod pa'i/ /'khor rnams rgya mtsho zhing mang sems can de bzhin du/ /bskal pa rdul phran kun mnyam pa/ /sgribalgepa med par mthong ba rnams kyis mthong / /rdul phran kun rtser de bzhin du/ /'khor dang zhing dang bskal pa thams cad ma lus par/ /kun kyang gzugs brnyan thabs tshul du/ /shin tu rnam phye yongs su mthong ba yin/ /'di nas de dag chos rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin zhing rnams kun dang dus dang bskal pa dang / /yang dag sangs rgyas de bzhin te/ /rang bzhin dngos bral 'byung ba'i tshul gyis mkhyen/ /'di gnas girasems can mnyam nyid dang / /chos rnams mnyam pa nyid dang sangs rgyas mnyam nyid dang / /zhing dang smon lam mnyam pa nyid/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la'ang de bzhin 'jug /sems can khrag khrig rnam par 'dul/ /sangs rgyas khrag khrig rnams kyang de bzhin gzhan mchod byed/ /gzhan rnams chos la rnam par rtog /'on kyang brtan pa gnas mchog 'di na 'khod/ /bskal pa khrag khrig mang pos kyang / /de dag smon lam ye shes yul blo'i⑧rnam pa 6ridag /bdag gis brjod par mi nus te/ /mtha' yas blo mnga' rnams kyi shin tu yangs47ri/ /de dag smad na pa mi mnga' ba/ /bsgribs ⑨med spyod yul rab la / trīshin tu dgyes pa yi/ /pho brang 'di la thal sbyar te/ /bdag kyang lus btud gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i 1 sras kyi thu bo ste/ /bsgribs 8med spyod pa 38—660

mnga' ba 'phags pa byams pa de/ /rnam dag blo mnga' dperwa)med la/ / de yi 3rjes su bsams te phyag du'atshal lo/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ༷khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan (gekyis brgyan pa'i snying po na 'khod pa'i7byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ de dag dang byang chub sems dpa'i bstod pa gzhan tshad med pa dag gis kyang / mngon par bstod de shin tu btud nas phyag 'tshal te(1)/ rab tu gus par bltas nas rim gror byas te / mngon du byas nas mchod de khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po'i sgo na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la blta bar ni mos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang phrad par ni sku dga' zhing sdod sdod (1pa las des byang chub sems dpa' byams pa khang pa brtsegs pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs gzhan zhig nas srog chags brgya stong du ma'i 'khor dang / lha dang klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po du mas mdun du 7byas te/ g.yas g.yonamanyanas brgya byin dang / tshangs tshapa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po rnams kyis〈nyephyag bya zhing yul de min gnas pa gnyen bshes dasu 'ong ba'i bram ze brgya stong mang pos bskor cing mdun du byas te/ khang pa brtsegs pa tsharnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po logs su 'ong ba nya tshomathong nas dga' rangs te/ mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa gang na ba der 38logs su mngon du bltas nyi6te/ thag ring po nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la lus thams cad kyis phab ste phyag 38—661

byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la bltas te/ 'khor kun la lag pa g.yas pas bstan nas yang dag pa'i yon tan gyis bsngags te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ltos shig bsam 1pa yongs su dag pa 'di/ /nor bzangs nor rnams rab tu brtan pa'i bu95)la/ /byang chub spyod pa dam 5)pa yongs tshol zhing / /mkhas pa nga'i57drung du nye bar 'ongs/ /legs par 'ongs pa sam snying rje byams byung khyod/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa 6legs 'ongs sam/ /legs par 3)'ongs sam blta na rab zhi ba/ /spyad pa spyod tshe dub par ma gyur tam/ /rnam dag bsam ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ /skyom med yid ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ /dbang po ma zhum tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ /mkhas pa spyod 9)tshe dub pa med grang ngo / /chos rnams thams cad rnam phye'i sna 7don byung ba/ /'gro ba thams cad rnam gdul rab brtson pa/ /bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyen bkur rab zhugs pa/ /brtul zhugs mi g.yo brtan pa khyod 1 'ongs legs/ /dge ba'i lam gyis 'ongs pa bder 'ongs sam/ /yon tan lam la gnas pa bder 'ongs sam / /rgyal ba'i lam la 1 zhugs pa bder 'ongs sam/ /lam rnams gang du'ang ngal bar ma gyur tam/ /yon tan rang bzhin tshur shog bder 'ongs sam / /dge bas mngon brlan tshur shog bder 'ongs sam/ /mtha' yas spyod yul legs par bder 'ongs sam/ /'gro ba kun na khyod ngamathong shin tu dkon / /thob dang ma thob mnyam pa'i yid ldan pa/ /smad dang sdug bsngal ma grags rnam par spangs/ /'jig rten chos la uta pal 15pad mo bzhin/ /yid la 'khrul med legs par bder 'ongs sam/ /g.yo dang sgyu bral bsam pa dge 2tshowa 662

ldan pa/ /nga rgyal dregs med snod kyi dam pa po/ /khro dang 'tshig ༷1)med khengs shing 'gying ba med/ /blta nakhug pa khyod mthong legs pa yin/ /tshur shog phyogs kun spyod yul mngon gyur pa/ /tshur shog rgyal ba'i mdzod rnams sgrub byed pa / /tshur shog rgyal ba'i mdzod rnams 'phel byed pa/ /yid la dub med legs par khyod 'ongs sam/ /tshur shog dus gsum yul ldan 'ongs pa legs/ /chos kyi dbyings la mos pa'i dkyil 'khor ldan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan snying por byung / /mkhas pa legs par 'ongs sam nami ngal lam/ /tshur shog 'jam dpal ye shes pad mo'i mchog /tshur shog sprin dpal char pas rnam spel ba / /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyisam btang ba tshur/ /khyod la bsgribs pa 3med pa'i phyogs kyang bstan/ /ltos shig smon lam dra ba ci 'dra ba/ /chos dbyings rgyas 'gengs bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod la zilam bsgrubasam pa/ /rgya che yangasam byed nor bzangs 'dir 'ongs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i spyod yul tshol byed cing / /rdul dang bral ba'i spyod pa 'gro 8ba'i phyir / /smon lam rlabs 7chen yongs su 'dri byed cing / /skyo ba'i yid med 'di ni 'dir 'ongs so/ /'das pa'i mgon pos gang la bslabs 1 mdzad de/ /de bzhin ma byon rnams kyang slob 'gyur la/ /bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i spyod 11par bya ba rnams/ /yongs su dris 12phyir 'di ni 'dir 'ongs so/ /'di ni bdag gis /lhadage bshes chos smra bas/ /chos kun nan tan yongs su ston byed pa / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam yongs ston pa/ /yin zhes sems gcig bsam minas 'dir 'ongs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag gis blo bskyed sapa / /sangs rgyas sras po byang chub bskyed nya byed pa/ /'di dag bdag bshes 38wa 663

sangs rgyas bsngags pa zhes/ /de ltar dge ba'i sems kyis 'dir 'ongs so/ /'di dag bskyed0)pas bdag gi ma lta bu/ /yon tan 'o ma sdud pas ma ma 'dra/ /byang chub yan lag yongs su skyong ba yin/ /dge bshes 'di dag gnod pa rnam par zlog(ge /rga shi mthar dbyed sman pa lta bu ste/ /bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs brgya byin lha dbang 'dra/ /zla ba lta bu medakar po'i phyogs kyis rgyas/ /zhi ba'i phyogs ston 3nanyi ma gsal ba 'dra/ /dgra dang 'grogasapo)la ri bo 'dra ba ste/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrug 75sems dang ldan/ /yongs su skyong dang mnyan pa 'dra ba zhes/ /de 'dra'i sems kyis nor bzangs 'dir 'ongs so/ /'jigs med skyob pas dpa' bo lta bu ste/ /ded dpon mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa yin//'di dag bdag la bde stobs dmyigasar yin zhes/ /de 'dra'i sems kyis dge bshes bsnyen bkur byed/ /chos kyi phyogs rnams rtag tu ston pa ste/ /sangs rgyas yon tan ye shes ston pa yin/ /ngan song ngan 'gro thams cad sbyong bar byed / /dge bshes 'di dag bdag la dge ba ston/ /'di dag rgyal ba'i mdzod kun stobs shepa yin/ /'di dag rgyal ba kun gyi mdzod srung stetsho/ /'di dag rgyal ba kun gyi gsang 'dzin ces/ /de ltar mkhas pa 'di ni dge bshes bsnyen/1la/ /ye shes phun 12ldan 'di las rnam par dganyunye /gzugs dang longs spyod cho 7rigs phun sum tshogs/ /'di las 8phun sum tshogs kun dkon pa minang / /bsam pa de 'dras 'di ni 'dir 'ongs so/ /bsam pa rlabs chen 'di la kun kyang ltos/ /mkhas pa'i dge bshes rnams la 'di stonarwa cing / /mkhas pa 'di blo ci 'dra skyed 19pa ltos/ /khyod kyis rtag tu de ltar bslab par bya / /'di ni sngon gyi bsod nams dge ba'i rgyus/ /byang chub zhugs te 'jam 38wa 664

dpal mthong gyur nas/ / de yi0)gdams ngag rjes su mthun spyod cing / /skyo ba med par rgyu ba 'di la ltos/ /'dir ni dga' bde thams cad kun spangs te//lha rdzas lta bu'i khyim yang yongs su spangs/ /pha ma ma ma skyidasapa rgya chen⑧kun/ /yongs su spangs shing bran ltar bshes gnyen sten⑤/ /mkhas pa 'dis yini bsam pa rnam sbyangs te/ /bdag gis masalus yongs su spangs57byas nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi pho brang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'bras bu de 'dra'ang thob par gyur / /'dis ni rga〈spedang nad kyis mnar ba yinyin/ /srog chags nyi sdug bsngal brgya yis gtses pa rnams/ /skye shi mya ngan 'jigs pas gdung bomathong nas/ /de dag don du snying rje'i sems kyis spyod/ /'gro rgyud lnga yi be'akhor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor btsir 7ba'i 'gro mthong nas/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'khor lo 'joms 7pa yi/ /ye shes rdo rje 12sra ba 'di tshol lo/ /'dod chags zhe snang rtswa sdong tsher marwa can/ /lta chags rtsa gi 7mang yongs su 'dzings pa yi/ /sems can zhing ni yongs su sbyangs(1ba'i phyir/ /shes rab gzhol brtanasngo rtebazang po 'di tshol lo/ /gti mug ma rig thibs po'i bsam pa can/ /'gro ba shes rab mig stor dmyigs med pa/ /de la phyogs bde ston pa'i mthu yod pa'itso/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon bzang por 'di 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i go bgos rnam thar bzhon pa zhon byu/ /ye shes ral gris sridamya ngan dgra 'jomasam pas/ /mi 'jigs stobs da pa'i dpa' bor gyur pa 'di/ /'gro ba rnams kyi lam ston 'gyur ba yin/ /'di ni chos kyi gru rab sbyor ba stetsho 8/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i lam la bslabs 87pa'o/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gis gling skyel ri ba / /'di ni khams gsum mtsho yi51skye ba 'dzin/ /ye shes 'od zer smon lam 38wa 665

dkyil 'khor can/ /sems can kun gyi gnas su snang byed pa'i/ /chos dbyings mkha' la 'od chen rab ldan par/ /'di ni sangs rgyas te)nyi mar 'char bar 'gyur/ /byams pa'i dga' ldanas ting 'dzin dang bsil ba'i①/ /sems can kun la snyoms sems 'od bzang la ri/ /dkar po'i chos kyis rinaridakyil 'khor yongs rgyas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zla ba zhi'adi ni 'char bar 'gyur/ /bsam pa'i gzhi 7rten brtan la rab gnas pa/ /byang chub spyod pas rim gyis5lde 'phags pa ste/ /chos kun rin chen 'byung gnas ldan pa yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems kyi klu yi7)dbang gis phyung spu/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' la mngon par 'phags/ /dkar po'i 'bras bu'i lo tog 'phel byed pa'i/ /'di ni 'gro bar chos sprin char 'bebs 'gyur/ /dag pa'i snying po'i 11dri gsum mun sel ba/ /byams pa'i snum yod dran pa'i snod brtan la12/ /dri med byang chub sems me 12'od bzang po'ikho/ /chos kyi mar me 'di ni 'bar byed 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni mar mer snying rje sko3ge/ /byams pa rdol 7pa mi g.yo bsam pa 'khregs1 / /byang chub yan lag mthar gyis byung 12ba yi/ /sangs rgyas sras su 'di ni yang dag skye/ /bsod nams snying po mngon par 'phel bar byed/ /ye shes snying po yongs su spyod par 'gyur/ /'di ni shes pa'i snying po 'char bar byed/ /smon lam ci 19bzhin snying po yang dag byung / /snying rje byams pas sprul pa 'di 'dra ba/ /sems can dgrol blo phan pa'i bsam ldan pa/ /rnam dag yid can 'di ni ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i 'gro ba lha dang mir bcas dkon/ /'di 'dra'i bsam pa rab tu rtsa brtan la/ /'di 'dra'i sbyor ba brtan pas rnam 'phel cing / /srid gsum yog ni )par byed 38wa 666

pa 'di 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes shing chen 1 'bras bu 'byung ba dkon/ /'di ni yon tan kun sgrubashedon du gnyer/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su dri bar5da/mosal/ /the tsoms④thams cad rnam par gsal 5)don du/ /le lo med par bshes gnyen thams cad sten⑥/ /'di ni bdud kyi dkrugs pa ma nyon mongs 'joms(3)//'di ni lta ba'i medri ma sred pa ⑩sel/ /'di ni 'gro ba thams cad dgrol la brtson / /mkhas pa 'di ni rtag tu khyad par tshol/ /yon tan lam la ma nor 31'di gnas pas/ /'di ni ngan song thams cad sbyong bar 'gyur/ /mtho ris lam yang nye bar ston par 'gyur/ /thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba 'dzud par 'gyur//'di ni 'gro rgyud kun gyi sdug bsngal sel/ /'di ni 'gro rgyud kun gyi bde ba stobasanyuge / /'di ni srid pa kun gyichu zhags pa 'thubs/ /srid pa'i 'gro rgyud thams cad sel bar 'gyur/ / lta ba dogs mipa rnam par 'byed par 'gyur/ / srid pa'i 'khri 7shing dra ba gcod par 'gyur/ /chags pa'i 'dod chags nye bar sbyong bar 'gyur/ /srid gsum lam0rteyang yongs su ston par 'gyur/ /'di ni 'jig rten mgon dang skyabs yin te/ /'di ni 'gro ba kun la nyi 'od byed pa'o/ /rnam pa kun tu srid pa sel la mkhas/ /sa gsum kun gyi 'dren par77'di 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs gnyid log 'gro ba sad par byed/ /'dod pa'i 'dam las mkhas pa 'di sgrol te/ /'du shes chags las yongs su 'di yang 'grel / /bcings pa kun las thar par byed par 'gyur/ /chos dbyings gzhi yi 21bye brag snang bar byed/ /'jig rten khams kyi bye brag sbyong bar 'gyur/ /chos kun gzhi yi gi bye brag pha rol phyin/ /nor bzangs khyod ni dga' ba skyed na par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa khyod kyi 2 sbyor ba'i tshul dag dang / /38wa 667

dag cing khyod la smad pa med tshul dang / /khyod kyi bsam pa'i nyu)yon tan ldan tshul las/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis bdag nyid dge bar byas tshul gyis/ /ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas kun mthong 'gyur/ /ring por mi thogs zhing rnams kun 'gror 'gyur/ /chos kun ring por mi thogs shes par 'gyur/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par sbyong bar 'gyur/ /sems can rgya mtsho rnam par 'grel bar 'gyur/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi yon rinatan rgya mtsho de 'dra 'o/ /khyod kyi mos pa'i dkyil 'khor tshul las na / /khyod ni yon tan rnams kyi snod du 'gyur/ /khyod ni dge ba yang dag 'byung gnas 'gyur/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi smon lam dkyil 'khor tshul las na/ /khyod kyisam④bdud kyi dkyil 'khor pham par byas༄ge/ /khyod kyis las kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par sbyangs / /nyon mongs dkyil 'khor khyod kyis dag par byas/ /ye shes rgyud ni rnam par sbyong bar 6)'gyur/ /chos kyi rgyud nitswarab tu brjod par 'gyur/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rgyud/ /ring poralomi thogs rnam par zlog par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'khor lo srid pa'i 'khor lo rten9/ /shu ba'i lam rgyud lnga yi nyu 'khor lor rmongs/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal 'khor lo gcod pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor 11bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rigs ni rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rigs ni yongs su sbyong bar the 'gyur/ /dge 'dun rigs ni yongs su bsdud 12par 'gyur/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i 'byung gnas khyod 'gyur ro/ /sred lapa'i dra ba rnam par zlog par 'gyur/ /lta ba'i dra ba thibs po de bzhin te/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dra ba 'grel 8bar 38—668

'gyur / /smon lam dra ba de 'dra0)khyod kyis sbyangs/ /sems can 5)khams ni yongs su smin byed 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams ni yongs su sbyong bar 5)'gyur/ /ye shes khams ni shin tu dag byed 'gyur/ /khyod kyi bsam pa'i khams ni de 'dra 'o/ /nor bzangs dga' ba 'phel bar byed pa khyod/ /sems can kuna'abul phan bdesnyedaga' byed 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' 6)rigs rgyud dga' byed cing / /sangs rgyas thams cad smon lam dga' byed 'gyur/ /sems can kun gyi 'gro ba'i gnas ston pa⑦/ /zhing rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan snang ston pa / /chos rnams thams cad snang ba rab ston pa'i/ /ltamasan bzang ba'i rgyal bar khyod 'gyur ro/ /chos dbyings snang bar byed pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /sems can khams rnams bde byed 'od ldan pa/ /ngan song thams cad zhi byed 'od ldan pa'i0/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal zhi bar byed par 'gyur/ /mtho ris lam ni nye bar ston par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas lam ni 'gro la 3 )'byed par 'gyur/ /thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba khrid51par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i lam ni khyod kyis rnam par sbyangs/ /log pa'i lam ni rnam par zlogatso par 'gyur/ /skye bo 'phags pa'i lam la 'dul bar 'gyur/ /brtan pa'i blo gros le lo med pa khyod/ /myi g.yeng 8byang chub lam ni de ltar tsholami/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor tshaganas pa'i lus can rnams/ /sdug bsngal mthar 'byin bya ba tekhyod brtson pas1 / /'gro ba srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi yon tan mtsho chen de 'dra 'o/ /ye shes nyi ma mchog gi (snye'od gzer mtshos19/ /lus can nyon mongs rgya mtsho yongs skams cer shing / /de dag nan tan mtsho la dgod 21byas nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu dgod du gyepar 'gyur/ /blo gros rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /38wa 669

spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par spyad par 1'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi smon lam rgya mtsho la/ /ring por nami thogs yongs su 'jug par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa khyod ni blo gros rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mang por — phyin par 'gyur/ /'khor rnams rgya mtsho mang po namathong bar 'gyur / /chos mang rgya sematsho yongs su 'thung bar 6'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sprin mang khrag khrig mthong bar 'gyur/ /mchod sprin shin tu rgya chen byed par 'gyur/ /chos kyi sprin mang khrag khrig thos par 'gyur/ /khyod ni smon lam de 'dra'i sprin kyang byed/ /sems can thams cad gnas mang rgyas 'gengs 'gyur/ /zhing rnams kun gyi gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas su phyinam par 'gyur/ /khyod ni de 'dra'i phyogs su zhugs pa yin/ /khyod ni ting 'dzin gnas su 'jug par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis 8rnam thar gnas rnams thob par 'gyur/ /khyod ni mngon shes gnas la spyod par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas la rab tu gnas/ /nyi zla'i gzugs rnams rab tu snang ba ltar/ /sems can kun gyi gnas su 'char bar 'gyur / /rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar mngon 'byung 'gyur/ /khyod kyi kha'abyung ba'i lam chen 1 de 'dra 'o/ /'jig rten kun la mi gnas spyod yul dang / /nam mkha'i spyod yul bzang por khyod spyod 'gyur/ /khyod kyi spyod yul rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi mngon shes spyod yul de 'dra 'o/ /mig 'phrul 'dra51ba'i bye brag gzhi mkhas khyod/ /zhing gi 12dra ba'i bye brag ji snyed gzhi/ / ser bu hunyemakha' la chags pa med pa ltar/ /ring por mi thogs rgyas par 'gengs par 'gyur / /chos dbyings 'byam 7klas khong du chud par 'gyur/ /'byam tshaklas 'jig rten khams su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas 38wa 670

'byam tu)klas kun/ /mthong bar 'gyur gyis gnor bzangs dga' bar gyis/ /khyod kyis de 'dra'i rnam thar de lta bu/ /mthong la mthong zhing da dung mthong bar 'gyur / /de bas mkhas pasaskyo bar ma byed cig /dga' yangs zang zing med pa nyams su longs5ge/ /nor bzangs khyod ni yon tan snod ltabazang ste/ /khyod ni rgyal ba rnams kyi gdams ngag mthun6)/ /khyod kyis tshul 'di yongs su gzung bar nus9ri/ /de bas rnam par 'phrul pa 'di nadag mthong / /sangs rgyas sras po gnas med spyod yul can/ /gang rnams mthong bar bskal pa khrag khrig du/ /shin tu dga' ('on legs brjod mi smos pa/ /de dag spyod legs spyod tshe 1 khyod kyis mthong / /de ltar 'jam dpal mngon du mthong gyur te/ /de 'dra'i yon tan snod du gyur byas pa/ /khyod kyis thob 11pa rgya che 12bsam mi khyab/ / mi yi /lhasrid par khyod ni legs par 'ongs/ /ngan song lam rnams thams cad rnam par zloga' /mi khom ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ /sdug bsngal chos rnams khyod kyis thams cad bor/ /mi dga' thams cad yongs su spang bar gyis/ /byis pa'i sa ni khyod kyis rnam par zlog15 /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan sa la gnas/ /ye shes sa yi tshadam pa yongs bskang zhing / /sangs rgyas sa rab ring por tsho/ tshomi thogs thob/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho snyed1 / /sangs rgyas ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod dang mtshungs/ / de yi 19tshad kyi smon lam ganga'i )chen mtsho/ /khyod kyis btsal 1zin shin tu dga' bar gyis/ /de ltar dbang po yongs su mi skyo la/ /bsam pa brtan zhing sbyor ba nges pa 22rnams/ /gang dag 'di 'dra'i bshes gnyen bsten dbyed pa/ /de dag ring por mi thogs mgon por 'gyur/ /khyod kyi byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can 38wa 671

mang po dul bar gyur mthong zhing 1/ /chos kun sgo yine byang chub spyod pa la/ /nam yang yid gnyis byed par ma gyur cig /de ltar phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra 'di/ /sangs rgyas sras po'ade ring 'dir mthong ba/ /don chos yon tan dang ba phun sum tshogs/ /khyod kyi bsod nams phun ldan bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar rgyal sras rnams kyi cargyun 'brel bar/ /rang rang so so'i smon lam bstan byas te/ /khyod kyi 5)de dag ma lus mthun rtogs pa/ /khyod mthongastonathob pa chen po ci 'dra ltos/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 9spyod pa'i snod gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i srid pa brgyar yang 8dkon pas na/ /de phyir rgyal sras de dag rgyun 'brel b.rayon / /khyod la rnam thar tshul rnams 7yongs su ston/ /bskal pa khrag khrig bye bar 'gro ba gang / /bde gshegs sras dang lhan cig 'grogs gyur pa(gle/ /de dag de rnams spyod yul mi shes te/ /de dag yon tan snod du bdag ma byas/ /khyod kyis 'di 'dra'i tshul 'di thos par 'gyur(/sgru/ /byang chub sems dpa' ski chen po'i rnam 'phrul ba/ /'gro ba kun na dkon pa khyod kyis mthong / /de ltarachanor bzangs dga' beba'i yid du gyis/ /khyod la sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyod gzung phyir yang gnas/ /khyod kyang de dag rjes su bstan la gnas/ /legs so nor bzangs khyod kyi 'tsho ba dge/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi chos la gnas/ /khyod ni rgyal sras yon tan rnams la slob/ /bde bar gshegs rigs rnam par 'phel byed 'gyur//nor bzangs dga' lob rgya chen nyams su long 1rte/ /sangs rgyas mnyam med thams cad khyod kyi pha/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khyod dang spun/ /byang chub yan lag thams cad khyod kyi gnyen/ /khyod ni bde gshegs thugs las 38—672

skyes pa'i sras/ /chos kyi rgyal po rigs pa'i rgyud ga1'dzin pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs rgyud 'phel bar byed/ /ring por tsho mi thogs chos rgyal thob 'gyur gyisani/ /nor bzangs dbang po tshim zhing dga' bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur gedam pa yang / /ring por mi thogs rmad byung thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras dang mtshungs shing mnyam par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi paspyod pa'i tshul mthun de 'dra 'o/ /mi gang ci 'dra'i sa bon 'debs byed pa/ /de ni de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /dga' ba rgya chen bsam yas nyams su long / /ngas ni de ring khyod kyi dbugs kyang dbyung / /tshe gcig khyod kyis gang rnams thobashegyur pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig bsam yas pa/ /bskal pa khrag khrig byang chub spyadamachin)spyod pa/ /de dag gis kyang phun sum 'di ma rnyed⑨ / /'di rnams thams cad mos pa'i 'bras bu ste/ /brtson 'grus bsam pa dag nimo7de bzhin no/ /gang zhig spyod pa 'di 'dra dka' 11ba yang / /nor bzangs spyod pa gang yin de la spyod/ /spyod pa thams cad smon lam byung ba yin//chos rnams thams cad mos las yongs su byung 'a/ /nor bzangs de ltar khyod kyis yongs su bsgrubs/ /rtag tu khyad hu par spyod pa btsal bar gyis/ / klu yi 8bsam pa ji snyed byung gyur pa/ /de snyed char pa yongs su 'bab par 'gyuratso / /smon lam ye shes spyod yul ji snyed pa/ /de snyed byang chub spyod pas nya rmorgyas par 'gyur/ /nor bzangs bzang po'i spyod ces bya ba 'di/ /tshul ni 1snyekhyod la bstan pa 'di yin gyis19/ /de shes gyis la dge bshes rang bzhin gyis/ /bsnyen bkur byed tshe 'jug 2 par ma byed cig /lus rnams bye ba sngan cad khyod 21kyis kyang / /'dod pa'i don du don med zad byas soms/ /da 2ni byang chub 38wa 673

yongs su tshol gyur na/ /brtul shugs nyabazang po brtul ri bas zhig go 'dangamacho / /khyod kyis bskal pa bye ba 'das byas te/ /'dusam byas sdug bsngal thams cad nyams su myong / / gang gā'i 45)bye snyed sangs rgyas mnyes ma byas/ /'di 'dra'i tshul yang thos par ma gyur to/ /de las dam6)ni khom par mir yang skyes(7ske/ /sangs rgyas 'byung namathong dge bshes 'di 'dra ste/ /byang chub mchog gi spyod pa'ang 9thos par 'gyur1 / /rnam dag sems su da gos/1cir mi 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa yang du 'byung 12bar 'gyur/ /dge bshes de bzhin chos mnyan 1 thos par 'gyur/ /gal te bsam pa yongs su ma sbyangs na/ /tshul 'di phyin chad 14thos par dka' ba yin/ /de bas dad dang mos dang bsam pa rnams / /yongs su bskyed skal bla ma phud 7dud kyis/ /the tsom hu lta ba yongs su skyo spangs 18la/ /yang dang yang du 'di 'dra'i 19tshul nyon cig /gang gis spyod la 'jug pa 'di 'dra 'di/ /thos nas de 'dra'i smon lam mngon bsgrubs shu )pa/ / de dag thob pa dam pa bsam mi khyab/ /21de dag mi yi sa srid par legs par 'ongs / /gang gis de 'dra'i mos pa sbyangs pa ni/ /de la bde gshegs du rtethams cad mi dpo/na no/ /de ni rgyal ba rnams kyi sras dang spun/ /de la phyin chad byang chub the tsom med/ /gang zhig 'di 'dra'i tshul 'dir zhugs gyur pa/ /des ni log par ltung ba thams cad spangs/ /des ni sdug bsngal chos rnams thams cad bstsal ri/ /des ni 7yon tan thams cad bsdu ba da byas/ /lus ni bor nas ring por 8mi thogs su/ /yongs su dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas su 'jug par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /nor bzangs khyod kyi 7sngon gyi rgyu stugs ripas/ /38wa 674

da ltar byung la mos pa nges pa yis/ /khyad par 3)don gnyer dge bshes bsten byas pasal/ /chu las uta0)pa la bzhin de phyir 'phel/ /dge bshes thams cad phu dud bsam pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes bya'i bsam pa dang //chos kun yongs su dri ba'i bsam pa can/ / brtul zhugasam bzang po ldan pa dal gyis longs/ /chos kyi nan tan kun la rab gnas pa/ /lam rnams rjes su kun tshol rab gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi75)smon lam rab gnas pa/ /yon tan chos rnams kun gyi snod khyod longs/ /mos pa phun sum tshogs pa ci 'dra bas/ /khyod kyis nga la phyag 'di byas pa ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor du mngon sum du/ /ring por mi thogs yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skyo ba'i yid med nor bzangs legs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi smon lam sems ldan pa/ /brtul zhugs brtan khyod ring por 7mi thogs par/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mthar phyin 'gyur/ /ye shes spyod yul rnam par mthar phyin pa'idabye/ /'jam dpal gan du nor bzangs khyod song ste/ /bzang po 9spyod pa dam pa mchog dris shig /de tshul khyod 'jug de nas 1 byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar byamasam/)pa chags med spyod yul gyis/ /nor bzangs yang dag legs pas 8'phags mthong nas/ /'khor rnams kun la mngon par bstan byas te/ / de yi hu yon tan legs mdzod nga'adi brjod do/ /'di 'dra'i rjes su bstan pa dam pa dang / /gdams ngag de 'dra mnor bzangs thos gyur nas/ /dga' ba'i shugs kyis 7dbang po mngon brlan 7pas/ /mchi ma'i rgyud 1 mang rab tu des kyang blags/ /dga' ba'i nyams chen nyams su myong bar 'gyur19/ /dbang po tshim 5 nas shugs kyis 1dbugs kyang phyung / /nor bzangs langs te 38—675

thal mo rab sbyar nas/ /byams pa de la bskor ba rab tu byas/ / de yishelag tu 'jam dpal sems dbang gis/ /me tog phreng ba rin chenasamadzes pa dag /byang chub sems dpa'i smon pas mngon 'thon pa/ /yid du 'ong bab mang sotsonabyung bar gyur / /nor bzangs de tshe rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /dga' bar de dag byams pa de la gtor/ /de tshe de yi57mgo la kun nas byugs/ /byams pas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras/ /rgyal ba'i sras po nor bzangs legs so legasapo / /de ltar khyod ni yongs su mi skyo bas/ /ngashedang 'jam dpal ci 'dra ci bzhin du/ /yon tan snod du khyod ni myur de 'gyur/ /thos nas nor bzangs dga' ba'i tshig 11brjod pa/ /'di 'dra'i dge bshes bdag dang phrad pa ni/ /srid pa brgya phrag 'grangs 13par shin tu dkon/ /bdag gis de ring 'dir phyin shin tu legs/ /yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /'jam dpal khyod kyi byin rlabs nyu bzang po yis/ /bdag gis bshes gnyen 'di dag dkon pa rnyed/ /khyod dang bdag tu myur du 'grogs par rokha// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/bo bam po bcu dgu skyes/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs na ji ltar byang chub sems dpas tsho byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab sna par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa byams pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 3 sasku tshe gcig gis thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 38wa 676
