nang du bdag nyid phyin par shes par gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag thams cad du yang rnam par 'phrul pa37/ bsam gyis na/mi khyab pa'i yul can rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa mang po yang mthong bar gyur te/ khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas thog ma rigs ni gang du skyes te④/ ming ni7ci zhes bya bar gyur pa zhig gis(snye/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dang yongs su bskul ba gang dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang gi ④yang dag par bskul ba dang / che'i tshad ni ci da/tsam zhig tu/ bskal pa'i ming ni ci zhes bya bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang la rgyan ni ji lta bu zhig dang ldan pa'i zhing7du 'khor ni ji lta bu zhig tu smon lam gyi tshikhyad par ni ji lta bu zhig mngon par bsgrubs te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ smon lam gyi (1sems bskyed pa de dag thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /shes par gyur to/ /khong du chud par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can de dag dang de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku che'i tshad dang 3rnyeche'i tshad ji srid cig tu gyur pa de tsam gyi dus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i zhabs kyi drung na bdag nyid 'dug par yang shes par gyur te/ bya ba de dag thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas thog ma gang du / byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur pa dang dus gang nas bzung ste1ge/de'i mying byams pa zhes bya bar gyur pa de dag mthong bar gyur to/ /la lar ni gang du spyod pa spyad pa dang / la lar ni gang du pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byas pa dang / la lar ni gang du bzod pa la zhugs pa dang / la lar ni gang du sa non pa dang / la lar ni gang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi sargyan 38—725

yongs su bzung ba dang / la lar ni gang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su bzung ba nyadang / la lar ni gang du mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur pa dang / la lar ni gang du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa dang / rnam pa ni ji lta bu zhig tu dumilung bstan pa dang ske/ lung ni sus bstan pa dang / yun ni ji srid cig gis lung bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/byang chub sems dpa' byams pa (mi'akhor los sgyur ④ba'i rgyal por gyur te/sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu 'god pa mthong bar gyur to / /la lar ni 'jig rten gyis/nyamagon por gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi rtso)phan pa dang ske/ bde ba thams cad kyis sems can rnams la nye bar sdud pa dang / la lar ni brgya byin du gyur te/ 'dod pa'i tsoyon tan gyi dga' ba las sems can rnams rnam par zlog 8)pa dang / la lar ni tshangs par gyur te/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa'i dga' ba sems can rnams la yongs su brjodashepa dang ske/ la lar ni lha'i dbang po rab mtshe mar gyur te/ tshad med pa'i yon tan sems can rnams la yongs su brjod 1 pa dang / la lar ni lha'i dbang po rab dga' ldan du gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' tshe gcig gis thogs pa'i yon tan brjod 1 pa dang / la lar ni lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dgar 3)gyur te/lha'i 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sprul pa'i rgyan yongs su ston pa dang / la lar ni lha'i rgyal nya po dbang bsgyur midu gyur te/ lha rnams la chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur skab yang dag par ston pa dang / la lar ni bdud du gyur te/ lha rnams la phun sum tshogs pa thams cad mi rtag par ston pa dang /38wa 726

la lar ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i gnas su skyes tehu3 / lha ma yin gyi52)'khor na nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / rlom pa thams cad rab tu spang ba dang / ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par bya ba dang / chos kyi ye shes kyi rgyu khuthob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston pa mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten mthong bar gyur te/ de namarngo byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'od kyis/ sems can dmyal ba thams cad snang bar byed cing / sems can dmyal bar skyes pa'i (gyesems can rnams kyi/ sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni yi dgas kyi gnas mthong bar gyur te/ de na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa / sems can yi dgas kyi gnas su skyes pa 6rnams la/ kha zas dang /btung ba mang po nye bar bsgrub cing bkres 7)pa dang / skom pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni byol song gi skye gnas na skye ba'i skye mched rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs kyis 2byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i / sems can mang po 'dul bar 9mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni rgyal po chen po'i khams su gtogs pa'i/ lha'i 'khor na 'jig rten gyi mgon po rnams la chos ston pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyirwasto'akhor na/ la lar ni lha'i rgyal po/ rab mtshe 32ma'i 'khor na/ la lar ni lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyi 1 'khor na/ la lar ni lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga'i 'khor na/ la lar ni lha'i rgyal po dbang bsgyur bgyi 'khor na/ la lar ni bdud kyi 'khor na/ khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ tshangs pa'i dbang po'irdzoge'akhor na/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa chos ston pa mthong ngo la lar 38—727

ni klu dang lto 'phye nyachen po'i 'khor na/ la lar ni gnod sbyin dang srin po'i〈'khor na/ la lar ni dri za dang mi'am ci'i 'khor na/ la lar ni lha ma yin dang gsod 'phrog gi dbang po'i 'khor na/ la lar ni nam mkha' lding gi dbang po chenas po'i 'khor na/ la lar ni mi'i 'khor na/ khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye༄chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'khor na/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa chos ston pasamathong ngo / /la lar ni nyan thos kyi 'khor na/ la lar ni rang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor na/ la lar ni byang chub sems dpa'i ༄6)'khor na/ khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems thog ma bskyed pa las dang po ba rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa chos stonam7)pa mthong ngo la lar ni spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams la/ la lar ni bzod pa thob cing phyir mi ldog pa rnams la/ la lar ni tshe gcig gis thogs shing dbang bskur ba rnams la/khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po la gnas pa rnams la sa'i khyad par yongs su brjod napa mthong ngo / /la lar ni sa bcu la gnas pa'i bar gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang lhan cig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas thams cad kyi khyad par yang dag par bgro bar skyed 9pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / la lar ni bslab pa thams cad la mngon du 'jug par bya ba kun tu mtha' yas pa dang / la lar ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la 'jug pa rgya chen po dang / la lar ni rnam par thar pa'i tshul zab mo dang / la lar ni bsam 38—728

gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms0par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa zhi ba'i yul gyis ④rgyas par dgang ba dang / la lar ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / 'dul ba dang / thabs kyi sgo la 'jug pa dang /la lar ni smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa rgya che ba dang / khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa skal ba mthun par spyod pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'grogs shing / 'jig rten la phan par bya ba'i don du/ bzo'i gnas sna tshogs dang / gtsug lag gi khyad par sems can thams cad ①la/ phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba dang / 'byor ba rnams yang dag par 'gro ba mthong ngo / /la lar ni byang chub sems dpa' tshe gcig gis/thogs pa rnams dang 'grogs shing / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes la dbang bskurababa'i sgo yang dag par 'gro stob mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa chags 7pa myed 3cing / lo brgya stong du mar mi gtong ba la thotshobartson pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni lung dbog 0pa dang /kha ton bya ba la brtson par/ la lar ni chos kyi sgo rab tu brtags 31pa la brtson par / la lar ni dam pa'i chos bgro nyi ba la brtson par/ la lar ni dam pa'i chos bri ba la brtson par/ la lar ni byams pa la mnyam par gzhag nyi par/ la lar ni bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa thams cad la mnyam par gzhag 〉par/la lar ni rgyas pa'i skye mched dang / rnam par thar pa thams cad la mnyam par gzhag parasku/ khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pa/byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin la/mnyam par gzhag par 7mthong ngo / /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni byang chub 38—729

sems dpa'i/ ting nge 'dzin sprul pa yod pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mang po mthong ste/ de dag gi0)lus thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sprul pa thams cad kyi sprin mang po 'byung ba mthong ngo la la'i rinalus dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/ lha'i ris kyi sprin mang po 'byung ba mthong ngo / /la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye /chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa5gedang /'jig rten gyi mgon po dang / 'khor los sgyur 5ba'i sprin mang po 'byung ba dang ske/ la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni4)/ khams kyi rgyal po'i sprin mang po 'byung ba dang / la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/rgyal bu gzhon kye nu'i sprin mang po 'byung ba dang / la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/ tshong dpon dang / blon po dang / khyim bdag gi sprin mang po dang / la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nasang ni/ nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprin mang po dang / la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i sprin mang po dang / la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/ sems can thams cad du sprul pa'i/ sprin tshad med pa 'byung ba mthong ngo / /la la'i lus dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas ni/ chos kyi sgo rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba thos par gyur 9te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i nyu tho yon tan bsngags pa'i sgo dang ske/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang ske/ brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs 38—730

dang ske/ smon lam dang / stobs dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo dang /bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa dang ske/ gzungs dang / spobs pa dang / bden pa dang / so sonyeyang dag par rig⑧pa dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / rten stipa dang / chos kyi mdo dang / dran pa nye bar gzhagamang)pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gtam dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gtam dang / theg pa chen po'i gtam dang / sa dang bzod pa dang ske/ spyod pa dang / smon lam gyi sgo dang / de bzhin du chos〈5)thams cad kyi sgor 'jug pa'i sgra mang po 'byung ba thos so/ /khang pa brtsegs pa la lar ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dus kun nas 'dus par mthong ste/de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi rnam pa tha dad pa47)sna tshogs skye ba dang / rigs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sku rnam par phye ba tshad med pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang /skupo)tshe rnam pa tha dad pa dang / zhing rnam pa tha dad pa dang / bskal pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / chos bstan pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / 'byung ba'i sgo rnam pa tha dad pa dang / dam pa'i chos gnas pa rnam pa tha dad pa nas/'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 1)thams cad du/ rnam pa tha dad pa dag kyang ma lus par mthong bar gyur to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po/ de'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs pa gcig cig 38—731

gzhan0)pas che la yangs shing / khang pa brtsegs pa gzhan thams cad kyi rgyan ma lus pa thams cad pas kyang ches lhag par 'phags pa'i rgyan gyis/ yang dag par brgyan pa zhig 'dug par mthong ste/ khang pa brtsegs pa de'i nang na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dug pa mthong ngo / /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de na yang / gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya dang ske/ 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas bye ba phrag brgya 'khod par namathong ngo / /'dzam bu'i gling de dag thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' byams pa pad mo'i nang dul skye ba dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pas yongs su blangs pa dang / gom pa bdun du 'gro ba dang / phyogs bcur rnam par bltas pa dang / seng ge'i nga ro chen po sgrog ④pa dang /gzhon nu'i sa thams cad yongs su ston pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na gnas pa dang / bza' shing gi thar bar 'gro ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon du phyogs te/ mngon par byung nas rab tu 'byung ba dang /dka' ba'i spyod pa yongs su ston pa dang / zas za ba dang / snying po byang chub tu 'gro ba dang / bdud rgol du gye'ajug pa dang / byang chub tu rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang / byang chub kyi shing la myig mi 'gebs par lta ⑦ba dang /tshangs pa chen pos gsol ba gdab pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 3chiba'i yul sna tshogs yongs su bstan pa dang spu /rnam pa tha dad pa dang / tshul dang mying rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / che'i tshad sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan sna tshogs 1 ritha dad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag 38—732

pa'i tshul bstan patusna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / spyod pa dang smon lam brjod pa sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / chos bstan cingaphan/rnam par dgod pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i thabs sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / ring bsrel bgo ba dang / bstan pa gnas pa'i byin gyis rlabs yongs su bstan pa sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ④zhing lha'i gnas su 'gro ba mthong ste/ de dag thams cad na'ang tshong dpon gyitshun)bu nor bzangs nyid rkang pa'i drung na 'dug par rang rangadza )gis shes par gyur to/ /de'i ⑦'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / bya ba thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang / tshe'i tshad〈rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad la dran pa ma nyamasalgepa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis ⑩'du shes kyi rnam 31pa thams cad khong du chud pa'i ye shes kyi sa la gnas pas/ khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gi drilalo dang / dril bu g.yer ku'i77dra ba dang / rol mo dang / glu la stsogs pa'i dmyigs pa ci snyed cig yod7pa de dag thams cad las/ chos kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba thos par gyur te/ la la las ni byang chub kyi sems rnam pa tha dad pa dang / la la las ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam rnam pa tha dad pa dang / la la las ni sa tshad med pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / la la las ni mngon par shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas77rnam par 'phrulamatshapa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / la la las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / la la las ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan rnam pa tha dad pa dang ske/ la la las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sprin tshad med pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / de bzhin du chos thams cad kyi 3 mosgra gong du ji skad du brjod pa 38wa 733

thams cad thos par gyur to/ /la la las ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'jug pa'i sgra thos te/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig ces bya bar byang chub sems dpa'i mying dang tsho/ che ge mo zhig gis na/chos kyi sgo ni che gem mo zhig ces bya ba thos/dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ che ge mo zhig gisasreyang dag par bskul/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni che ge mo zhig gi zhabs kyi drung du bskal pa'i ming ni 'di zhes bya bar/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni 'di lta bu zhig tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ni 'di lta bu zhig na 'dug 'dug ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba nirku'adi lta bu zhig bskyed nas / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan ni/ 'di lta bu dag gcig thos te/lhag pa'i bsam pa ni 'di lta bu dang / smon lam gyi rnam pa ni 'di 'dra ba sgruzhig gis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nasari bye/ des bskal pa ni 'disasnyed cig tu / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad khyade/ bskal pa 'di snyed cig gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ni 'di zhes bya/ sku tshe'i tshad ni 'di tsam zhig ste/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan dang / rgyan phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra ba dang /smon lam gyi khyad par 'di lta bu zhig dang / sems can rnam par gdul ba 'di 'dra ba zhig dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor kun nas 'dus pa 'di 'dra ba zhig go/ /de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang /bskal pa 'di snyed cig tu dam pa'i chos gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi don ni 'di tsam zhig tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra thos so/ /la la las ni 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming dang 8/che ge mo zhig sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod na/ gtang bar themedaka' ba 38—734

'di lta bu'i0)yongs su gtong ba brgya ni byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' che ge mo zhig ni/ tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgoms mo/ /brtson 'grus rtsomasamo / /bsam gtan la57snyoms par 'jug go/ /shes rab kyis 5rnam par dbye ba la brtson no/ /byang chub sems dpa' 46)che ge mo zhig ni dam pa'i chos yongs su btsal ba'i don du rgyal po'i srid yongs su gtong bar byed do/ /rin po che yongs su gtong ba dang / bu yongs su gtong ba dang / chung ma yongs su gtong ba dang / rkasalag dang myig dang / mgo yongs su gtong bsko7byed do/ /myer mchong ba/byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 37ming dang 12che ge mo zhig gis 1lhani de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bzung ste/ chos smra bar sgobyed do/ /chos kyi sbyin pa gtong ngo / /chos kyi mchod sbyin byed do/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgrengasnyengo ske/ /chos kyi rnga rdung ngo / /chos kyi dung 'bud do/ /chos kyi char 'bebs so / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyan pa 7byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs brgyan pa byed blorte/ /sems can la bde ba'i yo byad kyis sdud /rtedo/ /dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod srung ngo zhes bya ba'i sgra thos so/ /la la las ni 'jig rten gyi (3 khams che ge mo zhig ces bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ci nyamatshan che ge mo zhes du snyedabang bskur ba mying dang che ge mo zhig gis 'khor 'di lta bu zhig na sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di lta bu zhig dang / bskal pa 'di lta bu zhig la sku tshe'i tshad 'di tsam zhig dang chos bstan pa 'di lta bu dang / sems can 'dul 2lhab 'di 'dra ba dang /'di lta bu'i smon lam gyi du rimangon par 'tshang rgya bas da ltar bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo zhes bya ba dang nisnye/ de bzhin du drilas tsidang dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba 38wa 735

dang ske/ rol mo la stsogs pa'i dmigs pa thams cad las chos kyi sgo rnam pa tha dad pa tshad med pa'i sgra thos par gyur te/ sgra de dag thams cad thos pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dga' ba'i shugs rgya chen pos mngon par brlan pa'i sems kyis ①chos kyi sgo de dag thos nas la lar ni gzungs kyi sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni spobs pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni bzod pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni spyod pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur tol/ /la lar ni smon lam gyi sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni mngon par shes pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni rig pa dang ye shes snang ba'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo mang po thob par gyur to/ /la lar ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgor 'jug pa mang po thob par gyur to// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/(khe bam po nyi shu gcig dpa/ me long gi dkyil 'khor de dag las kyang gzugs brnyanasregyi rgyan rnam par dmigs pa tshad med pa mthong bar gyur te/ la lar ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan parnam par dmigs pa mthong ngo / /la lar ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan 6rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni nyan thos kyitso'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan gernam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni rang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan r+sharnam par dmigs pa dang ske/ la lar ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan tshernam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni kun nas nyon mongs pa'i zhing 38—736

gi gzugs brnyan7rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni rnam par dag pa'i zhing gi gzugs brnyan⑧rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa'i zhing gi migazugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang /la lar ni rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa'i zhing gi gzugs brnyan rngornam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni sangs rgyas dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan⑧rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang ske/ la lar ni chung ba'i 'jig rten kyi khams kyi 6༄gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni che ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni phra ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni rgya che ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni myig 'phrul gyis ge'ajug pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan 9)rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni snrel zhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs0lhabarnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni spyi'u tshugs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigasalgepa dang / la lar ni sa'itshwa gzhi mnyam par 'dug tshapa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa dang / la lar ni sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song dang / yi dgas kyi gnas kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par skadamigs pa dang / la lar ni lha dang myis gang ba'i ⑩'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs pa mthong bar gyur to/ /'chag sa de dag dang / gnas de dag dang / stan 1 de dag 38—737

la byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dgos pa sna tshogs la brtson pa dag kyang mthong bar gyur te17/ la lar ni 'chag pa dang / la lar ni bsam gtan byed pa dang / la lar 5ni lta ba dang / la lar7ni sems can rnams la snying rje chen pos rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / la lar ④ni gtsug lag gi tshul sna tshogs 'jig rten gyi don du 'gyur ba bsgrub pa dang / la laralo5)ni lung nod pa dang /la lara'inyuni kha ton byed pa dang / la lar〈peni yi ger 'dri513ba dang / la larapo)ni dri ba yongs su 'dri ba dang / la lar 7ni phung po gsum pa'i bshags77pa dang ske/ yongs su bsngo ba la brtson pa dang / la lar nya ni smon lam mngon par sgrub pa byed pa /lhemathong ngo / /ka ba de dag las kyang rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi 'od kyi dra ba mang po 'byung ba mthong ste/ la la las ni kha dog sngon po dang ske/ la la las ni kha dog ser po dang / la la las ni kha dog dmar po dang /la la las ni kha dog dkar po dang / la la las ni shel gyi kha dog dang / la la las ni gser gyi kha dog dang / la la las ni yin dra nī ri7la'i kha dog dang /la la las ni 'ja'i kha dog dang / la la las ni 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi kha dog dang / la la las ni 'od thams cad du snang ba'i kha dog dang nyusnye/ lus dang sems kyi bde ba skyed 7pa blta na mchog tu mdzes pa mthong bar gyur to/ /'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi chu shing gi ka ba de dag dang / rin po che thams cad kyi gzugs de dag kyang lag nas me tog gi sprin mngon par sbyong bar /rnyemathong ste/ lag nas phreng nyu9ba'i lda ldi dang / lag nas gos dang / lag nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / lag nas spos dang /bdug5 — )spos dang / byug pa dang / lag nas nor bu rin po che'i dra ba dang /38wa 738

lag nas rin po che sna tshogs dang / gser gyi lcag phod ①sna tshogs dang /lag nas mu tig sna tshogs kyi se mo do dang / lag nas rin po che sna tshogs kyi se mo do mngon par sbyong bshedang / lag na〈brgyan thams cad thogs par mthong ngo ske/ /la la〈peni gtsug gi rin po che dang / cod pan gyisala'adud cing myig myi 'gebs par bltasnyib dang / thal mo sbyar bezhing phyag 'tshal bar mthong ngo /mu tig gi phreng〈)ba de dag las kyang / spos sna tshogs kyis dri zhim porashebyas pa'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i char gyi rgyun 0phra mo 'bab par mthong ngo / /rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i phreng 37ba'i dra ba de dag las kyang / mar mye'i phreng ba rab tu 'bar ba mang po mthong tu bar gyur to/ /rin po che'i gdugs de dag kyang rgyan dang / lhab lhub thams cad kyis mdzes par brgyan tetunye/ rin po che'i dril dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i midra ba dang / dar gyi lda ldi dang / chun po dang —/ rin po che'i shar bu dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis sgo ngasalgeyongs su brgyan pa'i snying79po dang ldan pa tsomathong ngo / /rdzing de dag nas kyang /rin po che'i me tog pad mo dang / uta02pa la dang / ku mu da 3)dang / phun da0ste ri ka grangs med pa mngon par 'thon par 3nyamathong ste/ la la ni mtho gang 'khor ba tsam/ la la ni 'dom gang 'khor ba tsam/ la la ni shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam steX rte/ de dag la yang gzugs sna tshogs kyi rgyan mang po 'khod par mthong ste/ 'di ltar bud med kyi gzugs dang / skyes pa'i gzugs dang /khye'u'i〈 gegazugs dang / bu mo'i gzugs dang / brgya byin gyi 3thugazugs dang /tshangs pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig ge rten gyi mgon po'i gzugs dang / lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' 3938wa 739

lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs dang / nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa'i lus kha dog sna tshogs rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa mang po thal mo7sbyar te/ lus 'dud cing / phyag 'tshal bar 'khod par na mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa ciganyis kyis brgyan pa skyil mo krungasadu bcas te bzhugs pa dag kyang ltamathong ngo / /sa chen po'i gzhi be+e drur+yar+sā)las grub pa/ myig mangs 77ris su 'dug pa'i myig mangs du ris re re nas kyang gzugs brnyan ⑨rnam par dmyigs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po mthong bar gyur te/ khang pa brtsegs pa/ 1 la la /rtelas ni zhing gi gzugs brnyan (snyernam par dmigs pa/la la las ni byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs brnyanasarnam par dmigs pa/ la la las ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan rnam parachadamigs pa mthong bar gyur te / khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gi rgyan dang / lhab lhub ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang / myig mangs nyu ris re re la gzugs brnyan du tsosnang bar mthong ngo / /rin po che'i shing rin po che'i me tog dang / 'bras bu'i mdzod sna tshogs dang ldan pa de dag thams cad las kyang / lus phyed tsam byung ba'i gzugs dbyibs sna tshogs dang kha dog sna tshogs su 'dug pa mang po 'thon par mthong /rteste/ la la las ni sangs rgyas kyi shu /sku phyed tsams(1byung ba dang / la la las ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus phyed tsam byung ba dang / la la las ni lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po'i lus phyed tsam byung ba 38—740

dang ske/ la la las ni brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po'i lus phyed tsam byung ba dang / la la las ni 'khor los sgyur hu)ba dang /myi'i dbang po'i lus phyed tsam byung ba dang57/ la la las ni rgyal bu gzhon nu dang ske/ tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / blon po dang / skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / dge slong dang / dge slong sem dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma'i lus phyed tsam byung ba mthong ste/la la'i lag nas gi⑧me tog gi phreng53)ba spyod pa dang / la50la'i lag nas ni rin po che'i phreng ba mngon par spyod pa dang / la la'i lag nas ni rgyan thams cad mngon par thogs pa dang / la la ni lus 'dudaston)cing thal mo sbyar te myig mi 'gebs par 0lta zhing phyag 'tshal ba dang / la la ni mngon par bstod 〉pa dang ske/ la la ni mnyam par bzhag 11pa dang / la la ni gser gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni dngul gyi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni byi ru'i kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni rin po che bai drur+ya 7sngon po'i kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni rin po che yin dra nī /rtela'i kha dog tu 'dug pa dang /la la ni nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba'i kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni me tog tsam pa ku'i mi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / la la ni 'od kyi lus dang / la la ni mtshan gyis 8rnam par bris pa'i lus su mthong bar gyur to/ /zla gam de dag las 7kyang gnyi nyu 7zla dang gza' 12skar gyi gzugs brnyan 19gangs med pa mang po 'thon te/phyogs bcu du 7snang bar byed pa mthong bar gyur to/ /khang pa dang gzhal med khang dang khang pa brtsegs pa'i rtsig ngos de dag thams cad kyang rin po che thams 38—741

cad kyis myig mangs ris7su bris par mthong ste/ rin po che'i myig mangs ris de dag thams cad las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rim pas ji ltar spyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyodashepa thams cad rim par bamathong bar gyur te④no/ mig mangs7ris la la las ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pas mgo byin pa mthong ngo / /la la las ni myig byin pa dang / la la las ni lag pa byin pa dang / la la las ni gtsug gi rin po che byin pa dang / la la las ni thor pag dang bcas pa'irnyugatsug gi rin po che byin pa dang / la la las ni so byin pa dang / la la las ni lce byin pa dang / la la las ni rna ba byin pa dang / la la las ni sna byin pa dang /me la la las ni snying byin pa dang / la la las ni sha dang rkang byin pa dang / la la las ni khrag byin pa dang /na la la las ni pags7pa dang pri byin pa dang / la la las ni sen mo sha dang bcas par byin pa dang / la la las ni dra bar 'brel ba dang / bcas pa'i sor mo byin pa dang / la la las ni bu dang / bu mo dang chung ma byin pa dang / la la las ni rin po che'i (2phung po byin pa dang /la la las ni grong dang grong khyer dang / ljongs dang yul dang khams dang /rgyal po'i gnas byin pa dang / la la las ni 'dzam bu'i gling byin pa dang / la la las ni gling bzhi byin pa dang / la la las ni rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug byin pa dang ske/ la la las ni rgyal po'i khri byin pa dang / la la las ni bran pho smos hunyebyin pa dang / la la las ni btsun mo'i 'khor byin pa dang / la la las ni bza' shing gi ra ba dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal 8byin pa dang / la la las ni gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan byin pa dang / la la las ni me tog 38—742

dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa byin pa dang / la la las ni nad kyi7rtsi byin pa dang ske/ la la las ni kha zas dang / skom gyi rnam pa mang po byin pa dang / la la las ni yo byad thams cad byin pa dang / la la las ni gnas thams cad byin pa dang / la la las ni gzhal 2ba'i snod rin po ches gang — )ba byin pa dang /la la las ni rin po che'i shing rta byin pa dang / la la las ni btson 'anor na 'khod pa tharashebar byed pa dang / la la las ni gsad 65par chad pa lasam3rithar bar byed pa dang / la la las ni byis pa gso ba byed pa dang / la la lasasho ni lam stor bshel lam ston pa dang / la la las ni mnyan par gyur te/ chu klung gi rgyud la gru 'dor ba dang / la la las ni rta'i rgyal po stobs kyis sgrol bar gyur te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i srin po'i 3sto gling du nya2phyin par gyur pa'i sems can yongs su skyob pa dang / la la las ni drang srong chen por gyur te/ bstan pa 8mngon par bsgrub pa dang / la la las ni 'khor los sgyur bobar gyur te/sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la dgod tshapa dang / la la las ni smanamatshepar gyur te/ na ba'i gsos sman nya dang / la la las ni 38pha ma la phu 19dud byed pa dang / la la las ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro byed pa dang /la la las ni nyan thos kyi kha dog dang / gzugs kyis 3 tshosems can 21'dul ba la brtson pa dang / la la las ni rang sangs rgyas kyi kha dog dang / gzugs kyis gsems can 'dul ba la brtson pa dang / la la las ni byang chub sems dpa'i kha dog dang / gzugs kyis 3/sems can 'dul ba la brtson pa dang /la la las ni sangs rgyas kyi sku mdog dang sku gzugs kyis sems can 'dul ba la brtson pa dang〈ste/ la la las ni skyes pa'i rabs kyi khyad par thams cad kyis skye 38—743

ba yongs su bstanas37te/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pasnyedang / la la las ni chos smra ba'i gzugs kyis gede bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la zhugs te/lung dbog 47pa dang / kha ton5da bya ba dang tshul bzhin du dpyadakyipar bya ba la brtson pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la rgyan gyis brgyan paradzo byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byed du 'jug pa dang /sangs rgyas mchod pa la sems can yongs su bskulasnyib dang / spos dang byug pa gsol zhing / 'bru mar dri zhim pos byug pa dang / dril bu dang / me tog gi phreng 9)ba gsol ba la stsogs patshu/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa rnam pa thams cad la brtson pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la sems can rab tu 'god pa dang ske/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang / gso sbyin gyi tunyeyan lag brgyad dang /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs btsal ba dang / rab tu 'byung /rteb dang / chos mnyan pa dang / lung mnod5)pa dang / kha tonasabya ba dang / tshul bzhin yid la bya ba la sems can dgod 8par byed pa dang /chos kyi gtam bya ba'i phyir 9seng ge'i stan la 'dug cing sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnam par 'grel ba dang / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byams pas bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad pa de dag thams cad tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisatshwa 〉myig mangs5)ris de dag las rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du ho/mthong bar gyur to/ /des khang pa brtsegs pa/la lar sa )ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig bsnyen bkur ba de dag thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag thams cad kyi drung du bdag 38—744

nyid phyin cing / tshur shog nor bzangs legs par 'ongs sam mi ngal lam/ 'de renyebyang chub sems dpa'iskon/ rgyan dang yul rnam par sprul pa sa/bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di dag la ltos shig /ces bsgo'i zhing gtam shes par byedas5)par gyur te/ de ltar tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis〈6khang pa brtsegs pa/ de dag re re dang / dmigs pa de dag re re las kyang /(7 bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / yul rnam par sprul pa 'di dag dang / gzhan dag kyang grangs med pa mang po mthong bar gyur te/ dran pa'i mthu 72)nyams pa med pa dang ske/ mig yongs su dag pa/ phyogs kun du rnam par lta tsho ba dang / lhag mthong la lta ba'i ye shes sgrib pa med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes dang ske/ byin gyi borlabs kyi dbang rab tu thob pas11/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa la zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi sa la gnas te/ mtha' yas pa'i rgyan dang / yul rnam par sprul pa de dag thams cad mthong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na/ skyes bu gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam du/ gzugs kyi dmigs pa'i7khyad par sna tshogs mang po zhig mthong bar gyur te/ 'di ltar khyim dang gzhal med khang 12mdangs dga' ba'am/ grong dang / grong khyer dang ske/ ljongs dang / yul mdangs dga' ba'am/ bza' shing gi ra ba dang /kun dga'i bor ba dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal mdangs dga' ba'amatshe/shing dang / chu klung dang / rdzing dang / ri mdangs dga' ba'am/ gos dang ske/ kha zas dang / btung ba'i longs spyod nyams su bde ba'am/ glu tshadang ske/ sil snyan dang / rol mo'i sgra snyan pa sna tshogs kyis rtse 1 ba nyams su dga' ba zhig mthong ngam/ pha ma dang gnyen bshes 1 dang / bdag nyid 38—745

'grogs par shes par gyur pa'am/ rgya mtsho chen po dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / lha'i gnas thams cad dang nyu)/ 'dzam bu'i gling dag na bdagashedapag tshad brgya ri phrag du mar gnas par shes par gyur ④la/ khyim 'am ⑤gnas de yang shin tu yangs shing / yon tan dang rgyan thams cad kyisamañca yongs su brgyan par mthong ste/ nyin par zhig yin par shes kyang / nam de yang ring ba dang / thung bar bye brag mi 'byed la rmi lam yin pa tsam du'ang mi shes so / /bdag nyid kyangs bde ba'i yo byad thams cad dang ldan zhing lus kyi 'du byed zo bdog 8bde la snyoms 9༄pa dang / gnyid med de mi dga' ba thams cad yongs su bstsal tshabs/ dga' ba dang / bde ba rgya chen po nyams su myong ste/yun kyang ring mo zhig lon pa snyam nas/ nyin gcig gam/ nyin bdun nam/zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig gam/ lo gcig gam/ lo brgya'am/ de bas kyang ring ba ci11zhig lon pa tsam du shes par gyur nas/ sad na de thams cad kyang rjes su dran no/ /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 8kyang /byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs nyunyedang / khams gsum thams cad rmi lam lta bur yang dag par gzhol ba'i 7ye shes kyis chung ba'i 'du shes 'gags pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa yangs shing ske/ rgya mche ba dang / sgrib pa med pa la gnas shing / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan gyi yul khong du chud la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul la 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i blo lode nyu tshodang ldan pas/ rgyan rnam par sprul pa de dag thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to12/ /shes par gyur to/ /nyams su myong bar gyur to/ /rnam par dpyad par kyi gyur to/ /mtshan mar 3(9—746

byas par gyur to/ /dmigs kyis rtogs par gyur to/ /bdag nyid kyang / de dag na 'dug par shes par gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na/ mi nad pa sems kyi rgyud tha ma byung bar gyur te/ de ma thag tu skye ba'i sems nye bar gnas nas / las kyi tu)srid pa mngon du gyur na/ las ji lta bur byas shing bsags pa'i rnam par smin pas(1/ las mi dge ba'i rkyen gyis ni/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / yi dgas kyi yul lam/ gshin rje'i myi lag cha gnyemasar pa thogs pa/ gshe zhing khro ba dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur tsho/sems can dmyal (snyeba'i ngud mo 6dang / 'o dod kyi sgra yang thos par gyur la/ba tshwa'i57)chu de dag kyangasarimathong ste/ spu gri'i so bshibs79pa'i ri de dag dang /lcags kyi shal ma li'i tshisdong po de dag dang / ral gyi'i so'i 11nags tshal de dag kyang / mthong bar gyur tam/ sems can dmyal ba de dag kyang / kun nas 'bar zhing yongs su 'bar ba dang / rab tu 'bar ba dang / lcags kyi bum pa gcig tu 'bar ba de 12dag kyang / mthong bar gyur la/ gnod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang gnod par bya zhing / tshor ba de dag kyang nyams su myong ba tsam du shes par gyur te/ sems can dmyal ba pa 12de dag kyang /me'i gdung bas/ sdug bsngal ba zhig tu mthong ngam/ bdag gis 〉myong bar gyur tam/ las dge ba'i tshogs kyis lha'i khang pa dang / gnas shig mthong bar gyur tam/ lha'i 'khor dang / lha mo'i 'tshogs dang / rgyan rnam par phye ba thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur te/ bza' shing gi tshar ba dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal dang / chu klung dang / rdzing dang / rin po che'i ri dang /yid bzhin gyi shing dang / longs spyod mang po mthong ngo 1 rme/ /nyams su myong 38—747

bar gyur te/ tshe'i yun kyang de dang 37mnyam par shes par gyur na/ de ni 'di nas kyang 'phos pa med/ der yang skyes pa med de/ mi gesnang bar ma gyur bzhin du/ las kyi yul bsam gyis myi khyab pas bya ba'i rnam pa de lta bu dag shes shing mthong la nyams su myong bar rung ngo / /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ri byang chub sems dpa'i las kyisageyul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/rgyan rnam par sprul pa de dag thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste/dper na/ skyes bu 'byung po'i gdon gyis non pas455ni gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs mang po 6nomathong ste/ ci dris pa de dag gi lung yang ston to/ /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis mubyang chub sems dpa'i shun shes dang byin gyi ḍarlabs kyi mthus rgyan de dag thams cad samathong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ klu'i khang par phyin71pa'i skyes bu sna ni/ klu'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa la zhugs pas/ nyi ma gcig gam/ nyi ma bdun nam/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla bsamagacig gam/ lo gcig gam/ lo brgyar yang 'du shes kyi rnam par 7shes te/klu'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa dang / bral nas/ mi'i 'du shes kyi 8rnam par na geyid tsam las ma lon par mthong ngo / /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs 1 byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa 1snyem btang ba'i blo dang ldan pas kyang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i byin gyi rlabs 37kyis/ yud tsam gcig po de yang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang por shes par gyur tol/ /'di lta ste/ dper na/ tshangs pa chen po'i gzhal med khang 'gro ba thams cad na rgyan gyi dam pa phul zhes bya ba yod de ri/ de'i nang du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang / gzugs brnyan gyi tshul 38wa 748

du dmigs pa thams cad dang ma7'dres par gsal bar snang ngo / /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis dkyang / rgyan de dag thams cad dmigs pa'i /thams cad du/ phan tshun ma 'dres pa dang / phan tshun ma 'dzings gepar gzugs brnyanaphurab tu byung ba mthong yingo / /'di lta ste/ dper na/ rgyas pa'i skye mched kyi lasnyoms par 'jug pa la nirnam par spyod pa'i dge slong nidhi/gcig pu gnyis su med par tsokhang bu'am/ 'chag sa 'am17/ 'dug pa'i gnas na 'dug gam/ 'greng yang 0rung ste/ 'jig rten thams cad rgyas pa'i skye mched gang la snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ yul bzhin du bsam gtan pa'i yul / bsam gyis 8mi khyab par 1 rimathong zhing / nyams su myong ngo / /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu/ nor bzangs kyis 8kyang yul gang la zhugs pa'i tshul bzhin du rgyan de dag thams cad mthong zhing shes te/ nyams su myong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ dri za'i grong khyer rnams kyi rgyan dang lhab lhub thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings la mibyung ba ni yongs su snang yang ci la yang sgrib par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste dper na/ gnod sbyin gyi gzhal med khang mi'i khang pa na 'dug pa'am/ mi'i khang pa gnod sbyin gyi nyu khang pa'i khongs na 'dug pa ni phan tshun tha mi dad de〈snyelas kyi yul rnam pa ji ltar dag pa'i tshul bzhin du snang ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang rgya'i gzugs brnyan ltar snang ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po ni sngags dang rig 16sngags dang / rtsi'i mthu dang byin gyi tsho skurlabs kyis gzugs kyi 27rnam pa thams cad dang bya 32ba thams cad kyang yongs su ston to/ /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 2238—749

kyang byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i byin gyis 13rlabs dang na/ ye shes sgyu'i rim bsam gyis mi khyab pa cal zhugs pas byang chub sems dpa'i dbang dang byin gyi 5rirlab sa kyi ye shes chos thams cad shes pa sgyu ma'i stobs kyi nemangon par bsgrubs 7pa'i mthus rgyan gyi nayul rnam par sprul pa de dag thams cad 9 mthong bar gyur tol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas khang pa brtsegs pa de'i nang du song ste/ byin gyi 1 rlabs de dag brtul nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la se gol gyi sgra byas te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni chos rnams kyi 11chos nyid yin gyi 12longs rigs kyi bu chos thams cad ni rnam par bsgrub na 1lhanye bar 'grub pa'i mtshan nyid de/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ / /rang bzhin de lta bu ste yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /sgyu ma dang mi 15lam dang gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /de nas tshong rimadapon gyi bu nor bzangs se gol gyi sgra des ting nge 'dzin de las langs par gyur pa dang / de la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas smras pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi 1 rlabs rnam par 'phrul pa mthong mod/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mthu dang rgyu mthun pa mthong mod/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi ye shes kyis rnam par bsgrubs pa tu mthong mod/khyod kyis 2 byang chub sems dpa'i gnas mdangs dga' ba mthong mod/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 21yongs su bsdu ba mthong mod/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i sgo thos na mod/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan dang rgyan tshad med pa mthong med/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam rnam pa tha dad pa'i khyad par mthong med/ khyod kyis byang chub sems 38—750

dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis 1mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brang bar nabyas med/khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba dang bde ba myong mod nor bzangs kyisamacho /smras pa 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin gyi rlabs 5dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'dagongs pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mthus mthong ngo / /'phags pa rnam par thar pa 'di'i ming ci zhes bgyi smras pa/rigs kyi bu (3)rnam par thar pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi dmigs pa thams cad la shes pa rab tu zhugs pa'i dran pa nyams pa med pas brgyan 8pa'i snying po zhes bya ba ste/ rigs kyi bu rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag ni57tshe gcig gis thogs 7pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thob 11bo/ /nor bzangs kyis 3 smras pa/ 'phags pa rgyan de dag gang du mchis/ smras pa gang nas 'ong ba /neder ro/ /nor bzangs kyis 7smras pa gang nas mchis smras pa / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi byin gyi lorlabs mngon par bsgrubs pa las 'ongs so/ /de ni byin gyi rlabs 7de nyid la gnas shing gang du 1 yang song ba med la 'phos pa med do/ /phung por gyur pa med do/ /tshogs su gyur pa med do/ /brtsegs par gnas pa med do/ /dngos por 18gnas pa med do/ /yul na gnas pa ma yin no/ /phyogs na gnas pa ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ klu rnams kyi sprin gyi dra ba ni lus la yang mi gnas/sems la yang mi gnas nang la 19yang mi gnas mod kyi 2 klu'i sems kyi dbang dang klu'i dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pas 21char gyi rgyun tshad med pa bkye 22ba ni med pa ma yin te snang ngo / /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du rgyan de dag kyang nang na'angs lhaganas pa 24ma yin/ phyi rol na gnas pa yang ma yin te/ byang chub 38—751

sems dpa'i byin gyi 1nabs kyi dbang dang / khyod kyi snod bzang po'i5 phyir mi snang bar yang rim yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan pos ni sgyu ma'i yul cathams cad yongs su bstan kyang gang nas kyang ri 'ongs pas6med bshig 7kyang gang du yang 'gro ba myed de/ 8'pho ba myed mod kyi sngags dang rtsi'i mthus yongs su mi snang ba ma 9yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du rgyan de dag kyang gang du yang song ba med/ gang nas kyang 'ongs pa 7med la gang du'ang phung por gyur pa myed mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes sgyu ma bsam gyis 11mi khyab pa la shin tu bslabs 12pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs 1snyedang / ye shes kyi dbang gis yongs su mi snang ba ma yin no/ /nor bzangs kyis r+sāsmras pa/ 'phags pa shul ji srid cig nas gshegs smras pa/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'gro ba ni 'ong ba gemed par 'gro'o/ /g.yo ba dang gnas pa med par 'gro'o/ /gnas dang brtenasamed par 'gro'o/ /shi 'pho dang skye ba med par 'gro'o1 / /gnas pa nyi dang 'pho ba med par 'gro'o/ /g.yo ba dang ldang ba 9med par 'gro'o/ /ltos pa dang gnas med par 'gro'o/ /las dang rnam par smin pa med par 'gro'o/ /myi skye ba dang mi 'gag par 'gro'o//rtag pa med pa dang chad pa 3 med par 'gro'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni 'dul ba'i 21sems can la lta bas snying rje chen po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni sdug bsngal ba'i sems can yongs su skyob pas byams pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni gang du dga' bar skye bas tshul khrims so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 22kyi 'gro ba ni sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 2 smon lam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 38—752

rnams kyi 'gro ba ni thams cad du 1)bzhin yongs su ston pas mngon par shes pa'o / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung nas g.yo ba med pas mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni lus dang sems yongs su mi gtong bas len pa dang 'dor ba med pa'onas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni sems can thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang bas shes rab dang thabs so /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba ni mis yor dang gzugs brnyan dang /sprul pa lta bu yin pas sprul pa yongs su ston pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang khyod lam ji srid cig nas 'ongs shes khyod kyis 5smras pa ni/ rigs kyi bu nga phyoni tshe'i sa yul phreng ba stobs kyi grong rdal khang khyim can zhes bya ba de na tshong dpon sa skyong zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de sangs rgyas kyi chos la bzhag 7nas tshe'i sa'i mi rnams la snod kyi tshul bzhin du chos bstan pa 8byas te/ pha ma dang bram ze dang khyim bdag dang shesaganyen bshes su 'ong ba rnams theg pa chen po la yang dag par bskul nas 1 'dir 'ongs so/ /nor bzangs kyis 11smras pa/'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa gang lags/ smras pa rigs 12kyi bu bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sems ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su skyes 1nyepas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa'o/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rigs su skyes 〉pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa'o / /sa la gnas pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i rigs su skyes 15pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa'o/ /smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa ni spyod pa'i 38—753

rigs su skyes 1pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa'o/ /snying rje chen po ni bsdu ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi rigs su skyes napas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa'o/ /yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos rtogs par 4)bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rigs su skyes 45pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa'o/ /theg pa chen po ni thabs mkhas pa'i rigs su skyes pas 6byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa'o/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 7ba'i rigs su skyes na pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis ni mi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa'i rigs su skyes 9pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa'o / /rigs kyi bu chos thams cad kyi nan tan ni 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su skyed nyu rmepas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshe'i sa ste11/ rigs kyi bu bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che'i sa'o/ /rigs kyi bu thabs mkhas pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'o 12ma'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma lha ma'o / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni lhab lhub dang rgyan to/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bskyed 7pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni spyod pa rnam par dag par byed pa'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni bslab khripa la spyod du 'jug pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad ni grogs po'os/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i chos thams cad ni gnyen bshes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' 17thams cad ni phu nu'o / /byang chub kyi sems ni rigs so/ /nan tan ni 38—754

rigs kyi chos so/ /sa'i gnas ni rigs kyi gnas so/ /bzod pa thob pa ni rigs su rigs dang ldan par skyes pa'o/ smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa ni rigs kyi gzhung thob pa'o/ /spyod pa rnam par dag pa ni rigs kyi chos kyi rjes snyegs 3)pa'o/ /theg pa chen po la yang dag par bskulam ba ni rigs kyi rgyun mi gcod pa'o/ /dbang bskur nas tshe gcig gis thogs pa ni chos kyi rgyal po'i sras kyi thu bo'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du yang dag par bsgrub pa ni rigs kyi rgyud yongs su dag pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byis pa tha dad pa'i skye bo'i sa las shin tu 'das pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par zhugs pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su yang dag par byungalteb yina'an/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la rab tu gnas pa yin/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi gcad 5pa la zhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs yongs su bsdu ba la mngon par brtson pa yin/ rigs 'dang rus kyi57yongs su dag pa yin/ mnad 2kyi rgyud kyi 9smad du med pa yin/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu'i bonang na rigs la smos pa'i skyon thams cad kyi kha na ma tho ba myed pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs dam par skyes la smon lam chen po'i lus dang ldan pas rigs kyis btsun pa yin nohu1/ /rigs kyi bu rgyud kyi rigs de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni chos thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bur yongs su shes pas 1 'jig rten gyi skye gnas thams cad du smad pa med pa yin te srid pa'i skye gnas thams cad sprul pa lta bur yongs su shes pas srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud du skye zhing 38—755

gnas pa thams cad kyis kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad la 1bdag med par khong du chud pa'i nasems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bas yongs su mi skyo'o / /byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po'i lus dang ldan pa'i phyir sems can thams cad la phan gdags par cangal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba thams cad rmi lam lta bur yongs sum3rtogs pas bskal pa thams cad du gnas pas sgyid lug par mi 'gyur ro/ /phung po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes pas skye ba dang shi 'pho ba cadang 'chi ba yongs su bstan pa thams cad kyis dub par mi 'gyur ro/ /khams dang skye mched chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du rab tu rtogs pas yul thams cad kyi rma mi 7'byung ngo / /'du shes kyi rnam pa thams cad 8mig rgyu lta bur shin tu bsgoms 9pas 'khor ba'i 1 dga' ba thams cad kyis mos par mi 'gyur nyi1ro/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos thams cad la rnam par brtse 12bas bdud kyi yul thams cad kyis mi dogs 1 so/ /chos kyi lus su byung bas nyon mongs pa thams cad du ñcasmos su med do/ /skye ba la dbang rab tu thob pas 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad rtogs par khong du 5chud pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar nga ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi skye gnas kyi khongs su chud pa'i lus dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs dang mnyam pa'i kha dog gi khyad par dang sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa'i nges pa'i tshig gi bye brag dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam pa'i mying rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mos pa dang mnyam pa'i spyod lam dang 'gro ba rnam par gdul ba thams cad dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / sems can rnam par dag par bya ba thams cad dang 38—756

mnyam pa'i tshe dang / rigs su 1skye ba yongs su bstan napa dang / byis pa'i spyod pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sems can gyis ci'adu shes kyi rnam pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i yongs su shes par bya ba la 5'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi sprul pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i lus yongs su bstan cing brjod pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ sngon skal ba mnyam 6par spyod spyod pa'i sems can byang chub kyi sems stor bar gyur pa rnams yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang / 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes pa'i tshe yongs su bstan pa dang / lho phyogs kyi 7rgyud 'di'i yul phreng 8ba stobs kyi grong 'o rdal khang khyim dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'di'i bram ze'i rigs su skyes pa rnams dang / pha ma dang gnyen bshes su 'ong ba rnams rnam par gdul ba dang / bram ze'i rigs dang / rgyud kyi khyad par gyis rigs kyi 1 nga rgyal can du gyur pa 'di dag nga rgyal myed par byas te11/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bskyed pa'i don du 'dir skyes so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar nga 32lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di na thabs rnam pa 'di lta bus sems can bsam pa'i tshul ji lta bu 1lhadang ldan pa dang / rnam pa ji lta bur sgo'adul ba rnams yongs su spyin par bya ba dang ske/ gdul ba byed cing khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan 5pa'i snying po 'di na 'dug go/ /'di nas nga 7shi 'phos nas kyang bsam pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / dga' ldan gyi rigs nyi su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu skal ba mnyam par spyod spyod pa rnams yongs su spyin par bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i khams nas yongs su 'das pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang ye 38—757

shes dang / sprul pa'i rgyan yongs su bstan pa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba'i sred pa las rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'du byed thams cad myi rtag pa nyid du bstan pa dang / lhar skyes pa thams cad kyang mthar gud par gyur pa tsho17yongs su bstan pa dang / ye shes chen po'i chos kyi sgo 'chi 'pho'i rnam pa zhes bya ba tshe gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang dag par bgro 5bar bya ba dang / lhan cig yongs su smin par gyur pa rnams der ga /skye bar yongs su bsdu bar bya 4ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bkye ba'i 'dul ba'i 5pad mo rnams kyang kha dbye ba'i phyir dga' ldan gyi gnas su skye ba yongs su ston te/ dus la bab pa nel bsam pa yongs su rdzogs nas ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang thob par byed kyis / ngas byang chub thobastonanas kyang rigs kyi bu khyod dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur par bcas pas 'o/da dung yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /song rigs kyi bu da dung 1 tshoyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur 11pa'i gan du song 12la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya ba dang / ji ltar mngon par bsgrub pa dang /ji ltar smon par 1 bya ba dang / ji ltar rgyas par bya ba dang / ji ltar rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / ji ltar yongs su ngasbyang 15bar bya ba dang / ji ltar khong du chud par bya ba dang /kho ji ltar yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dris shig dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen des 1 khyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas spyod pa mngon par bsgrub pa de lta bu'i smon lam gyi 18khyad par 19ni byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag 38wa 758

stong la yang med do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa ni tshad med do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi 71khyad par nathams cad mngon par 8bsgrub pa ni tshad med do / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi yum lta bu'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong la gdams ngag ston pa'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang ske/ gdul ba la rab tu brtson pa'o 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su mying gi 'khor los rnam par rgyas par gyur pa'o / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du gtam gyi skyes 5bur gyur pa'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nebasngags shing bstod 7pa'o / /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba ste chos zab mo'i ye shes la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni 8rnam par thar pa thams cad kyi tshul thams cad la ring du song ba'i spyod yul dang ldan pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa kun tu bzang po la zhugs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen de 9ni khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyed 1 pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mang po rab tu sgrub pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa'o/ /yon tan thams cad la yang dag par skul 11ba'o/ /smon lam chen po'i dra ba thams cad du 'jug pa'o/ /38—759

smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa 1thams cad la rab tu gzhog pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsang ba thos par byed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad yang dag par ston pa'o/ /sngon gyi che'i gnas su skal ba mthun par spyad 5pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na khyod da ltar yang 'jam dpal gyi rkang pa'i drung na 'dug gis riyon tan gyi gdams ngag thams cad thob par bya ba la cayongs su skyo ba ma skyed 5cig yongs su skyid lug par ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nor bzangs khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig mthong ba dang / spyod pa'i sgo ji snyed cig thos pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i tshul ji snyed cig la zhugs pa dang / smon lam gyi khyad par ji snyed 6cig khong du chud pa de dag thams cad kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mthu dang byin gyi )rlabs su blta ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur na pa ni thams cad la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa'o/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 9byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs grong khyer brgya rtsa bcu kun tu rgyus te/ phyogs kyi gnas yid bde ba mngon du 'gyur ba 11zhes bya ba zhig na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sems shing rnam 12par lta bas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa mthong bar mos shing / smon la 1 phrad par dga' bas sdod cing 'dug 'dug 5pa dang / de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas / dpag tshad brgya rtsa bcu'i 15pha rol nas lag pa brkyang ste/ tshong dpon 38wa 760

gyi bu nor bzangs grong khyer yid bde ba mngon du 'gyur bas1na 'dug pa'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /dad pa'i dbang po dang myi ldan pa sems skyo ba can bsam pa zhum pa can sbyor ba nabor ba brtson 'grus ldog pa/ yon tan cung 5zad kyis dga' bar rtsi ba/dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig la zhen par gnas pa/ spyod pa dang smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa la myi mkhas pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma bzung cab/sangs rgyas kyis ma dgongs pa rnams kyis ni chos nyid 'di lta bu yongs su shes par bya ba dang tshul 'di lta bu dang / spyod yul 'di lta bu dang / gnas 'di lta bu yongs su shes par bya ba'am5/ rnam par shes par bya ba'am/ khong du chud par bya ba'am/ 'jug par bya ba'am/ yid ches par bya ba'am/ brtag par bya ba'am/ rtogs 6par bya ba'am/ thob par bya bar myi nus so/ /zhes te des de la chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan pa dang / yang dag par bskul 7)ba dang / gzengs nabastod pa dang dga' bar byas te chos kyi sgo grangs myed pa dang / ldan par byas nas ye shes mtha' yas pa'i snang ba chen po thob par byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs dang / spobs pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa dang / ye shes mtha' yas pa'i byin gyis byin du brlabasam 9par byas te/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la bzhag nas bdag gi yul la'ang rab tu bzhag 1 ste/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 1 drung nas song ngo / /shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces 12bya ba las sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u ste/ bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //38wa 761

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ti bam po nyi shu gnyis pan/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul 5)shin tu phra ba snyed bsnyen bkur ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du tshogs bsags pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa la mthun par 'dzin pas zhugs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi drung du bsam pa mnyam par 'gro ba ri/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad dga' bar bya bas 5yid mi 'byung 6ba'i blo dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i rjes su song ba snying rje chen po'i bsam pa rgya mtsho las yang dag par byung ba'i snying po dang ldan pa/ byams pa 7chen po'i tshul gyi sprin gyis na'agro ba thams cad rnam par snang bar byas 9pa/ dga' ba 1 chen po'i shugs rnam par 'phel ba'i lus dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya chen po la rab tu zhi bar rnam par dpyod 1 pa sgo thams cad nas lhug 12par 'phro ba'i gtong ba'i myig dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i 1 nan tan rab tu rdzogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mos pa'i lam du zhugs pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs la brtson 'grus kyi shugs rnam par 'phel ba r+ṣabyang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems dang bsam pas 7shin tu sbyangs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 10pa la zhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho khong du chud pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 17'khor lo'i tshul 18rgya 38wa 762

mtsho'i rjes su song ba/ 'jig rten gyi skye gnas thams cad du gzugs brnyan 1yongs su ston pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyi tshul rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/ bskal pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rab tu zhugs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yul snang ba rab tu thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po thams cad rnam par 'phel ba/thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam snang ba rab tu thob pa/ phyogs thams cad du sgrib pa med pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi tshul la rab tu zhugs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ zhing gi tshul thams cad la snang ba rab tu grub pa nasems can 'byam /klas pa thams cad kyi don bya ba la rgyud dang mi 'thun pa myed par 7rjes su song ngo 5/ /sgrib pa'i g.yang sa'i ri thams cad rnam par 'thor ba / sgrib pa med pa'i chos nyid 6kyi rjes su song ba byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sa'i gzhi kun tu gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po can la rab tu zhi bar rnam par dpyod 7pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul rjes su tshol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 8byin gyis brlabs 9pa de/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang 1 po'i spyod yul la rnam par dpyod 11cing 'dug par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i mying thos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thos pa dang / smon lam gyi khyad par thos pa dang tshogs yongs su bsgrub pa la 'jug pa dang gnas pa'i khyad par thos pa dang / mngon par bsgrub pa dang 'byung ba'i lam gyi khyad par thos pa dang / kun tu bzang po'i sa'i tshul gyi rgyud thos pa dang / sa'i tshogs thos pa dang sa thob par byed pa'i shugs thos pa dang sa yongs su gnon 1238wa 763

pa thos pa dang / sa la gnas pa thos pa dang/ sa sngon du 'dor bas rnam par 1gnon pa thos pa dang / sa'i spyod yul thos pa dang / sa'i byin gyi rlabs 5thos pa dang sa la yang dag par gnas pa thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar dga' zhing skom ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings ltar shin tu yangs pa'i sems mngon par zhen pa thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa dang ske/ zhing gi 'du shes shin tu bsgoms pa dang / chags pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i sems chos thams cad la 5)sgrib pa med pa'i spyod yul can dang / thogs pa myed pa'i sems phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / sgrib pa med pa'i sems 'thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi 7)yul yongs su gnon pa dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sems snying po byang chub kyi rgyan lhag mthong gis 8yongs su dag pa dang / shin tu rnam par phye ba'i sems sangs rgyas thams cad 9kyi chos rgya mtsho la zhugs pa dang / shin tu yangs pa'i sems sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba rgyas par 'gengs pa dang shin tu phye 1 ba'i sems sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par byed pa dang / tshad med pa'i sems sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gzugs brnyan rab tu 'byung ba dang / bskal pa thams cad du gnas pas 1 myi zad cing mthar thug pa med pa'i sems de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs 12pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 1 ma 'dres pa'i mthar thug pas snying po byang chubasangardo rje dam pa'i snying po can sade la pad mo'i stan rin po che thams cad kyi lhun can zhig la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la mngon par bltas te 'dug go/ /de ltar sa38—764

tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs de lta bu'i bsam pa dang yid la bya ba la brtson par gnas pa'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rlan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' 1kun tu bzang po nadang sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i skal ba mthun pas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur bar sngon gyi ltas bcu byung ngo / /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par dag pas rnam par dag par gyur to / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i zilam thams cad rnam par bstsal 6bas rnam par dag par 7gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad pad mo'i tshal nagyi rgyan ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 9rnam par dag pas rnam par dag par gyur to sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sems can thams cad kyi lus dang sems dga' zhing sim 1 par byed pas/ rnam par dag par gyur to sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin du kun tu 11gnas pas rnam par dag par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sems can gyi khams kun tu 12mtshan dang dpe byad 1 bzang pos rab tu brgyan par kun nas gnas pas rnam par dag par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyan dang lhab lhub kyi sprin gyis kun tu khebs par 7kun nas gnas pas 7rnam par dag par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sems can gyi lakhams thams cad phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang /1 gnod sems med pa'i sems dang ldan par kun nas gnas pas rnam par dag par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi 1 zhing thams cad snying po byang chub kyi 38—765

rgyan gyis brgyan par kun nas gnas pas rnam par dag par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sems can thams cad sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 1yid la bya ba la 5brtson par kun nas gnas pas rnam par dag par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur ba'i /sngon gyi ltas bcu po de dag byung bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po mthong 5bar 'gyur ba'i kyisngon gyi ltas snang ba chen po bcu byung bar gyur te / bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 8kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba mang po rnam par snang bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od kyis9dkyil 'khor mang po 'thon te1 / kha dog gcig pa dang kha dog sna tshogs dang kha dog brgya stong du mar chos kyi dbyings thams 1 cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur 12to / /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi 1 rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang rin po che thams cad kyi sprin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs par byed pa mang po 'thon te/chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba'i 'khor lo dang dkyil 'khor gyi sprin mang po 'thon te/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to4/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba 38wa 766

rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang spos dang / me tog dang phreng 1)ba dang byug pa dang bdug pa'i sprin mang po 'thon te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i yon tan gyi 2chos rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad kyi 'brug sgra rab tu sgrog cing /phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to / /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang nyi ma dang zla ba dang skar ma'i sprin mang po 'thon te/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i pa'od rab tu 'gyed gcing / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang lus thams cad kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa'i mar mye'i sprin mang po 'thon nas/sangs rgyas kyi 'od gzer ltar rab tu snang bar byed cing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las kyang nor bu rin po che'i gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur snang ba'i sprin mang po 'thon nasam/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re 6las kyang 'od gzer gyi gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dbyibs su snang ba'i sprin mang po 'thon te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang smon lam gyi 4sprin gyi char namangon par 'bebs shing /chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to9/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi 1 rdul shin tu phra ba rnams las rdul shin tu phra ba re re las 38—767

kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi gzugs brnyan gzugs kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi kha dog du snang ba'i sprin rgya mtsho sems can thams cad gdon pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 1)sgrub pa mang po 'thon te/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur ba'i (misngon gyi ltas snang ba chen po bcu po de dag byung bar gyur to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis sngon gyi ltas su snang ba bcu po de dag mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar gyur pa'i la skabs ni bye/ rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas ni 5brtan de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis ni brlabs rtsecisangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi snang ba ni yang dag par skyes/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la ni mngon du gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi byin gyis ni byin du brlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul la ni mngon par mos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul rlabs 7po che la ni 87shin tu nges pa'i stobs dang shugs ni rab tu thob/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa dang 'dra bar 9ni sems/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar bya ba la dbang po ni mngon du gyur 1 byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar bya ba la brtson 'grus kyi shugs chen po ni thob/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po yongs su btsal ba la brtson 'grus phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba dang ni ldan phyogs thams cad du mngon du gyur pa'i dbang po'i 31'khor lo dang kun tu lta 12bas yul yongs su gnon pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang 38—768

sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i zhabs kyi drung na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'dug pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i sems de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dmigs par bya ba la yang dag par btang —1ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i dmigs pa yongs su btsal ba dang mi 'bral ba'i bsam pa dang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar bya ba'i 'du shes kyi rnam pa'i snying po dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi myig byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lam la zhugs pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa'i bsam pa dang / snying rje chen po'i rdo rje thogs pa'i lhag pa'i ribasam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rjes su 'brang bar smon pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par byin gyis brlabs gupa dang / yongs su gnon pa'i rtsal rnam par dag paril na / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mnyam pa tshoganyid kyi rjes su song ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i sa la gnas pa'i ye shes la rnam par dpyod 6pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul la 7yang dag par gnas pa dang mi 8ldan pa des byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 9de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba/ bsam gyis 7mi khyab pa'i yul 11dang ldan pa/mi 'phrogs 7pa'i spyod yul can mu med pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 1 rnam par lta chob/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi skazil gyis ma 15non pa/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba1 ske/ mngon par 'phags pa'i yul 18dang ldan pa de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan sngar nya byang chub sems dpa'i 38wa 769

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 1rgya mtsho na ni 'dug /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis ni yongs su bskor/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis ni rimadun du byas shing / seng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad mo chen po'i snying po can zhig la 'dug pa mthong ste/ des de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyi 4ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'od zer gyi sprin mang po 'thon nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 5pa thams cad rab tu snang bar byas nas/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa mthong ngo / /des de'i lus las ne'od kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sprin mang po kha dog sna tshogs can mang po 'thon te/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dga' ba dang / mos pa'i shugs rgya chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed pa mthong ngo / /spyi bo dang phrag pa'i lhun gnyis dang / ba spu'i 7)sgo thams cad nas kyang spos 'od 'phro 8ba'i sprin gyi char kha dog sna tshogs su 'dug pa mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 9rgyas par bkang ste/ mngon par 'bab pa mthong ngo 1 / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang me tog thams cad kyi sprin gyi char sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 11mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 12'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bkang ste/ mngon par 'bab pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga 1 thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang spos sna tshogs kyi shing gi sprin mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon nas/ chos kyi 38—770

dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas rinyaklas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang nas/spos kyi shing nigi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byas te/ spos dang phye ma dang bdug pa'i mdzod zad mi shes pa'i char rab tu 'gyed cing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bkang ste/ mngon par 'bab par byed pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang gos sna tshogs kyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon te/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas (klas pa thams cad kun nas yog par byas nas brgyan par mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ba paspu'i sgo re re nas kyang 6dar sna tshogs kyi lda ldi'i sprin dang phreng 7ba sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / mu tig sna tshogs kyi sprin dang nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi sprin gyi char sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par na'athon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bkang ste/ mngon par 'bab pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 9ba spu'i sgo 7re re nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rin po che'i shing gi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon te/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthas 11mas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang nas/ rin 12po che'i shing las rin po che'i mdzod rnam par 'phro ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dag tu rin po che'i char chen po mngon par 'bab 1 par byed pa mthong ngo //ba spu'i sabu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang gzugs kyi khams kyi lha'i ris kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 38—771

'thon nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la yang dag par bsngags pa byed cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang tshangs pa'i rgyud du gtogs pa'i lha'i ris thams cad du 1sprul pa'i sprin mang po mngon par 'thon tedun/ mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba ri'adebs par mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang 'dod pa'i khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i lha'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mang po yang dag par 'dzin par mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang sems kyi skad cig re re la yanga'agesangs rgyas kyi zhing gi sprin dus gsum du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang 'dra ba / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon nas / chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ thams cad rgyas par bkang ste / sems can gnas med pa dang 5)skyabs myed pa dang rten myed pa rnams kyi gnas dang / skyabs dang rten du gyur par nemathong ngo ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang / sems kyi skad cig re re las risangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung geb dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon nas/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthas klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste'o)/ sems can mos pa rlabs po che 7rnams yongs su dag par sgrub pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i 38—772

bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang sems kyi skad cig re re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa 1la kun nas nyon mongs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin du phra ba snyed kyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas naklas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sems can rnams rnam par dag par 5sgrub pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga re re'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems kyi skad cig re re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun nas nyon mongs la rnam 5par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyis bklas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste ri/ sems can gcig tu kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams rnam par dag par gsusgrub pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas 1)kyang sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon te'i/ sems can gyi khams nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang nas sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'brang bar 11byed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang sems kyi skad cig re re la byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi sprin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul 12shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon nas/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyis 1 klas pa/ thams cad rgyas par chibakang ste/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams 38—773
