cad kyi mtshan mang po rjod 1par byed pa namathong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon te/ chos kyi 5dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam klas 4pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa 5nye bar bsgrub pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par brjod 6pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i sprin thams cad mkhyen dzopa nyid du yang dag par 'byung bas nadaga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi char mngon par 'thon nas mngon par 'bab pa mthong ngo / /des de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad 9las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang 1 mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 11ba'i sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba 12ston pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par 'byung ba'i 1 chos kyi sprin chen po rnam par li'aphel bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 38—774

'thon pa07mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis nabyang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rdzu 'phrul gyi yul de lta bu mthong nas / dga' rangs te mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas / de bas kyang shas cher byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus la sems sems pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' 5kun tu bzang po'i yan lag re re dang / yan lag rnam par phye ba re re dang / lus kyi cha re re dang / lus kyi cha rnam par phye ba re re dang / yan lag gi phyogs re re dang / yan lag gi phyogs rnam par phye ba re re dang / lus re re dang / lus rnam par phye ba re re dang / ba spu'i bu ga re re dang ba spu'i bu ga rnam par phye ba re re nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rlung gi phung po dang bcas/ chu'i phung po dang bcas / sa'i phung po dang bcas/ mye'i phung po dang bcas/ rgya mtsho dang bcas / gling dang bcas/ chu klung 6dang bcas/ rin po che'i ri dang bcas/ri rab dang bcas/ khor 7yug dang bcas/ grong dang grong khyer dang /ljongs dang yul dang khams dang rgyal po'i gnas dang bcas/ nags natshal dang bcas/ khang khyim dang bcas/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas/ sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 9dang bcas/ byol song gi 7skye gnas dang 11bcas/gshin rje'i 'jig rten 12dang bcas/ lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten dang bcas/klu'i 'jig rten dang bcas/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jig rten dang bcas/ myi'i 'jig rten dang bcas/ lha'i 'jig rten dang bcas/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang bcas/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi yul dang bcas gzugs kyi khams kyi yul dang bcas/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi yul dang bcas/ gzhi dang bcas 38—775

rten dang bcas/ dbyibs dang bcas1/ sprin dang bcas/ glog padang bcas / skar ma dang bcas/ nyin zhag dang bcas/ zla ba phyed dang bcas/zla ba gcig dang bcas/ dus dang bcas/ lo dang bcas/ bskal pa bar ma dang bcas bskal pa dang bcas par gzugs brnyan6)gyi tshul du mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams 'di la ji lta ba de bzhin du/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 4kyang mthong bar gyur to'i/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams podang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang 7)/ 'og dang steng gi phyogs thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang sangs rgyas byung (8)ba dang bcas / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du mthong bar gyur to/ /des smyo/mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ ji snyed pa 7de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i myi chen po'i 17mtshan re re las sangs rgyas byung ba dang bcas/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 1 thams cad dang bcas/ sems can 12dang bcas/ khang khyim dang bcas/ nyin zhag 14dang bcas bskal pa dang bcas par mthong bar gyur to/ /de bzhin tu phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam klas pa mthams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to9/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug /napa'i 'jig rten gyi 19khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud nu pa thams cad kyang 2138wa 776

mthong bar gyur pa de bzhin tu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 1)kyi sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus dang / myi chen po'i mtshan re re dang / ba spu'i bu ga re re nas shin tu rnam par phyedza ba dang / phan tshun ma 'dres par mthong bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po riyang ji ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan snga na caseng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad mo chen po'i snying po can la 'dug 5cing rnam par rtse 5ba 'di lta bu yongs su ston par mthong ba de bzhin du shar phyogs na'ang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 7bzang po'i dpal gyis na'ajig rten gyi khams pad mo'i dpal nas rnam par rtse ba 'di nyid yongs su ston cing 'dug par mthong ngo / /shar phyogs na ji lta ba de bzhin du phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi 1 drung na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po seng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad mo chen po'i snying po can la 'dug cing rnam par rtse ba 'di nyid yongs su ston pa mthong ngo / /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na seng ge'i khri rin po che'i pad mo chen po'i snying po can la 11'dug cing rnam par rtse ba 'di nyid yongs su ston par mthong ba de bzhin du/ phyogs bcu 1 kun gyi nyinasangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba dag la rdul shin tu phra ba re re'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings ltar rgya che ba dag ni gebyang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa 38—777

thams cad kyi 1zhabs kyi drung na seng dge'i khri rin po che'i pad mo chen po'i snying po can la 'dug cing rnam par rtse ba 'di nyid yongs su ston pa mthong ngo / /de'i lus re re las kyang dus gsum du byung ba'i dmigs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du rnam par dmigs par mngon par bstan pa mthong ngo / /zhing thams cad dang sems can thams cad dang sangs rgyas byung ba thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang rigazugs brnyan gyi tshul du rnam par dmigs par mngon tu bstan pa mthong ngo sems can thams cad kyi sgra dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang cagadams ngag yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsdu ba thams cad dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa dag kyang thos par gyur to/ /des de ltar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par rtse ba de lta bu dag mthong stede/ thos nas ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa bcu thob par gyur to/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad lus kyis 6rgyas par dgang 7ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du 'gro ba la tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing rim gro 8bya ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las de bzhin gshegs pa re re las kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su zhus 938—778

pa rab tu blang ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo nges par rtogs par bya ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis 1mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ / so so nayang dag par rig pa 1zad mi shes pa'is phyi ma'i mtha'i 5nur thug pa'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs nete / chos kyi tshig gcig shin tu bstan pa'i ye shes kyi 7 pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /chos kyi nargya mtsho thams cad mngon sum du rab tu shes pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyi 'du 9shes kyi rnam pa yongs su sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa thob par gyur to / /skad cig gcig la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mngon sum du rab tu shes pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa 1 thob par gyur to11/ /de ltar ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa dang ldan pa'i tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 12spyi bor byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste bzhag par gyur to/ /de ltar tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi spyi bo la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos lag pa bzhag ma thag tu de'i mod ngal des ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la zhugs par gyur te15/ ting nge 'dzin re re las sakyang 'jig rten gyi 1 khams rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu 38wa 779

phra ba snyed sngon chadas1ma mthong ba dag la'ang zhugs par gyur to/ /de'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ri rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang tshogs su gyur to/ /de'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos kyi ci snatshogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang rab tu ca byung bar gyur to//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu gnas par bya ba chen po gesangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis yinamangon par 'phags par gyur to/ /smon lam rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la'ang ri nozhugs par gyur to/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung 27ba'i lam sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kyang byung 9 bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la'ang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi 7shugs drag po sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kyang rnam par 'phel bar gyur 11to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes snang ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kyang rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /ji ltar mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan snga na 12'dug pas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang te1 / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi ngaspyi bor bzhag pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung na 'dug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos kyang lag pa g.yas pa brkyang zhing tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi skaspyi bo la bzhag par gyur to/ /de bzhin du phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kun gyi 38wa 780

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 1kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs su chud pa'i 'jig rten gyibakhams dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na 'dug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos kyang lag pa g.yas pa brkyang zhing tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 4spyi bo la bzhag 45)par gyur to/ / ji ltar 6)bcom ldan tso'adas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhabs kyi drung na 'dug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang napo'i lag 9)pas reg ste/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis mchos kyi sgo mang po la zhugs par gyur pa de bzhin du kun tu bzang po'i lus thams cad las 'phros 17pa'i lag pa'i sprin mang pos reg pa'i〈rtetshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 1 kyang chos kyi sgo mang po la tshul sna tshogs kyis 7zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos mtshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nga'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong mod/ smras pa 'phags pa mthong ni tshamathong na de tsam du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen na mkhyen grang ngo / /des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu ngas ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems mngon par 'dod cing / bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 1 4rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig tu rnam par spyad de/ bskal pa chen po de dag re re la yang byang chub kyi sems yongs su sbyong bar 1 byed cing / ngas de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig 19bsnyen bkur to/ /bskal pa chen po de dag re re la yang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bsod nams yongs su sdud pa 2 byed cing / mchod sbyin chen po 38wa 781

gtang 1ba thams cad dang sbyar ba/ 'jig rten thams cad du rnam par grags pa / sems can thams cad la bstabasam pa dag kyang mchod sbyin tu byas so/ /bskal pa chen po de dag re re la yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos la mngon par smon cing gtang ba dang / gtang 5ba chen po dang / shin tu gtangs tshob sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang 7brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig byas so/ /bskal pa chen po de dag na re re la yang lus dang srog phangs par bya ba myed par sangs rgyas kyi chos gces par bya bas lus brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhig yongs su btang ngo rgyal po'i srid chen po yang 'oyongs su btang ngo / /grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs dang yul dang khams dang rgyal po'i gnas dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /sdug cing yid du 'ong la btang nya mi bra ba'i 'khor gyi tshogs dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /bu dang bu mo dang chung ma 11dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /rang gi lus dang / sha dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /bdag gi lus las 12khrag dag kyang slong ba rnams la yongs su btang ngo / /rus pa dang rkang dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / / rkang pa dang lag pa dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /lha yan lag dang nying lag dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /sna dang rna ba dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /myig dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /rang gi kha nas lce'i dbang po dag kyang yongs su btang ngo / /bskal pa chen po 7de dag re re la yang 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags shing bla na med par gyur pa mthams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dbu la mngon par smon cing / rang gi tshamago sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig yongs su btang ngo / /38wa 782

bskal pa chen po re re la 1 ji lta ba de bzhin du bskal pa chen po rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing sne)brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las bskal pa rgya mtsho re re la yang de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i ri nirdulam shin tu phra ba snyed cig la dbang po dam par gyur te/ rim gro 6)byas so/ /bkur stimatsha)byas so/ / phud dud dun byas so/ /mchod pa byas so/ /na bza' dang / bshos dang /gzims cha dang / snyan gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad dag kyang dbul ba byas so//de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi bstan pa la yang rab tu byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gdams ngag thams cad la yang rab tu zhugs so/ /de dag gi bstan pa yang /yongs su gzung steri9/ rigs kyi bu de snyed kyi bskal pa rgya mtshor 7yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 31pa la sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam gyis / kyang / mi mthun pa'i sems bskyed du mi dran no/ /de snyed kyi bskal pa rgya mtshor 1 sems bskyed pa 1 'ga' tsam gyis 12kyang khong khro ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'am/bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems sam/ bdag yongs su bskyang zhing sayongs su gzung 1 ba'i sems sam/ bdag dang gzhan tu dbye 18ba'i sems sam/ byang chub kyi lam dang bral 19bar bya ba'i sems sam/ 'khor ba na gnas pas na tshoyongs su skyo ba'i sems sam/ zhum pa'i sems sam/ sgrib pas mgo rmongs pa'i 21sems bskyed du mi dran te/ gzhan du na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs bstsags 22pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems ye shes gzhan gyis da mi thub cing brgal 24bar dka' ba'i snying po dang ldan pa bskyed do/ /rigs kyi 25bu 'di dzilta ste / nga'i sngon gyi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 38wa 783

dag par byas pa'i sbyor ba dag nyudang / des snying rje chen po'i sems rab tu thob sten/ sems can yongs su bskyabs 0pa dang / yongs su smin par bya ba dang ske/ yongs su sbyang bar 4byas pa'i sbyor ba dag dang / sangs rgyas mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i sbyor ba dag dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su btsal ba'i don du bla ma la rim gror 5byas pa'i sbyor ba dag dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung 6ba'i don du lus yongs su btang ba'i sbyor ba dag dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung ba'i don du rang gi mesrog yongs su btang ba'i sbyor ba de dag ni bstan par bya nanon/ bskal pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyang 4)zad par 'gyur rol/ /rigs kyi bu ngas ni/ chos rgya mtsho de nyu3 snyed cig las kyang / tshig dang yi ge 'ga' tsam yang / sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab 31pa la brtson pa dang / rang gi sems kyi rgyud nges par shes par bya ba la brtson 12pa dang /pha rol gyis 1 chos mngon du thos par bya ba la brtson pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i ye shes snang ba thams cad rab tu brjod pa la brtson pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes thams cad rab tu brjod pa la brtson pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i bde ba yongs su bskyed pa la brtson pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan yang dag par bsngags pa la brtson pas 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal srid yongs su btang bas ma nyos 3gepa'am/bdog sapa thams cad yongs su btang bas ma nyos 3 pa gang yang 12med de/ de ltar nga nyid kyi sngon gyi 17sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa bstan par bya 3 tshon/ bskal pa rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed zad par 'gyur ro 1/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar ngas rnam pa de lta bu'i 38—784

tshogs kyi stobs dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyus1bstsags pa'i stobs dang / mos pa rgya chen po'i stobs dang / yon tan la nan tan du bya ba'i stobs dang /chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud par bya ba'i stobs dang ske/ shes rab kyi mig gi stobs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs mekyi stobs dang / smon lam chen po'i stobs dang / snying rje chen po'i stobs dang / shin tu sbyangs pa'i mngon par shes pa'i stobs dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'i stobs kyis chos kyi lus yongs su dag pa dus gsum du tha mi dad pa thob par gyur to/ /bla na med pa'i gzugs sakyi lus 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa thams cad dum rjes su song ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rab tu gzhol ba/ thams cad du rab tu gnas pa rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad rnam pa 5thams cad du/ ston pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ yid du 'ong phyi ba yang yongs su sbyangs so/ /rigs kyi bu ngas lus thob pa phun sum tshogs pa/ bskal pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas yongs su grub pa/bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang pos/ 'byung bar dka' ba mthong bar dka' ba 3)'di la ltos/ rigs kyi bu nga ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma 2bskyed pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du yang mi 'ong na/ mthong bar lta ji she zhig smos/rigs kyi bu77sems can gang dag nga'i ming thos pa tsam gyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba yod do/ /mthong ba tsam dang / reg pa tsam dang / bskyal ba tsam dang /11 rjes su 'brang ba tsam dang / mi lam du mthong ba tsam dang / rmi lam du ming thos pa 38—785

tsam gyis kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba yod de 1/ sems can la las ni nga nyin 5zhag gcig tu dran par byas na yongs su smin par 'gyur ro/ /la las ni zhag bdun dang / la las ni zla ba phyed dang / la las ni zla ba gcig dang / la las ni lo gcig dang ske/ la las ni lo brgya dang / la las ni bskal pa gcig dang / la las ni bskal pa brgya nas/ la las ni 4)bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba 5)snyed du nga rjes su dran par byas na / yongs su smin par 'gyur ro / /la las ni tshe gcig tu ngasanyurjes su dran par byas na/ yongs su smin par 'gyur 7)ro/ /8la las ni tshe'i rgyud sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 9yongs su smin par 'gyur ro/ /sems can la las 1 rini nga'i 'od mthong bas yongs su smin par 'gyur ro/ /la las 11ni 'od zer bkye ba mthong bas la las 12ni zhing bskyod pas la las 1 ni gzugs kyi lus bstan pas la las ni 1 dga' bar byas pas yongs su smin par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar thabs kyi tshul sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 7sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang gis nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thob tshapa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye'o/ /gang gis nga'i lus yongs su dag pa mthong bar gyur pa de dag ni nga'i lus lta bur skye bar 'gyur gyis 1 rigs kyi bu nga'i lus rnam par dag pa 'di la ltos shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 18byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus la 38wa 786

bsam0)pa dang / ba spu'i bu ga 5)re re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i ( kyisangs rgyas skye bas yongs su gang ba ( mthong ngo / /zhing rgya mtsho re re na yang 5)de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rgya mtshos 6)kun nas bskor ba mang po bzhugs pa 7)mthong ngo / /zhing rgya mtsho de dag thams cad kyang gzhi sna tshogs dang dbyibs sna tshogs dang /rgyan sna tshogs dang 'khor〈2)yug sna tshogs dang sprin sna tshogs dang nam mkha' sna tshogs kyis kun nas khebs she)pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba sna tshogs dang chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs kyi dbyangs midang ldan par mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga re re la ji lta ba bzhin du ba spu'i bu ga ma lus pa thams cad dang / mtshan thams cad dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la yang de bzhin te/ zhing rgya mtsho re re nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku sprul pa'i sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung 11nas phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste 12bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems can yongs su smin par mdzade pa mthong ngo ske/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas rjes su bstan nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du zhugs te/ sems can yongs su smin par byed par gyur nyu1to / /de ltar tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 7dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi brdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig gi drung du phyin te/ mthong ba dang bsnyen bkur bas ye shes kyi snang ba dang / tshedage ba'i rtsa ba bstsags pa de dag 38wa 787

gis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bstsags par gyur pa de'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /stong gi char yang ma yin brgya stong gi char yang ma yin/ bye ba brgya phrag stistong gi char yang ma yin te9ba/grangs dang cha dang bgrang ba dang dper bya ba da dang / rgyur bya ba tsam dune༄yang mi phod do/ /des dang po sems bskyed pa nas ④nye bar bzung nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong ba'i bar der sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ji snyed cig la zhugs par gyur pa ⑥de dag pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyedas kyi bar du 8byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i ba spu'i bu ga re rer〈sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 1 )pa mang po la sems kyi skad cig gcig gis zhugs par gyur te/ ba spu'i bu ga re rer ji lta ba de hunyabazhin du ba spu'i bu ga ma lus pa thams cad la yang sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod hu du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nya rnam par gnon pa skophyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par 'gengs pas zhugs kyang zhing rgya mtsho gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i mthar phyin par ma gyur te/ zhing rgya mtsho'i lhun dang zhing rgya mtsho'i bye brag dang / zhing rgya mtsho yongs su bsdu ba dang /zhing rgya mtsho yongs su 'grub pa dang / zhing rgya mtsho 'jig pa dang / zhing rgya mtsho rnam par phye ba dang / sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho gcig nas gcig tu brgyud sapa dang / sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho'i sku dang / sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho'i bye brag dang /tsha sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho yongs su bsdu ba nya dang / 38wa 788

sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho yongs su 'byung ba dang / sangs rgyas byung ba rgya mtsho yongs su ①'jig pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lus dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bye brag dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yongs su bsdu ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho (kyeyongs su 'byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yongs su du 'jig pa dang /sems can gyi khams la 'jug pa dang / gaskad cig re res sems can gyi dbang po shes pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi dbang po shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya zhing gdul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' 5)rnam par 'phrul pa zab mo la rnam par gnas pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnan pa'i rnam par gnon 6pa rgya mcho'i mthar yang57phyin par ma gyur te/ des zhing la lar ni bskal par rnam par spyad 9par gyur to/ /zhing la lar ni bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du spyad par gyur te/ zhing de dag nas kyang g.yos pa med do/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la yang zhing rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug cing sems can rnams kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byed par gyur te/ des de ltar mthar gyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam rgya mtsho mnyam pa nyid kyi bar du'ang thob par 'gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam 38—789

pa nyid dang / zhing thams cad lus kyis rgyas par dgang ba mnyam pa nyid dang spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par 1)rgyas par dgang ba mnyam pa nyid dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pas rgyas par dgang ba mnyam pa nyid dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mnyam pa nyid dang / so so nayang dag par rig da pa rnam par dag pa mnyam pa nyid dang / dbyangs brjod 4pa mnyam pa nyid dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho thams cad kyi sbyor ba mnyam pa nyid dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa mnyam pa nyid dang /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa 5rimanyam pa nyid dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po mnyam pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mnyam pa nyid kyang rjes su thob par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos bskal pa dang / bskal pa 'byam klas 6)pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 〉rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag brnan rinanote mngon par brjod pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis 9sgron lam btab pa/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi 1 riseng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o11 / /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis 12mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams / /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi 38wa 790

dbyings rnams ma lus par/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag 1gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad nargya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i bsgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gisam3)bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng 5)ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa'i gdugs snyomachog dang / /mar me nyamachog dang bdug pa gnyedam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /khyad par can gyi rgyan mchog thams cad kyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi//mchod pa gang rnams 1bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba nya cithams cad la yang mos / /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dbang gis na1 rke/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis712so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang //'gro ba rnams kyi 1 bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang ske/ /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 1 sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston tshagang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol tshabar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags 1 pa dang / /rjes su yi 18rang bskul zhing 38—791

gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung 1)zad bdag gis geci bstsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis gru byang chub phyir bsngo 'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur(ge// /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i 5zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur56rka/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /'thun par gyur cing sgyure' ba'ang grub 9 par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag 9spyod cing / /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur rta/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho /2skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung tsho/gebar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag par/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog / lha yi thuskad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul mabum dgacadang mi yi sna skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgras3)rnams ji tsam par/ thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan kyi to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson zhu )te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur(1// /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par 'gyur ba dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad mo chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad//zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal dgerab tu zhi 38wa 792

bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par 'gyur37/ /bdag gi nispyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po 7spyod pa rab tu stonam pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu phrad par shog /de dag bdag 'gis nam yang7yid mi dbyungs / /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams//mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba ltan/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar / /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyangs pa yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad tshapar bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed37ske/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyod pa spyod 12cing blta bar bgyi/ /de dag ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /skra nyi tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed 0kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung〈snyegacig yan lag rgya mcho1re sgra skad kyis / /rgyal ba kun 38wa 793

dbyangs yan lag rnam 1dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi(na/ /dus gsum gshegs pasargyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i 4tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yisam/ /de dag gi 6yang gsung dbyangs myi zad la/ / blo yi bya stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis 2)ni zhugs par spyad/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi 1)seng ge dag /de dag skad cig gcig la 1 )bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar 11stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum / dag gi zhing bkod pa1lha/ /de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrubarka/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing gi rgyan la 'jug /gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 6'khor lo bskoralo/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi 8'o/ /kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun nas sgo yi 1 theg pa'i stobs dag dang / /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang / /kun tu khyab pa 18byams pa dag gi stobs/ /kun tu dge ba'i bsod nams stobs rnams dang / /chags pa med par gyur pa'i 17ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /byang chub stobs rnams 2 yang dag sgrub par byed/ /las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms (1par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing / /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs 38—794

ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par sgrol1/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing ske/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /smon lam rgya mtsho rab tu rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad tsho par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba yi/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun bdag gis ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngon/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang / /bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra bar(3/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyod 5pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi kyi)ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ / de yi 7bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad gzung 8)med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang / /de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam 97par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de 1 bzhin te/ / ci tsam 11las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang 1 de tsam mo/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ / lha dang mi yi bde ba 1rimachog rnams kyang / /zhing gi rdul 38—795

snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing / /lan cig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pas 17ni/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pa/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spong bar0'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa 5spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong ske/ /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong sku / /kun tu bzang chos)po de yang ji50'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gi rtsodami shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po du spyod pa 'di brjod na / /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de myi thub/ /'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 9 'dug ste/ /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul/ /gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni klog gam ston pa yi1 3/ / de yi71rnam par smin pa 12sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi 32ma byed cig /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba 1thudang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag gi ni rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa 32rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags 7pa des/ /bdag gi lha dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /38wa 796

bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar gyo7bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus du dbyed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag geni phyir bstsal5nga te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon du gyur par shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bskang 5)/ /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing khya)dga' ba der/ /pad mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las ༅skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas (3)mngon sum dul/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo'i 1)stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ / gang gis bzang po spyod pa ston 0pa yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bstsags57pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /gang yang bzang po spyod pa bsngos pa yis /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa thob pa des/ /'gro ba sdug 1gebasngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab 'gro bar shog /tshe3lha shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba lasayi/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi nang tsha/ sdong pos brgyan pa zhes bya ba chos kyi rnam migrangs chen po las/ nor bzangs kyis 1 dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen 18bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig ste ci 1 snyed pa rdzogs sto// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde/ la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //2 38wa 797

sgode ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum las/'dir tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i 'khor lo'i snying po phul du byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che mtshan gyi rnam grangs shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod/ snyan gyi gong rgyan/ pad+ma'i rgyan sogs du ma dang ldan pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'u/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba/ sa bcu bstan pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa/'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u ste bdun la so so'i nang gses kyi dbye bas le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ sh+lau ka sum khri/ dgu stong sum cu/bam po brgya sum cu dang blo ka sum cu yod par bu ston rin po che sogs bzhed cing ske/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag tu bam po brgya dang bco lnga/ ldan dkar mar bam po brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun du mdzad/ deng sang gi dpe rnams la'ang bam grangs mang nyung ci rigs yod par snang / 'di thog mar 'phags pa klu sgrub la/ paṇ+ḍi ta byang chub bzang po dang pan+ḍi ta dga' ba gnyis kyis zhus/de gnyis mas rgya nag tu 'gyur mdzad/ rgya nag gi 'gyur la/ su ren+t+ra bo dhi dang ske/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas zhus chen mdzad par bshad cing / lung gi brgyud rim la'ang rgya nag nas 'gyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/'phags pa 'jam dpal/ mgon po klu sgrub/ gong gi paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis/ de nas hwa shang thu thu zhun sogs rim par brgyud de/ hwa shang gying ju la dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum gyis gsan/ de nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan nas deng sang gi bar du brgyud pa dang / rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub nas/ārla de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa sogs nas rim bzhin/ rdo rje gdan pa la 38—798

ba ri lo tsā bas gsan/ de nas mchims brtson seng / rje btsun sa skya pa chen po sogs brgyud par bshad do/ /'on kyang gong gi 'gyur byang 'di las lo paṇa gzhan gyis bsgyur tshul lo rgyus dang / dpe rnams la ma mthong ngo / /'di nyid tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi ma phyi byas nas 'jang sa tham rgyal pos bka' 'gyur ro cog par du bsgrubs pa deng sang li thang mtshal par du grags pa khungs thub kyi tshad mar bzung nas ma phyi byas pa yin kyang / skabs 'dir chad lhag dang brda ma dag pa mang ba 'dug pas/ slar yig rnying dag pa mang du btsal nas zhu dag bgyis pa yin la/ de'ang rgya dpe mi gcig pa dang / 'gyur mi mthun pa ni don gyi khog gcig kyang tshig la zhu dag mi btub na'ang / 'di'i dpe phal cher zhu dag pher ba kho na 'dug la 'on kyang rgyan la bkod pa dang / 'byam klas la rab 'byams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa la/ tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa dang / thugs la dgongs pa dang / nyin mtshan dang zla ba yar kham mar kham dang zhes pa la/ nyin mtshan dang yud du yan man dang zhes dang /tha snyad la rnam par dpyod pa zhes pa rnams 'gyur khyad lta bur 'dug pa don la mi 'gal bas rang sor bzhag /rgya skad la rang bzhin rkyen/ rnam 'gyur gyi tshul du ma yod pa/ bod la lo paṇa chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis don 'gyur mdzad pa 'ga' zhig /dus dang rnam dbye sogs shin tu rtogs dka' bas dpe mthun shas che ba gtso bor bzung / gzhan dogs gnas cung zad yod pa rnams/bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos rnams dang go bstun/ dpe phal cher la brda rnying shas che ba dang / 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i gsal kha mi snang bas/ bod kyi brda rnying pa sha stag zhig byung na 'brel chags pa 'dra yang phyis su brda gsar rnying 38—799

'dres nyams che ba dang / shad bar gcod mtshams 'khrugs pa mang du snang yang cung zad skyon chung ba'i dbang du byas nas btang snyoms su bzhag /de min mon pa'i rdo gcod zhu dag gi dpe zlar ma song bar nan tan chen pos shin tu dag khul du bgyis pa 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang ris med pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi dpal du bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du khor yug ri bo'i khongs 'dir/ nyi zla ltar gsal bar gyur cig /ces bod chen po'i yul ljongs sde bzhi'i 'byung gnas dge bcu'i khrims lugs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i nor 'dzin yangs pa chos bzhin du skyong ba'i lha chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' mi'i dbang po bstan pa tshe rings kyi zhal snga nas/ dge byed ces pa chu stag lor gsung rab 'di nyid par du bsgrub par mdzad pa'i skabs zhu dag las 'phros te 'di nyid kyi do dam par bkas gnang ba'i zhabs 'bring ba dge slong bkra shis dbang phyug gis gleng ba dza yan+tu// //ye dharmā he tu prabha wā ho turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dri ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ/71)38—800
